papers.abstract_original: An opaque product refers to a subset of products that only differ in some secondary attribute (such as color or style). After a customer purchases an opaque product, one of the products in the subset is then allocated to the customer. Selling opaque products has become popular on e-commerce platforms, because it is a source of flexibility that reduces demand variability and hence inventory cost. In this paper, we seek to understand how the design of opaque product configurations and the fraction of customers choosing opaque products impact the value of flexibility arising from opaque selling. The key finding from our study is the following insight: A modest opaque selling strategy where (i) the opaque options contain small subsets and (ii) only a small fraction of customers buy opaque products achieves substantial cost savings (compared with nonopaque traditional selling). Moreover, the cost savings of this modest opaque strategy is on the same order as a fully flexible scenario where all customers buy an opaque product. Our analysis relies on exploring a novel connection of multiproduct inventory management to the balls-into-bins framework along with a simple balancing policy for opaque selling. As a byproduct of our analysis, we show that the simple balancing policy is asymptotically optimal. For extensions outside of our theoretical analysis, we conduct extensive numerical experiments to show that our core insights continue to hold.This paper was accepted by Jayashankar Swaminathan, operations management.Funding: This work was supported by the Division of Civil, Mechanical and Manufacturing Innovation [Grant 1944428].Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2019.02983.
papers.abstract_zh: 不透明产品是指仅在某个次要属性（如颜色或款式）上有所不同的产品子集。顾客购买不透明产品后，该子集中的某一产品会被分配给该顾客。销售不透明产品在电子商务平台上已变得流行，因为它是一种灵活性来源，能够降低需求波动性，从而降低库存成本。在本文中，我们试图理解不透明产品配置的设计以及选择不透明产品的顾客比例如何影响由不透明销售产生的灵活性价值。我们研究的关键发现是以下洞见：一种适度的不透明销售策略，其中（i）不透明选项包含较小的子集，且（ii）只有一小部分顾客购买不透明产品，能够实现显著的成本节约（与不透明的传统销售相比）。此外，这种适度不透明策略的成本节约与所有顾客都购买不透明产品的完全灵活情景处于同一量级。我们的分析依赖于探索多产品库存管理与球入箱框架之间的一种新颖联系，以及一种用于不透明销售的简单平衡策略。作为我们分析的副产品，我们表明这种简单平衡策略是渐近最优的。对于理论分析之外的扩展，我们进行了大量数值实验，表明我们的核心洞见仍然成立。本文由运营管理领域的Jayashankar Swaminathan接受。资助：本工作得到了土木、机械和制造创新部门[资助号1944428]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2019.02983获取。

papers.abstract_original: We investigate how government borrowing behaviors influence private sectors by exploring the relationship between government debt maturity and credit term structures. Using individual corporate bonds data between 1987 and 2015, we find that a longer government debt maturity is associated with a steeper credit term structure in both the primary and secondary corporate bond markets. An instrumental variable approach and an exogenous event study help us establish a causality. Our findings are more pronounced among riskier corporate bonds, and the influences of Treasury bond supply on credit term spreads are more pronounced near the maturity where this supply shock originates, suggesting that the credit risk and the maturity clientele channels together drive our findings.This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance.Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2020.01979.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们通过探究政府债务期限与信用期限结构之间的关系，考察政府借贷行为如何影响私人部门。利用1987年至2015年间的个券公司债券数据，我们发现较长的政府债务期限与公司债券一级和二级市场中更陡峭的信用期限结构相关。工具变量方法和一项外生事件研究帮助我们确立了因果关系。我们的发现在风险较高的公司债券中更为显著，并且国债供给对信用期限利差的影响在供给冲击所源自的期限附近更为显著，这表明信用风险渠道和期限客户群渠道共同驱动了我们的发现。本文由金融领域编辑Victoria Ivashina接受。补充材料：网络附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2020.01979获取。

papers.abstract_original: How does information transparency affect customer retention in markets where quality is difficult to verify? Conventional wisdom suggests that transparency intensifies price competition and increases customer churn. We challenge this view by showing that acquisition-stage transparency can strengthen retention in markets for credence goods characterized by delayed feedback and persistent uncertainty, where customers revisit their decisions without clear quality signals. We develop a transparency-confidence-retention framework, in which transparency at acquisition builds choice confidence, a psychological switching cost that anchors customers to their initial decisions. Using 83,835 auto insurance contracts from a European insurer and multiple identification strategies, we find that customers acquired through transparent channels are 4.6%–11.8% less likely to churn than those acquired through less transparent channels. A randomized, controlled experiment with 1,515 participants shows that transparency reduces customer churn primarily by strengthening choice confidence rather than increasing conventional switching costs, such as brand trust or product fit. Decomposing transparency into attribute, comparative, and evaluative dimensions reveals that evaluative transparency exerts the strongest influence. Analyses of boundary conditions indicate that the retention effect of transparency is amplified when public and private signals remain congruent with earlier informational cues. These findings reconceptualize transparency as a relational mechanism that fosters decisional assurance and stabilizes retention under quality uncertainty.This paper was accepted by Anindya Ghose, information systems.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2020.02865.
papers.abstract_zh: 在质量难以验证的市场中，信息透明度如何影响客户留存？传统观点认为，透明度会加剧价格竞争并提高客户流失率。我们通过表明获取阶段的透明度能够增强信任品市场中的留存来挑战这一观点；信任品市场的特征是反馈延迟和持续不确定性，客户在没有明确质量信号的情况下会重新审视其决策。我们构建了一个透明度—信心—留存框架，其中获取阶段的透明度会建立选择信心，这是一种将客户锚定在其初始决策上的心理转换成本。利用来自一家欧洲保险公司的83,835份汽车保险合同以及多种识别策略，我们发现，通过透明渠道获取的客户相比通过较不透明渠道获取的客户，其流失可能性低4.6%–11.8%。一项有1,515名参与者参与的随机对照实验表明，透明度主要通过增强选择信心而非提高传统转换成本（如品牌信任或产品契合度）来减少客户流失。将透明度分解为属性维度、比较维度和评价维度后发现，评价性透明度的影响最强。对边界条件的分析表明，当公共信号和私人信号与先前的信息线索保持一致时，透明度的留存效应会被放大。这些发现将透明度重新概念化为一种关系机制，它在质量不确定性下培养决策确定性并稳定留存。本文由信息系统领域的Anindya Ghose接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2020.02865获取。

papers.abstract_original: Letting managers have more authority over hiring decisions is becoming an increasingly common management practice among business chains worldwide, yet both theoretical and empirical evidence on its effects remains limited. Local manager hiring (LMH) refers to decentralizing hiring decisions to local business unit managers, rather than relying on the headquarters’ human resource department to make decisions. To assess the impacts of LMH on employee recruitment, productivity, and firm performance, we partnered with a large Chinese firm operating 111 retail stores through a twelve-month field experiment. Results show that LMH leads to an increase in both the mean and variance of individual productivity, yielding a boost in store-level sales of approximately 7%–8%. Store-level performance gains were driven by both the direct effects of recruiting higher-performing workers and the indirect effects of positive spillovers from new hires to existing employees. In line with our theory, LMH achieved superior outcomes in stores with better-aligned managerial incentives, more repeat customers, and lower levels of busyness. However, the rise in variance indicates greater inconsistency in hiring outcomes, which led to worse outcomes in some stores. These findings highlight the central trade-off of decentralized hiring: While it can improve average performance by leveraging local knowledge, it also increases the risk of costly hiring mistakes.This paper was accepted by Isabel Fernandez-Mateo, organizations.Funding: This work was supported by The Chiang Ching-Kuo Foundation [Grant DD086-A-18]; Stanford Center at Peking University; Stanford King Center on Global Poverty and Development.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2020.03837.
papers.abstract_zh: 让经理在招聘决策上拥有更多权力，正成为全球商业连锁企业中越来越常见的管理实践，但关于其影响的理论和实证证据仍然有限。本地经理招聘（LMH）是指将招聘决策下放给本地业务单元经理，而不是依赖总部人力资源部门做出决策。为评估LMH对员工招聘、生产率和公司绩效的影响，我们与一家经营111家零售门店的大型中国公司合作，进行了为期十二个月的实地实验。结果显示，LMH导致个人生产率的均值和方差均上升，使门店层面销售额提升约7%–8%。门店层面的绩效提升既由招聘更高绩效员工的直接效应驱动，也由新员工对现有员工的正面溢出这一间接效应驱动。与我们的理论一致，在管理激励更一致、回头客更多、繁忙程度更低的门店中，LMH取得了更优的结果。然而，方差的上升表明招聘结果的不一致性更大，这导致一些门店的结果更差。这些发现凸显了分散化招聘的核心权衡：虽然它可以通过利用本地知识提高平均绩效，但也增加了代价高昂的招聘失误风险。本文由组织领域的Isabel Fernandez-Mateo接受。资助：本工作得到蒋经国基金会[资助号DD086-A-18]、北京大学斯坦福中心、斯坦福全球贫困与发展国王中心的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2020.03837获取。
papers.title_original: The Trade-Offs of Letting Local Managers Make Hiring Decisions
papers.title_zh: 让本地经理做出招聘决策的权衡

papers.abstract_original: Our study examines the impact of nonfraud financial restatements on the careers of corporate accountants. Using LinkedIn data, we identify a sample of accountants working at 201 firms that restated their financial statements between 2004 and 2014. We find that compared with human resource employees within the same company or corporate accountants in matched control firms, accountants in restatement firms, particularly senior staff, have a higher rate of departure and a lower probability of moving to a higher-ranked position outside the company after a restatement is announced. Using a longer job search period as a measure of being forced to leave, we find that the higher departure rate for senior accountants is because of being forced out rather than leaving voluntarily. The higher departure rates occur only for accountants working at firms with more severe restatements. In a separate sample of firms that restate financial statements because of clerical errors, we do not find higher departure rates for accountants after the restatement is revealed. Our results suggest that senior accountants in restatement firms experience negative outcomes in the labor market.This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting.Funding: J. (X.) Jiang acknowledges research support from the Eli Broad College of Business. M. Shen acknowledges financial support from the NUS Start-up Grant [Grant A-0003914-00-00] and the Singapore MOE Tier-1 Grant [Grant A-8000098-00-00].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.00430.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们的研究考察了非欺诈性财务重述对公司会计师职业生涯的影响。利用LinkedIn数据，我们识别了一个在2004年至2014年间重述其财务报表的201家公司中工作的会计师样本。我们发现，与同一公司内的人力资源员工或匹配控制公司中的公司会计师相比，重述公司中的会计师，尤其是高级员工，在重述公告后离职率更高，且在公司外部晋升到更高职位的概率更低。使用更长的求职期作为被迫离职的衡量标准，我们发现高级会计师的较高离职率是因为被迫离职而非自愿离职。较高的离职率仅出现在重述更严重的公司中工作的会计师中。在另一个因笔误而重述财务报表的公司样本中，我们没有发现重述披露后会计师的离职率更高。我们的结果表明，重述公司中的高级会计师在劳动力市场中经历了负面结果。本文由会计学领域的Suraj Srinivasan接受。资助：J. (X.) Jiang感谢Eli Broad商学院的 research support。M. Shen感谢新加坡国立大学启动资助[资助号A-0003914-00-00]和新加坡教育部Tier-1资助[资助号A-8000098-00-00]的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.00430获取。

papers.abstract_original: Do job seekers consider the race or gender of an employer when applying for a job? Although we have extensive research on employer-side discrimination, we know less about employee-side biases and their consequences. In this study, we examine how the gender and race of the employer shape the willingness of prospective employees to apply for a job. To examine this, we conducted a field experiment where we randomized real jobseekers into three conditions according to employer demographics. We find that job candidates were less likely to apply to a job when they learn that the founders are Black, and, when they did apply, they requested 10% higher salary. In addition, the more qualified a candidate, the less likely they were to apply to Black founders, leaving Black founders with a pool of candidates that is smaller, worse, and more expensive than their White peers. We find no gender penalty for White female founders. Findings from two survey experiments suggest that the penalty is unique to White applicants evaluating Black founders and reflects a concern among White applicants that they will be less likely to fit within a firm and that the firm is less likely to be successful in the long run. We find no evidence of a widespread applicant homophily where all applicants favor founders of their own ethnic group, nor do we find evidence of widespread statistical discrimination whereby all applicants penalize Black founders for being atypical members of the entrepreneurial class.This paper was accepted by Olav Sorenson, organizations.Funding: Financial support from the INSEAD Alumni Fund is gratefully acknowledged.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.00481.
papers.abstract_zh: 求职者在申请工作时会考虑雇主的种族或性别吗？尽管我们对雇主侧歧视已有大量研究，但对雇员侧偏见及其后果了解较少。在本研究中，我们考察雇主的性别和种族如何塑造潜在雇员申请工作的意愿。为考察这一点，我们进行了一项实地实验，将真实求职者根据雇主人口统计特征随机分配到三种条件中。我们发现，当求职者得知创始人是黑人时，他们申请该工作的可能性更低；而当他们确实申请时，他们要求的薪资高出10%。此外，候选人越合格，他们申请黑人创始人职位的可能性越低，使黑人创始人拥有的候选人池比其白人同行更小、更差且更昂贵。我们发现白人女性创始人没有受到性别惩罚。两项调查实验的结果表明，这种惩罚是白人申请者评估黑人创始人时特有的，并反映了白人申请者的一种担忧，即他们不太可能融入公司，且公司不太可能长期成功。我们没有发现广泛的申请者同质性证据，即所有申请者都偏爱与自己族裔群体相同的创始人；也没有发现广泛的统计性歧视证据，即所有申请者都因黑人创始人作为创业阶层非典型成员而惩罚他们。本文由组织领域的Olav Sorenson接受。资助：感谢INSEAD校友基金的财政支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.00481获取。
papers.title_original: Do Job Applicants Consider Founder Race and Gender? Evidence from a Field Experiment
papers.title_zh: 求职者会考虑创始人的种族和性别吗？来自实地实验的证据

papers.abstract_original: Today’s employees often work in teams on complex problems. Yet, we know very little about how to incentivize such work. We conduct two laboratory experiments where groups of three work on a complex task and are paid by the quality of their answer. We then study whether a peer evaluation which determines the individual pay share improves group performance. We do so both in an in-person as well as in an online setting. In both settings, overall group performance was not significantly affected by the peer evaluation. Yet, groups behaved differently under peer evaluation: Participants reported higher motivation and groups worked longer and communicated more. We find evidence consistent with two possible performance-reducing channels of peer evaluation tied to performance pay. First, behavior may shift toward impressing one’s team members, though this does not necessarily improve performance. Second, higher work effort because of the peer evaluation in the presence of time constraints may lead to more timeouts and incompletely worked-out solutions.This paper was accepted by Yan Chen, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.00840.
papers.abstract_zh: 如今的员工经常在团队中处理复杂问题。然而，我们对如何激励此类工作知之甚少。我们进行了两项实验室实验，其中三人一组完成一项复杂任务，并根据其答案质量获得报酬。然后，我们研究决定个人薪酬份额的同伴评价是否改善团队绩效。我们既在面对面环境中也在在线环境中进行了这项研究。在两种环境中，整体团队绩效均未受到同伴评价的显著影响。然而，团队在同伴评价下的行为有所不同：参与者报告了更高的积极性，团队工作时间更长，沟通更多。我们发现了与同伴评价结合绩效薪酬的两种可能的降低绩效渠道相一致的证据。第一，行为可能转向给团队成员留下好印象，尽管这不一定提高绩效。第二，在存在时间约束的情况下，同伴评价带来的更高工作努力可能导致更多超时和未完全解决的方案。本文由行为经济学与决策分析领域的Yan Chen接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.00840获取。

papers.abstract_original: Outcomes-based reimbursement rewards health providers with better health outcomes with higher payments. Such reimbursement policies require several design choices, including the type of contract (e.g., capitation or fee-for-service), measure (e.g., population- or provider-level outcomes), and whether to contract with individual providers or larger groups. We explore which outcomes-based reimbursement policies may be vulnerable to potentially illegal collusion, and whether collusion issues can be averted through incentive design. We present a game-theoretic model a chronic care pathway in a two-tier healthcare system. We identify differences in the impact of collusion on health, costs, and system efficiency under different reimbursement policies. Theoretical and numerical results (calibrated to data from two pathways for diabetes) show that whether an outcomes-adjusted reimbursement system is vulnerable to collusion depends critically on one trait: whether the income of physicians who receive referrals scales with volume. In systems where it does, as with fee-for-service models in the United States, there exist financial incentives to collude, underlining the importance of addressing collusion through laws. Systems that lack this trait (e.g., the UK NHS) are more resistant to collusion. Exploring theoretically optimal contracts, we find evidence of strong performance of outcomes-adjusted capitation contracts with individual providers using population-level data.This paper was accepted by Terry Taylor, operations management.Funding: S. E. Chick acknowledges research support through the Novartis Chair for Healthcare Management.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.02283.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于结果的报销以更高的支付奖励健康结果更好的医疗服务提供者。此类报销政策需要若干设计选择，包括合同类型（例如，按人头付费或按服务付费）、测量指标（例如，人群层面或提供者层面的结果），以及与个体提供者还是更大的群体签约。我们探讨哪些基于结果的报销政策可能容易受到潜在非法合谋的影响，以及合谋问题能否通过激励设计加以避免。我们提出了一个两级医疗体系中慢性病照护路径的博弈论模型。我们识别了在不同报销政策下合谋对健康、成本和系统效率影响的差异。理论结果和数值结果（根据两条糖尿病路径的数据校准）表明，经结果调整的报销体系是否容易受到合谋影响，关键取决于一个特征：接受转诊的医生的收入是否随业务量而变化。在具有这一特征的体系中，如美国的按服务付费模式，存在合谋的财务激励，凸显了通过法律解决合谋问题的重要性。缺乏这一特征的体系（例如，英国NHS）对合谋更具抵抗力。在探讨理论上最优合同时，我们发现使用人群层面数据的、与个体提供者签订的经结果调整的按人头付费合同具有强劲表现的证据。本文由Terry Taylor（运营管理）接受。资助：S. E. Chick感谢Novartis医疗管理教席的研究支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.02283获取。
papers.title_original: Choosing Outcomes-Based Reimbursement Policies: Should We Worry About Collusion?
papers.title_zh: 选择基于结果的报销政策：我们是否应担心合谋？

papers.abstract_original: We study access to ride-sharing across geographical regions using both theoretical and empirical analyses. We specifically model and examine the effects of economies of density in ride-sharing. Our model predicts that (i) economies of density skew access to ride-sharing away from less dense regions; (ii) the skew will be more pronounced for smaller platforms (i.e., “thinner markets”); and (iii) ride-sharing platforms do not find this skew efficient and thus, use price and wage levers to mitigate (but not eliminate) it. We show that these insights are robust to whether the source of economies of density is the supply side or the demand side. We then calibrate our model using ride-level Uber data from New York City. We use the model to simulate counterfactual scenarios, offering a quantitative evaluation of our theoretical results and informing platform strategy and policy.This paper was accepted by Omar Besbes, revenue management and market analytics.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.02699.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们结合理论分析与实证分析，研究了不同地理区域间网约车服务的获取。我们特别建模并考察了网约车中密度经济的影响。我们的模型预测：(i) 密度经济会使网约车服务的获取向密度较低区域倾斜减少；(ii) 这种倾斜对于较小的平台（即“更稀薄的市场”）会更加明显；(iii) 网约车平台并不认为这种倾斜是有效率的，因此会使用价格和工资杠杆来缓解（但无法消除）它。我们表明，无论密度经济的来源是供给侧还是需求侧，这些洞见都是稳健的。随后，我们使用纽约市的Uber行程级数据校准了我们的模型。我们使用该模型模拟反事实情景，为我们的理论结果提供定量评估，并为平台策略和政策提供参考。本文由Omar Besbes（收益管理与市场分析）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.02699获取。

papers.abstract_original: We consider the problem of learning an optimal prescriptive tree (i.e., an interpretable treatment assignment policy in the form of a binary tree) of moderate depth from observational data. This problem arises in numerous socially important domains, such as public health and medicine, where interpretable and data-driven interventions are sought based on data gathered in deployment rather than from randomized trials. We propose a method for learning optimal prescriptive trees using mixed-integer optimization technology assuming that our data satisfy standard causal inference assumptions (conditional exchangeability and positivity) and are discrete/discretized. We show that under mild conditions, our method is asymptotically exact (i.e., it converges to an optimal out-of-sample treatment assignment policy as the number of historical data samples tends to infinity). Contrary to the existing literature, our approach (a) does not require data to be randomized, (b) does not impose stringent assumptions on the learned trees, and (c) has the ability to model domain-specific constraints. Through extensive computational experiments, we demonstrate that our asymptotic guarantees translate to significant performance improvements in finite samples as well as showcase our uniquely flexible modeling power by incorporating budget and fairness constraints.This paper was accepted by Chung Piaw Teo, optimization.Funding: N. papers.abstract_zh: 我们考虑从观察数据中学习一棵中等深度的最优处方树（即以二叉树形式表示的可解释处理分配策略）的问题。该问题出现在许多具有社会重要性的领域，例如公共卫生和医学，在这些领域中，人们基于部署中收集的数据而非随机试验来寻求可解释且数据驱动的干预措施。我们提出一种使用混合整数优化技术学习最优处方树的方法，假设我们的数据满足标准因果推断假设（条件可交换性和正值性）并且是离散/离散化的。我们表明，在温和条件下，我们的方法是渐近精确的（即，随着历史数据样本数量趋于无穷，它收敛到最优样本外处理分配策略）。与现有文献相比，我们的方法（a）不要求数据是随机化的，（b）不对学习到的树施加严格假设，并且（c）能够建模领域特定约束。通过大量计算实验，我们证明我们的渐近保证在有限样本中转化为显著的性能改进，并通过纳入预算和公平约束展示我们独特的灵活建模能力。本文由优化领域的Chung Piaw Teo接受。资助：N. papers.abstract_original: We investigate how an on-demand service platform’s mechanism to share demand-supply mismatch information spatially affects drivers’ relocation decisions and the platform’s matching efficiency. We consider three mechanisms motivated by practice; the platform shares demand-supply mismatch information about either zones(s) with excess demand with all drivers (surge information sharing, common practice today), all zones with all drivers (full information sharing), or zone(s) with excess demand only with drivers sufficiently close by (local information sharing). We develop a game-theoretic model with three zones wherein drivers in two non-surge zones decide whether to relocate to the surge zone with excess demand. We incorporate two spatial aspects: drivers’ relocation costs and initial supply across different non-surge zones. Theoretically, full information sharing can hurt the platform’s matching efficiency compared with surge information sharing under low relocation costs because drivers in non-surge zones facing high demand locally do not chase the surge as much. Local information sharing is strictly dominated by other mechanisms in terms of matching efficiency when the supply of drivers near the surge zone is limited and weakly dominated otherwise by surge information sharing. We test these theory predictions in the laboratory with human participants as drivers in an environment where theoretical matching efficiency is highest with surge and lowest with local information sharing. Experimentally, the platform serves fewer customers than predicted with surge information sharing because drivers relocate too often, compromising efficiency in non-surge zones. In contrast, the platform serves more customers than predicted with full and local information sharing, and these mechanisms perform at least as well in matching efficiency as surge. Therefore, sharing demand-supply mismatch information either fully or in a targeted manner (as in local) can help to alleviate coordination problems on a platform. A behavioral equilibrium incorporating loss aversion through mental accounting and decision errors describes drivers’ behavior in our experiments better than the rational equilibrium.This paper was accepted by Elena Katok, operations management.Funding: This research was funded in part by the National Science Foundation [Award #2049872]. The authors also gratefully acknowledge partial support from the Business Analytics Center at Georgia Tech Scheller College of Business.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.03426.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究按需服务平台在空间上共享供需错配信息的机制如何影响司机的重新定位决策以及平台的匹配效率。我们考虑三种受实践启发的机制；平台要么将所有司机与存在超额需求的区域共享供需错配信息（高峰信息共享，即当今的常见做法），要么将所有区域的信息与所有司机共享（完全信息共享），要么仅与距离足够近的司机共享存在超额需求的区域的信息（局部信息共享）。我们构建了一个包含三个区域的博弈论模型，其中两个非高峰区域的司机决定是否重新定位到存在超额需求的高峰区域。我们纳入两个空间方面：司机的重新定位成本以及不同非高峰区域之间的初始供给。在理论上，与高峰信息共享相比，在低重新定位成本下，完全信息共享可能损害平台的匹配效率，因为本地面临高需求的非高峰区域中的司机不会那么积极地追逐高峰。当高峰区域附近的司机供给有限时，局部信息共享在匹配效率方面被其他机制严格占优，而在其他情况下则被高峰信息共享弱占优。我们在实验室中让人类参与者作为司机，在理论匹配效率以高峰信息共享最高、以局部信息共享最低的环境中检验这些理论预测。在实验中，由于司机过于频繁地重新定位，损害了非高峰区域的效率，平台在高峰信息共享下服务的顾客少于预测值。相比之下，在完全信息共享和局部信息共享下，平台服务的顾客多于预测值，并且这些机制在匹配效率上至少与高峰信息共享一样好。因此，完全地或以有针对性的方式（如局部信息共享）共享供需错配信息，有助于缓解平台上的协调问题。一个通过心理账户纳入损失厌恶并包含决策误差的行为均衡，比理性均衡更好地描述了我们在实验中司机的行为。本文由运营管理领域编辑Elena Katok接受。资助：本研究部分由国家科学基金会资助[奖项编号2049872]。作者们还感谢佐治亚理工学院Scheller商学院商业分析中心提供的部分支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.03426获取。

papers.abstract_original: Hong Kong introduced a Tobin property tax—the Special Stamp Duty (SSD)—in 2010, which substantially increased the selling costs of short-term residential property holders. This study examines the effectiveness of this Tobin tax in curbing speculation and cooling down the housing market. We find that the SSD effectively curtails flippers who hold homes for less than two years and reduces their market presence from 23.2% in 2009% to 2.4% in 2011 and 0.9% in 2013. However, one year after implementing the tax, housing prices grow by 12.64% and 15.76% in the primary and secondary markets, respectively, indicating a lack of a market cooling effect. Flippers strategically defer sales to circumvent the SSD charges, resulting in the sharp bunching of urgent sales immediately after the lock-in period ends. Further, the SSD effectively increases selling costs and prolongs potential sellers’ holding periods, thereby significantly reducing liquidity and driving up prices in the secondary market. The unintended externality is that the unmet housing demand from the secondary market triggers a buying frenzy in the primary market, which increases the prices in the primary market as well. Our findings have policy implications for the viability of Tobin taxes for regulating real estate markets.This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance.Funding: S. Agarwal was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72495154].Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.00370.
papers.abstract_zh: 香港于2010年引入了托宾房产税——特别印花税（SSD），这大幅提高了短期住宅物业持有者的出售成本。本研究考察了这一托宾税在遏制投机和冷却住房市场方面的有效性。我们发现，SSD有效抑制了持有房屋不足两年的炒房者，使其市场占比从2009%年的23.2%降至2011年的2.4%和2013年的0.9%。然而，在实施该税一年后，一手市场和二手市场的房价分别上涨了12.64%和15.76%，表明缺乏市场冷却效应。炒房者策略性地推迟出售以规避SSD费用，导致在锁定期结束后立即出现紧急出售的急剧聚集。此外，SSD有效提高了出售成本并延长了潜在卖方的持有期，从而显著降低了流动性并推高了二手市场价格。意外的外部性是，二手市场未满足的住房需求引发了一手市场的购买狂潮，这也推高了一手市场的价格。我们的发现对托宾税用于监管房地产市场的可行性具有政策启示。本文由Agostino Capponi接受，金融领域。资助：S. Agarwal获得国家自然科学基金[资助号72495154]的资助。补充材料：互联网附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.00370获取。
papers.title_original: Tobin Tax Policy, Housing Speculation, and Property Market Dynamics

papers.abstract_original: Unstructured text provides decision makers with a rich data source in many domains, ranging from product reviews in retail to nursing notes in healthcare. To leverage this information, words are typically translated into word embeddings—vectors that encode the semantic relationships between words—through unsupervised learning algorithms such as matrix factorization. However, learning word embeddings from new domains with limited training data can be challenging because the meaning/usage may be different in the new domain; for example, the word “positive” typically has positive sentiment, but often has negative sentiment in medical notes because it may imply that a patient tested positive for a disease. In practice, we expect that only a small number of domain-specific words may have new meanings. We propose an intuitive two-stage estimator that exploits this structure via a group-sparse penalty to efficiently transfer learn domain-specific word embeddings by combining large-scale text corpora (such as Wikipedia) with limited domain-specific text data. We bound the generalization error of our transfer learning estimator, proving that it can achieve high accuracy with substantially less domain-specific data when only a small number of embeddings are altered between domains. Furthermore, we prove that all local minima identified by our nonconvex objective function are statistically indistinguishable from the global minimum under standard regularization conditions, implying that our estimator can be computed efficiently. Our results provide the first bounds on group-sparse matrix factorization, which may be of independent interest. We empirically evaluate our approach compared with state-of-the-art fine-tuning heuristics from natural language processing.This paper was accepted by Chung Piaw Teo, optimization.Funding: The authors gratefully acknowledge indispensable financial support from the Wharton Analytics Initiative and the Wharton Dean’s Fund.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01740.
papers.abstract_zh: 非结构化文本为决策者在许多领域提供了丰富的数据来源，从零售中的产品评论到医疗保健中的护理记录。为了利用这些信息，通常通过无监督学习算法（如矩阵分解）将词语转换为词嵌入——即编码词语之间语义关系的向量。然而，从训练数据有限的新领域学习词嵌入可能具有挑战性，因为在新领域中含义/用法可能不同；例如，词语“positive”通常具有正面情感，但在医疗记录中往往具有负面情感，因为它可能意味着患者某种疾病检测呈阳性。在实践中，我们预计只有少量领域特定词语可能具有新含义。我们提出了一种直观的两阶段估计器，通过组稀疏惩罚利用这一结构，将大规模文本语料库（如维基百科）与有限的领域特定文本数据相结合，从而高效地迁移学习领域特定词嵌入。我们界定了迁移学习估计器的泛化误差，证明当领域之间只有少量嵌入发生变化时，它可以用显著更少的领域特定数据实现高精度。此外，我们证明在标准正则化条件下，我们的非凸目标函数所识别的所有局部最小值在统计上与全局最小值不可区分，这意味着我们的估计器可以高效计算。我们的结果提供了组稀疏矩阵分解的首个界，这可能具有独立的研究价值。我们根据自然语言处理中最先进的微调启发式方法对我们的方法进行了实证评估。本文由Chung Piaw Teo，优化接受。资助：作者们衷心感谢沃顿分析倡议和沃顿院长基金不可或缺的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01740获取。
papers.title_original: Group-Sparse Matrix Factorization for Transfer Learning of Word Embeddings
papers.title_zh: 用于词嵌入迁移学习的组稀疏矩阵分解

papers.abstract_original: We develop an end-to-end, scalable machine learning framework for designing bundle recommendations in a high-dimensional choice setting. We leverage historical purchases and consideration sets determined from clickstream data to generate dense representations (embeddings) of products. We impose minimal structure on these embeddings and develop heuristics for complementarity and substitutability among products. Subsequently, we use the heuristics to create multiple bundle recommendations for each of 4,500 focal products and test their performance using a field experiment with a large retailer. We use the experimental data to optimize the recommendation design policy with offline policy learning. Our optimized policy is robust across product categories, generalizes well to the retailer’s entire assortment, and provides an expected improvement of 35% ($5 per 100 visits) in revenue from bundle recommendations over the baseline policy.This paper was accepted by Hemant Bhargava, information systems.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01864.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一个端到端、可扩展的机器学习框架，用于在高维选择环境中设计捆绑推荐。我们利用历史购买和由点击流数据确定的考虑集来生成产品的稠密表示（嵌入）。我们对这些嵌入施加最小结构，并开发产品之间互补性和替代性的启发式方法。随后，我们使用这些启发式方法为4,500个焦点产品中的每一个创建多个捆绑推荐，并使用与一家大型零售商的实地实验来测试其表现。我们使用实验数据通过离线策略学习来优化推荐设计策略。我们优化后的策略在产品类别之间具有稳健性，能很好地推广到零售商的整个商品组合，并且相对于基线策略，在捆绑推荐收入方面提供35%（每100次访问5美元）的预期改进。本文由Hemant Bhargava（信息系统）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01864获取。
papers.title_original: Scalable Bundle Recommendations: A Large-Scale Field Experiment
papers.title_zh: 可扩展的捆绑推荐：一项大规模实地实验

papers.abstract_original: Ad fraud is increasingly becoming a major concern in online advertising, with publishers being one of the key sources of fraudulent ad traffic. Although ad fraud deterrence is a critical problem from both technical and economic perspectives, past research has not considered their interplay. Our paper fills this critical gap by building a game-theoretic model wherein an ad network (an intermediary between publishers and advertisers) strategically leverages its technological tool (the configuration of a given fraud detection technology) and economic tool (the payment to publishers) to deter ad fraud and maximize profits effectively. Our analysis generates several interesting findings. For example, as the fraud detection technology and fraud generation techniques improve, we show that although the ad network needs to respond by making the technology configuration stricter to dampen fraud motives and admit less ad traffic, it may sometimes need to increase the payment. Furthermore, although many stakeholders advocate instituting strict legislation and policies to reduce malicious publishers, we show that this may sometimes fail to reduce fraud traffic and even hurt an ad network’s profit. In addition, our results provide other useful implications that present a new theoretical perspective on the incentive problems in ad fraud generation and detection. Our study also draws valuable insights for ad networks into implementing effective ad fraud deterrence policies and for advertisers to audit and monitor their ad campaign performance.This paper was accepted by Hemant Bhargava, information systems.Funding: S. Kumar thanks the Temple Center for International Business Education and Research for partially supporting this research.Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02201.
papers.abstract_zh: 广告欺诈正日益成为在线广告中的一个主要问题，而发布商是欺诈性广告流量的关键来源之一。尽管广告欺诈威慑从技术和经济角度来看都是一个关键问题，但过去的研究并未考虑二者之间的相互作用。我们的论文通过构建一个博弈论模型填补了这一关键空白，在该模型中，广告网络（发布商与广告商之间的中介）战略性地利用其技术工具（给定欺诈检测技术的配置）和经济工具（向发布商支付的款项）来威慑广告欺诈并有效最大化利润。我们的分析产生了若干有趣的发现。例如，随着欺诈检测技术和欺诈生成技术的改进，我们表明，尽管广告网络需要通过使技术配置更严格来抑制欺诈动机并接纳更少的广告流量，但它有时可能需要增加支付。此外，尽管许多利益相关者主张制定严格的立法和政策以减少恶意发布商，但我们表明，这有时可能无法减少欺诈流量，甚至损害广告网络的利润。此外，我们的结果提供了其他有用的启示，为广告欺诈生成和检测中的激励问题提供了新的理论视角。我们的研究还为广告网络实施有效的广告欺诈威慑政策以及广告商审计和监控其广告活动绩效提供了有价值的见解。本文由信息系统领域的Hemant Bhargava接受。资助：S. Kumar感谢天普大学国际商务教育与研究中心对本研究的部分支持。补充材料：在线附录可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02201获取。

papers.abstract_original: We analyze a model where dealers provide market liquidity by intermediating trades between clients. They exert unobservable search effort to improve intermediation profit. This moral-hazard friction limits their ability to raise external finance and compete with each other, constraining market liquidity even for safe assets and more so for those with higher search costs. Dealers mitigate this friction by using debt financing and intermediating across multiple markets, making leverage endogenous and linked to liquidity variations in otherwise unrelated markets. Capping leverage reduces dealer external financing and has mixed effects on welfare. It worsens liquidity but encourages effort. Our findings illuminate how postcrisis regulations impact bond market liquidity.This paper was accepted by William Cong, finance.Funding: J. C.-F. Kuong gratefully acknowledges the financial support from INSEAD and HKIMR.Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02278.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们分析了一个模型，其中交易商通过为客户之间的交易提供中介来提供市场流动性。他们付出不可观测的搜寻努力以提高中介利润。这种道德风险摩擦限制了他们筹集外部融资和相互竞争的能力，制约了市场流动性，即使对于安全资产也是如此，而对于搜寻成本更高的资产则更是如此。交易商通过使用债务融资并在多个市场进行中介来缓解这种摩擦，使杠杆内生化并与原本不相关市场的流动性变化相关联。限制杠杆会减少交易商的外部融资，并对福利产生混合影响。它恶化了流动性，但鼓励了努力。我们的发现阐明了危机后监管如何影响债券市场流动性。本文由金融学领域的William Cong接受。资助：J. C.-F. Kuong感谢INSEAD和HKIMR的财政支持。补充材料：在线附录可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02278获取。

papers.abstract_original: This paper studies price and liquidity dynamics in the presence of costly short-selling when uninformed traders have limited willingness-to-pay to trade securities. In this setting, unraveling and Bayesian social learning interact to produce a novel mechanism, dynamic unraveling: Unraveling that generates signals that lead to future unraveling. Applying the theory, I show how dynamic unraveling explains low-volume crashes: falls in the prices of securities on low or declining trading volume. In this context, short-selling restrictions can make low-volume crashes more likely by intensifying dynamic unraveling, but liquidity injections have the opposite effect.This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02412.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在卖空成本高昂且不知情交易者交易证券的支付意愿有限的情况下，价格与流动性的动态变化。在这一设定下，瓦解与贝叶斯社会学习相互作用，产生了一种新颖的机制——动态瓦解：即产生导致未来瓦解的信号的那种瓦解。应用该理论，我展示了动态瓦解如何解释低成交量崩盘：即证券价格在成交量低或下降时下跌。在这一背景下，卖空限制会通过加剧动态瓦解而使低成交量崩盘更可能发生，但流动性注入则具有相反的效果。本文由金融领域编辑Agostino Capponi接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02412 获取。

papers.abstract_original: As the economy digitizes, menu costs fall, and firms can more easily monitor prices. These trends have led to the rise of automated pricing (and repricing) tools. We employ a novel e-commerce data set to examine the effect of algorithmic pricing in the wild. Evidence from an event study suggests that firms that start employing repricing tools drop their prices by 16.93%, with market prices falling by 9.67%. However, algorithmic pricing companies have developed “resetting” strategies (which regularly raise prices in the hope that competitors will follow) in order to avoid stark Bertrand-Nash competition. We find that these strategies are effective at coaxing competitors to raise their prices; when a resetting strategy is adopted on a market with less than six serious competitors, both competitor prices and market prices eventually increase by 11.4%. Although the resulting patterns of cycling prices are reminiscent of Maskin-Tirole’s Edgeworth cycles, a model of equilibrium in delegated strategies fits the data better. This model suggests that the average price over the cycle will be the monopoly price. Moreover, if the available repricing technologies remain fixed, cycling and prices could rise significantly. However, cycling is still relatively rare in the data, even when studying a convenience sample of products with at least one merchant using a repricing tool.This paper was accepted by Omar Besbes, revenue management and market analytics.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02462.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着经济数字化，菜单成本下降，企业可以更容易地监测价格。这些趋势导致了自动定价（和重新定价）工具的兴起。我们使用一个新颖的电子商务数据集来考察现实世界中算法定价的效应。来自事件研究的证据表明，开始使用重新定价工具的企业将价格降低16.93%，市场价格下降9.67%。然而，算法定价公司已经开发出“重置”策略（定期提高价格，希望竞争对手跟随），以避免激烈的伯特兰-纳什竞争。我们发现这些策略能有效诱导竞争对手提高价格；当在拥有少于六个严肃竞争对手的市场上采用重置策略时，竞争对手价格和市场价格最终都上涨11.4%。尽管由此产生的价格循环模式让人联想到Maskin-Tirole的埃奇沃思周期，但委托策略中的均衡模型更符合数据。该模型表明，周期内的平均价格将是垄断价格。此外，如果可用的重新定价技术保持固定，循环和价格可能显著上升。然而，即使在研究至少有一个商家使用重新定价工具的产品便利样本时，循环在数据中仍然相对罕见。本文由Omar Besbes（收益管理与市场分析）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02462获取。

papers.abstract_original: U.S. health system reform simultaneously promotes alternative payment models (APMs) and integrated provider organizations, where integration is assumed to better enable providers to coordinate and manage the risks introduced by APMs. While the interaction of these two changes has implications for both APM design and regulation of provider integration, it is not well studied. In this paper, we offer empirical evidence on the role of horizontal and vertical integration of orthopedic surgeons in driving heterogeneity in the impact of the Comprehensive Joint Replacement (CJR) APM. Using a quasi-experimental generalized difference-in-differences approach, we find that, relative to similar control hospitals, CJR hospitals with fully horizontally and vertically integrated orthopedic surgeons receive a 5.83% increase in CMS payments to hospitals but do not differ in CJR quality measures. Further analysis shows that the increase in payments stems from changes in physicians’ clinical decision-making that reduce penalties (increase CMS payments) to hospitals for low-value care and reduces CMS payments to postacute care (PAC) providers. Consequently, these hospitals also receive greater CJR reward payments. Overall, our findings suggest that integrated providers are likely to perform better under APMs, providing novel insights for policymakers, payors, and healthcare providers as they design, implement, and evaluate value-based reforms.This paper was accepted by Carri W. Chan, healthcare management.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02547.
papers.abstract_zh: 美国医疗体系改革同时推动替代支付模式（APMs）和整合型提供者组织，其中整合被认为能更好地使提供者协调和管理APMs引入的风险。虽然这两项变革的相互作用对APM设计和提供者整合的监管都有影响，但尚未得到充分研究。在本文中，我们提供实证证据，说明骨科医生的横向和纵向整合在驱动综合关节置换（CJR）APM影响异质性中的作用。使用准实验广义双重差分方法，我们发现，相对于类似的对照医院，拥有完全横向和纵向整合的骨科医生的CJR医院在CMS向医院的支付上获得5.83%的增加，但在CJR质量指标上没有差异。进一步分析表明，支付的增加源于医生临床决策的变化，这些变化减少了医院因低价值护理而受到的处罚（增加CMS支付），并减少了CMS向急性后期护理（PAC）提供者的支付。因此，这些医院也获得更高的CJR奖励支付。总体而言，我们的发现表明，整合型提供者在APMs下可能表现更好，为政策制定者、支付方和医疗提供者在设计、实施和评估基于价值的改革时提供了新见解。本文由Carri W. Chan接受，医疗管理。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02547获取。
papers.title_original: The Role of Physician Integration in Alternative Payment Models: The Case of the Comprehensive Joint Replacement Program
papers.title_zh: 医生整合在替代支付模式中的作用：以综合关节置换计划为例

papers.abstract_original: Project-based organizations allow employees in ostensibly similar roles to acquire very different experiences by working on different kinds of projects. We study how people build careers in these contexts, examining when employees choose to diversify their experience—both in terms of project content and collaborators—and how the resulting diversification affects their career advancement. Using longitudinal project data from a services organization, our results suggest that employees initially explore different kinds of work by moving across project types, but then go on to find their fit in a particular area. This process is quicker for high-performing employees and for those with longer tenure and more diverse collaborator networks. We also find that promotion rates and compensation are lower for employees who worked on a broader portfolio of content types and collaborators in the most recent year, but higher for employees who had worked on broader project portfolios in prior years.This paper was accepted by Lamar Pierce, organizations.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02622.
papers.abstract_zh: 项目型组织允许表面上担任相似角色的员工通过从事不同类型的项目获得截然不同的经验。我们研究人们在此类情境中如何构建职业生涯，考察员工何时选择使其经验多样化——既包括项目内容方面，也包括合作者方面——以及由此产生的多样化如何影响其职业晋升。利用一家服务型组织的纵向项目数据，我们的结果表明，员工最初通过跨项目类型流动来探索不同类型的工作，但随后会在某一特定领域找到自己的匹配。这一过程对于高绩效员工以及任职时间更长、合作者网络更多样化的员工而言更快。我们还发现，对于在最近一年从事内容类型和合作者组合更广泛的员工，晋升率和薪酬较低，但对于在之前年份从事项目组合更广泛的员工，晋升率和薪酬较高。本文由组织学领域的Lamar Pierce接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02622获取。

papers.abstract_original: In a bug bounty program (BBP), organizations incentivize hackers—who could otherwise be “enemies”—to report security vulnerabilities by publicly offering monetary rewards. This paper develops an analytical framework to characterize BBPs and their strategic and economic impacts. Strategically, BBPs induce some hackers to self-select into cooperative vulnerability discovery and reporting, diverting them away from attacking (attack diversion) and delegating part of the protection effort to them (protection delegation). We show that (i) BBPs can be beneficial even when hackers are inefficient at vulnerability identification, yet more participants might make BBPs less attractive to firms. (ii) Although BBPs improve security, they might encourage competitive hackers (i.e., attackers) to exert more efforts. (iii) The coopetition dynamics can render a firm’s provision of rewards and in-house efforts socially inefficient. Common cybersecurity regulations, such as breach penalties and bounty reward subsidies, may exacerbate the inefficiency. We find complementarity between bounty subsidies and breach penalties, suggesting that combining and customizing them according to firm characteristics could enhance BBP efficiency. (iv) Contrary to the conventional wisdom that crowdsourcing rewards increase with participant size, we identify scenarios in which a firm should reduce or make nonmonotonic adjustments to a bounty reward as participant size increases. (v) Legal safe harbor for security testing or policies that reduce duplicate report submissions can lower firm payoffs under BBPs. We draw related implications for research and practice in information security and crowdsourcing.This paper was accepted by Hemant Bhargava, information systems.Funding: This research is supported in part by the HKSAR General Research Fund Project 16503620.Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02682.
papers.abstract_zh: 在漏洞赏金计划（BBP）中，组织通过公开提供金钱奖励，激励本可能成为“敌人”的黑客报告安全漏洞。本文构建了一个分析框架，以刻画BBP及其策略与经济影响。在策略上，BBP促使部分黑客自我选择进入合作性的漏洞发现与报告，使其从攻击行为中转移（攻击转移），并将部分保护工作委托给他们（保护委托）。我们表明：（i）即使黑客在漏洞识别方面效率不高，BBP仍可能有益，但更多参与者可能使BBP对企业吸引力下降。（ii）尽管BBP改善了安全性，但它们可能鼓励竞争性黑客（即攻击者）付出更多努力。（iii）这种竞合动态可能使企业提供奖励和内部努力在社会意义上变得低效。常见网络安全监管措施，如违规处罚和赏金奖励补贴，可能加剧这种低效。我们发现赏金补贴与违规处罚之间存在互补性，表明根据企业特征将二者结合并定制化，可提升BBP效率。（iv）与“众包奖励随参与者规模增加而增加”的传统观点相反，我们识别出在参与者规模增加时，企业应降低赏金奖励或对其进行非单调调整的情形。（v）安全测试的法律安全港或减少重复报告提交的政策，可能降低企业在BBP下的收益。我们据此得出对信息安全与众包研究与实践的启示。本文由信息系统领域的Hemant Bhargava接受。资助：本研究部分得到香港特别行政区一般研究基金项目16503620的支持。补充材料：在线附录可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02682获取。
papers.title_original: Crowdsourcing from Hackers: Strategic Coopetition and Governance in Bug Bounty Programs
papers.title_zh: 从黑客处众包：漏洞赏金计划中的策略性竞合与治理

papers.abstract_original: Many large cities have adopted a policy of restricting the number of new vehicle licenses in order to address the challenges of traffic and air pollution problems. An important question that then arises is how to allocate these limited new license quotas among a large set of demanders while taking both social efficiency and equality into consideration. Inspired by this practical problem, we study the problem of designing simple and optimal mechanisms to tradeoff between efficiency and equality in a similar public goods allocation problem. We first propose a truthful two-group mechanism framework that is both general and simple and then use it to compute the optimal solution that maximizes social efficiency while guaranteeing a certain level of equality. Interestingly and surprisingly, under some natural conditions regarding the players’ private values, we show that the optimal mechanisms within the proposed framework are always the mechanisms that first run an auction and then run a lottery (ATL for short). In addition, beyond the framework and those conditions, we prove that the ATL mechanism can always guarantee at least 1−c+c2 (c∈[0,1] is the minimum equality level) of the optimal solution efficiency. This approximation ratio can in practice be further improved to near-optimal when resources are scarce and the natural conditions hold. We further establish a theoretical connection between these natural conditions and common value distributions, demonstrating that these conditions are widely satisfied in practice. Finally, we implement several experiments to verify the ATL mechanism’s optimality and robustness.This paper was accepted by Chung Piaw Teo, optimization.Funding: This work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72401252, 72192830, 72192832, 62472428, 72192804, 72301235, 72394360 and 72394363]; the Public Computing Cloud, Renmin University of China, the fund for building world-class universities (disciplines) of Renmin University of China; the Beijing Natural Science Foundation [Grant Z220001].Supplemental Material: The online appendices are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02785.
papers.abstract_zh: 许多大城市采取了限制新车辆牌照数量的政策，以应对交通和空气污染问题的挑战。随之出现的一个重要问题是，如何在考虑社会效率和平等的同时，在大量需求者之间分配这些有限的新牌照配额。受这一实际问题的启发，我们研究了在类似的公共品分配问题中设计简单且最优机制以权衡效率与平等的问题。我们首先提出了一个既通用又简单的真实两组机制框架，然后利用它来计算在保证一定平等水平的同时最大化社会效率的最优解。有趣且令人惊讶的是，在关于参与者私人价值的一些自然条件下，我们表明所提出框架内的最优机制总是先进行拍卖再进行摇号的机制（简称ATL）。此外，在该框架和这些条件之外，我们证明ATL机制总能保证至少达到最优解效率的1−c+c2（c∈[0,1]为最低平等水平）。当资源稀缺且自然条件成立时，这一近似比在实践中可进一步改进至接近最优。我们进一步建立了这些自然条件与常见价值分布之间的理论联系，证明这些条件在实践中被广泛满足。最后，我们实施了若干实验以验证ATL机制的最优性和稳健性。本文由优化领域Chung Piaw Teo接受。资助：本工作得到国家自然科学基金[资助号72401252、72192830、72192832、62472428、72192804、72301235、72394360和72394363]；中国人民大学公共计算云、中国人民大学世界一流大学（学科）建设基金；北京市自然科学基金[资助号Z220001]的支持。补充材料：在线附录可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02785获取。
papers.title_original: Simple and (Approximately) Optimal Mechanism in Efficiency and Equality Tradeoff
papers.title_zh: 效率与平等权衡中的简单且（近似）最优机制

papers.abstract_original: Using career history data from employees’ online profiles, we provide empirical evidence regarding how human resources systems can affect the gender gap in job tenure. Our results indicate that female workers experience shorter average job tenure than male workers. Our results further show that abandoning forced ranking systems helps to narrow this gender gap. We present experimental evidence indicating that in forced ranking environments, women experience shorter tenure than men and are more likely to exit their roles. This is true even when women are on equal footing with men. Finally, we present survey evidence that under forced ranking systems, more women resign as compared with men. In sum, our empirical, experimental, and survey results indicate that forced ranking systems may contribute to a gender gap in job tenure. Accordingly, abandoning such systems may help promote workplace gender equality.This paper was accepted by Yan Chen, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Funding: This work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72472068, 72422022, 72272055, 72321001, 72342009, 72325010, and 72172085], the Key Project of Philosophy and Social Science Research of the Chinese Ministry of Education [Grant 22JZD012], Shenzhen Natural Science Foundation [Grant JCYJ20250604144252069], and Macau University of Science and Technology (MUST) Faculty Research Grant [Project No. FRG-25-013-MSB].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.03264.
papers.abstract_zh: 利用员工在线档案中的职业历史数据，我们提供了关于人力资源系统如何影响工作任期性别差距的经验证据。我们的结果表明，女性工人的平均工作任期短于男性工人。我们的结果进一步表明，放弃强制排名制度有助于缩小这一性别差距。我们提供的实验证据表明，在强制排名环境中，女性的任期短于男性，且更有可能退出其职位。即使女性与男性处于平等地位时也是如此。最后，我们提供的调查证据表明，在强制排名制度下，辞职的女性多于男性。总之，我们的经验、实验和调查结果表明，强制排名制度可能导致工作任期的性别差距。因此，放弃此类制度可能有助于促进职场性别平等。本文由行为经济学与决策分析领域的Yan Chen接受。资助：本工作得到了国家自然科学基金[资助号72472068、72422022、72272055、72321001、72342009、72325010和72172085]、教育部哲学社会科学研究重大项目[资助号22JZD012]、深圳市自然科学基金[资助号JCYJ20250604144252069]以及澳门科技大学（MUST）教师研究基金[项目号FRG-25-013-MSB]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.03264获取。

papers.abstract_original: Multiarmed bandit (MAB) algorithms are efficient approaches to reduce the opportunity cost of online experimentation and are used by companies to find the best product from periodically refreshed product catalogs. However, these algorithms face the so-called cold-start at the onset of the experiment due to a lack of knowledge of customer preferences for new products, requiring an initial data collection phase known as the burn-in period. During this period, standard MAB algorithms operate like randomized experiments, incurring large burn-in costs which scale with the large number of products. We attempt to reduce the burn-in by identifying that many products can be cast into two-sided products and then naturally model the rewards of the products with a matrix, whose rows and columns represent the two sides, respectively. Next, we design two-phase bandit algorithms that first use subsampling and low-rank matrix estimation to obtain a substantially smaller targeted set of products and then apply a Upper Confidence Bound procedure on the target products to find the best one. We theoretically show that the proposed algorithms lower costs and expedite the experiment in cases when there is limited experimentation time along with a large product set. Our analysis also provides insights into three experiment regimes of long, short, and ultra-short horizon, determined by the dimensions of the matrix. Empirical evidence from both synthetic data and a real-world data set on music streaming services validates the superior performance suggested by our theory.This paper was accepted by J. George Shanthikumar, data science.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.03394.
papers.abstract_zh: 多臂老虎机（MAB）算法是降低在线实验机会成本的有效方法，被企业用于从定期更新的产品目录中寻找最佳产品。然而，由于缺乏对新产品的客户偏好知识，这些算法在实验开始时面临所谓的冷启动问题，需要一个称为预热期的初始数据收集阶段。在此期间，标准MAB算法如同随机实验一样运行，产生巨大的预热成本，且该成本随产品数量庞大而增加。我们试图通过识别许多产品可以被归入双边产品来减少预热，然后自然地用矩阵对产品的奖励进行建模，矩阵的行和列分别代表两侧。接下来，我们设计了两阶段老虎机算法，首先使用子采样和低秩矩阵估计获得一个大幅缩小的目标产品集，然后对目标产品应用上置信界程序以找到最佳产品。我们从理论上证明，在实验时间有限且产品集庞大的情况下，所提出的算法能降低成本并加速实验。我们的分析还提供了对由矩阵维度决定的三种实验机制——长、短和超短视界——的见解。来自合成数据和音乐流媒体服务真实世界数据集的实证证据验证了我们的理论所表明的优越性能。本文由数据科学领域的J. George Shanthikumar接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.03394获取。
papers.title_original: Speed Up the Cold-Start Learning in Two-Sided Bandits with Many Arms
papers.title_zh: 加速多臂双边老虎机中的冷启动学习

papers.abstract_original: A common challenge faced by two-sided marketplaces is to expand the market while ensuring satisfactory matching of the two sides. We study a new platform growth strategy that increases market thickness with free entry while allowing suppliers to discretionarily signal product quality to buyers, thus forming a tiered market structure that maintains matching performance. We consider such an example with nonfungible token (NFT) markets where suppliers could choose to delay the entry cost of the NFT creation fee until an NFT is sold (lazy minting) or pay the fee up front at the time of NFT creation (gas minting). We use the difference-in-differences strategy to identify the impact of this lazy-minting policy on market matching performance. We find that the impacts of this policy are multifaceted: Although the introduction of lazy minting reduces the average matching likelihood of an NFT by 98.2%, it increases the gas-minting segment’s matching likelihood by 112.3% and first-sale price by 126.5%. Overall, this new growth strategy benefits the platform because of increased total sales and higher revenues. We unravel two mechanisms: the market thickness effect and the quality signaling effect. For the latter, we introduce a systematic framework to empirically establish the quality signaling mechanism with a separating equilibrium, where suppliers prefer gas minting for their high-quality creations. This effectively sends a quality signal that buyers could rely on to recognize high-quality NFTs. This new platform growth strategy provides generic implications for platforms endeavoring to balance market thickness and matching performance.This paper was accepted by Anindya Ghose, information systems.Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.03573.
papers.abstract_zh: 双边市场面临的一个共同挑战是扩大市场，同时确保双方令人满意的匹配。我们研究了一种新的平台增长策略，该策略通过免费进入增加市场厚度，同时允许供应商自行向买家传递产品质量信号，从而形成分层市场结构以维持匹配绩效。我们以非同质化代币（NFT）市场为例，供应商可以选择将NFT创建费用的进入成本推迟到NFT售出时（懒惰铸造），或在NFT创建时预先支付费用（燃料铸造）。我们使用双重差分策略来识别这种懒惰铸造政策对市场匹配绩效的影响。我们发现该政策的影响是多方面的：尽管引入懒惰铸造使NFT的平均匹配可能性降低了98.2%，但它使燃料铸造细分市场的匹配可能性提高了112.3%，首次销售价格提高了126.5%。总体而言，这种新的增长策略因总销售额增加和收入提高而使平台受益。我们揭示了两种机制：市场厚度效应和质量信号效应。对于后者，我们引入了一个系统性框架，通过分离均衡来实证建立质量信号机制，其中供应商更倾向于为其高质量创作选择燃料铸造。这有效地发出了买家可以依赖以识别高质量NFT的质量信号。这种新的平台增长策略为努力平衡市场厚度与匹配绩效的平台提供了通用启示。本文被信息系统领域的Anindya Ghose接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.03573获取。

papers.abstract_original: We study serial supply chain problems where a product is transported from a supplier to a warehouse (inbound transportation), and then from the warehouse (outbound transportation) to a retailer such that demand for a given planning horizon is satisfied. We consider heterogeneous vehicles of varying capacities for transportation in each time period, and the objective is to plan inbound and outbound transportation along with inventory in each time period so that overall inventory and transportation costs are minimized. These problems belong to the class of two-echelon lot-sizing (2-ELS) problems with the warehouse and retailer as the first and second echelons, respectively. We address an open question raised in van Hoesel et al. [van Hoesel S, Romeijn HE, Morales DR, Wagelmans APM (2005) Integrated lot sizing in serial supply chains with production capacities. Management Sci. 51(11):1706–1719]: Does there exist a polynomial-time algorithm for 2-ELS with a single capacitated vehicle for each of the inbound and outbound transportation? Specifically, we introduce polynomial-time algorithms for this problem and its three generalizations with multiple capacitated vehicles for inbound and/or outbound transportation, thereby generalizing the results of Kaminsky and Simchi-Levi [Kaminsky P, Simchi-Levi D (2003) Production and distribution lot sizing in a two stage supply chain. IIE Trans. 35(11):1065–1075] and Sargut and Romeijn [Sargut FZ, Romeijn HE (2007) Capacitated production and subcontracting in a serial supply chain. IIE Trans. 39(11):1031–1043] for 2-ELS with a single capacitated vehicle for inbound transportation and uncapacitated outbound transportation. We showcase the practical applications of these approaches in efficiently solving discrete two- and multiechelon lot-sizing problems that arise in freight transportation, the international shipping industry, and the tire manufacturing industry. Based on our computational experiments, we observe that the algorithm for discrete 2-ELS with a capacitated vehicle for inbound and outbound transportation is computationally efficient in comparison with solving the mixed binary formulations of two- and multiechelon lot-sizing problems using an off-the-shelf optimization solver.This paper was accepted by Chung Piaw Teo, optimization and decision analytics.Funding: This work was supported by the Division of Civil, Mechanical and Manufacturing Innovation of National Science Foundation [Grants 1824897 and 2034503].Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.04106.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究串行供应链问题，其中产品从供应商运输到仓库（入库运输），然后从仓库（出库运输）运输到零售商，以满足给定规划期内的需求。我们考虑每个时间段内用于运输的容量各异的异质车辆，目标是在每个时间段内规划入库和出库运输以及库存，以使总体库存和运输成本最小化。这些问题属于两级批量（2-ELS）问题类别，其中仓库和零售商分别为第一级和第二级。我们解决了van Hoesel等人[van Hoesel S, Romeijn HE, Morales DR, Wagelmans APM (2005) Integrated lot sizing in serial supply chains with production capacities. Management Sci. 51(11):1706–1719]提出的一个开放问题：对于入库和出库运输各有一辆容量受限车辆的2-ELS，是否存在多项式时间算法？具体而言，我们为该问题及其三个推广（入库和/或出库运输有多辆容量受限车辆）引入了多项式时间算法，从而推广了Kaminsky和Simchi-Levi[Kaminsky P, Simchi-Levi D (2003) Production and distribution lot sizing in a two stage supply chain. IIE Trans. 35(11):1065–1075]以及Sargut和Romeijn[Sargut FZ, Romeijn HE (2007) Capacitated production and subcontracting in a serial supply chain. IIE Trans. 39(11):1031–1043]关于入库运输有一辆容量受限车辆且出库运输无容量限制的2-ELS的结果。我们展示了这些方法在有效求解货运、国际航运业和轮胎制造业中出现的离散两级和多级批量问题方面的实际应用。基于我们的计算实验，我们观察到，与使用现成优化求解器求解两级和多级批量问题的混合二元公式相比，用于入库和出库运输均有容量受限车辆的离散2-ELS算法在计算上是高效的。本文由优化与决策分析领域的Chung Piaw Teo接受。资助：本工作得到美国国家科学基金会土木、机械与制造创新部的支持[资助号1824897和2034503]。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.04106获取。
