papers.abstract_original: We study infinite-horizon Markov decision processes (MDPs) with fast–slow structure, in which some state variables evolve rapidly (fast states), whereas others change more gradually (slow states). This structure commonly arises in practice when decisions must be made at high frequencies over long horizons and when slowly changing information still plays a critical role in determining optimal actions. Examples include inventory control under slowly changing demand indicators or dynamic pricing with gradually shifting consumer behavior. Modeling the problem at the natural decision frequency leads to MDPs with discount factors close to one, making them computationally challenging. We propose a novel approximation strategy that freezes slow states during phases of lower level planning and subsequently applies value iteration to an auxiliary upper level MDP that evolves on a slower timescale. Freezing states for short periods of time leads to easier to solve lower level problems, whereas a slower upper level timescale allows for a more favorable discount factor. On the theoretical side, we analyze the regret incurred by our frozen-state approach, and this leads to simple insights on how to trade off regret versus computational cost. Empirically, we benchmark our new frozen-state methods on three domains: (i) inventory control with fixed order costs, (ii) a grid world problem with spatial tasks, and (iii) dynamic pricing with reference price effects. We demonstrate that the new methods produce high-quality policies with significantly less computation, and we show that simply omitting slow states is often a poor heuristic.This paper was accepted by J. George Shanthikumar, data science.Funding: This research is based upon work supported by the U.S. National Science Foundation [Grant 1807536].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00012.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究具有快慢结构的无限期马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），其中一些状态变量快速演化（快状态），而另一些则变化更为缓慢（慢状态）。当决策必须在长时域内以高频做出，且缓慢变化的信息在决定最优行动时仍起关键作用时，这种结构在实践中经常出现。例子包括缓慢变化的需求指标下的库存控制，或消费者行为逐渐变化的动态定价。以自然决策频率对问题建模会导致折扣因子接近1的MDP，使其在计算上具有挑战性。我们提出一种新颖的近似策略，在较低层级规划阶段冻结慢状态，随后将值迭代应用于在较慢时间尺度上演化的辅助上层MDP。将状态冻结较短时间会带来更易求解的较低层级问题，而较慢的上层时间尺度则允许更有利的折扣因子。在理论方面，我们分析冻结状态方法产生的遗憾，并由此得到关于如何在遗憾与计算成本之间进行权衡的简单洞见。在实证方面，我们在三个领域对我们的新冻结状态方法进行基准测试：（i）具有固定订货成本的库存控制，（ii）具有空间任务的网格世界问题，以及（iii）具有参考价格效应的动态定价。我们证明新方法以显著更少的计算产生高质量策略，并表明简单省略慢状态通常是一种糟糕的启发式方法。本文由数据科学领域的J. George Shanthikumar接受。资助：本研究基于美国国家科学基金会[资助号1807536]支持的工作。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00012获取。
papers.title_original: Frozen-State Value Iteration: Faster Reinforcement Learning by Freezing Slow States
papers.title_zh: 冻结状态值迭代：通过冻结慢状态实现更快强化学习

papers.abstract_original: We study an off-policy contextual pricing problem in which the seller has access to samples of prices that customers were previously offered, whether they purchased at that price, and auxiliary features describing the customer and/or item being sold. This is in contrast to the well-studied setting in which samples of the customer’s valuation (willingness to pay) are observed. In our setting, the observed data are influenced by the previous pricing policy, and we do not know how customers would have responded to alternative prices. We introduce suitable loss functions for this setting that can be directly optimized to find an effective pricing policy with expected revenue guarantees without the need for estimation of an intermediate demand function. We focus on convex loss functions, which are especially important when linear pricing policies are preferred for interpretability. In such cases, the revenue optimization problem remains convex and tractable. Specifically, we propose generalized hinge and quantile pricing loss functions that price at a multiplicative factor of the conditional expected valuation or a particular quantile of the prices that sold despite the valuation data not being observed. We prove expected revenue bounds for these pricing policies when the valuation distribution is log-concave, and we provide generalization bounds for the finite sample case. Finally, we conduct simulations on both synthetic and real-world data to demonstrate that this approach is competitive with and, in some settings, outperforms state-of-the-art methods in contextual pricing.This paper was accepted by Vivek Farias, data science.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00122.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究一个离策略上下文定价问题，其中卖方可以获得客户先前被提供价格的样本、他们是否以该价格购买，以及描述客户和/或所售商品的辅助特征。这与已被充分研究的、观察到客户估值（支付意愿）样本的设定形成对比。在我们的设定中，观察到的数据受到先前定价政策的影响，并且我们不知道客户对替代价格会如何反应。我们为该设定引入合适的损失函数，这些损失函数可以直接优化，以找到具有预期收入保证的有效定价政策，而无需估计中间需求函数。我们关注凸损失函数，当线性定价政策因可解释性而更受偏好时，凸损失函数尤为重要。在此类情况下，收入优化问题保持凸且可处理。具体而言，我们提出广义铰链和分位数定价损失函数，它们在条件期望估值的乘法因子处定价，或在尽管估值数据未被观察到但仍售出的价格的特定分位数处定价。我们证明当估值分布为对数凹时这些定价政策的预期收入界，并提供有限样本情况下的泛化界。最后，我们在合成数据和真实世界数据上进行模拟，以证明该方法与上下文定价中的最先进方法相比具有竞争力，并在某些设定中优于它们。本文由Vivek Farias（数据科学）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00122获取。
papers.title_original: Convex Surrogate Loss Functions for Contextual Pricing with Transaction Data
papers.title_zh: 基于交易数据的上下文定价的凸替代损失函数

papers.abstract_original: We consider a joint pricing and inventory control problem in which pricing can be adjusted more frequently than inventory ordering decisions. More specifically, the pricing decision is adjusted every period, whereas new inventory is ordered every epoch, with each epoch consisting of multiple periods. This setting is motivated by many examples, especially among online retailers, in which prices are much easier to change than inventory levels, because changing the latter is subject to prior arrangements or logistical constraints. In this setting, the retailer determines the inventory level at the beginning of each epoch and solves a dynamic pricing problem within that epoch, with no further replenishment opportunities. The optimal pricing and inventory control policy is obtained from an intricate dynamic program (DP), in which the inventory level is the state variable and the pricing policy is characterized as a function of the inventory level. We consider the situation in which the demand-price function and the distribution of random demand noise are both unknown to the retailer, who must develop an online learning algorithm to learn this information while simultaneously maximizing total profit. We propose a learning algorithm that applies linear bandit techniques under the upper confidence bound framework, and we prove that it converges through the DP recursions to the optimal pricing and inventory control policy that would be obtained under complete demand information. The theoretical lower bound for the convergence rate of the learning algorithm is proved based on the multivariate Van Trees inequality coupled with some structural DP analyses, and we show that the upper bound of our algorithm’s convergence rate matches the theoretical lower bound. Numerical results show that our learning algorithm performs very well.This paper was accepted by J. George Shanthikumar, data science.Funding: This work was supported by the MIT Data Science Laboratory, Purdue University Data Science Center for Decision Making, the Hong Kong Research Grants Council (RGC) Early Career Scheme [CityU21505825], the Hong Kong RGC General Research Fund [CityU11508223], and the Joint Research and Innovation Seed Grants program between the University of Illinois System and the University Academic Alliance in Taiwan.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00129.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考虑一个联合定价和库存控制问题，其中定价可以比库存订购决策更频繁地调整。更具体地说，定价决策每个周期调整一次，而新库存每个纪元订购一次，每个纪元由多个周期组成。这一设定受到许多例子的启发，尤其是在在线零售商中，价格比库存水平更容易改变，因为改变后者受制于事先安排或物流约束。在这一设定中，零售商在每个纪元开始时确定库存水平，并在该纪元内解决动态定价问题，没有进一步的补货机会。最优定价和库存控制政策由一个复杂的动态规划（DP）获得，其中库存水平是状态变量，定价政策被刻画为库存水平的函数。我们考虑需求-价格函数和随机需求噪声分布对零售商均未知的情况，零售商必须开发在线学习算法来学习这些信息，同时最大化总利润。我们提出一种学习算法，在上置信界框架下应用线性赌博机技术，并证明它通过DP递推收敛到在完全需求信息下将获得的最优定价和库存控制政策。学习算法收敛速度的理论下界基于多元Van Trees不等式并结合一些结构性DP分析得到证明，并且我们表明我们算法收敛速度的上界与理论下界相匹配。数值结果表明我们的学习算法表现非常好。本文由J. George Shanthikumar（数据科学）接受。资助：本工作得到MIT Data Science Laboratory、Purdue University Data Science Center for Decision Making、香港研究资助局（RGC）早期职业计划 [CityU21505825]、香港RGC一般研究基金 [CityU11508223]，以及University of Illinois System与University Academic Alliance in Taiwan之间的联合研究与创新种子资助计划的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00129获取。
papers.title_original: Dynamic Pricing with Infrequent Inventory Replenishments
papers.title_zh: 补货不频繁下的动态定价

papers.abstract_original: Shipping experience improvement has been an essential business strategy in e-commerce. Beyond investing directly in improving shipping speed, online retailers have recently expanded their focus on other shipping strategies, such as offering consumers the option to pick up orders at a local station. This paper uses the opening of hundreds of such pickup stations as a natural experiment to study the impact of these stations on consumers. We find that the introduction of pickup stations increased total sales by 3.9%. In contrast with past literature, we show that shipping time reduction is not the driving factor in the impact of pickup stations. Yet, the logistic flexibility introduced by pickup stations explains the sales impact. To explicitly examine how logistic flexibility affects consumers’ decisions on purchases, we develop and estimate a structural model of consumer choice. In our model, consumers value two types of logistics flexibility—the flexibility to pick up their items at their preferred times, referred to as the value of preferred time flexibility, and the flexibility to delay pickup decisions to the last moment, referred to as the value of last-minute choice flexibility. We show that the value of preferred time flexibility accounts for 76.2% of the impact on sales, whereas the value of last-minute choice flexibility accounts for the remaining 23.8%. Using our estimated model, we develop a counterfactual strategy in building pickup stations that could achieve the sales lift with 56.4%–63.6% fewer stations. Last but not least, using our estimated time flexibility, we also develop a novel shipping strategy without pickup stations that could improve sales by 8.4%. Our estimates suggest that our counterfactual logistic strategies could increase consumer welfare by 2.0%–10.0%.This paper was accepted by Elena Katok, operations management.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00163.
papers.abstract_zh: 改善配送体验一直是电子商务中的一项重要经营策略。除了直接投资于提升配送速度外，在线零售商近来还扩大了对其他配送策略的关注，例如为消费者提供在本地站点自提订单的选项。本文利用数百个此类自提站点的开设作为自然实验，研究这些站点对消费者的影响。我们发现，自提站点的引入使总销售额提高了3.9%。与以往文献相反，我们表明配送时间缩短并非自提站点影响的驱动因素。然而，自提站点引入的物流灵活性解释了销售影响。为明确考察物流灵活性如何影响消费者的购买决策，我们开发并估计了一个消费者选择的结构模型。在我们的模型中，消费者重视两类物流灵活性——在偏好时间自提商品的灵活性，称为偏好时间灵活性价值，以及将自提决策推迟到最后一刻的灵活性，称为最后一刻选择灵活性价值。我们表明，偏好时间灵活性价值占销售影响的76.2%，而最后一刻选择灵活性价值占其余的23.8%。使用我们估计的模型，我们开发了一种建设自提站点的反事实策略，可以用少56.4%–63.6%个站点实现同样的销售提升。最后但同样重要的是，利用我们估计的时间灵活性，我们还开发了一种无需自提站点的新型配送策略，可将销售额提高8.4%。我们的估计表明，我们的反事实物流策略可使消费者福利提高2.0%–10.0%。本文由运营管理领域编辑Elena Katok接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00163 获取。
papers.title_original: The Value of Logistic Flexibility in E-commerce
papers.title_zh: 电子商务中物流灵活性的价值

papers.abstract_original: Assuming no arbitrage and that a polynomial in the time to maturity approximates spot-rate increments, we develop a consistent approach to estimate factor risk premia in the bond market. This approach is attractive, as the underlying risk factors are the time-varying coefficients of the polynomial specification, and the factor loadings correspond to familiar bond risk characteristics, such as duration and convexity. Our two-factor model—with a positive (negative) duration-factor (convexity-factor) risk premium—is easy to estimate and provides straightforward economic intuition for the concave term structure of bond risk premia and the downward-sloping term structure of bond Sharpe ratios. Our model decomposes the conditional factor risk premia into a “status quo” component—the expected factors’ realizations when expected spot-rate increments are zero—and the factors’ forecasts. The status quo factor risk premia provide measures of the state of fixed income markets that both outperform alternative measures and are easily estimated in real time; moreover, the underlying risk factors and their loadings are familiar to and readily interpreted by investors and traders.This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00212.
papers.abstract_zh: 假设不存在套利，且到期时间的多项式可近似即期利率增量，我们开发了一种一致的方法来估计债券市场中的因子风险溢价。这种方法具有吸引力，因为基础风险因子是多项式设定的时变系数，而因子载荷对应于熟悉的债券风险特征，如久期和凸性。我们的双因子模型——具有正的（负的）久期因子（凸性因子）风险溢价——易于估计，并为债券风险溢价的凹形期限结构和债券夏普比率的向下倾斜期限结构提供了直接的经济直觉。我们的模型将条件因子风险溢价分解为“现状”成分——即当预期即期利率增量为零时因子的预期实现值——以及因子的预测。现状因子风险溢价提供了固定收益市场状态的度量，既优于替代度量，又易于实时估计；此外，基础风险因子及其载荷对投资者和交易者而言是熟悉的且易于解释的。本文由金融学领域的Lukas Schmid接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00212获取。
papers.title_original: Bond Risk Characteristics and Factor Risk Premia
papers.title_zh: 债券风险特征与因子风险溢价

papers.abstract_original: Faster e-commerce fulfillment often comes at a cost to the environment because of energy-intensive transportation modes and more frequent, less consolidated last-mile deliveries. Despite these environmental implications, most retailers feel pressure to provide fast fulfillment to remain competitive. But what if consumers could be nudged to voluntarily choose green-but-slow shipping? In practice, a variety of information strategies are used to nudge such decisions, but it is unclear which strategy is best and why. This study examines these questions in two logistical contexts, each involving a different type of process change to support green-but-slow shipping: shipping mode and order consolidation. We first introduce a conceptual framework for selecting information strategies based on their influence on customer perceptions related to key stakeholders in each context: delivery convenience (self), environmental impact (society), and sustainability intention (retailer). Then, drawing on behavioral research and industry practices, we identify and test the effect of a comprehensive set of information strategies (i.e., Process, Green Label, Green Process, and Green Outcome) through controlled experiments involving 3,800 participants. Experimental results suggest that different logistical contexts require distinct nudging strategies, aligning with our conceptual framework. We find that including a green label is particularly effective for the shipping mode context, especially when combined with outcome information. In contrast, process information is more promising in the order consolidation context. Also, adding financial incentives can enhance the effectiveness of information strategies without a clear environmental signal, whereas pairing them with a simple green label may be effective for low eco-conscious individuals.This paper was accepted by Elena Katok, operations management.Funding: This work was supported by the Institute on the Environment, University of Minnesota [MF-0009-23].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00239.
papers.abstract_zh: 更快的电子商务履约往往以环境为代价，因为其使用能源密集型运输方式以及更频繁、整合程度更低的最后一英里配送。尽管存在这些环境影响，大多数零售商仍感受到提供快速履约以保持竞争力的压力。但是，如果消费者可以被助推去自愿选择绿色但缓慢的配送呢？在实践中，人们使用多种信息策略来助推此类决策，但尚不清楚哪种策略最佳以及原因何在。本研究在两个物流情境中考察这些问题，每个情境都涉及不同类型的流程变革以支持绿色但缓慢的配送：运输方式和订单整合。我们首先引入一个概念框架，用于根据信息策略对客户关于各情境中关键利益相关者感知的影响来选择信息策略：配送便利性（自我）、环境影响（社会）和可持续性意图（零售商）。然后，借鉴行为研究和行业实践，我们通过涉及3,800名参与者的受控实验，识别并检验一整套信息策略（即流程、绿色标签、绿色流程和绿色结果）的效果。实验结果表明，不同的物流情境需要不同的助推策略，这与我们的概念框架一致。我们发现，加入绿色标签对运输方式情境尤其有效，特别是与结果信息结合时。相比之下，流程信息在订单整合情境中更有前景。此外，在没有明确环境信号时，加入经济激励可以增强信息策略的有效性，而将其与简单的绿色标签搭配可能对生态意识较低的个人有效。本文由运营管理领域的Elena Katok接受。资助：本工作得到明尼苏达大学环境研究所[MF-0009-23]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00239获取。
papers.title_original: Nudging Green-but-Slow Shipping Choices in Online Retail
papers.title_zh: 在在线零售中助推绿色但缓慢的配送选择

papers.abstract_original: I document the advertised corporate culture among start-up firms from an online job board. Two corporate culture types emerge: one that concerns the well-being of employees (worker-centered culture) and another that emphasizes other values, such as customers, firms, and markets (firm-centered culture). The worker-centered culture attracts 20% more applications than the other culture type. Firms advertising the worker-centered culture pay 5% lower salaries than measurably similar jobs. Outcomes do not significantly differ among firms that promote different types of corporate culture. To assess whether a worker-centered culture is adopted to reduce labor costs or enhance productivity, I develop an equilibrium model. The model implies that many firms adopt a worker-centered culture primarily for cost savings.This paper was accepted by Ashish Arora, entrepreneurship and innovation.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00254.
papers.abstract_zh: 我记录了来自一个在线招聘网站的初创企业所广告宣传的企业文化。出现了两种企业文化类型：一种关注员工的福祉（以员工为中心的文化），另一种强调其他价值，如客户、企业和市场（以企业为中心的文化）。以员工为中心的文化比其他文化类型多吸引20%的申请。宣传以员工为中心文化的企业支付的薪酬比可测量相似的职位低5%。推广不同类型企业文化的企业之间，结果没有显著差异。为了评估采用以员工为中心的文化是为了降低劳动力成本还是提高生产率，我建立了一个均衡模型。该模型意味着，许多企业采用以员工为中心的文化主要是为了节省成本。本文由创业与创新领域的Ashish Arora接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00254获取。
papers.title_original: Start-Up Firms and Corporate Culture: Evidence from Advertised Corporate Culture
papers.title_zh: 初创企业与企业文化：来自广告宣传的企业文化的证据

papers.abstract_original: This research presents an innovative approach to network development which goes beyond conventional models that use connection rules for individual agents. We show that agents can produce diverse network structures through uniform edge searches which involve random connection attempts without preference. This model offers a new viewpoint on network formation by emphasizing edges in contrast to nodes. Within this framework, edges are considerably more crucial than those in other network formation models as they represent tangible interactions such as question-and-answer exchanges, commercial transactions, and coauthorships, rather than abstract relationships. We prove that the model converges to a stationary equilibrium degree distribution, implying that in the long term, the probability of observing certain network characteristics stabilizes and becomes time-invariant. Furthermore, we derive closed‐form asymptotic expressions for key network statistics and validate them through both simulations and real‐world data sets. Our research shows that three core dimensions are inherently in competition with one another: (1) quantity (mean degree), reflecting agents’ overall connectivity; (2) quality (clustering coefficient), capturing local cohesion; and (3) equity (skewness of the in-degree distribution), indicating how strongly connections concentrate on a few nodes. Our results show that raising the search times boosts quantity but lowers quality by diluting clustering, whereas raising the secondary connection probability enhances clustering yet decreases equity by concentrating in-degree and intensifying the Matthew effect. These trade-offs reveal essential limits of network formation while providing a flexible framework which connects theoretical insight to practical decisions in network design and management.This paper was accepted by J. George Shanthikumar, data science.Funding: The research of J. Qi is funded by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72422005] and the Hong Kong Research Grant Council [Grants GRF 16209923, 16213424, and TRS T32-615/24-R]. Y.-J. Chen acknowledges financial support from the Hong Kong Research Grant Council [Grants C6020-21GF, 16212821, and 16204521].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00475.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究提出了一种创新的网络发展方法，超越了使用个体主体连接规则的传统模型。我们表明，主体可以通过均匀边搜索产生多样化的网络结构，这种搜索涉及无偏好的随机连接尝试。该模型通过强调边而非节点，为网络形成提供了新视角。在此框架内，边比其他网络形成模型中的边更为关键，因为它们代表了诸如问答交流、商业交易和合著等实质性互动，而非抽象关系。我们证明该模型收敛于一个平稳均衡度分布，这意味着长期来看，观察到某些网络特征的概率会稳定并变得不随时间变化。此外，我们推导了关键网络统计量的闭式渐近表达式，并通过模拟和真实世界数据集进行了验证。我们的研究表明，三个核心维度本质上相互竞争：(1) 数量（平均度），反映主体的整体连通性；(2) 质量（聚类系数），捕捉局部凝聚力；以及 (3) 公平性（入度分布的偏度），表明连接在少数节点上的集中程度。我们的结果表明，提高搜索次数会提升数量，但通过稀释聚类而降低质量，而提高二次连接概率会增强聚类，但通过集中入度并加剧马太效应而降低公平性。这些权衡揭示了网络形成的基本限制，同时提供了一个灵活的框架，将理论洞见与网络设计和管理中的实际决策联系起来。本文由数据科学领域的J. George Shanthikumar接受。资助：J. Qi的研究由中国国家自然科学基金[资助号72422005]和香港研究资助局[资助号GRF 16209923、16213424和TRS T32-615/24-R]资助。Y.-J. Chen感谢香港研究资助局[资助号C6020-21GF、16212821和16204521]的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00475获取。
papers.title_original: Analyzing Network Formation Using Big Data Analytics: A Study of Degree Distribution, Clustering Coefficient, Diameter, and Assortativity
papers.title_zh: 利用大数据分析网络形成：度分布、聚类系数、直径与同配性研究

papers.abstract_original: We propose a novel approach to measure the cost of aggregate economic fluctuations that does not require complete specification of investors’ risk preferences or their beliefs. With data on consumption and asset prices, an information-theoretic method is used to recover an information kernel (I-SDF). The I-SDF prices asset returns much better than tightly parametrized structural models, thereby offering a reliable candidate for the measurement of the welfare cost of business cycles. Our method enables the estimation of both the unconditional (or, average) cost of fluctuations, as well as the cost conditional on the state of the economy. We find that the cost of fluctuations is strongly time varying and countercyclical and that the cost of business cycle fluctuations is substantial, accounting for a quarter to a third of the cost of all consumption uncertainty.This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00484.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种衡量总体经济波动成本的新方法，该方法不需要完整设定投资者的风险偏好或信念。利用消费和资产价格数据，使用信息论方法恢复一个信息核（I-SDF）。I-SDF对资产回报的定价远优于严格参数化的结构模型，从而为衡量经济周期的福利成本提供了一个可靠的候选方法。我们的方法能够估计波动的无条件（或平均）成本，以及以经济状态为条件的成本。我们发现，波动的成本具有强烈的时变性和逆周期性，并且经济周期波动的成本是巨大的，占所有消费不确定性成本的四分之一到三分之一。本文由金融学领域的Lukas Schmid接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00484获取。
papers.title_original: The Market Cost of Business Cycle Fluctuations
papers.title_zh: 经济周期波动的市场成本

papers.abstract_original: Inventory models with large and uncertain lead times are notoriously difficult to manage due to the curse of dimensionality. Recent works suggest that in inventory models with large deterministic lead times, semi-open-loop policies are asymptotically optimal. In this paper, we provide a theoretical foundation for the superior performance of semi-open-loop policies in inventory models where the lead times are not only large but also exhibit high variability. In the single-sourcing lost-sales inventory model with divisible products, we show that the optimality gap of constant-order policies decays exponentially fast as the lead time increases. In the single-sourcing lost-sales inventory model with indivisible products, under the assumption that the placed orders cannot cross in time, we propose a bracket policy, which alternates deterministically between two consecutive integer order quantities, and prove that the bracket policy is asymptotically optimal. In the dual-sourcing backlog inventory model with divisible products, we show that a semi-open-loop policy, which places a constant order from the regular supplier in each period, and implements a state-dependent modified base-stock policy from the emergency supplier, is asymptotically optimal, and we also extend our analysis to the joint pricing and inventory model. Finally, we provide a comprehensive numerical study to demonstrate the good performance of the proposed policies and derive further managerial insights.This paper was accepted by Jeannette Song, operations management.Funding: This work was supported by the National Science Foundation [Grant CMMI-1635160], the Hong Kong Research Grants Council [General Research Fund CityU11508223], and the Hong Kong Research Grants Council [Early Career Scheme CityU21505825].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00539.
papers.abstract_zh: 具有大且不确定提前期的库存模型由于维数灾难而众所周知难以管理。最近的研究表明，在具有大确定性提前期的库存模型中，半开环策略是渐近最优的。在本文中，我们为半开环策略在提前期不仅大而且表现出高变异性的库存模型中的优越性能提供了理论基础。在具有可分割产品的单源缺货销售库存模型中，我们表明恒定订货策略的最优性差距随着提前期的增加呈指数快速衰减。在具有不可分割产品的单源缺货销售库存模型中，在已下订单不能交叉的假设下，我们提出了一种括号策略，该策略在两个连续整数订货量之间确定性地交替，并证明括号策略是渐近最优的。在具有可分割产品的双源积压库存模型中，我们表明一种半开环策略是渐近最优的，该策略在每个时期从常规供应商处下恒定订单，并从应急供应商处实施状态依赖的修正基本库存策略，我们还将分析扩展到联合定价和库存模型。最后，我们提供了一项全面的数值研究，以证明所提出策略的良好性能，并得出进一步的管理见解。本文由运营管理领域的Jeannette Song接受。资助：本研究由国家科学基金会[Grant CMMI-1635160]、香港研究资助局[General Research Fund CityU11508223]和香港研究资助局[Early Career Scheme CityU21505825]资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00539获取。
papers.title_original: Asymptotic Optimality of Semi-Open-Loop Policies in Inventory Models with Stochastic Lead Times
papers.title_zh: 随机提前期库存模型中半开环策略的渐近最优性

papers.abstract_original: We show that increased media coverage strongly predicts lower subsequently announced firm fundamentals, earnings surprises, and higher likelihoods of bankruptcy, dividend cuts, and delistings. Additionally, we find that media articles often convey negative sentiment, with investor attention increasing around the publication of negative articles, suggesting that the media tilts coverage toward negative events to drive readership. We also show that media coverage initially impedes price discovery for negative news through an attention effect and that investors respond sluggishly to the negative signal embedded in media coverage decisions, leading to a gradual incorporation of the negative information into prices and return predictability.This paper was accepted by David Simchi-Levi, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00580.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们表明，媒体报道的增加强烈预测了随后公布的公司基本面走低、盈利意外以及更高的破产、削减股息和退市可能性。此外，我们发现媒体文章往往传达负面情绪，投资者关注度在负面文章发表前后上升，这表明媒体将报道向负面事件倾斜以推动读者量。我们还表明，媒体报道最初通过关注效应阻碍了负面消息的价格发现，并且投资者对媒体报道决策中所蕴含的负面信号反应迟缓，导致负面信息逐渐被纳入价格并产生收益可预测性。本文由金融领域的David Simchi-Levi接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00580获取。
papers.title_original: Bad News Bearers: The Negative Tilt of the Financial Press
papers.title_zh: 坏消息的传递者：财经媒体的负面倾向

papers.abstract_original: We consider a two-stage joint production and service planning problem under demand ambiguity. The product-service provider receives a fixed amount of revenue from the recipient in advance (first-stage), and is committed to fulfill all the demands realized over a specific period (second-stage). The provider aims to determine the portfolio of products with the associated service levels and the capacity to maximize the expected total profit. We study the problem in a data-driven setting assuming the historical information on demand and the associated covariates are available, where the service decision is itself a key covariate for demand. In order to capture the effect of demand correlation and variance-heterogeneity across products and the effect of service dependency under demand ambiguity, we construct a predictive ambiguity set leveraging seemingly unrelated regression (SUR) estimated with feasible generalized least squares (FGLS), which treats the service level as a regressor and addresses the heteroskedasticity. We then develop a decision-dependent two-stage distributionally robust optimization (DRO) model. Operationally, we identify that the developed predictive DRO model can be reformulated as an empirical counterpart under the predicted demand distribution regularized by a perceived shortage cost as the shadow price for ambiguity aversion. Exploiting this structure, we analyze the ambiguity-averse operational properties and risk exposure in terms of worst-case performance sensitivity. Statistically, our approach enjoys finite-sample performance guarantee and asymptotic consistency under several regularity conditions. Computationally, the proposed model can be reformulated as a mixed-integer conic program that enjoys an appealing structure for optimization. Finally, sufficient numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.This paper was accepted by J. George Shanthikumar, data science.Funding: S. M. Wang is supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72471224, 72171221, 71922020, and 71988101], the Fundamental Research Funds for the Central Universities [Grant UCAS-E2ET0808X2], and a grant from the MOE Social Science Laboratory of Digital Economic Forecasts and Policy Simulation at UCAS. F. Saldanha-da-Gama and S. M. Wang are also jointly supported by the President’s International Fellowship Initiative [Grant 2025PVA0080] of the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS). S. Y. Wang is supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 71988101].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00608.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考虑需求模糊条件下的两阶段联合生产与服务规划问题。产品服务提供者预先从接受方获得固定金额的收入（第一阶段），并承诺满足在特定期间内实现的全部需求（第二阶段）。提供者旨在确定产品组合及相应的服务水平与产能，以最大化期望总利润。我们在数据驱动的设定下研究该问题，假设关于需求及相应协变量的历史信息可得，其中服务决策本身即为需求的一个关键协变量。为了刻画需求相关性以及跨产品的方差异质性，以及需求模糊下服务依赖性的影响，我们构建了一个预测性模糊集，利用可行广义最小二乘法（FGLS）估计的看似无关回归（SUR），该方法将服务水平视为回归量并处理异方差性。随后，我们建立了一个决策依赖的两阶段分布鲁棒优化（DRO）模型。在操作层面，我们发现所构建的预测性DRO模型可以重新表述为一个经验对应模型，其基于预测需求分布，并以感知短缺成本作为模糊厌恶的影子价格进行正则化。利用这一结构，我们分析了模糊厌恶的运营属性以及在最坏情况绩效敏感性方面的风险暴露。在统计层面，我们的方法在若干正则条件下具有有限样本绩效保证和渐近一致性。在计算层面，所提出的模型可以重新表述为一个混合整数锥规划，其具有利于优化的吸引人的结构。最后，充分的数值实验证明了所提方法的有效性。本文由J. George Shanthikumar，数据科学领域接受。资助：S. M. Wang受国家自然科学基金[资助号72471224、72171221、71922020和71988101]、中央高校基本科研业务费[资助号UCAS-E2ET0808X2]以及中国科学院大学数字经济预测与政策模拟教育部社会科学实验室的资助。F. Saldanha-da-Gama和S. M. Wang还共同受到中国科学院（CAS）院长国际 fellowship 计划[资助号2025PVA0080]的资助。S. Y. Wang受国家自然科学基金[资助号71988101]的资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00608获取。

papers.abstract_original: We model endogenous trading and liquidity provision at a decentralized exchange (DEX) and demonstrate that increasing DEX trading fees can increase DEX trading volume. DEXs employ a mechanical pricing rule whereby price impacts decrease with inventory that DEXs acquire by offering fee revenues to investors. Consequently, higher DEX fees can incentivize higher inventory, thereby reducing price impacts. Moreover, the reduction of price impact can offset the increase in fees so that the marginal cost of DEX trading declines despite charging a higher trading fee. In turn, lower DEX marginal trading costs lead to an increase in DEX trading volume.This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们对去中心化交易所（DEX）中的内生交易与流动性提供进行建模，并证明提高DEX交易费用可以增加DEX交易量。DEX采用一种机械式定价规则，即价格影响随DEX所持有的库存增加而减小，而DEX通过向投资者提供费用收入来获取这些库存。因此，更高的DEX费用可以激励更高的库存，从而降低价格影响。此外，价格影响的降低可以抵消费用的增加，以至于尽管收取更高的交易费用，DEX交易的边际成本仍然下降。反过来，更低的DEX边际交易成本导致DEX交易量增加。本文由金融领域编辑Agostino Capponi接受。

papers.abstract_original: We use career backgrounds of initial employees from a full cohort of U.S. startups to measure founding teams’ skillsets. Startups with more diverse prior industry experience grow faster than same-industry local peers. One-standard-deviation-higher diversity is associated with 16% (10%) higher five-year employment (sales) growth, controlling for demographic diversity, prestartup wages, and other observables. Startups in innovative industries and facing lower coordination costs among team members drive the results. To address endogeneity, we exploit shocks in which teams suddenly lose members with unduplicated skills. Overall, combining individual specialization with team-level diversification allows teams to act as “jacks of all trades and masters of each.”This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance.Funding: This research uses data from the Census Bureau’s Longitudinal Employer Household Dynamics Program, which was partially supported by the National Science Foundation [Grants SES-9978093, SES-0339191 and ITR-0427889], the National Institute on Aging [Grant AG018854], and grants from the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation.Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00773.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们使用来自美国初创企业全队列的初始员工的职业背景来衡量创始团队的技能组合。先前行业经验更多样化的初创企业比同行业本地同行成长更快。在控制人口统计多样性、创业前工资和其他可观测变量后，多样性高一个标准差与五年就业（销售）增长高出16%（10%）相关。创新型行业中的初创企业以及团队成员间协调成本较低的初创企业驱动了这些结果。为解决内生性，我们利用团队突然失去拥有不可替代技能的成员的冲击。总体而言，将个人专业化与团队层面的多元化相结合，使团队能够成为“万事通且各有所长”。本文由Bo Becker（金融领域）接受。资助：本研究使用了美国人口普查局纵向雇主-家庭动态项目的数据，该项目部分得到了美国国家科学基金会[资助号SES-9978093、SES-0339191和ITR-0427889]、美国国家老龄化研究所[资助号AG018854]以及Alfred P. Sloan基金会资助的支持。补充材料：互联网附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00773获取。

papers.abstract_original: In malaria-endemic countries, the limited availability of affordable antimalarial medication has contributed to the widespread distribution of counterfeit drugs. This paper examines such markets to determine how philanthropic donors can best allocate limited funds to subsidize the purchase or sales of antimalarial drugs via private-sector distribution channels. We develop a game-theoretic model of the antimalarial supply chain wherein the retailer strategically sources legitimate drugs from a donor-certified supplier, potentially counterfeit drugs from an uncertified supplier, or both. In contrast with the extant literature, we demonstrate that, in the presence of counterfeits, exclusive reliance on purchase subsidies may no longer be optimal. Specifically, under donor budget constraints, offering sales subsidies that incorporate both legitimate and counterfeit drugs may be preferable or, in some cases, abstaining from subsidy provision completely. Additionally, we evaluate the implications of three pertinent nonsubsidy strategies deployed to combat counterfeit drugs: imposing penalties for sourcing counterfeits, eliminating subsidies on counterfeit drugs with traceability technology, and implementing price controls. Our study concludes with extensive numerical analysis calibrated to malaria data from Mozambique. Overall, this paper offers strategic guidance for improving outcomes in the presence of counterfeit drugs. Our results highlight the need for governments and donors to carefully consider market-specific factors, such as retailers’ pricing power and donors’ budget constraints, when designing subsidy schemes and access policies for life-saving medicines. These insights could potentially be extrapolated to address similar challenges in other endemic disease contexts, offering a broader framework for enhancing public health in resource-constrained environments.This paper was accepted by Jeannette Song, operations management.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00885.
papers.abstract_zh: 在疟疾流行国家，可负担的抗疟药物供应有限，导致了假药的广泛流通。本文研究此类市场，以确定慈善捐赠者如何最好地分配有限资金，通过私营部门分销渠道补贴抗疟药物的购买或销售。我们构建了一个抗疟药物供应链的博弈论模型，其中零售商策略性地从捐赠者认证的供应商处采购合法药物，可能从未经认证的供应商处采购假药，或两者兼有。与现有文献相比，我们证明，在存在假药的情况下，完全依赖购买补贴可能不再是最优的。具体而言，在捐赠者预算约束下，提供同时涵盖合法药物和假药的销售补贴可能更可取，或者在某些情况下，完全放弃提供补贴。此外，我们评估了三种用于打击假药的相关非补贴策略的影响：对采购假药施加处罚、利用溯源技术消除对假药的补贴，以及实施价格管制。我们的研究以针对莫桑比克疟疾数据校准的广泛数值分析作为结尾。总体而言，本文为在存在假药的情况下改善结果提供了战略指导。我们的结果凸显了政府和捐赠者在设计救命药物的补贴方案和可及性政策时，需要仔细考虑市场特定因素，例如零售商的定价能力和捐赠者的预算约束。这些见解有可能被外推，以应对其他地方性疾病背景下的类似挑战，为在资源受限环境中增强公共卫生提供一个更广泛的框架。本文由运营管理领域的Jeannette Song接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00885获取。
papers.title_original: From Black to Gray: Improving Access to Antimalarial Drugs in the Presence of Deceptive Counterfeits
papers.title_zh: 从黑色到灰色：在存在欺骗性假药的情况下改善抗疟药物的可及性

papers.abstract_original: We consider a high-dimensional dynamic pricing problem under nonstationarity, in which a firm sells products to T sequentially arriving consumers that behave according to an unknown demand model with potential changes at unknown times. The demand model is assumed to be a high-dimensional generalized linear model (GLM), allowing for a feature vector in Rd that encodes products and consumer information. To achieve optimal revenue (i.e., least regret), the firm needs to learn and exploit the unknown GLMs, monitoring for potential change points. To tackle such a problem, we first design a novel penalized likelihood-based online change-point detection algorithm for high-dimensional GLMs, and this is the first algorithm in the change-point literature that achieves optimal minimax localization error rate for high-dimensional GLMs. A change-point detection assisted dynamic pricing (CPDP) policy is further proposed and achieves a near-optimal regret of order O(sϒTT log(Td)), where s is the sparsity level and ϒT is the number of change points. This regret is accompanied with a minimax lower bound, demonstrating the optimality of CPDP (up to logarithmic factors). In particular, the optimality with respect to ϒT is seen for the first time in the dynamic pricing literature and is achieved via a novel accelerated exploration mechanism. Extensive simulation experiments and a real data application on online lending illustrate the efficiency of the proposed policy and the importance and practical value of handling nonstationarity in dynamic pricing.This paper was accepted by Vivek Farias, data science.Funding: F. Jiang is supported in part by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72522009, 12201124, 12331009, 72271060, and 72432002] and National Key Research and Development Program of China [Grant 2024YFA1015700]. Y. Yu is supported by Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council [Grant EP/Z531327/1] and the Leverhulme Trust.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00889.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考虑非平稳下的高维动态定价问题，其中一家公司向T个序贯到达的消费者销售产品，这些消费者按照一个未知的需求模型行事，该模型可能在未知时间发生潜在变化。假设需求模型为高维广义线性模型（GLM），允许存在一个Rd维的特征向量，用以编码产品和消费者信息。为实现最优收益（即最小遗憾），公司需要学习和利用未知的GLM，同时监测潜在的变点。为解决这一问题，我们首先为高维GLM设计了一种新颖的基于惩罚似然的在线变点检测算法，这是变点文献中首个对高维GLM达到最优极小极大定位误差率的算法。进一步提出了一种变点检测辅助的动态定价（CPDP）策略，达到了O(sϒTT log(Td))阶的近最优遗憾，其中s为稀疏度水平，ϒT为变点数量。该遗憾伴随一个极小极大下界，证明了CPDP的最优性（至多相差对数因子）。特别地，关于ϒT的最优性在动态定价文献中首次出现，并通过一种新颖的加速探索机制实现。大量模拟实验和一项关于在线借贷的真实数据应用说明了所提策略的效率以及处理动态定价中非平稳性的重要性和实践价值。本文由Vivek Farias接受，数据科学。资助：F. Jiang部分受到国家自然科学基金[资助号72522009、12201124、12331009、72271060和72432002]和国家重点研发计划[资助号2024YFA1015700]的资助。Y. Yu受到工程与物理科学研究理事会[资助号EP/Z531327/1]和Leverhulme Trust的资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00889获取。

papers.abstract_original: Among commodity futures sectors, only industrial metals returns predict future industrial production growth and revisions in producers’ expectations about future economic conditions across a wide range of countries. This predictive power is stronger in countries more exposed to the global economy, is driven by demand shocks, persists after controlling for trade dependence, continues to hold after the financialization of commodity markets, and is reflected in international stock returns. In contrast, energy and agriculture futures also contain relevant information but mainly for countries that depend on these commodities through trade. Our findings provide global evidence in support of the informational role of commodity markets and identify industrial metals as a reliable barometer of future global economic activity.This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00899.
papers.abstract_zh: 在各商品期货板块中，只有工业金属收益能够预测未来工业生产增长以及生产商对未来经济状况预期的修正，且这一预测能力横跨众多国家。这种预测能力在更易受全球经济影响的国家更强，由需求冲击所驱动，在控制贸易依赖后依然存在，在商品市场金融化之后仍然成立，并反映在国际股票收益中。相比之下，能源和农产品期货也包含相关信息，但主要针对通过贸易依赖这些商品的国家。我们的发现提供了支持商品市场信息角色的全球性证据，并将工业金属识别为未来全球经济活动的可靠晴雨表。本文由Lukas Schmid（金融学）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00899获取。

papers.abstract_original: Normative theories assume that people have stable preferences across logically equivalent decision contexts. Preference reversals, cases where preferred options vary across decision contexts, violate this assumption and suggest that preferences are constructed during the decision-making process. We contribute to this literature by identifying a boundary condition for these context effects. We theorize that monetary preference elicitations, such as willingness to pay (WTP) and willingness to accept (WTA), evoke comparisons to external out-of-context standards, such as the market price of similar goods. These out-of-context comparisons should weaken the influence of the local context. Our theory predicts that context effects will be weaker for (1) monetary versus nonmonetary preference elicitations (e.g., WTP/WTA versus choice) and when (2) options differ on attributes highly correlated with market prices of similar goods and services. Across 22 studies, we find support for these predictions using three canonical decision context effects (intertemporal tradeoffs, framing effects, and attraction effects), incentive-compatible and stated preferences, and different response formats (binary, continuous, and mixed). Preferences for a wide range of goods and services—including baked goods, apartments, and lotteries—exhibit these patterns. Our theory explains substantial variance in context effects and offers testable predictions for when context effects will arise in research and practice.This paper was accepted by George Wu, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Funding: This work was supported by Connaught Fund.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00913.
papers.abstract_zh: 规范性理论假设人们在逻辑等价的决策情境中具有稳定的偏好。偏好反转，即偏好的选项在不同决策情境中发生变化的情况，违反了这一假设，并表明偏好在决策过程中被构建。我们通过识别这些情境效应的一个边界条件来为这一文献做出贡献。我们理论化认为，货币偏好引出，如支付意愿（WTP）和接受意愿（WTA），会引发与外部脱离情境的标准（如类似商品的市场价格）的比较。这些脱离情境的比较应该会削弱局部情境的影响。我们的理论预测，情境效应在（1）货币与非货币偏好引出（例如，WTP/WTA与选择）相比时会更弱，并且当（2）选项在与类似商品和服务的市场价格高度相关的属性上存在差异时也会更弱。在22项研究中，我们使用三种经典的决策情境效应（跨期权衡、框架效应和吸引效应）、激励相容和陈述性偏好以及不同的响应格式（二元、连续和混合），发现了对这些预测的支持。对广泛商品和服务的偏好——包括烘焙食品、公寓和彩票——表现出这些模式。我们的理论解释了情境效应中的大量方差，并为情境效应在研究和实践中何时出现提供了可检验的预测。本文由George Wu（行为经济学与决策分析领域）接受。资助：本工作得到了康诺特基金的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00913获取。

papers.abstract_original: We develop and estimate a structural model of buyers’ observational learning, search, and bidding, using unique data on in-person home viewings and transactions. We use the estimated model to quantify the welfare impact of different information disclosure rules. Our findings indicate that prohibiting the disclosure of home viewing information while permitting only the disclosure of time-on-market would extend the sale time and raise the transaction price, benefiting sellers but harming buyers on average.This paper was accepted by Raphael Thomadsen, marketing.Funding: Z. Zhou gratefully acknowledges support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72192844].Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00917.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们利用关于实地看房和交易的独特数据，开发并估计了一个买方观察学习、搜寻和投标的结构模型。我们使用估计的模型来量化不同信息披露规则的福利影响。我们的发现表明，禁止披露看房信息而仅允许披露市场停留时间，会延长销售时间并提高交易价格，使卖方受益但平均而言损害买方。本文由市场营销领域的Raphael Thomadsen接受。资助：Z. papers.abstract_original: This paper documents that the payoffs from investing in growth stocks, as measured by the decile-rank distributions (DRD) of future revenues, earnings, investment, and stock returns, follow a bimodal U-shaped pattern. In contrast, the DRD of value stocks follows a traditional bell-shaped distribution. This divergence in payoff structures suggests growth stocks are more prone to structural shocks, such as disruptive technologies. Consequently, their pricing is heavily influenced by investors’ attitude toward exceptional outcomes, resulting in lower expected stock returns in equilibrium. We find that stocks with more pronounced bimodal payoffs are associated with significantly lower subsequent stock returns.This paper was accepted by Eric So, accounting.Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00980.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文记录了投资成长型股票的收益，以未来收入、盈利、投资和股票回报的十分位排名分布（DRD）衡量，遵循双峰U型模式。相比之下，价值型股票的DRD遵循传统的钟形分布。这种收益结构的差异表明，成长型股票更容易受到结构性冲击的影响，例如颠覆性技术。因此，其定价在很大程度上受到投资者对异常结果态度的影响，导致均衡状态下预期股票回报较低。我们发现，具有更明显双峰收益的股票与随后显著较低的股票回报相关。本文由会计学领域的Eric So接受。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00980获取。

papers.abstract_original: Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) provide the most credible estimates of advertising incrementality but are difficult to scale. We propose Predicted Incrementality by Experimentation (PIE), which reframes ad measurement as a campaign-level prediction problem. PIE uses a sample of RCTs to learn a mapping from campaign features to causal effects, then applies it to campaigns not run as RCTs. Because the RCTs identify the causal effects, PIE can incorporate post-determined features—campaign-level aggregates such as test-group outcomes, exposure rates, and last-click conversions, computed after campaign completion. These metrics reflect the consumer behaviors that generate treatment effects, so they carry predictive information about incrementality, even though they would be invalid controls in a causal model. Using 2,226 Meta ad experiments, PIE achieves an out-of-sample R2=0.88 for incremental conversions per dollar, compared with R2=0.19 for industry-standard seven-day last-click attribution. In a decision-making framework, PIE disagrees with RCT-based decisions in only 8%–12% of campaigns, compared with 12%–20% for last-click attribution. We conclude that PIE can help scale causal measurement from a limited number of RCTs to a large set of nonexperimental campaigns.This paper was accepted by Raphael Thomadsen, marketing.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01108.
papers.abstract_zh: 随机对照试验（RCT）提供了最可信的广告增量效应估计，但难以规模化。我们提出通过实验预测增量效应（PIE），它将广告测量重新构建为一个活动层面的预测问题。PIE利用一组RCT样本学习从活动特征到因果效应的映射，然后将其应用于未作为RCT运行的活动。由于RCT识别了因果效应，PIE可以纳入事后确定的特征——即在活动完成后计算的活动层面汇总指标，如测试组结果、曝光率和最后点击转化。这些指标反映了产生处理效应的消费者行为，因此它们携带关于增量效应的预测信息，尽管在因果模型中它们会是无效的控制变量。使用2,226个Meta广告实验，PIE在每美元增量转化上实现了样本外R2=0.88，而行业标准的七日最后点击归因的R2=0.19。在决策框架中，PIE仅在8%–12%的活动上与基于RCT的决策不一致，而最后点击归因则为12%–20%。我们得出结论，PIE可以帮助将因果测量从有限数量的RCT扩展到大量非实验活动。本文由营销学领域的Raphael Thomadsen接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01108获取。

papers.abstract_original: This paper investigates how autonomous vehicles (AVs) may reshape morning commute travel patterns and impact parking in a central business district (CBD). We develop a continuous-time game-theoretic traffic model that takes into account key economic deterrents to driving, such as parking fees and traffic congestion, and characterize the departure time and parking location (inside or outside the CBD parking area) patterns of commuters in equilibrium. Our analysis shows that all AV commuters may choose to park outside the CBD in equilibrium, increasing both vehicle hours and vehicle miles traveled as compared with the case with all human-driven vehicles. This change increases the total system cost and suggests a potential for CBD land use changes (e.g., repurposing CBD parking spots as commercial and residential areas) after the mass adoption of AVs. To reduce the total system cost, an urban planner may regulate commuters’ decisions by adjusting parking fees and/or imposing congestion tolls as a short-term measure, or adjusting infrastructure, for example, converting CBD parking spaces to drop-off spots for AVs. Our results indicate that these measures can reduce the total system cost substantially (e.g., up to 28.5% when calibrating our model to data from Pittsburgh).This paper was accepted by Chung Piaw Teo, optimization and decision analytics.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01213.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文研究自动驾驶汽车（AVs）可能如何重塑早高峰通勤出行模式并影响中央商务区（CBD）的停车。我们构建了一个连续时间博弈论交通模型，该模型考虑了驾驶的关键经济抑制因素，如停车费和交通拥堵，并刻画了通勤者在均衡中的出发时间和停车位置（CBD停车区域内或外）模式。我们的分析表明，在均衡中，所有AV通勤者可能都选择在CBD外停车，与全部由人工驾驶车辆构成的情形相比，这会增加车辆小时和车辆行驶里程。这一变化增加了总系统成本，并表明在AV大规模采用后，CBD土地利用可能发生变化（例如，将CBD停车位重新用途化为商业和住宅区）。为降低总系统成本，城市规划者可以作为短期措施通过调整停车费和/或征收拥堵费来监管通勤者的决策，或调整基础设施，例如将CBD停车空间改造成AV下客点。我们的结果表明，这些措施可以大幅降低总系统成本（例如，在将我们的模型校准到匹兹堡数据时最高可达28.5%）。本文由优化与决策分析领域的Chung Piaw Teo接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01213获取。

papers.abstract_original: We address the joint assortment and inventory optimization problem for an online retailer facing a set of N substitutable products. The retailer must determine both the assortment and inventories of these products before the start of the selling season to maximize the expected profit. We consider a setting with dynamic SOBS, where consumers’ choices follow the Markov chain choice model. This is a challenging problem, and even computing the expected profit for a given assortment and inventory solution requires solving an intractable dynamic program. We present a sample average approximation-based algorithm for the problem that achieves a regret of O˜(NT) with respect to an linear program (LP) upper bound. Our algorithm first selects an assortment by balancing the expected revenue (from a single consumer) and the inventory cost. We do this by identifying a subset of products that can pool demand from the universe of substitutable products without significantly cannibalizing the revenue in the presence of dynamic substitution behavior of consumers. We then use a sample average approximation-based LP to decide on the inventory level for each item in the selected assortment. We numerically show that our algorithm considerably improves the performance over standard approaches from the literature on a wide range of instances of the Markov chain choice model and demonstrate that it carefully handles the inventory of products in the long tail (i.e., products with small mean total demand).This paper was accepted by Chung Piaw Teo, optimization.Funding: This work was supported by Amazon [Research Award (V. Goyal and O. El Housni)] and the National Science Foundation [Grants CMMI 1636046 (V. Goyal) and 2226900 (O. El Housni)]. The research was partially supported by RGC from Hong Kong [Grant 16215820 (G. Gallego)].Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01322.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一家在线零售商在面临一组N个可替代产品时的联合品类与库存优化问题。零售商必须在销售季开始前确定这些产品的品类和库存，以最大化预期利润。我们考虑一个具有动态SOBS的环境，其中消费者的选择遵循马尔可夫链选择模型。这是一个具有挑战性的问题，即使计算给定品类和库存解的预期利润也需要求解一个难以处理的动态规划。我们提出了一种基于样本平均近似的算法，该算法相对于线性规划（LP）上界实现了O˜(NT)的遗憾。我们的算法首先通过平衡（来自单个消费者的）预期收入与库存成本来选择品类。我们通过识别一个产品子集来实现这一点，该子集能够从可替代产品的总体中汇集需求，同时在消费者动态替代行为存在的情况下不会显著蚕食收入。然后，我们使用基于样本平均近似的LP来决定所选品类中每个商品的库存水平。我们通过数值方法表明，在马尔可夫链选择模型的大量实例上，我们的算法相比文献中的标准方法显著提高了性能，并证明它能够谨慎处理长尾产品（即平均总需求较小的产品）的库存。本文由优化领域的Chung Piaw Teo接受。资助：本工作得到了亚马逊[研究奖（V. Goyal和O. El Housni）]和国家科学基金会[资助号CMMI 1636046（V. Goyal）和2226900（O. El Housni）]的支持。本研究部分得到了香港RGC[资助号16215820（G. Gallego）]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01322获取。

papers.abstract_original: We study the design of an optimal credit registry in a general equilibrium steady-state setting where borrowers can default strategically and future access to credit markets serves as soft collateral to enforce loan repayment. We endogenize the probabilities for exclusion after default and subsequent reinstatement of clean credit records. When there are sufficient funds, optimal credit stringency is as loose as possible, subject to borrowers’ incentive constraints. When there are insufficient funds, credit stringency is driven by the need to equilibrate nonexcluded borrowers with available funds, and it increases as the imbalance grows. We examine how population growth, mortality, and persistence affect our results. Finally, we compare the simple two-tier scheme with the three-tier scheme and characterize solutions to a general N-tier registry. We show that a more graduated registry is not necessarily a better one.This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究在一个一般均衡稳态环境中，最优信贷登记系统的设计，其中借款人可以策略性违约，而未来进入信贷市场的机会充当软抵押品以强制偿还贷款。我们将违约后被排除以及随后恢复清洁信用记录的概率内生化。当资金充足时，在借款人的激励约束下，最优信贷严格程度尽可能宽松。当资金不足时，信贷严格程度由使未被排除的借款人与可用资金相均衡的需要所驱动，并随着失衡的加剧而提高。我们考察人口增长、死亡率和持续性如何影响我们的结果。最后，我们将简单的两级方案与三级方案进行比较，并刻画一般N级登记系统的解。我们表明，更细分的登记系统未必是更好的登记系统。本文由Will Cong（金融学）接受。

papers.abstract_original: Leading online service providers, as major customers of cloud computing services, are increasingly adopting a multicloud strategy to enhance service delivery across different locations. However, compatibility issues among various cloud platforms complicate the implementation of this strategy. To address this challenge, cloud providers can offer a multicloud management platform that acts as a bridge between distinct cloud environments. Although such a platform can enhance customers’ multicloud experience, it also entails additional costs for the cloud providers. Our paper examines cloud providers’ compatibility decisions and the impact of compatibility on competing cloud providers and their customers. Our findings reveal that, when compatibility is established in equilibrium, cloud providers consistently set higher prices for their resources than when compatibility is absent. Additionally, we find that a cloud provider with greater market dominance always attracts more demand, whereas the rival with smaller market dominance may experience a demand decrease. Interestingly, when a cloud provider establishes compatibility in equilibrium, the competitor’s profit always increases, although customer welfare can decline under compatibility. These insights, along with other findings presented in the paper, can support cloud providers in deciding when to establish compatibility and how to price their resources effectively. Furthermore, we provide guidelines for policymakers on when compatibility could enhance customer welfare, supporting effective implementation of compatibility strategies.This paper was accepted by D. J. Wu, information systems.Funding: S. Kumar thanks Temple Center for International Business Education and Research for partially supporting this research.Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01359.
papers.abstract_zh: 作为云计算服务的主要客户，领先的在线服务提供商越来越多地采用多云策略，以增强在不同地点的服务交付。然而，各种云平台之间的兼容性问题使这一策略的实施变得复杂。为应对这一挑战，云提供商可以提供多云管理平台，充当不同云环境之间的桥梁。尽管这样的平台可以增强客户的多云体验，但它也给云提供商带来了额外成本。本文考察了云提供商的兼容性决策以及兼容性对相互竞争的云提供商及其客户的影响。我们的发现表明，当兼容性在均衡中建立时，云提供商对其资源设定的价格始终高于兼容性不存在时。此外，我们发现具有更大市场主导地位的云提供商总是吸引更多需求，而市场主导地位较小的竞争对手可能经历需求下降。有趣的是，当一家云提供商在均衡中建立兼容性时，竞争对手的利润总是增加，尽管在兼容性下客户福利可能下降。这些洞见以及本文提出的其他发现，可以支持云提供商决定何时建立兼容性以及如何有效地为其资源定价。此外，我们为政策制定者提供了关于兼容性何时可以增强客户福利的指导，支持兼容性策略的有效实施。本文由信息系统领域的D. J. Wu接受。资助：S. Kumar感谢天普大学国际商务教育与研究中心对本研究的部分支持。补充材料：在线附录可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01359获取。

papers.abstract_original: The growing importance of content marketing on social media has made it imperative for firms to evaluate the effectiveness of their posts in driving business performance. However, academic research offers limited insight into how firm-generated content on social platforms affects performance metrics such as product sales and returns. This paper contributes to addressing that gap by examining the relationship between social media marketing on Facebook and transactional outcomes, using data from the online channel of a luxury fashion accessory manufacturer. We augment the transaction data with the firm’s Facebook posts, classifying them as either informative or persuasive. Informative posts are further distinguished based on whether they pertain to standard (ISP posts) or customizable (ICP posts) product features. Our results indicate that ISP posts are associated with increases in sales and returns, whereas ICP posts are associated with decreases in both outcomes. Moreover, we find that the associations of ISP posts with sales and returns are weaker when accompanied by persuasive content, whereas persuasive content only attenuates the relationship between ICP posts and returns. These findings are robust across alternative model specifications and estimation methods and offer valuable managerial insights for firms seeking to optimize their social media marketing strategies.This paper was accepted by D. J. Wu, information systems.Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01432.
papers.abstract_zh: 社交媒体上内容营销日益重要，使得企业必须评估其帖子在推动业务绩效方面的有效性。然而，学术研究对于社交平台上企业生成内容如何影响产品销售和退货等绩效指标提供的见解有限。本文通过使用一家奢侈时尚配饰制造商在线渠道的数据，考察Facebook上的社交媒体营销与交易结果之间的关系，为弥补这一空白做出贡献。我们用该公司的Facebook帖子扩充交易数据，将其分类为信息型或说服型。信息型帖子进一步根据其涉及标准（ISP帖子）还是可定制（ICP帖子）产品特征加以区分。我们的结果表明，ISP帖子与销售和退货的增加相关，而ICP帖子与这两种结果的减少相关。此外，我们发现当ISP帖子伴随说服型内容时，其与销售和退货的关联较弱，而说服型内容仅减弱ICP帖子与退货之间的关系。这些发现在替代模型设定和估计方法下均稳健，并为寻求优化社交媒体营销策略的企业提供了有价值的管理启示。本文由D. J. Wu，信息系统领域接受。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01432获取。

papers.abstract_original: This paper studies how product market competition shapes the impact of private equity (PE) acquisitions on consumers. We examine nursing home buyouts and observe that PE-owned facilities exhibit greater competitive sensitivity: competing more aggressively when competitive incentives are strong and exploiting market power more aggressively when competitive incentives are weak. We find that PE-owned facilities are more sensitive to local market competition—even when comparing effects only across facilities purchased as part of the same acquisition—and are more responsive to a pro-competitive policy helping consumers compare facilities. This suggests that regulators should attend to the competitive sensitivity of acquirers and the concentration of markets where acquisitions occur, as well as consider pro-competitive policies to mitigate or even reverse PE’s potentially adverse consequences.This paper was accepted by Carrie Chan, healthcare management.Funding: This work was supported by the UCLA Price Center for Entrepreneurship and Innovation and the UCLA Fink Center for Finance and Investment.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01486.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文研究产品市场竞争如何塑造私募股权（PE）收购对消费者的影响。我们考察养老院收购，并观察到PE拥有的设施表现出更大的竞争敏感性：当竞争激励强烈时更积极地竞争，当竞争激励微弱时更积极地利用市场势力。我们发现，PE拥有的设施对当地市场竞争更为敏感——即使在仅比较作为同一收购一部分被购买的设施之间的效应时也是如此——并且对帮助消费者比较设施的促进竞争政策更为敏感。这表明监管者应关注收购方的竞争敏感性以及收购发生市场的集中度，并考虑促进竞争的政策以缓解甚至逆转PE潜在的不利后果。本文由Carrie Chan接受，医疗管理领域。资助：本工作获得加州大学洛杉矶分校创业与创新Price中心和加州大学洛杉矶分校金融与投资Fink中心的资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01486获取。

papers.abstract_original: Delivery time is one of the keys to e-commerce success. Although retailers are taking steps to offer fast delivery services, these approaches are expensive, and they may not be sustainable in the long term. By leveraging a unique shift resulting from user-interface designs on eBay.com, we find that introducing a nudging-based function (i.e., a guaranteed delivery toggle) is a promising cost-effective approach that may ameliorate the relationship between slow delivery time and product sales. Specifically, our research devises three complementary studies—(1) examining the sales impact of the toggle function using a large-scale secondary data set, (2) investigating the underlying mechanism of the toggle effectiveness through laboratory and online experiments, and (3) analyzing the far-reaching impacts on consumers’ subsequent rating behaviors—to establish the external and internal validity and the robustness of this finding. We attribute the expansion of slow-delivery item sales (Study 1) to the subtle change in the design of the choice architecture from simultaneous attribute choices to sequential attribute choices (Study 2). Study 3 reveals the mitigation of dimensional rating bias toward delivery time, further interpreting the nudging effect of sequential attribute choices. Given the dilemma of e-commerce for fast-delivery provision, our research elucidates how practitioners improve their operational decisions to address the last-mile logistics problem by factoring in a simple and free delivery-related nudge.This paper was accepted by D. J. Wu, information systems.Funding: This research was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72101104, 72471106, and 72571259], and it was partially supported by the Soft Science Special Project of the Gansu Basic Research Plan [Grant 24JRZA032] and the Fundamental Research Funds for the Central Universities [Grant 2024lzujbkyqm009].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01572.
papers.abstract_zh: 配送时间是电子商务成功的关键之一。尽管零售商正在采取措施提供快速配送服务，但这些方法成本高昂，且从长期来看可能不可持续。通过利用eBay.com上用户界面设计所产生的一次独特变动，我们发现引入一种助推式功能（即保证送达切换开关）是一种有前景且具有成本效益的方法，可能改善慢速配送时间与产品销售之间的关系。具体而言，我们的研究设计了三个互补研究——（1）使用大规模二手数据集考察该切换功能的销售影响，（2）通过实验室和在线实验探究该切换功能有效性的潜在机制，以及（3）分析对消费者后续评分行为的深远影响——以确立这一发现的外部效度、内部效度和稳健性。我们将慢速配送商品销售的扩大（研究1）归因于选择架构设计的微妙变化，即从同时属性选择转变为顺序属性选择（研究2）。研究3揭示了针对配送时间的维度评分偏差的缓解，进一步解释了顺序属性选择的助推效应。鉴于电子商务在提供快速配送方面的困境，我们的研究阐明了从业者如何通过纳入一个简单且免费的配送相关助推来改进其运营决策，以应对最后一英里物流问题。本文由D. J. Wu（信息系统）接受。资助：本研究得到国家自然科学基金 [资助号72101104、72471106和72571259] 的支持，并部分得到甘肃省基础研究计划软科学专项 [资助号24JRZA032] 和中央高校基本科研业务费 [资助号2024lzujbkyqm009] 的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01572获取。

papers.abstract_original: We study a discrete-time dynamic multiway matching model. There are finitely many agent types that arrive stochastically and wait to be matched. State-of-the-art dynamic matching policies in the literature require the knowledge of all system parameters to determine an optimal basis of the fluid relaxation, and focus on controlling the number of waiting agents using only matches within the optimal basis. In this paper, we propose a primal-dual policy that schedules matches for future arrivals based on an estimator for the dual solution. Our policy does not require the knowledge of the arrival rates and operates with greater flexibility as it does not restrict matches to only the match types within an optimal basis. We show that our policy is the first to achieve constant regret at all times under unknown arrival rates, and when the arrival rates are known, it achieves the optimal scaling. Furthermore, when the arrival rates are known, the primal-dual policy significantly outperforms alternative dynamic matching policies in several numerical simulations.This paper was accepted by Baris Ata, stochastic models and simulation.Funding: J. Xu is supported in part by the National Science Foundation [Grant CCF-1856424 and NSF CAREER award CCF-2144593]. S. H. Yu is supported in part by the National Science Foundation [Grant CCF-1856424].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01668.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究一个离散时间动态多向匹配模型。存在有限多种代理类型，它们随机到达并等待匹配。文献中最先进的动态匹配策略需要知道所有系统参数，以确定流体松弛的最优基，并且仅使用最优基内的匹配来控制等待代理的数量。在本文中，我们提出一种原始-对偶策略，基于对偶解的估计器为未来到达安排匹配。我们的策略不需要知道到达率，并且由于不将匹配限制在最优基内的匹配类型，因此具有更大的灵活性。我们表明，我们的策略是首个在未知到达率下始终实现常数遗憾的策略，并且当到达率已知时，它实现了最优缩放。此外，当到达率已知时，原始-对偶策略在若干数值模拟中显著优于其他动态匹配策略。本文由Baris Ata（随机模型与模拟）接受。资助：J. Xu部分得到美国国家科学基金会[Grant CCF-1856424和NSF CAREER award CCF-2144593]的支持。S. H. Yu部分得到美国国家科学基金会[Grant CCF-1856424]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01668获取。

papers.title_zh: 多向动态匹配的常数遗憾原始-对偶策略

papers.abstract_original: The share-of-choice product design problem is to find the product, as defined by its attributes, that maximizes market share arising from a collection of customer types or segments. When customers follow a logit model of choice, the market share is given by a weighted sum of logistic probabilities, leading to the logit-based share-of-choice product design problem. In this paper, we develop a methodology for solving this problem to provable optimality. We first analyze the complexity of this problem and show that this problem is theoretically intractable: it is NP-Hard to solve exactly, even when there are only two customer types, and it is furthermore NP-Hard to approximate to within a nontrivial factor. Motivated by the difficulty of this problem, we propose three different mixed-integer exponential cone programs of increasing strength for solving the problem exactly, which allow us to leverage modern integer conic program solvers such as Mosek. Using both synthetic problem instances and instances derived from real conjoint data sets, we show that our methodology can solve large instances to provable optimality or near optimality in operationally feasible time frames and yields solutions that generally achieve higher market share than previously proposed heuristics.This paper was accepted by J. George Shanthikumar, data science.Supplemental Material: The electronic companion and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01774.
papers.abstract_zh: 选择份额产品设计问题是要找到由其属性定义的产品，使其来自一组客户类型或细分市场的市场份额最大化。当客户遵循Logit选择模型时，市场份额由Logistic概率的加权和给出，从而引出基于Logit的选择份额产品设计问题。在本文中，我们开发了一种将该问题求解至可证明最优的方法。我们首先分析该问题的复杂性，并表明该问题在理论上是难解的：即使只有两种客户类型，精确求解它也是NP-Hard的，而且在非平凡因子范围内近似它同样是NP-Hard的。受该问题难度的启发，我们提出了三种强度递增的不同混合整数指数锥规划来精确求解该问题，这使我们能够利用诸如Mosek等现代整数锥规划求解器。使用合成问题实例和来自真实联合分析数据集的实例，我们表明我们的方法可以在运营上可行的时间范围内将大型实例求解至可证明最优或接近最优，并且通常比先前提出的启发式方法获得更高的市场份额。本文由数据科学领域编辑J. George Shanthikumar接受。补充材料：电子附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01774获取。
papers.title_original: Exact Logit-Based Product Design
papers.title_zh: 精确的基于Logit的产品设计

papers.abstract_original: We study a newsvendor problem with unknown demand distribution in a nonstationary demand environment over a multiperiod time horizon. The demand in each period consists of a time-varying demand level and an additive random shock. Neither the demand level nor the random shock is separately observable. The amount of change in the demand level over the time horizon is measured by a cumulative variation metric. The problem has widespread applications, such as perishable inventory planning, staffing, and medical resource capacity planning in the wake of COVID-19. We design a family of nonparametric dynamic ordering policies, termed two-stage estimation (2SE) policies, that track the shifts in the unknown demand level while accounting for the unobservable random demand shocks. To compute the order quantity in each period, these policies only need the past demand observations, without any access to the underlying demand distribution. For a finite variation “budget,” we prove that our ordering policies are first-order optimal in the sense that their regret grows at the smallest possible rate. We also extend our analysis to the case of asymptotically large variation budgets. Through case studies based on real-life data, we show that our policies can save more than 20% of overage and underage costs, relative to policies widely used for perishable inventory replenishment and nurse staffing. Moreover, our simulation experiments indicate that our policies consistently maintain superior performance across diverse patterns of nonstationary demand environments.This paper was accepted by David Simchi-Levi, operations management.Funding: N. B. Keskin and J.-S. Song were supported by the Duke University Fuqua School of Business, and X. Min was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72401195] and the China Postdoctoral Science Foundation [2025T180216].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01823.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究一个在非平稳需求环境中、跨多期时间范围、需求分布未知的报童问题。每一期的需求由一个随时间变化的需求水平和一个加性随机冲击组成。需求水平和随机冲击均不可分别观测。需求水平在时间范围内的变化量由一个累积变异度量来衡量。该问题具有广泛的应用，例如在COVID-19之后易腐库存规划、人员配备和医疗资源能力规划。我们设计了一类非参数动态订购策略，称为两阶段估计（2SE）策略，它们跟踪未知需求水平的变化，同时考虑不可观测的随机需求冲击。为计算每一期的订购量，这些策略只需要过去的需求观测值，而无需接触潜在的需求分布。对于有限变异“预算”，我们证明我们的订购策略是一阶最优的，即其遗憾以最小可能速率增长。我们还将分析扩展到渐近大变异预算的情形。通过基于现实数据的案例研究，我们表明，相对于广泛用于易腐库存补货和护士配备的策略，我们的策略可以节省超过20%的过量成本和短缺成本。此外，我们的模拟实验表明，我们的策略在多样化的非平稳需求环境模式中始终维持优越表现。本文由运营管理领域的David Simchi-Levi接受。资助：N. B. Keskin和J.-S. Song得到杜克大学富卡商学院的支持，X. Min得到国家自然科学基金[资助编号72401195]和中国博士后科学基金[2025T180216]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01823获取。
papers.title_original: The Nonstationary Newsvendor: Data-Driven Nonparametric Learning
papers.title_zh: 非平稳报童问题：数据驱动的非参数学习

papers.abstract_original: Social media platforms are popular for advertisers to promote products to their audience via posts. Developing these posts with the appropriate number of image features is essential as these features enhance informativeness and visual complexity, impacting how users engage with posts. However, the existing literature offers a limited investigation into this topic, primarily examining low-level imagery information while overlooking high-level image features, cross-platform differences arising from different user expectations, and the tradeoffs firms must make in tailoring their strategies. To address this critical gap, we develop an optimization framework for analyzing and publishing social media image posts for different platforms within a firm’s limited budget. This optimization framework is grounded in empirical modeling of the association between image features and social media user engagement, with primary and secondary features identified using deep learning algorithms. We focus on secondary features because they add visual complexity and informativeness, are controllable by designers, and are costly to extract, underscoring the need to assess their value for engagement. We find a nonlinear association between secondary features and engagement that varies across the two platforms. The optimization framework, which models the nonlinear relationship and is tested on realistic scenarios, considers and compares our approach against commonly used strategies that allocate budgets solely based on the user bases of platforms, those that ignore secondary features, and those that do not use duplicate features that can enhance informational richness and context. We present key implications for firms seeking to maximize user engagement on social media platforms.This paper was accepted by George Shanthikumar, data science.Funding: S. Kumar was supported by the Temple Center for International Business Education and Research.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01838.
papers.abstract_zh: 社交媒体平台深受广告主欢迎，他们通过帖子向受众推广产品。开发具有适当数量图像特征的帖子至关重要，因为这些特征增强了信息性和视觉复杂性，影响用户与帖子的互动方式。然而，现有文献对这一主题的考察有限，主要研究低层次图像信息，而忽视了高层次图像特征、因不同用户期望而产生的跨平台差异，以及企业在调整策略时必须做出的权衡。为弥补这一关键空白，我们开发了一个优化框架，用于在企业有限预算内分析和发布面向不同平台的社交媒体图像帖子。该优化框架以图像特征与社交媒体用户参与度之间关联的实证建模为基础，并使用深度学习算法识别主要特征和次要特征。我们重点关注次要特征，因为它们增加视觉复杂性和信息性，可由设计者控制，且提取成本高昂，这凸显了评估其对参与度价值的必要性。我们发现次要特征与参与度之间存在非线性关联，且这种关联在两个平台之间有所不同。该优化框架对非线性关系进行建模，并在现实场景中进行了测试，它考虑并将我们的方法与常用策略进行了比较，这些策略包括仅根据平台用户基数分配预算的策略、忽略次要特征的策略，以及不使用能够增强信息丰富度和语境重复特征的策略。我们提出了对寻求在社交媒体平台上最大化用户参与度的企业的关键启示。本文由数据科学领域的George Shanthikumar接受。资助：S. Kumar获得了天普大学国际商务教育与研究中心的资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01838获取。
papers.title_original: Know Your Users via Image Analytics Before Developing Posts: Data-Driven Optimization Framework to Enhance Social Media Engagement
papers.title_zh: 在开发帖子之前通过图像分析了解你的用户：增强社交媒体参与度的数据驱动优化框架

papers.abstract_original: Common wisdom suggests that the “curse of knowledge” (COK), whereby better-informed individuals are unable to ignore their private information when forecasting others’ beliefs, reduces the quality of communication. We study how this bias affects costly information provision by a founder who wants to raise financing from an outside investor. When the founder exhibits COK about the content of her communication, there is less information provision and payoffs tend to be lower for both players. However, we show that when the founder exhibits COK about the context of her message, the bias can lead to more information production and better investment decisions. Moreover, this can exacerbate the conflict of interest between the founder and the outsider.This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting.Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01839.
papers.abstract_zh: 普遍观点认为，“知识诅咒”（COK），即信息更充分的个体在预测他人信念时无法忽视其私人信息，会降低沟通质量。我们研究了这种偏差如何影响一位希望从外部投资者处筹集资金的创始人的有成本信息提供。当创始人在其沟通内容上表现出COK时，信息提供更少，且双方的收益往往更低。然而，我们表明，当创始人在其信息背景上表现出COK时，这种偏差可能导致更多信息生产和更好的投资决策。此外，这可能加剧创始人与外部人之间的利益冲突。本文由会计学领域Ranjani Krishnan接受。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01839获取。
papers.title_original: Information Provision and the Curse of Knowledge
papers.title_zh: 信息提供与知识诅咒

papers.abstract_original: The robust multiproduct pricing problem is to determine the prices of a collection of products to maximize the worst-case revenue, where the worst case is taken over an uncertainty set of demand models that the firm expects could be realized in practice. A tacit assumption in this approach is that the pricing decision is a deterministic decision: the prices of the products are fixed and do not vary. In this paper, we consider a randomized approach to robust pricing, where a decision maker specifies a distribution over potential price vectors to maximize its worst-case revenue over an uncertainty set of demand models. We formally define this problem—the randomized robust price optimization problem—and analyze when a randomized price scheme performs as well as a deterministic scheme versus when it yields a benefit. We also propose solution methods for obtaining an optimal randomization scheme over a discrete set of candidate price vectors and show how these methods are applicable for common demand models, such as the linear, semi-log, and log-log demand models. We numerically compare the randomized and deterministic approaches on a variety of synthetic and real problem instances; on instances derived from a real grocery retail scanner data set, we show that the improvement in worst-case revenue can be as high as 92%. Using the same grocery retail scanner data set, we also show that the randomized approach can produce price prescriptions that achieve higher out-of-sample revenue than the nominal and deterministic robust approaches.This paper was accepted by Chung Piaw Teo, optimization.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01844.
papers.abstract_zh: 稳健多产品定价问题是确定一组产品的价格，以最大化最坏情况下的收入，其中最坏情况是在企业预期实践中可能实现的需求模型的不确定集上取得的。这种方法中的一个默认假设是，定价决策是确定性决策：产品价格是固定的，不会变化。在本文中，我们考虑一种随机化的稳健定价方法，其中决策者指定潜在价格向量上的一个分布，以在需求模型的不确定集上最大化其最坏情况收入。我们正式定义这一问题——随机化稳健价格优化问题——并分析随机化价格方案何时与确定性方案表现一样好，以及何时产生收益。我们还提出了在离散候选价格向量集合上获得最优随机化方案的求解方法，并展示这些方法如何适用于常见需求模型，例如线性、半对数和双对数需求模型。我们在各种合成和真实问题实例上对随机化方法和确定性方法进行了数值比较；在来自真实杂货零售扫描仪数据集的实例上，我们表明最坏情况收入的改善可高达92%。使用同一杂货零售扫描仪数据集，我们还表明随机化方法可以产生比名义和确定性稳健方法实现更高样本外收入的价格处方。本文由优化领域编辑Chung Piaw Teo接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01844获取。
papers.title_original: Randomized Robust Price Optimization
papers.title_zh: 随机化稳健价格优化

papers.abstract_original: Observable priority queues, where some customers are served ahead of others, are prevalent in many service systems, ranging from the entertainment industry to emergency departments (EDs). In this paper, we study the rational abandonment behavior of utility-maximizing customers in the context of an observable two-class priority queue and identify novel performance and pricing implications. We first characterize the structure of the rational abandonment strategy and show that it has a threshold-based last-come, first-abandon structure. We then examine the steady-state performance of the system under the rational abandonment strategy and in contrast with an exogenous abandonment model commonly used in the literature. We show that using the exogenous abandonment model could result in highly suboptimal decisions when considering capacity planning to meet target waiting times and/or abandonment rates. We further investigate optimal pricing strategies under rational abandonment. Our results highlight the importance of the timing of payments. We show that welfare maximization requires charging only a service fee and no entrance fee. In contrast, revenue maximization generally requires a combination of both an entrance and a service fee. Furthermore, welfare-maximizing prices always involve abandonment, whereas revenue maximization may require pricing strategies that prevent abandonment. Finally, we discuss the implications of our results for our motivating applications, including the perils of charging nonurgent ED patients upfront.This paper was accepted by Baris Ata, stochastic models and simulation.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01924.
papers.abstract_zh: 可观察优先队列，即一些顾客先于其他顾客获得服务，在许多服务系统中普遍存在，从娱乐行业到急诊科（EDs）皆是如此。在本文中，我们在一个可观察的两类优先队列背景下，研究效用最大化顾客的理性放弃行为，并识别出新的绩效与定价含义。我们首先刻画理性放弃策略的结构，并表明其具有基于阈值的后到先放弃结构。然后，我们考察在理性放弃策略下系统的稳态绩效，并与文献中常用的外生放弃模型进行对比。我们表明，在考虑为满足目标等待时间和/或放弃率而进行容量规划时，使用外生放弃模型可能导致高度次优的决策。我们进一步研究理性放弃下的最优定价策略。我们的结果凸显了付款时机的重要性。我们表明，福利最大化要求只收取服务费而不收取入场费。相反，收入最大化通常要求同时收取入场费和服务费。此外，福利最大化价格总是涉及放弃，而收入最大化可能要求采取防止放弃的定价策略。最后，我们讨论我们的结果对启发性应用的含义，包括向非紧急ED患者预收费用的风险。本文由Baris Ata（随机模型与仿真）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01924获取。

papers.abstract_original: Prior studies draw mixed conclusions on the market response to California SB 826, the first board gender diversity mandate in the United States. We find that these discrepancies stem from two factors: confusion about the legislative process and the use of different return methodologies. We find that the response to early dates in the legislative process yields largely insignificant and sometimes conflicting results, depending on the return methodology used. This result is consistent with our finding that many of these dates generated little interest from investors. Returns are mostly negative and significant on the date the bill was signed into law. Additionally, all models show a negative and significant relation between the signing-day return and the number of female directors needed to meet the law.This paper was accepted by Eric So, accounting.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01986.
papers.abstract_zh: 先前研究对市场对加州SB 826（美国首个董事会性别多样性强制规定）的反应得出了混杂的结论。我们发现这些差异源于两个因素：对立法过程的混淆以及使用了不同的收益计算方法。我们发现，对立法过程中早期日期的反应在很大程度上不显著，且有时相互矛盾，具体取决于所使用的收益计算方法。这一结果与我们的发现一致，即其中许多日期几乎未引起投资者的兴趣。在该法案签署成为法律之日，收益大多为负且显著。此外，所有模型都显示，签署日收益与为满足该法律所需的女性董事人数之间存在负向且显著的关系。本文由Eric So，会计学领域接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01986获取。
