papers.abstract_original: Frontline health workers are an indispensable asset in the healthcare ecosystem of low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). They not only provide clinical care to patients but also frequently shoulder nonclinical responsibilities such as inventory management. However, many lack the necessary skills to effectively manage inventories, leading to the pervasive problem of health commodity stock-outs. To address this problem, several LMICs have launched training programs aimed at enhancing the inventory management skills and capabilities of frontline health workers. Leveraging fine-grained data over a five-year period (2015–2019) from approximately 17,000 health facilities across Indonesia—where the public health supply chain operates as a hybrid push–pull model—we evaluate the impact of a large-scale inventory management training program on contraceptive stock-outs. Applying difference-in-differences estimations, we find that the training program is associated with a significant reduction in stock-outs (i.e., 6.52 percentage points, or approximately 30%). Our numerical calculations suggest that the training program prevents, on average, more than 800 unintended pregnancies and saves 4.25 maternal and newborn lives per 100,000 women of reproductive age within the catchment area of a treated health facility. A counterfactual benefit–cost analysis shows that on-site delivery of the training program (i.e., on the job within a health facility) yields operational and public health benefits that significantly exceed those achieved through off-site delivery (i.e., outside the health facility in a classroom). Our research highlights the practicality and scalability of human-capital-focused interventions in improving health commodity availability and public health outcomes in LMICs.This paper was accepted by Stefan Scholtes, healthcare management.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03696.
papers.abstract_zh: 一线卫生工作者是中低收入国家（LMICs）医疗生态系统中不可或缺的资产。他们不仅为患者提供临床护理，还经常承担库存管理等非临床职责。然而，许多人缺乏有效管理库存的必要技能，导致卫生商品缺货这一普遍问题。为解决这一问题，若干中低收入国家已启动培训项目，旨在提升一线卫生工作者的库存管理技能和能力。利用印度尼西亚约17,000家卫生机构五年期间（2015–2019）的细粒度数据——在该国，公共卫生供应链以推拉混合模式运作——我们评估了一项大规模库存管理培训项目对避孕药具缺货的影响。应用双重差分估计，我们发现该培训项目与缺货显著减少相关（即6.52个百分点，或约30%）。我们的数值计算表明，该培训项目平均在每家受训卫生机构服务范围内每100,000名育龄妇女中，防止了超过800例意外怀孕，并挽救了4.25名孕产妇和新生儿生命。一项反事实效益-成本分析显示，现场交付培训项目（即在卫生机构内边工作边培训）所产生的运营和公共卫生效益显著超过异地交付（即在卫生机构外的教室中）所取得的效益。我们的研究凸显了以人力资本为重点的干预措施在改善中低收入国家卫生商品可及性和公共卫生结果方面的实用性和可扩展性。本文已被Stefan Scholtes接受，医疗管理领域。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03696获取。

papers.title_zh: 培训中低收入国家的一线卫生工作者以减少避孕药具缺货：来自印度尼西亚的证据

papers.abstract_original: In an environment where demand is unknown to the firm, it is important to investigate how capacity adjustment and dynamic pricing can be integrated so that the firm can learn about the demand on the fly while making capacity and pricing decisions. In this paper, we design learning algorithms for the joint capacity and pricing management problem. To evaluate the performance of our algorithms, we consider a large-demand asymptotic regime where the demand and capacity are scaled up with the selling horizon T. We first establish an Ω(T3/5) lower bound on the regret under any admissible policy. We propose a novel double-trisection algorithm that utilizes pricing decisions to collect demand information and tune capacity rate levels safely, attaining an O˜(T3/5) regret upper bound that matches the lower bound. We then modify our algorithm to address the issue when the number of capacity adjustment opportunities K is limited and find that only a few opportunities to adjust capacity levels (i.e., K≳lnlnT) are sufficient to achieve the optimal regret rate. We also consider seasonal demands and provide a modified algorithm to incorporate the seasonality. We finally conduct numerical experiments on a test bed inspired by public operational and financial data.This paper was accepted by J. George Shanthikumar, data science.Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03749.
papers.abstract_zh: 在需求对企业未知的环境中，重要的是研究如何整合产能调整和动态定价，使企业能够在做出产能和定价决策的同时实时学习需求。在本文中，我们为联合产能与定价管理问题设计学习算法。为了评估我们算法的性能，我们考虑一个大规模需求渐近机制，其中需求和产能随销售时域T按比例放大。我们首先在任何可容许策略下建立Ω(T3/5)的遗憾下界。我们提出一种新颖的双三分算法，利用定价决策收集需求信息并安全地调整产能率水平，达到O˜(T3/5)的遗憾上界，与下界相匹配。然后我们修改算法以解决产能调整机会数量K有限的问题，并发现只有少数调整产能水平的机会（即K≳lnlnT）就足以实现最优遗憾率。我们还考虑季节性需求，并提供修改后的算法以纳入季节性。最后，我们在受公共运营和财务数据启发的测试平台上进行数值实验。本文由数据科学领域的J. George Shanthikumar接受。补充材料：在线附录可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03749获取。
papers.title_original: Capacity and Pricing Management with Demand Learning
papers.title_zh: 需求学习下的产能与定价管理

papers.abstract_original: Many business settings involve fluid teams, where team members come together to work on a project, after which the team is disbanded. It is well-known that coordination can be challenging and affect the performance outcomes of fluid teams. The literature has studied how several facets of experience can facilitate learning and improve outcomes for fluid teams. However, the role of experience with success and failure and its effect on improving outcomes for fluid teams has remained unexplored. In this study, we use data from the motion picture industry to examine how the experience with success and failure resident within key members of a movie production team affects profitability. Our analysis of the data for 2,091 movies released in the United States between 1999 and 2018 reveals that a movie’s profitability depends on the production team’s history with success and failure. Additionally, we find that teams with a history of success result in movies with higher profits, whereas teams with a history of failure result in movies with lower profits. We also find that increased relative dispersion in the team’s experience does not affect the movie’s profitability. Further analysis of the composition of movie teams indicates that financial performance can be significantly impacted when movie teams are predominantly composed of members with a history of success or failure. We contribute by illustrating a new measure of team experience relevant for fluid teams and by providing insights on how to compose teams based on members’ experience with success and failure.This paper was accepted by Elena Katok, operations management.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03756.
papers.abstract_zh: 许多商业环境涉及流动团队，团队成员聚集在一起从事一个项目，之后团队解散。众所周知，协调可能具有挑战性并影响流动团队的绩效结果。文献研究了经验的几个方面如何促进学习和改善流动团队的成果。然而，成功和失败经验的作用及其对改善流动团队成果的影响尚未被探索。在本研究中，我们使用电影产业的数据来检验电影制作团队关键成员所拥有的成功和失败经验如何影响盈利能力。我们对1999年至2018年间在美国上映的2,091部电影的数据分析表明，电影的盈利能力取决于制作团队的成功和失败历史。此外，我们发现具有成功历史的团队制作的电影利润更高，而具有失败历史的团队制作的电影利润更低。我们还发现，团队经验相对离散度的增加并不影响电影的盈利能力。对电影团队构成的进一步分析表明，当电影团队主要由具有成功或失败历史的成员组成时，财务绩效可能受到显著影响。我们的贡献在于提出了一种与流动团队相关的新团队经验度量，并提供了关于如何根据成员的成功和失败经验来组建团队的见解。本文被运营管理领域的Elena Katok接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03756获取。

papers.title_original: The Role of Success and Failure in Fluid Teams: Evidence from the Motion Picture Industry
papers.title_zh: 流动团队中成功与失败的作用：来自电影产业的证据

papers.abstract_original: We study periodic review perishable inventory systems with a fixed product lifetime, positive replenishment lead times, and a general issuance policy under the average cost criterion. The optimal replenishment policy for such systems is notoriously complex and computationally intractable because of the curse of dimensionality. To address this challenge, we propose a class of projected inventory level (PIL) policies, which maintain a constant expected on-hand inventory level, and compare them with conventional base-stock (BS) policies that maintain a constant inventory position. For both backlogging and lost-sales systems, we show that the best PIL policy is asymptotically optimal with large unit penalty costs for a broad class of unbounded demand distributions. When demand is bounded and the unit penalty cost is sufficiently large, we prove that the best BS policy is optimal under first-in-first-out issuance, whereas the best PIL policy is optimal under last-in-first-out issuance (under certain conditions). Furthermore, we show that both policies are asymptotically optimal as the demand population size grows large, and their optimality gaps diminish exponentially fast in backlogging systems under a broad range of issuance policies. To facilitate computation, we introduce a class of approximate PIL (APIL) policies and extend most theoretical results for PIL to the APIL policy. Numerical results show that both PIL and APIL policies perform very close to optimal and significantly outperform BS policies.This paper was accepted by Jeannette Song, operations management.Funding: X. Gong and H. Yin were partially supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72425008] and the Hong Kong Research Grants Council General Research Fund [Grant CUHK14500120]. J. Bu was partially supported by the Hong Kong Research Grants Council General Research Fund [Grant PolyU15504525].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03801.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究在平均成本准则下，具有固定产品寿命、正补货提前期和一般发放策略的周期性检查易腐库存系统。由于维数灾难，此类系统的最优补货策略以极其复杂和计算上难以处理而著称。为应对这一挑战，我们提出一类预计库存水平（PIL）策略，其维持恒定的预期在手库存水平，并将其与维持恒定库存位置的传统基本库存（BS）策略进行比较。对于缺货补货和失销系统，我们证明，对于一大类无界需求分布，在单位惩罚成本较大时，最优PIL策略是渐近最优的。当需求有界且单位惩罚成本足够大时，我们证明在先进先出发放下最优BS策略是最优的，而在后进先出发放下（在一定条件下）最优PIL策略是最优的。此外，我们证明，随着需求总体规模变得很大，两种策略都是渐近最优的，并且在缺货补货系统中，在广泛的发放策略下，它们的最优性差距以指数速度缩小。为便于计算，我们引入一类近似PIL（APIL）策略，并将PIL的大部分理论结果推广到APIL策略。数值结果表明，PIL和APIL策略的表现都非常接近最优，并显著优于BS策略。本文由Jeannette Song，运营管理接受。资助：X. Gong和H. Yin部分得到国家自然科学基金[资助号72425008]和香港研究资助局优配研究金[资助号CUHK14500120]的支持。J. Bu部分得到香港研究资助局优配研究金[资助号PolyU15504525]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03801获取。
papers.title_original: Managing Perishable Inventory Systems with Positive Lead Times: Inventory Position vs. Projected Inventory Level
papers.title_zh: 管理具有正提前期的易腐库存系统：库存位置与预计库存水平

papers.abstract_original: Since the advocacy for droit de suite in France in the 1890s, policymakers and the public have recognized artworks as intellectual property and sought to grant artists resale royalties—yet encountered heated debates and various logistical obstacles. The emergence of blockchain technology now makes automated royalty collection feasible. We examine the impact of resale royalties on artists’ pricing decisions and the overall efficiency of the art market. We build an infinite-horizon model in which an artist sells her artwork in the primary market, after which it can be resold in a sequence of secondary markets. We find that when artwork popularity is public information, royalties—acting as a tax on resales—reduce the artwork’s resale value and transaction volume, lowering the artist’s profit and leaving all market participants worse off. However, when the artist possesses superior information about artwork popularity compared with buyers, a popular artist may set an inefficiently high price to signal its appeal, which hurts primary market efficiency. In this case, royalties benefit the popular artist by reducing the unpopular artist’s incentive to mimic, thereby mitigating price distortion in the primary market. Consequently, the profit of a popular artist first increases and then decreases with the royalty rate, peaking at a unique positive rate. Social welfare may either rise or fall with the royalty rate, depending on whether the reduction in primary-market price distortion outweighs the deadweight loss in resale markets. We also analyze alternative cases of incomplete information in which either the primary buyer or neither party has superior information, and show that royalties may still increase the artist’s expected profit by reducing the price distortion in the primary market.This paper was accepted by Dmitri Kuksov, marketing.Funding: J. Chen acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 724B2030]. T. T. Ke acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72422003 and 72394395] and the General Research Fund of the Hong Kong Research Grants Council [Grant 14500421]. X. Cao acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72532007].Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03810.
papers.abstract_zh: 自1890年代法国倡导追续权以来，政策制定者和公众已认识到艺术作品属于知识产权，并寻求授予艺术家转售版税——却遭遇了激烈辩论和各种后勤障碍。区块链技术的出现如今使自动化版税征收成为可行。我们考察转售版税对艺术家定价决策及艺术市场整体效率的影响。我们构建了一个无限期界模型，其中一位艺术家在一级市场出售其艺术作品，此后该作品可在一系列二级市场中转售。我们发现，当艺术作品受欢迎程度是公共信息时，版税——作为对转售的税收——会降低艺术品的转售价值和交易量，降低艺术家的利润，并使所有市场参与者境况变差。然而，当艺术家相比买家拥有关于艺术作品受欢迎程度的更优信息时，一位受欢迎的艺术家可能设定一个低效率的高价以传递其吸引力的信号，这损害一级市场效率。在这种情况下，版税通过降低不受欢迎艺术家模仿的激励而使受欢迎的艺术家受益，从而缓解一级市场中的价格扭曲。因此，受欢迎的艺术家利润先随版税率上升而后下降，在一个唯一的正版税率处达到峰值。社会福利可能随版税率上升或下降，取决于一级市场价格扭曲的减少是否超过转售市场中的无谓损失。我们还分析了不完全信息的其他情形，其中要么一级买家、要么双方都不拥有更优信息，并表明版税仍可能通过减少一级市场价格扭曲来提高艺术家的期望利润。本文由市场营销领域的Dmitri Kuksov接受。资助：J. Chen感谢国家自然科学基金[资助编号724B2030]的财务支持。T. T. Ke感谢国家自然科学基金[资助编号72422003和72394395]以及香港研究资助局一般研究基金[资助编号14500421]的财务支持。X. Cao感谢国家自然科学基金[资助编号72532007]的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03810获取。
papers.title_original: From Canvas to Blockchain: Impact of Royalties on Art Market Efficiency
papers.title_zh: 从画布到区块链：版税对艺术市场效率的影响

papers.abstract_original: Strategic product placement can have a strong influence on customer purchase behavior in physical stores as well as online platforms. Motivated by this, we consider the problem of optimizing the placement of substitutable products in designated display locations to maximize the expected revenue of the seller. We model the customer behavior as a two-stage process: first, the customer visits a subset of display locations according to a browsing distribution; and second, the customer chooses at most one product from the displayed products at those locations according to a choice model. Our goal is to design a general algorithm that can select and place the products optimally for any browsing distribution and choice model, and we call this the Placement problem. We give a randomized algorithm that utilizes an α-approximate algorithm for cardinality-constrained assortment optimization and outputs a Θ(α)logm-approximate solution (in expectation) for Placement with m display locations—that is, our algorithm outputs a solution with value at least Ω(α)logm factor of the optimal—and this is tight in the worst case. We also give algorithms with stronger guarantees in some special cases. In particular, we give an efficient deterministic Ω(1)logm-approximation algorithm for the Markov choice model and a tight (1−1/e)-approximation algorithm for the problem when products have identical prices.This paper was accepted by Omar Besbes, revenue management and market analytics.Funding: O. El Housni received financial support from the National Science Foundation (NSF) Division of Civil, Mechanical, and Manufacturing Innovation [Grant 2226900]. R. Udwani received financial support from the NSF Division of Civil, Mechanical, and Manufacturing Innovation [Grant 2340306].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03826.
papers.abstract_zh: 战略性产品陈列会对实体店以及线上平台中的顾客购买行为产生强烈影响。受此启发，我们考虑在指定陈列位置优化可替代产品摆放以最大化卖家预期收入的问题。我们将顾客行为建模为一个两阶段过程：首先，顾客根据浏览分布访问一部分陈列位置；其次，顾客根据选择模型从这些位置所陈列的产品中选择至多一件产品。我们的目标是设计一种通用算法，能够针对任意浏览分布和选择模型最优地选择和摆放产品，我们将此称为陈列问题。我们给出一种随机化算法，该算法利用基数约束下的选品优化的α-近似算法，并为具有m个陈列位置的陈列问题输出一个（在期望意义下）Θ(α)logm-近似解——也就是说，我们的算法输出的解的值至少为最优解的Ω(α)logm倍——并且这在最坏情况下是紧的。我们还在一些特殊情形下给出具有更强保证的算法。特别地，我们为马尔可夫选择模型给出一个高效的确定性Ω(1)logm-近似算法，并针对产品价格相同的情形给出一个紧的(1−1/e)-近似算法。本文由Omar Besbes，收入管理与市场分析领域接受。资助：O. El Housni获得美国国家科学基金会（NSF）土木、机械与制造创新部的财务支持[资助号2226900]。R. Udwani获得美国国家科学基金会土木、机械与制造创新部的财务支持[资助号2340306]。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03826获取。
papers.title_original: When Location Shapes Choice: Placement Optimization of Substitutable Products
papers.title_zh: 当位置塑造选择：可替代产品的陈列优化

papers.abstract_original: Suppliers operating in developing economies may resort to compelling their workforce to engage in excessive overtime, resulting in severe physical and mental health issues for workers and the potential for significant damage to the brand image of multinational enterprises (MNEs) if these practices are exposed to the public. In this paper, we develop a game-theoretic model of a dyadic supply chain to analyze a manufacturer’s operational strategies to combat the use of excessive overtime by a supplier. These strategies encompass a stick strategy of auditing the supplier’s practice (i.e., the auditing strategy) and carrot supplier development strategies of subsidizing the supplier’s workforce retention initiative (i.e., the workforce retention subsidy strategy) and upskilling the supplier’s workers to increase their versatility (i.e., the cross-training strategy). When auditing stands as the sole viable strategy, it can effectively mitigate the supplier’s violation behavior only when the auditing accuracy is significant. In the scenario where both workforce retention subsidy and auditing are viable, interestingly, workforce retention subsidy may be a complement for auditing, contrary to the naive belief that the strategies are always substitutes in combating excessive overtime. Compared with the case when auditing is the sole viable strategy, we find that workforce retention subsidy may increase the manufacturer’s profit and reduce the supplier’s overtime simultaneously. However, the subsidy may also backfire, increasing the expected degree of excessive overtime and decreasing social welfare, when workforce retention subsidy and auditing are substitutes. Furthermore, the workforce retention subsidy could lead to a social welfare level that is even higher than that in a centralized supply chain benchmark without the workforce retention subsidy. In situations where both cross-training and auditing are viable, cross-training may also be a complement for auditing, driven by the enhanced flexibility of the workforce. However, similar to the workforce retention subsidy, cross-training may lead to a win-win outcome or backfire.This paper was accepted by Jayashankar Swaminathan, operations management.Funding: C. Jiao was partially supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72301261, 72531009, 72188101, 72471218] and the China Scholarship Council.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03852.
papers.abstract_zh: 在发展中经济体运营的供应商可能诉诸强迫其劳动力从事过度加班，导致工人严重的身心健康问题，并且如果这些做法被公之于众，可能对跨国企业（MNEs）的品牌形象造成重大损害。本文建立了一个二元供应链的博弈论模型，以分析制造商打击供应商使用过度加班的运营策略。这些策略包括审计供应商做法的“大棒”策略（即审计策略），以及补贴供应商劳动力保留倡议（即劳动力保留补贴策略）和提升供应商工人技能以增加其多面性（即交叉培训策略）的“胡萝卜”供应商发展策略。当审计是唯一可行策略时，只有当审计准确性显著时，它才能有效缓解供应商的违规行为。在劳动力保留补贴和审计均可行的情况下，有趣的是，劳动力保留补贴可能是审计的补充，这与认为这些策略在打击过度加班中总是替代的朴素信念相反。与审计是唯一可行策略的情况相比，我们发现劳动力保留补贴可能同时增加制造商的利润并减少供应商的加班。然而，当劳动力保留补贴和审计是替代品时，补贴也可能适得其反，增加过度加班的预期程度并降低社会福利。此外，劳动力保留补贴可能导致社会福利水平甚至高于没有劳动力保留补贴的集中式供应链基准。在交叉培训和审计均可行的情况下，交叉培训也可能是审计的补充，这由劳动力灵活性的增强驱动。然而，与劳动力保留补贴类似，交叉培训可能导致双赢结果或适得其反。本文由Jayashankar Swaminathan（运营管理领域）接受。资助：C. Jiao获得国家自然科学基金[资助号72301261、72531009、72188101、72471218]和中国国家留学基金管理委员会的部分支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03852获取。

papers.abstract_original: We study the impact of truthful revelation mechanisms, like fact checking, on the incentives for media outlets to produce misinformation. The existing literature suggests that such interventions will always reduce this incentive. In this paper, we consider a context in which consumers benefit both, and to varying degrees, from the truth contained in news reports and from sharing, discussing, and reacting to news stories that, independent of their truthful content, reinforce and enhance their social identity. In such a setting, we find that truthful revelation will not always decrease, and may in fact increase, the incentives for biased reporting. We identify two distinct mechanisms behind this effect. First, we show that truthful revelation may improve the ability of a biased media outlet to signal its type to consumers. Second, we find that heterogeneous preferences for misinformation endow the outlet with a demand function that may imply an increase or decrease in the incentives to produce biased news due to the stochasticity implied by the fact checking process. Finally, we provide two empirical examples that offer results that are consistent with the idea that media outlets are unlikely to reduce, and may increase, bias when they expect the truth to be revealed imminently.This paper was accepted by Raphael Thomadsen, marketing.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03896.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究事实核查等真相揭示机制对媒体机构生产错误信息激励的影响。现有文献表明，此类干预总是会降低这种激励。在本文中，我们考虑这样一种情境：消费者既从新闻报道所包含的真相中获益，也从分享、讨论和回应新闻故事中获益，且获益程度各不相同，而这些新闻故事无论其真实内容如何，都会强化和增强他们的社会认同。在这样的情境中，我们发现真相揭示并不总是会降低、事实上可能反而会增加有偏报道的激励。我们识别出这一效应背后的两种不同机制。第一，我们表明真相揭示可能提高有偏媒体机构向消费者传递其类型信号的能力。第二，我们发现对错误信息的异质性偏好赋予媒体机构一种需求函数，由于事实核查过程所隐含的随机性，该需求函数可能意味着生产有偏新闻的激励增加或减少。最后，我们提供两个实证例子，其结果与以下观点一致：当媒体机构预期真相即将被揭示时，它们不太可能减少偏见，反而可能增加偏见。本文由市场营销领域的Raphael Thomadsen接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03896 获取。
papers.title_original: Will the Truth Free Us from Misinformation?
papers.title_zh: 真相会让我们摆脱错误信息吗？

papers.abstract_original: Last-mile delivery, the most expensive stage of the shipment process, has become increasingly important in online retail, raising the strategic question of whether firms should outsource it to customers via pickup stations or offer home delivery. In this paper, we examine the economic value of last-mile delivery to inform this high-stakes decision. Partnering with Cainiao, Alibaba’s logistics platform, we exploit a quasi-experiment where home delivery service was sequentially rolled out to pickup stations in 2021. A staggered difference-in-differences design reveals that home delivery significantly increases sales and customer spending on Alibaba’s retail platform. Because last-mile delivery is labor-intensive and capacity constrained, effectively allocating delivery resources is crucial. To address this challenge, we propose a novel operations-aware targeting framework that integrates causal machine learning with constrained optimization to identify and prioritize the most valuable customers. The framework incorporates both capacity and fairness constraints to maximize sales while maintaining equitable service access. We further extend it with routing optimization, enabling value-aware delivery planning that jointly considers sales uplift and spatial efficiency. We demonstrate that the resulting targeting and routing policies significantly improve revenue performance. Taken together, we show that last-mile delivery is not merely a cost center but also a revenue driver. By adopting tailored logistics strategies that balance customer needs with resource constraints, online retailers can unlock substantial value and win the last mile of e-commerce.This paper was accepted by Jeannette Song, operations management.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03991.
papers.abstract_zh: 最后一英里配送是运输过程中最昂贵的阶段，在在线零售中已变得日益重要，这提出了一个战略问题：企业应通过自提站将其外包给顾客，还是提供送货上门。在本文中，我们考察最后一英里配送的经济价值，以为这一高风险决策提供依据。我们与阿里巴巴的物流平台菜鸟合作，利用一个准实验，其中送货上门服务在2021年依次推广到自提站。交错双重差分设计揭示，送货上门显著提高了阿里巴巴零售平台上的销售额和顾客支出。由于最后一英里配送是劳动密集型且受产能约束，有效分配配送资源至关重要。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的、考虑运营的定向框架，将因果机器学习与约束优化相结合，以识别并优先考虑最有价值的顾客。该框架纳入产能和公平约束，以在最大化销售额的同时保持公平的服务获取。我们进一步将其扩展到路径优化，实现价值感知的配送规划，同时考虑销售提升和空间效率。我们证明，由此产生的定向和路径策略显著提高了收入绩效。综上所述，我们表明最后一英里配送不仅是成本中心，也是收入驱动因素。通过采用量身定制的物流策略，在顾客需求与资源约束之间取得平衡，在线零售商可以释放巨大价值并赢得电子商务的最后一英里。本文由Jeannette Song（运营管理）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03991获取。
papers.title_original: The Value of Last-Mile Delivery in Online Retail
papers.title_zh: 在线零售中最后一英里配送的价值

papers.abstract_original: This paper reports a meta-analysis of 86 studies of the two parameters of quasi-hyperbolic (β−δ) discounting, the dominant model of self-control failures in behavioral economics. The central tenet of the model is that decision makers have a “present bias,” β, for immediate rewards, on top of standard exponential discounting of the future, δ. After correcting for selective reporting, we obtain a meta-analytic estimate of β for money of 0.938, with 95% confidence interval [0.905, 0.972]. For nonmonetary rewards, our estimate of β is 0.750, with 95% confidence interval [0.643, 0.857], and there is no evidence of selective reporting. We find that present bias for real effort, although stronger than for money, is weaker than for other rewards such as real consumption.This paper was accepted by Manel Baucells, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Funding: This research was partly supported by the Australian Government through the Australian Research Council’s Centre of Excellence for Children and Families over the Life Course [Project IDs CE140100027 and CE200100025]. S. L. Cheung received financial support from the Australian Research Council [Grant DP160101794]. A. Tymula received financial support from the University of Sydney [Bridging Grant G199763].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04003.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文报告了对86项关于准双曲（β−δ）贴现两个参数研究的元分析，准双曲贴现是行为经济学中自我控制失败的主导模型。该模型的核心原则是，决策者除了对未来进行标准指数贴现δ之外，还对即时奖励存在“现时偏差”β。在纠正选择性报告后，我们得到金钱的β元分析估计值为0.938，95%置信区间为[0.905, 0.972]。对于非货币奖励，我们的β估计值为0.750，95%置信区间为[0.643, 0.857]，并且没有选择性报告的证据。我们发现，对真实努力的现时偏差虽然强于金钱，但弱于其他奖励，如真实消费。本文由Manel Baucells接受，行为经济学与决策分析。资助：本研究部分得到澳大利亚政府通过澳大利亚研究理事会儿童与家庭生命历程卓越中心的支持[项目ID CE140100027和CE200100025]。S. papers.abstract_original: Using online lending microdata, I show that sleep has important consequences for household financial outcomes. Insufficient sleep raises default risk, particularly for loan applications made in the morning when the effects of a lack of sleep are strongest. For identification, I apply a spatial regression discontinuity design leveraging exogenous discontinuities in sunset time across time zone boundaries, supplemented by analyses utilizing daylight savings time shifts. The results suggest that a behavioral mechanism behind this effect is increased levels of heuristic thinking in the application process, signaling a lack of deliberation in acquiring additional credit under the conditions of poor sleep. These findings are consistent with laboratory studies demonstrating that sleep loss is associated with lower risk aversion and impulsivity. Overall, this study provides the first evidence of the impact of insufficient sleep on household behavior and welfare in credit markets.This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04031.
papers.abstract_zh: 利用在线借贷微观数据，我表明睡眠对家庭金融结果具有重要影响。睡眠不足会提高违约风险，尤其是对于在早晨提交的贷款申请，此时睡眠不足的影响最强。为了进行识别，我采用空间回归断点设计，利用时区边界处日落时间的外生不连续性，并辅以利用夏令时变化的分析。结果表明，这一效应背后的行为机制是申请过程中启发式思维水平上升，表明在睡眠不佳的条件下获取额外信贷时缺乏审慎思考。这些发现与实验室研究一致，后者表明睡眠缺失与较低的风险厌恶和冲动性相关。总体而言，本研究首次提供了睡眠不足对信贷市场中家庭行为和福利影响的证据。本文由Camelia Kuhnen（金融）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04031获取。

papers.abstract_original: We study and develop an algorithmic framework for incorporating “ex ante” constraints—constraints on outcomes that hold only on average—into stateful sequential search problems with costly inspection. Our framework encompasses the classical Weitzman’s Pandora’s box and its extensions to joint Markovian scheduling, which model richer processes such as multistage search with multiple layers of inspection. Ex ante constraints are particularly motivated by social considerations in algorithmic hiring, where they can adjust outcome distributions to promote equity and access. Although most work in the algorithmic fairness literature in computer science and economics has focused on incorporating such constraints into machine learning tasks like classification and regression, far less attention has been devoted to operational problems such as sequential search, with their unique intricacies. Our work aims to bridge this gap. Building on the optimality of index-based policies in the unconstrained versions of these problems, we show that optimal policies under a single ex ante constraint (e.g., demographic parity) retain an index-based structure but require (i) dual-based adjustments of the indices and (ii) randomization between two such adjustments via a “tie-breaking rule,” both easy to compute and economically interpretable. We then extend our results to multiple affine constraints by reducing the problem to a variant of the exact Carathéodory problem and providing a polynomial-time algorithm that constructs an optimal randomized dual-adjusted index-based policy satisfying all constraints simultaneously. For general affine and convex constraints, we develop a primal-dual algorithm that randomizes over a polynomial number of dual-based adjustments, yielding a near-feasible, near-optimal policy. These results rely on the key observation that a suitable relaxation of the Lagrange dual function for these constrained problems admits index-based policies akin to those in the unconstrained setting. Finally, through a numerical study, we investigate the implications of imposing socially aware ex ante constraints and their socially desirable outcomes.This paper was accepted by Vivek Farias, data science.Funding: R. Niazadeh’s research was partially supported by the Asness Junior Faculty Fellowship at The University of Chicago Booth School of Business.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04079.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究并开发了一个算法框架，用于将“事前”约束——即仅在平均意义上成立的结果约束——纳入带有昂贵检查的有状态序贯搜索问题。我们的框架涵盖了经典的Weitzman潘多拉魔盒及其向联合马尔可夫调度的扩展，后者可建模更丰富的流程，如具有多层检查的多阶段搜索。事前约束尤其受到算法招聘中社会考量的推动，在这些场景中，它们可以调整结果分布以促进公平和机会获取。尽管计算机科学和经济学中算法公平性文献的大部分工作都集中在将此类约束纳入分类和回归等机器学习任务，但对序贯搜索等运营问题的关注要少得多，而这些问题有其独特的复杂性。我们的工作旨在弥合这一差距。基于这些问题的无约束版本中指数型策略的最优性，我们表明，在单一事前约束（例如人口统计均等）下的最优策略保留了指数型结构，但需要（i）基于对偶的指数调整，以及（ii）通过“平局打破规则”在两种此类调整之间进行随机化，两者都易于计算且具有经济学可解释性。然后，我们将结果扩展到多个仿射约束，通过将问题归约为精确Carathéodory问题的一个变体，并提供一种多项式时间算法，构造出同时满足所有约束的最优随机化对偶调整指数型策略。对于一般的仿射和凸约束，我们开发了一种原始-对偶算法，在多项式数量的对偶调整上进行随机化，产生一个近似可行、近似最优的策略。这些结果依赖于一个关键观察：这些约束问题的拉格朗日对偶函数的适当松弛允许类似于无约束情形中的指数型策略。最后，通过数值研究，我们考察了施加具有社会意识的事前约束的影响及其社会合意的结果。本文由Vivek Farias，数据科学领域接受。资助：R. Niazadeh的研究部分得到芝加哥大学布斯商学院Asness Junior Faculty Fellowship的资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04079获取。

papers.abstract_original: Data-extrapolation technologies enable progress by importing and applying empirical patterns from one domain to another. Their reliance on empirical patterns, however, is also their limitation: these tools can only be applied where data are abundant. Using the setting of structural biology, I investigate the impact of a data-extrapolation technology on innovation. I exploit the variation in prior data availability to compare areas in which the tool was usable to those in which it was not. I find that the tool increased the quantity of research in data-rich areas: the resulting output yielded limited biological insights but was methodologically rigorous and contributed to downstream research.This paper was accepted by Toby Stuart, entrepreneurship and innovation.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04115.
papers.abstract_zh: 数据外推技术通过将某一领域的经验模式引入并应用于另一领域来推动进步。然而，它们对经验模式的依赖也正是其局限所在：这些工具只能应用于数据丰富的领域。本文以结构生物学为背景，考察一种数据外推技术对创新的影响。我利用先前数据可得性的差异，将可使用该工具的区域与无法使用该工具的区域进行比较。我发现，该工具增加了数据丰富区域的研究数量：由此产生的成果所带来的生物学洞见有限，但在方法上严谨，并对下游研究有所贡献。本文由创业与创新领域的Toby Stuart接收。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04115 获取。

papers.abstract_original: Do digital technologies reinforce managerial hierarchies or, instead, make them less relevant? We propose that the answer to this question depends on the nature of the technology: specifically, its relative impact on managers’ capacity to supervise and on subordinates’ need for supervision. Applying this framework to collaborative work management (CWM) technologies that facilitate real-time collaboration, communication, and task coordination, we predict that the adoption of such technologies should reduce managerial intensity and increase decentralization in organizations. To test this prediction, we use a difference-in-differences design on a novel data set built from over 26 million job listings (Lightcast) and over 20 million social profiles (Revelio) matched to 3,017 U.S. public firms in Compustat, which we track over the period from 2010 to 2019. We find that over the observation window, CWM technology adopters show a 3% reduction in managerial intensity and a 5%–7% increase in nonmanagerial skills linked to decentralization in their job postings in the years following adoption. The pattern of results is robust to a battery of validations, alternative measures, and specifications, and it strongly supports the idea that these technologies enable collaboration and make organizations less hierarchical along the dimensions that we studied.This paper was accepted by Sameer Srivastava, organizations.Funding: P. Gulati acknowledges financial support from the UCL School of Management, the Ian Potter ‘93 PhD Award at INSEAD, and the Will Mitchell Dissertation Research Grant. P. Puranam acknowledges financial support from the Desmarais Fund at INSEAD for the Organizations & Algorithms Project.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04127.
papers.abstract_zh: 数字技术是强化了管理等级制度，还是反而使其变得不那么重要？我们提出，这一问题的答案取决于技术的性质：具体而言，取决于其对管理者监督能力的相对影响以及对下属被监督需求的相对影响。将这一框架应用于促进实时协作、沟通和任务协调的协作工作管理（CWM）技术，我们预测此类技术的采用应会降低组织中的管理强度并提高分权化程度。为检验这一预测，我们使用双重差分设计，基于一个新颖数据集，该数据集由超过 26 百万条职位招聘信息（Lightcast）和超过 20 百万条社交档案（Revelio）构建，并与Compustat中 3,017 家美国上市公司匹配，我们追踪这些公司从 2010 年到 2019 年的情况。我们发现，在观察窗口期内，CWM技术采用者在采用后的年份中，其职位招聘信息显示管理强度下降 3%，与分权化相关的非管理技能增加 5%–7%。这一结果模式在一系列验证、替代度量和设定下均稳健，并有力支持了以下观点：这些技术促进了协作，并使我们所研究的维度上组织变得更加扁平化。本文由组织学领域的Sameer Srivastava接受。资助：P. papers.abstract_original: We propose deep neural networks for data-driven stochastic optimization. Using historical data (covariates, decisions, costs), we propose to train a neural network to predict the objective value as a function of both the decision and covariate. After training, for a given covariate, this predicted objective is optimized over the decision variables using gradient-based methods with analytical gradients and Hessians. Performance is characterized by neural network generalization bounds. Comprehensive experiments on newsvendor, personalized assortment pricing, and call center staffing problems demonstrate our method’s strength over existing approaches such as conditional stochastic optimization and analytical approximations, especially when (i) the objective function is unknown, (ii) moderate to large data sets are available, or (iii) the problem structure resists simple parametric approximations.This paper was accepted by Chung Piaw Teo, optimization and decision analytics.Funding: The research of N. Chen is supported by the UTMM MARC Grant and the IMI Research Grant. The research of J. Milner is supported by NSERC [Grant 453954].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04141.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了用于数据驱动随机优化的深度神经网络。利用历史数据（协变量、决策、成本），我们提出训练一个神经网络来预测作为决策和协变量函数的目标值。训练完成后，对于给定的协变量，使用基于梯度的方法以及解析梯度和海森矩阵，在决策变量上优化该预测目标。性能由神经网络泛化界来刻画。在报童问题、个性化品类定价和呼叫中心人员配置问题上的综合实验表明，我们的方法优于条件随机优化和解析近似等现有方法，尤其是在以下情况下：(i) 目标函数未知，(ii) 可获得中到大型数据集，或 (iii) 问题结构难以进行简单的参数近似。本文由Chung Piaw Teo（优化与决策分析）接受。资助：N. papers.abstract_original: The rarity of objectively known probabilities undermines the risk-ambiguity dichotomy, challenging the practical relevance of related theories. We return to classical lotteries—coins, dice, and similar devices—which inspired early probability theories through the idea of equiprobable outcomes and are widely considered strong candidates for objective probability. We adapt axioms of expected utility for risk to advocate average utility for classical lotteries, highlighting their conceptual affinity. Any general unknown event is conceived as a collection of possible classical-lottery frequencies, consistent with the ambiguity literature, and we suggest normative principles for their aggregation into an indifferent matching frequency. These principles identify a model in the spirit of the smooth model of ambiguity; the agent assigns subjective probabilities over the frequencies and aggregates them via a nonlinear mixture. The nonlinearity reflects the agent’s distinct attitudes toward classical-lottery frequencies versus subjective probabilities; a concave mixture, for example, captures ambiguity aversion. Our approach provides a concrete justification for the distinct attitudes and presents several advantages for model elicitation. We illustrate the theory’s applicability through examples and, especially, social policy evaluation where the veil of ignorance can be seen as a classical lottery.This paper was accepted by Manel Baucells, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Funding: J. Li was supported by the General Research Fund of the Hong Kong Research [Grant Council under research project LU13500322]. I. Tsetlin and F. Wang do not have fundings that need to be disclosed.
papers.abstract_zh: 客观已知概率的稀缺性削弱了风险-模糊二分法，挑战了相关理论的实践相关性。我们回到古典彩票——硬币、骰子和类似装置——它们通过等概率结果的思想启发了早期概率理论，并被广泛认为是客观概率的有力候选。我们为风险调整期望效用公理，以倡导古典彩票的平均效用，突出其概念上的亲缘性。任何一般未知事件被构想为可能的古典彩票频率的集合，这与模糊性文献一致，我们提出将其聚合为无差异匹配频率的规范性原则。这些原则确定了一个具有模糊性平滑模型精神的模型；代理人赋予频率主观概率，并通过非线性混合将其聚合。这种非线性反映了代理人对古典彩票频率与主观概率的不同态度；例如，凹混合捕捉了模糊厌恶。我们的方法为这种不同态度提供了具体理由，并在模型引出方面呈现出若干优势。我们通过示例，尤其是社会政策评估来说明该理论的适用性，其中无知之幕可以被视为一种古典彩票。本文由Manel Baucells接受，行为经济学与决策分析。资助：J. Li受到香港研究资助局[研究项目LU13500322下的资助]的一般研究基金资助。I. Tsetlin和F. Wang没有需要披露的资助。

papers.abstract_original: Supply uncertainty, characterized by stochastic lead times and random supply quantities, has attracted increasing attention from academia, industries, and governments, particularly in the aftermath of the COVID-19 pandemic. In this paper, we consider the problem of managing lost-sales inventory systems with general supply uncertainty: stochastic lead times and random supplies. Unlike the previous studies, we assume the decision maker has no prior information on the stochastic demand and supply. We propose the first provably effective learning algorithm for inventory management problems with censored demand and supply data under general supply uncertainty. Then, we establish a cumulative regret of O˜(L+poly(L¯)·T) for this learning algorithm compared with the best constant-order policy, where L¯ is the upper bound of the random part, and L is the deterministic part of the stochastic lead times. We also conduct numerical experiments to demonstrate the effectiveness of our algorithm. Our approach lies in developing a new framework for transformed convexity. Furthermore, we address the unique challenges of our problem through new techniques, for example, estimating the long-run cost by establishing coupling and concentration results utilizing the system structures. These techniques are also of independent interest. Beyond our problem, our framework provides broad implications for other operations management (OM) problems exhibiting transformed convexity.This paper was accepted by J. George Shanthikumar, data science.Funding: J. Lyu and Y. Zhou are supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 52494974]. S. Yuan is supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72588101, 72425008].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04203.
papers.abstract_zh: 以随机提前期和随机供应数量为特征的供应不确定性，已日益受到学术界、产业界和政府的关注，尤其是在COVID-19疫情之后。在本文中，我们考虑管理具有一般供应不确定性的缺货销售库存系统的问题：随机提前期和随机供应。与以往研究不同，我们假设决策者对随机需求和供应没有先验信息。我们提出了第一个可证明有效的学习算法，用于在一般供应不确定性下处理具有截尾需求和供应数据的库存管理问题。然后，我们为该学习算法建立了与最佳常数订货策略相比的累积遗憾O˜(L+poly(L¯)·T)，其中L¯是随机部分的上界，L是随机提前期的确定性部分。我们还进行了数值实验以证明我们算法的有效性。我们的方法在于开发了一个用于变换凸性的新框架。此外，我们通过新技术解决了我们问题的独特挑战，例如，利用系统结构建立耦合和集中结果来估计长期成本。这些技术也具有独立的研究价值。在我们的问题之外，我们的框架对其他表现出变换凸性的运营管理（OM）问题具有广泛的启示。本文由J. George Shanthikumar，数据科学接受。资助：J. Lyu和Y. Zhou得到国家自然科学基金[资助号52494974]的支持。S. Yuan得到国家自然科学基金[资助号72588101、72425008]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04203获取。

papers.abstract_original: We study the dynamics of firm-bank relationships following corporate acquisitions using a novel firm-bank data set for 23 European countries over 2008–2014. Our data allows us to track changes in both firm ownership and bank relationships over time. To examine the effect of ownership change on bank relationships, we combine a difference-in-differences approach with matching. We find that the majority of acquisitions are associated with substantial changes in bank relationships of target firms. Acquiring firms actively change the composition of these relationships, incorporating banks with superior knowledge of the target’s local market or with expertise in the target’s industry. This reallocation appears to mitigate informational frictions associated with the acquisition. Our findings are consistent with theories of financial intermediation that emphasize the role of banks in accumulating and providing soft information about the real economy.This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance.Funding: This work used the Dutch national e-infrastructure with the support of the SURF Cooperative [Grant EINF-9542].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04231.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们使用涵盖23个欧洲国家在2008–2014年间的新型企业-银行数据集，研究公司收购后企业-银行关系的动态变化。我们的数据使我们能够追踪企业所有权和银行关系随时间的变化。为了检验所有权变更对银行关系的影响，我们将双重差分方法与匹配相结合。我们发现，大多数收购都伴随着目标企业银行关系的重大变化。收购方积极改变这些关系的构成，纳入对目标企业当地市场有更深入了解或具备目标企业所在行业专业知识的银行。这种重新配置似乎缓解了与收购相关的信息摩擦。我们的发现与强调银行在积累和提供实体经济软信息方面作用的金融中介理论相一致。本文由金融学领域的Bo Becker接受。资助：本工作使用了荷兰国家电子基础设施，并得到SURF合作组织[资助号EINF-9542]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04231获取。

papers.abstract_original: Rapid advancement in self-driving technology has brought mobile retail into the spotlight. Motivated by its potential, we present a model, theory, and insights into the operations of mobile retail, where a fleet of wheeled stores traverses a service region, selectively seeks locations in which to perch, and fulfills local customer demand. The goal of retailers is to strike a balance between perching and migrating to maximize total revenue. To dispatch such stores, retailers need to consider the following time-sensitive factors: (i) how busy the service is, (ii) how soon customers will arrive, and (iii) how quickly freshness decays. We propose and analyze a model that incorporates these factors into the classical traveling salesman problem (TSP), which we call the “time-sensitive TSP.” Using the continuous approximation approach, we derive the optimal revenue as well as the upper and lower bounds in the asymptotic regime as candidate locations increase to infinity. The tightness of the bounds is validated. Our analysis demonstrates that store mobility creates value by bringing proximity to customers. We further uncover the effects of these time-sensitive features on decision making. Specifically, the scaling relationship between revenue and fleet size is affected by customer tardiness and busyness. Busyness determines stores’ ability to expand their service, whereas tardiness affects how effectively stores can utilize the initial high-freshness period. These findings deepen our understanding of mobile retail operations.This paper was accepted by Karan Girotra, operations management.Funding: J. Cao acknowledges the support from McCombs Research Excellence Grant. W. Qi acknowledges the support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72242106, 72188101, and 72521001].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04259.
papers.abstract_zh: 自动驾驶技术的快速发展使移动零售成为关注焦点。受其潜力的启发，我们针对移动零售的运营提出了一个模型、理论及洞见。在移动零售中，一支由车轮上的商店组成的车队在服务区域内穿行，有选择地寻找停驻地点，并满足当地顾客需求。零售商的目标是在停驻与迁移之间取得平衡，以最大化总收入。为了调度这些商店，零售商需要考虑以下时间敏感因素：(i) 服务有多繁忙，(ii) 顾客多久会到达，以及 (iii) 新鲜度衰减有多快。我们提出并分析了一个将这些因素纳入经典旅行商问题（TSP）的模型，我们称之为“时间敏感TSP”。使用连续近似方法，我们推导出当候选地点增加到无穷大时，渐近情形下的最优收入以及上界和下界。这些界的紧致性得到了验证。我们的分析表明，商店的移动性通过使商店接近顾客而创造价值。我们进一步揭示了这些时间敏感特征对决策的影响。具体而言，收入与车队规模之间的标度关系受到顾客迟到和繁忙程度的影响。繁忙程度决定了商店扩展其服务的能力，而迟到则影响商店能够多有效地利用初始的高新鲜度时期。这些发现加深了我们对移动零售运营的理解。本文由运营管理领域的Karan Girotra接受。资助：J. Cao感谢McCombs Research Excellence Grant的支持。W. Qi感谢国家自然科学基金[资助号72242106、72188101和72521001]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04259获取。

papers.abstract_original: We identify latent demands in index option markets using a sign-restricted vector autoregression (VAR) and highlight the bias from treating (equilibrium) net demand as exogenous. Market-maker and end-user demand curves are far from infinitely elastic as assumed by some models, but elasticities exceed existing estimates for equities. Characterizing demand curves provides insights into the structure of index option markets. Deteriorating market conditions are associated with right shifts of the latent demand curves. The at-the-money (ATM) (out-of-the-money (OTM)) markets for calls and puts are mainly driven by end-user (market-maker) demand, and end-user (market-maker) ATM (OTM) call option demand predicts S&P500 returns.This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04263.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们使用符号限制向量自回归（VAR）识别指数期权市场中的潜在需求，并强调将（均衡）净需求视为外生变量所产生的偏差。做市商和最终用户的需求曲线远非某些模型假设的无限弹性，但弹性超过了现有对股票的估计。刻画需求曲线为指数期权市场的结构提供了洞见。市场状况恶化与潜在需求曲线的右移相关。平值（ATM）（虚值（OTM））看涨和看跌期权市场主要由最终用户（做市商）需求驱动，而最终用户（做市商）ATM（OTM）看涨期权需求预测标普500回报。本文被金融领域的Lukas Schmid接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04263获取。

papers.abstract_original: Motivated by the need for more efficient and reliable methods of group testing during widespread infectious outbreaks, this paper introduces a novel operational improvement to the widely used Dorfman’s group testing procedure, where a single test is conducted on the pooled sample, followed by individual testing of positive pools. Our method minimizes a weighted sum of testing volume and misclassifications, taking prevalence rates and interindividual Pearson correlation coefficients as inputs, and employs a distributionally robust optimization (DRO) framework to address the ambiguity in the joint infection distribution induced by these correlations. We study two correlation structures within a population. In single-cluster cases, where all subject pairs share equal correlation, we connect our analysis to Nash equilibrium principles and show that higher correlation favors larger testing groups, whereas higher prevalence often calls for individual testing. In multicluster cases, where the population consists of several intracorrelated but interindependent clusters, we highlight the effectiveness of mixed-cluster testing strategies, particularly under low prevalence and correlation. This is a notable addition to the prevailing view that advocates pooling correlated individuals. We provide polynomial-time solutions for both correlation structures and demonstrate the trade-offs and benefits of our DRO approach through a thorough comparison with stochastic alternatives. Using a case study based on a real-world COVID-19 data set, we show that our proposed pooling strategy can save up to 0.1 tests per individual compared with an independence-based pooling scheme and up to 0.5 tests per individual compared with a heuristic pooling strategy implemented in the studied region.This paper was accepted by Jeannette Song, operations management.Funding: This research was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72293582 and 72422005], the Hong Kong Research Grants Council [Collaborative Research Fund C6103-20GF, General Research Fund 14210523, 16209923, and 16213424], and the Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada [Grants RGPIN-2024-05910 and DGECR-2024-00094].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04308.
papers.abstract_zh: 受在广泛传染病暴发期间对更高效、更可靠分组检测方法需求的启发，本文对广泛使用的Dorfman分组检测程序提出了一种新颖的运营改进，即对合并样本进行单次检测，随后对阳性池进行个体检测。我们的方法最小化检测量与误分类的加权和，以患病率和个体间皮尔逊相关系数为输入，并采用分布稳健优化（DRO）框架来处理由这些相关性所诱导的联合感染分布中的模糊性。我们研究总体内的两种相关结构。在单簇情形中，即所有受试者配对具有相同相关性，我们将分析与纳什均衡原理相联系，并表明更高的相关性有利于更大的检测组，而更高的患病率往往需要个体检测。在多簇情形中，即总体由若干簇内相关但簇间独立的簇组成，我们强调混合簇检测策略的有效性，尤其是在低患病率和低相关性下。这是对主张合并相关个体的主流观点的一个重要补充。我们为两种相关结构提供多项式时间解，并通过与随机替代方案的全面比较展示我们DRO方法的权衡与收益。使用基于真实世界COVID-19数据集的一个案例研究，我们表明，与基于独立性的合并方案相比，我们提出的合并策略每人最多可节省0.1次检测，与所研究地区实施的启发式合并策略相比，每人最多可节省0.5次检测。本文由运营管理领域编辑Jeannette Song接受。资助：本研究得到国家自然科学基金[资助编号72293582和72422005]、香港研究资助局[协作研究基金C6103-20GF，一般研究基金14210523、16209923和16213424]以及加拿大自然科学与工程研究理事会[资助编号RGPIN-2024-05910和DGECR-2024-00094]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04308 获取。

papers.abstract_original: As ride-sharing becomes an integral part of ride-hailing platforms, understanding its operational and economic implications is crucial. Although shared rides can improve system efficiency and reduce congestion, they also introduce trade-offs, such as longer wait times and rider discomfort. In this paper, we develop a game-theoretic queueing model to examine how a platform operating with one of three objectives, i.e., volume, revenue, or social welfare maximization, sets prices for solo and shared rides, while self-interested riders decide whether to request a ride and, if so, whether to share. Our analysis uncovers a counterintuitive pricing pattern in stark contrast to the standard pricing theory: a platform that aims to maximize volume or social welfare may charge higher prices for both solo and shared rides than when it pursues revenue maximization. Because ride-sharing expands service capacity and improves society-wide service access (particularly for riders not so sensitive to the discomfort of sharing), a volume-maximizing platform and a social planner tend to induce more ride-sharing than a revenue-centric platform. Increased ride-sharing, in turn, further relieves platform congestion, decreases riders’ average wait times, and boosts their willingness to pay for both shared and solo services. That said, a platform may shut down shared services in small markets with low arrival rates of riders, as the extended rider-pairing process can make the entire system less efficient than one with only solo services. Finally, although ride-sharing always (weakly) enhances a specific targeted performance metric desired by the platform, its effect on rider welfare is more nuanced. Under volume or revenue maximization, ride-sharing expands service access and benefits riders overall. However, under social welfare maximization, it may reduce total rider surplus, as the platform restricts service access to prevent excessive discomfort borne by sharing riders from outweighing the overall gains in the platform’s operational efficiency. We calibrate the model and illustrate our insights using the Chicago ride-hailing data.This paper was accepted by Karan Girotra, operations management.Funding: This research was supported by the Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada [Grant RGPIN-2021-04295].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04324.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着拼车成为网约车平台不可或缺的一部分，理解其运营和经济影响至关重要。尽管共享出行可以提高系统效率并减少拥堵，但它们也引入了权衡，例如更长的等待时间和乘客不适。在本文中，我们建立了一个博弈论排队模型，以考察一个以三种目标之一（即销量、收入或社会福利最大化）运营的平台如何为独享和共享出行定价，同时自利的乘客决定是否请求出行，以及如果请求，是否选择共享。我们的分析揭示了一种与标准定价理论形成鲜明对比的反直觉定价模式：一个旨在最大化销量或社会福利的平台，可能对独享和共享出行都收取比其追求收入最大化时更高的价格。由于拼车扩大了服务能力并改善了全社会范围的服务可及性（特别是对不太敏感于共享不适的乘客），一个销量最大化平台和一个社会规划者往往比一个以收入为中心的平台诱导更多的拼车。拼车的增加反过来进一步缓解平台拥堵，降低乘客的平均等待时间，并提高他们为共享和独享服务付费的意愿。话虽如此，在乘客到达率较低的小市场中，平台可能会关闭共享服务，因为延长的乘客配对过程可能使整个系统比仅提供独享服务的系统效率更低。最后，尽管拼车总是（弱）提升平台所期望的某一特定目标绩效指标，但其对乘客福利的影响更为微妙。在销量或收入最大化下，拼车扩大了服务可及性并总体上使乘客受益。然而，在社会福利最大化下，它可能降低乘客总剩余，因为平台限制服务可及性，以防止共享乘客承受的过度不适超过平台运营效率总体收益。我们校准了模型，并使用芝加哥网约车数据说明了我们的洞见。本文由Karan Girotra（运营管理）接受。资助：本研究得到加拿大自然科学与工程研究理事会[Grant RGPIN-2021-04295]的资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04324获取。
papers.title_original: Shared or Solo? Platform Pricing and Rider Choices in Ride-Hailing
papers.title_zh: 共享还是独享？网约车中的平台定价与乘客选择

papers.abstract_original: We examine the decision to become an entrepreneur in the context of online business. Using data on entrepreneurs from a large e-commerce marketplace in China, we find that individuals are more likely to start online businesses after observing the salient success of nearby stores. Leveraging the platform’s store rating system and detailed geographic information in rural China, we show that an upgrade in a local store’s rating leads to a significant increase in new store entries nearby. This effect diminishes with physical distance and intensifies with the salience of the upgrade. However, these entry decisions appear to be suboptimal; entrants driven by local upgrade events underperform in sales and are more likely to exit, especially during downturns in overall market conditions. Our findings are consistent with salience-based theories of decision making, in which individuals overweight highly visible local information.This paper was accepted by Lin William Cong, finance.Funding: C. Lin acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Project 72192841] and the Research Grant Council of the Hong Kong SAR, China [Project T35-710/20-R]. S. Liu acknowledges financial support from the Research Grant Council of the Hong Kong SAR, China [Project 12503324].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04409.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们在在线商业的背景下考察成为企业家的决策。利用来自中国一个大型电子商务市场企业家的数据，我们发现，个体在观察到附近店铺的显著成功后，更有可能创办在线企业。借助该平台的店铺评级系统和中国农村的详细地理信息，我们表明，当地店铺评级的升级会导致附近新店铺进入显著增加。这一效应随着物理距离的增加而减弱，并随着升级的显著性而增强。然而，这些进入决策似乎并非最优；受当地升级事件驱动的进入者在销售方面表现不佳，且更有可能退出，尤其是在整体市场状况低迷期间。我们的发现与基于显著性的决策理论一致，即个体会过度重视高度可见的本地信息。本文已被Lin William Cong接受，金融领域。资助：C. Lin感谢国家自然科学基金[项目72192841]和香港特别行政区研究资助局[项目T35-710/20-R]的财务支持。S. Liu感谢香港特别行政区研究资助局[项目12503324]的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04409获取。
papers.title_original: The Salience of Entrepreneurship: Evidence from Online Business
papers.title_zh: 创业的显著性：来自在线商业的证据

papers.abstract_original: This study investigates how the platform’s disintermediation governance policy (i.e., the policy that disciplines complementors and consumers circumventing the platform to transact directly) affects complementors’ product innovation and launching strategies. We leverage a change in the Communication Guideline on Amazon.com (i.e., the focal platform), which prohibits complementors (i.e., sellers) from sending external website links, telephone numbers, and email addresses to buyers in direct messaging, as a policy shock to Amazon complementors. By conducting a difference-in-differences analysis, we find that the governance policy significantly reduces product innovation on the focal platform among complementors with direct selling channels as measured by the number of new products and the innovativeness of new products. These main effects are mitigated by complementor reputation on Amazon and complementor multihoming. Mechanism analyses show that complementors with direct selling channels increase the number of new products launched through those channels after the policy change (i.e., the switching effect). Moreover, complementors tend to strategically switch innovative and high-value products away from the focal platform while leaving less innovative but price-competitive products on it to attract Amazon consumers before diverting to their direct selling channels (i.e., the bait effect). Our results have implications for platform governance policies regarding disintermediation and its impact on complementor product innovation and launch strategies both on and off the focal platform.This paper was accepted by D. J. Wu, information systems.Funding: G. Gu gratefully acknowledges research support from the USC Marshall School of Business.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04439.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究考察平台的去中介化治理政策（即约束互补者和消费者绕过平台直接交易的政策）如何影响互补者的产品创新和发布策略。我们利用Amazon.com（即焦点平台）上《沟通指南》的一项变更作为对Amazon互补者的政策冲击，该变更禁止互补者（即卖家）在直接消息中向买家发送外部网站链接、电话号码和电子邮件地址。通过进行双重差分分析，我们发现，该治理政策显著降低了具有直销渠道的互补者在焦点平台上的产品创新，以新产品数量和新产品的创新性衡量。这些主效应被互补者在Amazon上的声誉和互补者的多归属所缓解。机制分析表明，具有直销渠道的互补者在政策变更后增加了通过这些渠道发布的新产品数量（即转换效应）。此外，互补者倾向于策略性地将创新性和高价值产品从焦点平台转移出去，同时将创新性较低但价格有竞争力的产品留在焦点平台上，以吸引Amazon消费者，然后再引流至其直销渠道（即诱饵效应）。我们的结果对有关去中介化的平台治理政策及其对互补者产品创新和发布策略在焦点平台内外的影响具有启示意义。本文由D. J. Wu，信息系统接受。资助：G. Gu感谢USC Marshall商学院的 research support。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04439获取。
papers.title_original: Disintermediation Governance and Complementor Innovation: An Empirical Look at Amazon.com
papers.title_zh: 去中介化治理与互补者创新：对Amazon.com的实证考察

papers.abstract_original: This paper examines how infrastructure development affects stock market participation in India using trading data from more than 13 million individuals. Using the phased rollout of a national road construction program as a natural experiment, we find that new road connections lead to significant increases in both trading activity and the number of investors. These effects are driven primarily by new market entrants and are most pronounced in rural and intermediately developed regions as well as among male and middle-aged investors. Two main mechanisms explain these patterns. First is an information channel: improved connectivity reduces information frictions, facilitates portfolio diversification, and encourages investment in geographically distant firms. Second is a financial inclusion channel: road construction spurs new bank branch openings—especially by state-owned banks—expanding access to financial services and enabling portfolio reallocation from savings and consumption to equity markets. We find limited evidence for a third possible channel, risk sharing, whereby participation rises with road connectivity in regions with high income volatility. Whereas initial investor returns are positive, long-term performance declines and risk-taking increases, suggesting that infrastructure expansion promotes market participation but not necessarily optimal investment outcomes.This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04496.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文使用来自超过13百万个体的交易数据，考察基础设施发展如何影响印度的股票市场参与。使用一项国家道路建设计划的分阶段推出作为自然实验，我们发现新的道路连接导致交易活动和投资者数量显著增加。这些效应主要由新市场进入者驱动，并且在农村和中等发达地区以及男性和中年投资者中最为明显。两种主要机制解释了这些模式。第一是信息渠道：改善的连通性减少了信息摩擦，促进了投资组合多样化，并鼓励对地理上遥远公司的投资。第二是金融包容渠道：道路建设刺激了新的银行分支机构开设——尤其是国有银行——扩大了金融服务的获取，并使投资组合从储蓄和消费重新配置到股票市场。我们发现对第三种可能渠道——风险分担——的证据有限，即在高收入波动地区，参与度随道路连通性上升。虽然初始投资者回报为正，但长期表现下降且风险承担增加，表明基础设施扩张促进了市场参与，但不一定带来最优投资结果。本文由Lukas Schmid接受，金融。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04496获取。
papers.title_original: The Road to Stock Market Participation
papers.title_zh: 通往股票市场参与之路

papers.abstract_original: Wisdom of crowds estimates can be compromised when some agents’ predictions are systematically biased. A natural remedy is to aggregate predictions from a subset of more accurate agents rather than the entire crowd. I propose cluster weight on advice (CWOA), a novel “two-shot” algorithm to identify a more accurate subgroup in a single-prediction-problem context. CWOA first applies kernel density estimation to identify clusters of similar initial predictions. If multiple clusters emerge—indicating potential heterogeneity in agents’ information—the algorithm proceeds to present a piece of numerical advice (e.g., the group mean) and elicit updated predictions. This enables the calculation of the weight on advice (WOA)—the scaled magnitude of each agent’s belief revision. CWOA then averages the updated predictions within the cluster with the lowest mean WOA. A behavioral model and simulations explain both why and when cluster-level WOA signals accuracy. Better-informed agents—having already incorporated higher-quality information—perceive less corrective value in the advice and therefore, exhibit lower WOA. CWOA does not require agents to know the true biases or the composition of the crowd; a modest relative advantage in perceived estimation bias by better-informed agents may be sufficient, even under misperceptions of variance, advice quality, and psychological biases in advice taking. Empirically, I first test and confirm the model’s key insight in a controlled experimental setting. I then validate CWOA’s performance across multiple preregistered and archival data sets, including a study in which numerical advice comes from artificial intelligence. CWOA consistently outperforms benchmarks, including the state-of-the-art metaprediction-based methods.This paper was accepted by Jack Soll, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04499.
papers.abstract_zh: 当一些代理人的预测存在系统性偏差时，群体智慧的估计可能会受到损害。一个自然的补救办法是从一个更准确的代理人子集而非整个群体中聚合预测。我提出建议权重聚类（CWOA），一种新颖的“两阶段”算法，用于在单一预测问题情境中识别更准确的子群。CWOA首先应用核密度估计来识别相似初始预测的聚类。如果出现多个聚类——表明代理人信息可能存在异质性——该算法接着呈现一条数值建议（例如，组均值）并引出更新后的预测。这使得能够计算建议权重（WOA）——每个代理人信念修正的缩放幅度。CWOA随后对平均WOA最低的聚类内的更新预测取平均。一个行为模型和模拟解释了聚类层面WOA为何以及何时预示准确性。信息更充分的代理人——已经纳入了更高质量的信息——认为建议的纠正价值较小，因此表现出较低的WOA。CWOA不要求代理人知道真实偏差或群体构成；信息更充分的代理人在感知估计偏差上的适度相对优势可能就足够了，即使在对方差、建议质量以及建议采纳中的心理偏差存在误判的情况下也是如此。在实证上，我首先在受控实验环境中检验并确认了该模型的关键洞见。随后，我在多个预注册和档案数据集上验证了CWOA的表现，包括一项数值建议来自人工智能的研究。CWOA始终优于基准，包括最先进的基于元预测的方法。本文已被Jack Soll接受，行为经济学与决策分析领域。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04499获取。
papers.title_original: Leveraging Collective Advice-Taking Behavior to Infer Accuracy and Improve the Wisdom of Crowds
papers.title_zh: 利用集体建议采纳行为推断准确性并改进群体智慧

papers.abstract_original: Modeling and leveraging consumers’ dynamic search behaviors presents significant business opportunities. Although deep learning methods excel at processing vast consumer data for predictive tasks, their opaque nature limits interpretability and fails to explicitly model consumer decision making. In contrast, economic theory suggests that consumers follow a sequential search strategy, evaluating alternatives until they find the best match for their preferences. To bridge this gap, we propose the sequential search transformer (SST), a deep structural econometric model that integrates deep learning with sequential search theory to model search and purchase decisions. SST unifies these two approaches into an end-to-end trainable model, improving both predictive accuracy and policy evaluation capabilities. Unlike conventional deep learning models, SST explicitly models consumer decision making, and unlike existing sequential search models, it enables consumer behavior modeling across sessions and sequentially resolves utility uncertainty for searched items. We provide a theoretical analysis of the identification strategy for the SST model and show that all parameters can be identified under the proposed framework. Then, we apply SST to a data set with detailed clickstream data collected from a U.S. e-commerce website. Empirical evaluations show that SST outperforms state-of-the-art deep learning and structural models in predicting consumer searches and purchases. Moreover, policy experiments demonstrate SST’s effectiveness in optimizing product recommendations and new product promotion strategies, ultimately enhancing consumers experience and driving revenue growth.This paper was accepted by Hemant Bhargava, information systems.Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04540.
papers.abstract_zh: 对消费者动态搜索行为进行建模并加以利用，带来了重大的商业机会。尽管深度学习方法在处理海量消费者数据以完成预测任务方面表现出色，但其不透明的性质限制了可解释性，并且未能明确地对消费者决策进行建模。相比之下，经济理论表明，消费者遵循序贯搜索策略，评估各个备选项，直到找到最符合其偏好的选择。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了序贯搜索Transformer（SST），这是一种深度结构计量经济学模型，将深度学习与序贯搜索理论相结合，以对搜索和购买决策进行建模。SST将这两种方法统一为一个端到端可训练的模型，同时提高了预测准确性和政策评估能力。与传统深度学习模型不同，SST明确地对消费者决策进行建模；与现有序贯搜索模型不同，它能够跨会话对消费者行为进行建模，并序贯地解决已搜索项目的效用不确定性。我们提供了对SST模型识别策略的理论分析，并表明在所提出的框架下所有参数均可被识别。随后，我们将SST应用于一个从美国电子商务网站收集的包含详细点击流数据的数据集。实证评估表明，SST在预测消费者搜索和购买方面优于最先进的深度学习和结构模型。此外，政策实验表明，SST在优化产品推荐和新产品推广策略方面具有有效性，最终提升消费者体验并推动收入增长。本文由信息系统领域的Hemant Bhargava接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04540获取。
papers.title_original: Sequential Search Transformer: A Deep Structural Econometric Model
papers.title_zh: 序贯搜索Transformer：一种深度结构计量经济学模型

papers.abstract_original: Online communities can create complex knowledge products, such as software, by leveraging collaboration and division of labor between their core members and the crowd across tasks. Recent literature has focused on how incentives stimulate crowd contributions. Limited attention has been paid to potential intergroup spillovers, that is, how incentivizing crowd contributions affects nonincentivized core members’ contributions. In this paper, we examine how core members of the Python developer community responded to the Internet Bug Bounty program, an initiative that offers monetary incentives for bug reporting by the crowd. Using a difference-in-differences strategy and the Java community as the control group, we find that the Python core members reduced their contributions to the incentivized task of bug reporting after the program’s implementation. Importantly, they also reduced their contributions to the nonincentivized task of enhancement reporting, a critical knowledge creation task for improving Python. Such reduction has led to a decline in the overall contributions of enhancement reports and related code commits to Python. Further analysis suggests that the negative intergroup spillover of the incentive on core members’ nonincentivized task contributions can plausibly be explained by reduced intertask learning. Our study offers implications for crowdsourcing, the design of incentives for digital public goods, and task delegation.This paper was accepted by Anindya Ghose, information systems.Funding: This research is supported in part by the HKSAR General Research Fund Project 16503620.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04544.
papers.abstract_zh: 在线社区可以通过利用核心成员与大众之间跨任务的协作和分工，创造出复杂的知识产品，例如软件。近期文献关注激励如何刺激大众贡献。但人们对潜在的群际溢出效应关注有限，即激励大众贡献如何影响未受激励的核心成员的贡献。在本文中，我们考察Python开发者社区的核心成员如何回应互联网漏洞赏金计划，该计划为大众报告漏洞提供金钱激励。使用双重差分策略并以Java社区作为对照组，我们发现Python核心成员在该计划实施后减少了对受激励任务即漏洞报告的贡献。重要的是，他们还减少了对未受激励任务即改进报告的贡献，而改进报告是改进Python的一项关键知识创造任务。这种减少导致对Python的改进报告及相关代码提交的总体贡献下降。进一步分析表明，激励对核心成员未受激励任务贡献的负面群际溢出，可以合理地由跨任务学习减少来解释。我们的研究对众包、数字公共物品的激励设计以及任务委派具有启示意义。本文由信息系统领域的Anindya Ghose接受。资助：本研究部分得到香港特别行政区一般研究基金项目16503620的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04544获取。
papers.title_original: Incentivizing Crowds and Intergroup Spillovers: Evidence from the Internet Bug Bounty Program
papers.title_zh: 激励众包与群际溢出效应：来自互联网漏洞赏金计划的证据

papers.abstract_original: Banks’ lending technology hinges on their handling of soft and hard information in dealing with different types of credit demand. Through assembling a novel data set on banks’ investment in information technologies (IT), this paper provides concrete empirical evidence on how banks adapt their lending technologies. We find investment in communication IT is associated with improving banks’ ability to produce and transmit soft information, whereas investment in software IT helps enhance banks’ hard information processing capacity. We exploit policies that affect geographic regions differentially to show causally that banks respond to an increased demand for small business credit (mortgage refinance) by increasing their spending on communication (software) IT spending. We also find that the entry of fintech induces commercial banks to increase their investment in IT—more so in the software IT category.This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance.Funding: Z. He acknowledges financial support from the John E. Jeuck Endowment at the University of Chicago Booth School of Business, as most of the work was done while he worked at the University of Chicago.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04608.
papers.abstract_zh: 银行的贷款技术取决于其在应对不同类型信贷需求时对软信息和硬信息的处理。通过汇集一套关于银行信息技术（IT）投资的新颖数据集，本文提供了关于银行如何调整其贷款技术的具体经验证据。我们发现，通信IT投资与银行生产和传递软信息能力的提升相关，而软件IT投资则有助于增强银行的硬信息处理能力。我们利用对不同地理区域产生差异化影响的政策，以因果方式表明，银行通过增加通信（软件）IT支出，来应对小企业信贷（抵押贷款再融资）需求的增加。我们还发现，金融科技的进入促使商业银行增加其IT投资——在软件IT类别中更是如此。本文由金融领域编辑Bo Becker接受。资助：Z. He感谢芝加哥大学布斯商学院John E. Jeuck捐赠基金提供的财务支持，因为大部分工作是在他任职于芝加哥大学期间完成的。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04608获取。

papers.abstract_original: We examine the impact of working from home (WFH) practices on the financial services industry, focusing on sell-side equity analysts. We find that analysts who previously benefited from access to in-person interactions with other informed parties experience a greater decline in earnings forecast accuracy following the COVID lockdown and the shift to WFH. Notably, the informational advantage associated with the in-person access disappears during the lockdown and returns once restrictions are lifted. Our results are stronger for all-star analysts and analysts with shorter coverage periods, suggesting that all-star analysts rely relatively more on access to in-person interactions prelockdown and that accumulated firm-specific knowledge mitigates the loss of in-person interactions. Our results remain robust across alternative analyst performance measures. We conclude that, despite recent advances in communications technology, AI, and machine learning, in-person interactions remain a unique and difficult to substitute information channel for sell-side research providers and that WFH impedes information flows between market participants in capital markets.This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting.Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04637.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察了居家办公（WFH）实践对金融服务业的影响，重点关注卖方股票分析师。我们发现，此前受益于与其他知情方进行面对面交流机会的分析师，在COVID封锁和转向居家办公之后，其盈利预测准确度出现了更大的下降。值得注意的是，与面对面接触相关的信息优势在封锁期间消失，并在限制解除后恢复。我们的结果对于明星分析师和覆盖期较短的分析师更为显著，这表明明星分析师在封锁前相对更依赖面对面交流的机会，而积累的公司特定知识缓解了面对面交流的丧失。我们的结果在替代的分析师绩效指标下保持稳健。我们得出结论：尽管通信技术、人工智能和机器学习近期取得了进步，面对面交流对于卖方研究提供者而言仍然是一种独特且难以替代的信息渠道，而居家办公阻碍了资本市场中市场参与者之间的信息流动。本文由会计学领域的Suraj Srinivasan接受。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04637获取。

papers.abstract_original: We study a two-stage newsvendor model where the initially uncertain mean demand is revealed midstream, allowing for a second, costlier order to be placed. The two-stage process is relevant to many retailers who have access to two supply options: a long-lead, low-cost option where orders need to be placed under much demand uncertainty, and a short-lead, high-cost option after a signal is revealed that updates the mean demand. We introduce a forecast evolution model that describes how the initial forecast for mean demand varies in response to the signal, which generalizes the popular additive and multiplicative martingale model of forecast evolution (MMFE). We show that the optimal first-stage order solves a simple ordinary differential equation (ODE), whereas the second-stage order is analytically available. We characterize asymptotics for the first-stage order and expected profit as the forecasted mean demand grows, and propose a simple, asymptotically optimal heuristic. We apply our study to data from a national retail chain, where we calibrate our model by maximum likelihood estimation (MLE). The comparison of several heuristic policies, as well as two benchmarks, shows the efficacy of our method. When the signal is more uncertain (e.g., for product lines with impulse- and trend-driven purchases), our heuristic with a simple adjusted critical fractile outperforms benchmarks; otherwise, the classic newsvendor solution performs well and is asymptotically optimal. We also extend the approach to distribution-free settings and capacitated systems.This paper was accepted by Jeannette Song, operations management.Funding: This work was supported by the Guangdong Key Lab of Mathematical Foundations for Artificial Intelligence [Grant 72192805], the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72401245], Imperial Business School (School Research Fund), and Shenzhen Stability Science Program 2022.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04692.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究一个两阶段报童模型，其中初始不确定的平均需求在中途被揭示，从而允许进行成本更高的第二次订货。这一两阶段过程与许多拥有两种供应选择的零售商相关：一种是在需求高度不确定下需要下单的长提前期、低成本选择，另一种是在揭示更新平均需求的信号之后的短提前期、高成本选择。我们引入一个预测演化模型，描述平均需求的初始预测如何随信号而变化，该模型推广了流行的加性和乘性鞅预测演化模型（MMFE）。我们证明，最优的第一阶段订货量求解一个简单的常微分方程（ODE），而第二阶段订货量可以解析获得。我们刻画了当预测平均需求增长时第一阶段订货量和期望利润的渐近性质，并提出一个简单且渐近最优的启发式方法。我们将研究应用于一家全国性零售连锁店的数据，并通过最大似然估计（MLE）校准我们的模型。对若干启发式策略以及两个基准的比较显示了我们的方法的有效性。当信号更加不确定时（例如，对于冲动型和趋势驱动购买的产品线），我们采用简单调整临界分位数的启发式方法优于基准；否则，经典报童解表现良好且渐近最优。我们还将该方法扩展到无分布假设的情形和产能受限系统。本文由运营管理领域的Jeannette Song接受。资助：本工作得到广东省人工智能数学基础重点实验室[资助号72192805]、国家自然科学基金[资助号72401245]、帝国理工商学院（学院研究基金）以及深圳稳定科学项目2022的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04692获取。
papers.title_original: Sourcing with Demand Updates
papers.title_zh: 需求更新下的采购

papers.abstract_original: Despite their potential to advance financial inclusion and improve business outcomes, digital payment solutions have low adoption rates among retail merchants in developing economies. Prior interventions have tackled prepurchase frictions such as awareness and affordability, showing limited success. We instead examine postpurchase frictions in the merchant onboarding journey, focusing on installation complexity and value uncertainty. We implement a randomized field experiment with 479 cash-only retailers in Mexico, testing interventions modeled on customer success management (CSM)—a marketing function widely used by business-to-business technology companies to onboard and retain clients, but not previously examined causally. In the first treatment group (T1: n = 159), we tackle installation complexity by introducing a CSM to support system integration for a provided digital payment solution. In the second treatment group (T2: n = 162), we further tackle value uncertainty by adding a second CSM to support value realization. Relative to the control group (n = 158), long-term adoption increased by 21.4 percentage points in T1 and by an additional 13.4 points in T2. Mechanism evidence shows that system integration primarily operates on the extensive margin of ensuring a functioning device in-store and substitutes for missing digital capacity, which constitutes merchants’ digital savviness and the local installed base of cardholders. By contrast, value realization operates on the intensive margin of usage and complements existing digital capacity. Cost-benefit analyses and spillover analyses support the scalability of our interventions. These findings offer insights into promoting the diffusion of digital payments.This paper was accepted by Raphael Thomadsen, marketing.Funding: This research was supported by the Stanford King Center on Global Poverty and Development, the World Bank’s Latin America and the Caribbean Gender Innovation Lab (LACGIL) with the Umbrella Facility for Gender Equality (UFGE), and the MasterCard Center for Inclusive Growth. Further support is acknowledged from the Leonard L. Berry Chair in Services Marketing at Mays Business School.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04703.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管数字支付解决方案具有促进金融普惠和改善经营成果的潜力，但在发展中经济体的零售商户中采用率较低。此前的干预措施解决了购前摩擦，如认知和可负担性，但成效有限。我们转而考察商户入驻过程中的购后摩擦，重点关注安装复杂性和价值不确定性。我们在墨西哥的479家仅收现金的零售商中实施了一项随机实地实验，测试以客户成功管理（CSM）为蓝本的干预措施——CSM是一种被企业对企业技术公司广泛用于客户入驻和留存的营销职能，但此前未被因果性地考察过。在第一个处理组（T1：n = 159）中，我们通过引入一名CSM来支持所提供数字支付解决方案的系统集成，以解决安装复杂性问题。在第二个处理组（T2：n = 162）中，我们进一步通过增加第二名CSM来支持价值实现，以解决价值不确定性问题。相对于对照组（n = 158），长期采用率在T1中提高了21.4个百分点，在T2中又额外提高了13.4个百分点。机制证据表明，系统集成主要在广延边际上发挥作用，即确保店内设备正常运行，并替代缺失的数字能力，后者构成商户的数字素养和当地持卡人装机基础。相比之下，价值实现主要在使用强度这一集约边际上发挥作用，并与现有数字能力形成互补。成本效益分析和溢出分析支持我们干预措施的可扩展性。这些发现为促进数字支付的扩散提供了洞见。本文由营销学领域的Raphael Thomadsen接受。资助：本研究得到斯坦福大学全球贫困与发展国王中心、世界银行拉丁美洲和加勒比性别创新实验室（LACGIL）与性别平等伞形基金（UFGE）以及万事达卡包容性增长中心的支持。还感谢梅斯商学院服务营销Leonard L. Berry教席的进一步支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04703获取。

papers.abstract_original: This paper empirically investigates how exposures of an industry’s cash flows and stock returns to discount rate shocks are affected by the market concentration of its upstream and downstream industries. In the cross-section of U.S. industries, we find that industries’ cash flows and stock returns are more negatively exposed to fluctuations in the aggregate discount rate if their upstream or downstream industries are more concentrated. These industries also have higher expected stock returns and costs of capital. Our study highlights the role of vertical competition in determining firm risk exposure and expected returns.This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance.Funding: K. C. J. Wei received partial financial support from the Research Grants Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China [Project 15510222].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04715.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文实证研究了一个行业的现金流和股票收益对贴现率冲击的暴露如何受其上游和下游行业市场集中度的影响。在美国行业的横截面中，我们发现，如果行业的上游或下游行业更加集中，其现金流和股票收益对总体贴现率波动的负向暴露更强。这些行业还具有更高的预期股票收益和资本成本。我们的研究强调了纵向竞争在决定企业风险暴露和预期收益中的作用。本文由Lukas Schmid，金融领域接受。资助：K. C. J. Wei获得中国香港特别行政区研究资助委员会的部分财务支持[项目15510222]。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04715获取。
