papers.title_zh: 动态合谋、纵向竞争与系统性风险

papers.abstract_original: We evaluate the extent to which small businesses maintain an online presence and estimate the impact of digital representation on business performance. Looking at a review platform, we find that roughly 18% of bars and restaurants in our sample do not have a listing as of the end of 2017, even though creating one is free. We then estimate the effect of adding a new listing using tax records on revenues combined with temporal variation in listing activity as well as a natural experiment that added over a thousand businesses to the platform via a data acquisition. The results suggest that new listings increase revenues in the range of 5%–10%; however, these effects vary substantially across establishments. Establishments that struggle to develop a reputation (e.g., nonchains or those in tourist areas) and those with a higher quality of product (e.g., larger restaurants or those with good reviews) experience larger increases after being listed.This paper was accepted by Duncan Simester, marketing.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04716.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们评估了小企业维持在线存在的程度，并估计了数字化呈现对企业绩效的影响。通过考察一个评论平台，我们发现，截至2017年底，我们样本中大约18%的酒吧和餐厅没有列表，尽管创建列表是免费的。然后，我们使用税收记录中的收入数据，结合列表活动的时间变化，以及一项通过数据收购将一千多家企业添加到该平台的自然实验，估计了添加新列表的效果。结果表明，新列表使收入增加约5%–10%；然而，这些效果在不同机构之间差异很大。难以建立声誉的机构（例如，非连锁店或位于旅游区的机构）以及产品质量较高的机构（例如，较大的餐厅或拥有好评的餐厅）在被列入列表后经历了更大的增长。本文由市场营销领域的Duncan Simester接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04716获取。
papers.title_original: Getting on the Map: The Impact of Online Listings on Business Performance
papers.title_zh: 登上地图：在线列表对企业绩效的影响

papers.abstract_original: Does AI democratize knowledge production or amplify existing disparities? We investigate this tension by studying the deployment of neural machine translation across more than 100 Wikipedia language communities. Leveraging rich, fine-grained data and exogenous variation from a natural experiment, we uncover the “AI democratization paradox,” where the technology simultaneously drives democratizing and concentrating forces. AI lowered barriers, leading to a substantial increase in content creation across diverse target languages without sacrificing quality or readership. However, the benefits were concentrated: well-resourced communities captured disproportionate gains—three to four times larger than mid-tier editions. Whereas editors actively leveraged AI to address representation gaps, translating female biographies at twice the expected rate, structural constraints still limited the impact in high-need areas. We conclude that technological solutions alone cannot overcome structural inequalities; AI’s distributional impact is contingent on the interplay between technological capabilities and existing social structures.This paper was accepted by Anindya Ghose, information systems.Funding: This work was supported by the Wikimedia Research & Technology Fund and European Union – NextGenerationEU funds, Component M4.C2, Investment 1.1, PRIN 2022 PNRR, CUP: J53D23015440001.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04717.
papers.abstract_zh: 人工智能是使知识生产民主化，还是放大现有差距？我们通过研究神经机器翻译在超过100个维基百科语言社区中的部署来考察这一张力。利用丰富、细粒度的数据以及来自自然实验的外生变异，我们揭示了“人工智能民主化悖论”，即该技术同时驱动民主化力量和集中化力量。人工智能降低了门槛，导致多种目标语言的内容创作大幅增加，且未牺牲质量或读者群。然而，收益是集中的：资源充足的社区获得了不成比例的收益——比中等层级版本大三到四倍。尽管编辑者积极利用人工智能来弥补代表性差距，以两倍于预期的速度翻译女性传记，但结构性约束仍限制了其在高需求领域的影响。我们得出结论，仅靠技术解决方案无法克服结构性不平等；人工智能的分配影响取决于技术能力与现有社会结构之间的相互作用。本文由信息系统领域的Anindya Ghose接受。资助：本研究得到维基媒体研究与技术基金以及欧盟NextGenerationEU资金的支持，组成部分M4.C2，投资1.1，PRIN 2022 PNRR，CUP：J53D23015440001。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04717获取。
papers.title_original: The AI Democratization Paradox: Evidence from Decentralized Knowledge Communities
papers.title_zh: 人工智能民主化悖论：来自去中心化知识社区的证据

papers.abstract_original: Prior research indicates that social capital constrains opportunistic behavior and facilitates cooperation in bilateral relationships. We hypothesize that firms conducting business with high social capital customers are perceived by their banks as having lower supply chain risk and document a negative association between suppliers’ loan spreads and the social capital of their major customers. Our cross-sectional analyses show that the negative association is stronger when (1) suppliers make more relationship-specific investments or have weaker bargaining power; and (2) customers’ information environment is more opaque. Further analyses reveal that customers’ social capital has a positive impact on their supplier firms’ nonpricing loan terms. Taken together, our findings indicate that customers’ social capital engenders a spillover effect along the supply chain, enabling suppliers to enjoy lower borrowing costs and more favorable nonpricing loan terms by mitigating the hold-up risks they face.This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting.Funding: Y. Guan received financial support from Nanyang Technological University [Start-up Grant 021234-00001]. X. Li received financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72302180] and the China Postdoctoral Science Foundation [Grants 2025T180187 and 2021M692542]. H. Wu received financial support from City University of Hong Kong.Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04778.
papers.abstract_zh: 先前研究表明，社会资本约束机会主义行为并促进双边关系中的合作。我们假设，与高社会资本客户开展业务的企业被其银行认为具有较低的供应链风险，并记录了供应商贷款利差与其主要客户社会资本之间的负相关关系。我们的横截面分析表明，当（1）供应商进行更多关系专用性投资或议价能力较弱时；以及（2）客户的信息环境更不透明时，这种负相关关系更强。进一步分析揭示，客户的社会资本对其供应商企业的非定价贷款条款有正向影响。综上所述，我们的发现表明，客户的社会资本在供应链中产生溢出效应，使供应商能够通过缓解其面临的套牢风险而享受更低的借贷成本和更有利的非定价贷款条款。本文由会计学领域的Ranjani Krishnan接受。资助：Y. Guan获得南洋理工大学[启动资助021234-00001]的财务支持。X. Li获得国家自然科学基金[资助号72302180]和中国博士后科学基金[资助号2025T180187和2021M692542]的财务支持。H. Wu获得香港城市大学的财务支持。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04778获取。

papers.title_zh: 社会资本沿供应链的溢出效应：来自债务成本的证据

papers.abstract_original: Investing in children’s human capital reduces business investments for U.S. entrepreneurial households. Using financial account data of 90,000 small businesses linked to their owners and a regression discontinuity design that compares the business performance of households with college-aged dependents (18–22) to those with near-college-aged dependents (14–17), I show that business revenues and expenses decline sharply when owners’ children reach age 18. Despite the declines, profitability and productivity remain largely unaffected, suggesting a general downsizing rather than a loss in efficiency. Heterogeneity analysis shows that downsizing is concentrated among highly indebted owner households and businesses with volatile cash flows. For each dollar increase in household spending associated with a child turning 18, business expenses decline by $2.26. These findings are consistent with entrepreneurial parents reallocating capital from business investments toward their children’s human capital, as both compete for the same pool of internal family financial resources. This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04789.
papers.abstract_zh: 对子女的人力资本投资减少了美国创业家庭的商业投资。利用90,000家小企业与其所有者关联的金融账户数据，以及一个比较有大学适龄受抚养人（18–22岁）家庭与有接近大学适龄受抚养人（14–17岁）家庭商业表现的断点回归设计，我表明当所有者的子女达到18岁时，企业收入和支出急剧下降。尽管出现下降，盈利能力和生产率基本未受影响，表明这是一次普遍性的规模缩减而非效率损失。异质性分析表明，规模缩减集中在高负债的所有者家庭和现金流波动的企业中。对于与子女年满18岁相关的家庭支出每增加一美元，企业支出下降$2.26。这些发现与创业父母将资本从商业投资重新配置到子女的人力资本相一致，因为两者竞争同一池的家庭内部金融资源。本文由金融学领域的Camelia Kuhnen接受。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04789获取。

papers.abstract_original: The tax avoidance literature identifies dozens of variables that are related to corporate tax avoidance, but it lacks a framework for understanding the relative importance of these variables and the theories that drive these relations. We distill decades of tax avoidance research into key theories and create a unified sample that contains 31 independent variables from prior literature to quantify the relative and total importance of proposed explanations. Using Shapley value variance decomposition, we show that investment-related factors and operating metrics dominate effective tax rate (ETR) measures and consistently rank high across a range of tax avoidance proxies. When we examine the relative importance of time-invariant effects, we find that manager, firm, and segment fixed effects explain the greatest variation in tax avoidance. We offer several actionable opportunities for future research and offer several key takeaways for researchers and policymakers.This paper was accepted by Eric So, accounting.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04839.
papers.abstract_zh: 避税文献识别了数十个与公司避税相关的变量，但缺乏一个框架来理解这些变量的相对重要性以及驱动这些关系的理论。我们将数十年的避税研究提炼为关键理论，并创建了一个统一样本，其中包含来自先前文献的31个自变量，以量化所提出解释的相对重要性和总体重要性。使用Shapley值方差分解，我们表明与投资相关的因素和经营指标在有效税率（ETR）指标中占主导地位，并在一系列避税代理变量中始终排名靠前。当我们考察时不变效应的相对重要性时，我们发现管理者、公司和分部固定效应解释了避税中最大的变异。我们为未来研究提供了若干可操作的机遇，并为研究人员和政策制定者提供了若干关键启示。本文由会计领域的Eric So接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04839获取。
papers.title_original: Explaining Corporate Tax Avoidance
papers.title_zh: 解释公司避税

papers.abstract_original: Does the offshoring of production degrade or enhance the innovative capabilities of manufacturing firms? We contribute to this debate with causal evidence that offshoring impacts both the level and nature of innovation. Exploiting a policy shock that differentially affected the ability of Taiwanese firms to offshore production of certain goods to China, we find a decline in innovation levels and a shift from product to process innovation in the technologies directly related to product categories that could be offshored more easily after the policy shock. However, we also find evidence that the policy shock led to a reallocation of research effort within the firm, raising innovative effort in product categories not directly impacted by the shock and shifting them toward product innovation.This paper was accepted by Alfonso Gambardella, business strategy.Funding: This work was supported by the Mack Institute for Innovation Management, Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania, and the National Science Foundation [Grant 1360170] and the Portuguese National Science Foundation.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04944.
papers.abstract_zh: 生产的离岸外包是降低还是提升了制造企业的创新能力？我们以因果证据为这场辩论做出贡献，表明离岸外包同时影响创新的水平和性质。利用一项政策冲击——该冲击对台湾企业将某些商品的生产离岸外包至中国的能力产生了差异化影响——我们发现，在政策冲击后更容易离岸外包的产品类别直接相关的技术中，创新水平下降，并且从产品创新转向工艺创新。然而，我们也发现证据表明，该政策冲击导致企业内研究努力的重新配置，提高了未直接受冲击影响的产品类别的创新努力，并将其转向产品创新。本文由商业战略领域的Alfonso Gambardella接受。资助：本工作得到宾夕法尼亚大学沃顿商学院Mack创新管理研究所、国家科学基金会[资助号1360170]以及葡萄牙国家科学基金会的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04944获取。
papers.title_original: Does Offshoring Production Reduce Innovation? Firm-Level Evidence from Taiwan
papers.title_zh: 生产离岸外包会减少创新吗？来自台湾的企业层面证据

papers.abstract_original: Asteroids and other near-Earth objects pose a significant ongoing threat to our planet with the potential for catastrophic effects on human life, the environment, and the global economy. Advance warning would be necessary to deflect any object on a collision course with Earth, but detection and tracking technologies require substantial financial commitments. This paper presents a multiattribute utility framework to analyze whether and which detection technologies are worthwhile. This approach provides a rigorous and systematic understanding of the uncertainties, multiple objectives, and tradeoffs inherent in decisions involving low-probability, high-consequence events. The model shows that the detection technology investment decision is driven more by the abundant population of smaller (<140 meters in diameter) undiscovered near-Earth objects than by any other size category. In addition, we find that the preferred investment alternative varies substantially over a range of plausible value tradeoffs that a decision maker might assign to each human fatality, a well-studied economic measure used by governments and policymakers that is called the value of a statistical life. The model we present allows a decision maker to jointly examine the role of risk and ambiguity preferences in determining the best alternative, and we further extend the framework to consider how a decision maker might evaluate alternatives when the threat affects a larger group of people while the economic cost of investment is borne by a smaller subset of stakeholders.This paper was accepted by George Wu, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04948.
papers.abstract_zh: 小行星和其他近地天体对我们的星球构成重大的持续威胁，可能对人类生命、环境和全球经济造成灾难性影响。要偏转任何与地球碰撞轨道上的物体，提前预警是必要的，但探测和跟踪技术需要大量的资金投入。本文提出了一个多属性效用框架，以分析探测技术是否值得投资以及哪些技术值得投资。这种方法提供了对涉及低概率、高后果事件的决策中固有的不确定性、多重目标和权衡的严谨而系统的理解。模型表明，探测技术投资决策更多地由大量较小（直径<140米）的未发现近地天体所驱动，而非任何其他尺寸类别。此外，我们发现，在决策者可能赋予每例人类死亡的一系列合理价值权衡范围内，首选的投资方案差异很大，这一价值权衡是一种被政府 and 政策制定者广泛研究的经济衡量指标，称为统计生命价值。我们提出的模型允许决策者联合考察风险和模糊性偏好在确定最佳方案中的作用，我们进一步扩展该框架，以考虑当威胁影响更大群体而投资的经济成本由较小子集利益相关者承担时，决策者如何评估备选方案。本文由行为经济学与决策分析领域的George Wu接受。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04948获取。
papers.title_original: Evaluating Investments in Asteroid Detection Technologies to Prevent Catastrophic Impacts on Earth
papers.title_zh: 评估小行星探测技术投资以防止对地球的灾难性撞击

papers.abstract_original: Feedback is vital for growth and learning, yet anecdotal evidence suggests people often hesitate to provide it, and its provision may be shaped by asymmetries and gender-related biases. We study feedback provision across variations in the nature of performance signals, their instrumental value, and the recipient’s gender. We find that a surprising degree of both positive and negative feedback is withheld, with a follow-up experiment suggesting that advisors’ feedback decisions are driven mainly by transparency- and duty-related considerations, or, to a lesser extent, are motivated by self-serving reasons. Additionally, when initial performance signals are vague, advisors are more likely to withhold noninstrumental negative than positive feedback—an effect we conjecture may be stemming from the lower psychological cost of lying (by omission) under uncertainty. Suggestive evidence shows the difference is more pronounced for female recipients, and exploratory analysis traces this to stronger ego-protective concern by advisors for women than for men.This paper was accepted by Marie Claire Villeval, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Funding: This study was funded by the British Academy [Grant SRG1920/100428], the Portuguese Foundation for Science and Technology [FCT Grant PTDC/EGE-ECO/5020/2021], the University of Exeter Business School, and the Faculty of Business and Law, University of Portsmouth. The study was preregistered on the American Economic Association’s registry for randomized controlled trials (No. AEARCTR-0006966), and it was approved by the Scientific Council of Nova School of Business and Economics and the Research Ethics Committees of both the University of East Anglia (0347) and the University of Exeter (8317399).Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05001.
papers.abstract_zh: 反馈对成长和学习至关重要，然而轶事证据表明，人们常常犹豫是否提供反馈，而且反馈的提供可能受到不对称性和与性别相关的偏见的影响。我们研究了在绩效信号的性质、其工具性价值以及接收者性别发生变化时的反馈提供情况。我们发现，令人惊讶的是，正面和负面反馈都有相当程度被隐瞒，一项后续实验表明，顾问的反馈决策主要受透明度相关和义务相关考虑的驱动，或者在较小程度上受自利原因的驱动。此外，当初始绩效信号模糊时，顾问更可能隐瞒非工具性的负面反馈而非正面反馈——我们推测这一效应可能源于在不确定性下（通过省略）说谎的较低心理成本。提示性证据表明，这种差异对女性接收者更为明显，探索性分析将此追溯到顾问对女性比对男性有更强的自我保护的关切。本文由行为经济学与决策分析领域的Marie Claire Villeval接受。资助：本研究由英国科学院[Grant SRG1920/100428]、葡萄牙科学技术基金会[FCT Grant PTDC/EGE-ECO/5020/2021]、埃克塞特大学商学院以及朴茨茅斯大学商业与法律学院资助。该研究已在美国经济学会随机对照试验注册中心预注册（No. AEARCTR-0006966），并获得了新星商业与经济学院科学委员会以及东英吉利大学（0347）和埃克塞特大学（8317399）研究伦理委员会的批准。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05001获取。
papers.title_original: The Signals We Give: Performance Feedback, Gender, and Competition
papers.title_zh: 我们给出的信号：绩效反馈、性别与竞争

papers.abstract_original: Smallholder farmers in emerging economies are vital to the global food supply, yet they remain highly vulnerable to yield risks such as extreme weather. Whereas government subsidies that compensate farmers in low-yield scenarios are common in developed countries, such policies are often impractical in emerging economies because of the high cost of assessing yields on small farms. To address this, an innovative index-based approach has gained traction, under which payments are triggered when a predetermined index (e.g., rainfall) predicts a low yield. Yet the inevitable inaccuracy of indices in reflecting actual yields weakens the alignment between payments and actual yields, reducing risk protection for farmers. This paper analyzes how governments should design yield protection subsidies under index inaccuracy. Our analysis reveals several insights. First, unlike actual yield–based policies, higher subsidies under index-based policies can inadvertently increase farmers’ income variability. Building on this, we identify a nonmonotonic relationship between the optimal subsidy and index accuracy: as accuracy improves, subsidies should initially increase but then decrease once accuracy becomes sufficiently high. Second, whereas price protection subsidies (which compensate for low prices) are often viewed as strategic substitutes for yield protection as both can increase income and incentivize planting, we show that they act as strategic complements when index accuracy is low, meaning the presence of price protection warrants a higher index-based yield protection subsidy and vice versa. Finally, when governments allocate budgets between subsidy payments and improving index accuracy, we find that tighter budgets can make it especially important to prioritize index accuracy.This paper was accepted by Christoph H. Loch, operations management.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05008.
papers.abstract_zh: 新兴经济体中的小农户对全球粮食供应至关重要，但他们仍然极易受到极端天气等产量风险的影响。尽管在低产量情景下补偿农民的政府补贴在发达国家很常见，但由于评估小农场产量的成本高昂，此类政策在新兴经济体往往不切实际。为解决这一问题，一种创新的基于指数的方法已获得关注，即当预先确定的指数（如降雨量）预测低产量时触发赔付。然而，指数在反映实际产量方面不可避免的不准确性削弱了赔付与实际产量之间的一致性，降低了对农民的风险保护。本文分析了在指数不准确的情况下政府应如何设计产量保护补贴。我们的分析揭示了若干洞见。第一，与实际产量为基础的保单不同，基于指数的保单下更高的补贴可能无意中增加农民的收入波动性。在此基础上，我们识别出最优补贴与指数准确性之间的非单调关系：随着准确性提高，补贴应首先增加，但一旦准确性变得足够高，补贴则应减少。第二，尽管价格保护补贴（补偿低价格）通常被视为产量保护的战略替代品，因为两者都能增加收入并激励种植，但我们表明，当指数准确性较低时，它们充当战略互补品，这意味着价格保护的存在要求更高的基于指数的产量保护补贴，反之亦然。最后，当政府在补贴支付与提高指数准确性之间分配预算时，我们发现更紧张的预算可能使优先考虑指数准确性变得尤为重要。本文由运营管理领域的Christoph H. Loch接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05008获取。
papers.title_original: Index-Based Yield Protection for Smallholder Farmers
papers.title_zh: 面向小农户的基于指数的产量保护

papers.abstract_original: We document a novel support mechanism in financial institutions—the direct flow channel—through which banks coordinate client investments to stabilize affiliated mutual funds facing severe redemptions. Inflows from banks’ retail and institutional clients offset a sizable share of outflows, mitigating adverse performance effects, forced sales, and redemption spillovers. Support via the direct flow channel is liquidity driven, concentrated in fragile but viable funds, and most pronounced when cash and family support are insufficient, while complementing credit lines when they are available. Importantly, we find no evidence that bank clients incur systematic costs, underscoring the stabilizing role of banks as coordination devices.This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05036.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们记录了金融机构中一种新颖的支持机制——直接流动渠道——银行通过该渠道协调客户投资，以稳定面临严重赎回的关联共同基金。来自银行零售和机构客户的资金流入抵消了相当大份额的流出，减轻了不利的业绩影响、被迫抛售和赎回溢出效应。通过直接流动渠道提供的支持是流动性驱动的，集中于脆弱但可行的基金，并且在现金和家族支持不足时最为明显，同时在信贷额度可用时对其形成补充。重要的是，我们没有发现银行客户承担系统性成本的证据，凸显了银行作为协调装置的稳定作用。本文由Camelia Kuhnen（金融学）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05036获取。
papers.title_original: Liquidity Support in Financial Institutions
papers.title_zh: 金融机构中的流动性支持

papers.abstract_original: We develop a general-equilibrium multi-industry model with endogenous product variety and study its implications for asset prices. We estimate the model with both the Generalized Method of Moments (GMM) and the Simulated Method of Moments (SMM) and show that the equity premium and risk-free rate are consistent with empirically reasonable risk aversions and discount factors. The market risk premium increases significantly with the interindustry product complementarity. The model also generates the additional novel predictions that the market risk premium increases with the intraindustry product substitutability, and that industries with more substitutable products have higher excess returns. We show support for these implications in our empirical analysis.This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05040.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个具有内生 product variety 的一般均衡多行业模型，并研究其对资产价格的含义。我们使用广义矩方法（GMM）和模拟矩方法（SMM）估计该模型，并表明股权溢价和无风险利率与经验上合理的风险厌恶和贴现因子相一致。市场风险溢价随着行业间产品互补性显著上升。该模型还产生了额外的新预测：市场风险溢价随着行业内产品替代性上升，并且产品替代性更高的行业具有更高的超额收益。我们在实证分析中为这些含义提供了支持。本文由金融学领域的Agostino Capponi接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05040获取。
papers.title_original: Product Variety and Asset Pricing
papers.title_zh: 产品多样性与资产定价

papers.abstract_original: Using China’s randomized pre-initial public offering on-site inspection program, we examine the causal effects of proactive public enforcement on the financial reporting quality of initial public offering applicants. Our analysis shows that the program enhances the reporting quality of selected applicants by screening out firms with questionable financial disclosures. More importantly, it generates a significant deterrence effect, discouraging future applicants from submitting low-quality financial reports. However, we also find that public enforcement can lead to the rejection of some firms that may otherwise merit approval. These findings highlight both the benefits and costs of employing public enforcement to improve financial reporting in settings with weak institutional oversight.This paper was accepted by Eric So, accounting.Funding: K. Guo acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72302146 and 72132006], the Shanghai Pujiang Program, and the National Social Science Fund of China [Grant 22AZD034].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05042.
papers.abstract_zh: 利用中国随机化的首次公开发行前现场检查计划，我们考察了主动公共执法对首次公开发行申请人的财务报告质量的因果效应。我们的分析表明，该计划通过筛除财务披露存在问题的公司，提高了被选中申请人的报告质量。更重要的是，它产生了显著的威慑效应，阻止未来申请人提交低质量的财务报告。然而，我们也发现，公共执法可能导致一些原本可能值得批准的公司被拒绝。这些发现凸显了在制度监督薄弱的环境中使用公共执法来改善财务报告的收益与成本。本文由Eric So，会计学接受。资助：K. Guo感谢国家自然科学基金[资助号72302146和72132006]、上海浦江人才计划和国家社会科学基金[资助号22AZD034]的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05042获取。
papers.title_original: Public Enforcement and Initial Public Offering Reporting Quality in Weak Institutional Environments: Evidence from a Random Experiment in China
papers.title_zh: 弱制度环境下的公共执法与首次公开发行报告质量：来自中国随机实验的证据

papers.abstract_original: We analyze the dynamics of carry in crypto markets—the difference between futures and spot prices—and document that it can reach exceptionally high levels, sometimes exceeding 40% per annum, with significant variation over time. This phenomenon reflects a substantial and volatile inconvenience yield associated with holding spot cryptocurrencies relative to futures. We trace the large and volatile crypto carry to the interplay of two main forces: (i) demand from smaller, trend-chasing investors seeking leveraged exposure and (ii) the limited deployment of arbitrage capital because of regulatory and margin frictions. Our findings highlight how structural limits to arbitrage—especially severe in the case of crypto—can amplify price inefficiencies across financial markets, offering lessons for understanding asset pricing and market behavior more generally.This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance.Funding: M. Schmeling acknowledges financial support from the German Science Foundation [Grant SCHM 2623/2-1].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05069.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们分析了加密货币市场中持有收益（carry）的动态——即期货价格与现货价格之间的差异——并记录其可以达到异常高的水平，有时超过每年40%，且随时间显著变化。这一现象反映了相对于期货持有现货加密货币所伴随的巨大的、波动的不便收益。我们将巨大且波动的加密货币持有收益追溯到两种主要力量的相互作用：（i）寻求杠杆敞口的较小、追逐趋势的投资者的需求，以及（ii）由于监管和保证金摩擦导致的套利资本部署有限。我们的发现强调了套利的结构性限制——在加密货币情况下尤为严重——如何放大整个金融市场的价格低效，为更普遍地理解资产定价和市场行为提供了启示。本文由金融学领域的Agostino Capponi接受。资助：M. Schmeling感谢德国科学基金会[资助SCHM 2623/2-1]的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05069获取。

papers.abstract_original: Using security-level bookbuilding data, we examine the pricing dynamics and demand of green bond offerings (GBOs) relative to their conventional counterparts. We show that greenium arises from ESG-focused investors’ almost exclusive demand for GBOs. GBOs typically receive significantly larger order books, allowing underwriters to compress offering spreads more for GBOs than for comparable conventional offerings. Even at the same level of investor demand, underwriters tighten spreads more for GBOs, suggesting that ESG-focused investors exhibit lower price sensitivity. These results remain robust when we proxy for ESG-focused investor demand in the primary market using their holdings of similar bonds in the secondary market. Further analyses rule out the temporary price pressure or liquidity preference explanations. Our study provides direct evidence to support investor-tastes models.This paper was accepted by Prof. Bo Becker, finance.Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05106.
papers.abstract_zh: 利用证券层面的簿记建档数据，我们考察了绿色债券发行（GBOs）相对于传统债券发行的定价动态与需求。我们表明，绿色溢价源于以ESG为重点的投资者对GBOs几乎排他性的需求。GBOs通常获得显著更大的订单簿，使承销商能够比可比的传统发行更大幅度地压缩GBOs的发行利差。即使在相同的投资者需求水平下，承销商对GBOs的利差收紧幅度也更大，这表明以ESG为重点的投资者表现出更低的价格敏感性。当我们用这些投资者在二级市场对类似债券的持有量来代理一级市场中以ESG为重点的投资者需求时，这些结果依然稳健。进一步的分析排除了暂时性价格压力或流动性偏好的解释。我们的研究提供了直接证据来支持投资者偏好模型。本文由金融学Bo Becker教授接受。补充材料：数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05106 获取。
papers.title_original: Deciphering Greenium: The Role of Investor Demand
papers.title_zh: 解读绿色溢价：投资者需求的作用

papers.abstract_original: Motivated by an application at the Raleigh-Durham International Airport, we consider a service system in which a manager aims to track the number of people in the system based only on noisy observations of arrivals and departures over a time horizon. We study two tracking problems in this context. In the busyness tracking problem, the manager seeks to determine whether the system is busy or not, whereas in the population tracking problem, the manager tracks the number of people in the system and accumulates losses as squared errors. We characterize the cumulative losses of various policies in an asymptotic regime in which the time horizon grows large. We prove general lower bounds on the cumulative loss of any policy and propose relatively simple policies that achieve these lower bounds, up to logarithmic terms. These policies outperform naive tracking policies in many instances. Finally, we characterize the impact of having the ability to periodically inspect the system at a cost. We find that effective population tracking policies take opportunities to reset the population count to accurate estimates to stop the accumulation of error. Without inspections, this is achieved by resetting the population count to zero when a near-empty system is detected based on observing the departure stream. Inspections, although coming at a cost, allow for greater flexibility in the timing of corrections and, hence, improved performance. We demonstrate the performance of our policies using real-world data we collected by installing people-counting sensors at the airport.This paper was accepted by Vivek Farias, data science.Funding: Financial support from the Triangle Impact Challenge 2021 is gratefully acknowledged.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05152.
papers.abstract_zh: 受罗利-达勒姆国际机场一个应用的启发，我们考虑一个服务系统，其中管理者旨在仅基于在一个时间范围内对到达和离开的噪声观测来追踪系统中的人数。我们在此背景下研究两个追踪问题。在繁忙度追踪问题中，管理者试图确定系统是否繁忙，而在人群追踪问题中，管理者追踪系统中的人数并以平方误差累积损失。我们在时间范围趋于很大的渐近情形下刻画各种策略的累积损失。我们证明任何策略累积损失的一般下界，并提出相对简单的策略，这些策略达到这些下界，直至对数项。这些策略在许多情况下优于朴素的追踪策略。最后，我们刻画了有能力以一定成本定期检查系统的影响。我们发现，有效的人群追踪策略会抓住机会将人数计数重置为准确估计，以阻止误差的累积。在没有检查的情况下，这通过在基于观测离开流检测到系统接近空时，将人数计数重置为零来实现。检查虽然带来成本，但允许在修正时机上具有更大的灵活性，从而改善性能。我们使用通过在机场安装人数计数传感器收集的真实世界数据展示了我们策略的性能。本文由Vivek Farias，数据科学领域接受。资助：感谢Triangle Impact Challenge 2021的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05152获取。
papers.title_original: Data-Driven Population Tracking in Service Systems
papers.title_zh: 服务系统中数据驱动的人群追踪

papers.abstract_original: Loyalty programs are widespread across various markets, offering members rewards based on their past purchases for future benefits. This study offers new insights into the strategic use of loyalty programs and their impact on market competition by exploring the dynamics of loyalty programs within a repeated ordered search framework, in which consumers sequentially search for the optimal product across multiple firms over two periods. Our findings highlight distinct roles for price discounts and rewards in influencing consumer decisions. Price discounts discourage further search in the current shopping period, whereas rewards encourage consumer loyalty by inducing prominence in subsequent visits. As search costs increase, firms tend to offer lower price discounts but higher rewards, and this results in a higher industry profit but lower consumer surplus. Compared with their absence, loyalty programs decrease both industry profit and consumer welfare, leading to a lose–lose outcome. Moreover, we demonstrate that, when the firms are heterogeneous in terms of their network sizes, those with larger networks tend to offer lower rewards yet achieve greater consumer loyalty in contrast to the firms with smaller networks, which compensate with higher rewards.This paper was accepted by Dmitri Kuksov, marketing.Funding: T.T. Ke acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72422003 and 72394395] and the Hong Kong Research Grants Council [Grant 14503122]. X. Zhu acknowledges support from INFORMS Society for Marketing Science Doctoral Early Stage Research Grant (awarded in 2023).Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05203.
papers.abstract_zh: 忠诚度计划在各个市场中广泛存在，根据会员过去的购买行为为其提供未来收益的奖励。本研究通过在重复有序搜索框架内探讨忠诚度计划的动态，为忠诚度计划的战略运用及其对市场竞争的影响提供了新的见解。在该框架中，消费者在两个时期内跨多家公司依次搜索最优产品。我们的发现凸显了价格折扣和奖励在影响消费者决策中的不同作用。价格折扣会抑制消费者在当前购物期内的进一步搜索，而奖励则通过在后续访问中诱导突出性来鼓励消费者忠诚。随着搜索成本上升，公司倾向于提供更低的价格折扣但更高的奖励，这导致行业利润更高但消费者剩余更低。与没有忠诚度计划相比，忠诚度计划会降低行业利润和消费者福利，导致双输结果。此外，我们证明，当公司在网络规模方面存在异质性时，与网络规模较小的公司相比，网络规模较大的公司倾向于提供更低的奖励，却能获得更高的消费者忠诚度，而网络规模较小的公司则以更高的奖励作为补偿。本文由营销领域编辑Dmitri Kuksov接受。资助：T.T. Ke 感谢中国国家自然科学基金[资助号 72422003 和 72394395]以及香港研究资助局[资助号 14503122]提供的财务支持。X. Zhu 感谢INFORMS营销科学学会博士早期研究资助（于2023年颁发）的支持。补充材料：在线附录可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05203 获取。

papers.abstract_original: Using data on over 160,000 U.S. private pension plans, we analyze the investment performance of defined benefit (DB) and defined contribution (DC) plans. We find a positive asset size effect in performance, stronger in DB plans partly because of greater economies of scale in administrative expenses. Small DB plans underperform small DC plans on various performance metrics and face the highest termination risk. After adjusting for investable passive benchmarks, DC plans outperform DB plans in all but the largest size decile. Our findings suggest that plan consolidation and converting small DB plans to the DC structure are likely to improve the efficiency of pension financing.This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05241.
papers.abstract_zh: 利用超过160,000个美国私人养老金计划的数据，我们分析了确定给付型（DB）和确定缴费型（DC）计划的投资绩效。我们发现绩效中存在正的资产规模效应，在DB计划中更强，部分原因是管理费用方面更大的规模经济。小型DB计划在各种绩效指标上表现不如小型DC计划，并面临最高的终止风险。在根据可投资的被动基准进行调整后，DC计划在除最大规模十分位以外的所有规模组中均优于DB计划。我们的发现表明，计划合并以及将小型DB计划转换为DC结构，可能会提高养老金融资的效率。本文由金融学领域的Camelia Kuhnen接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05241获取。
papers.title_original: Investment Performance of Private Pension Plans: Defined Benefit vs. Defined Contribution
papers.title_zh: 私人养老金计划的投资绩效：确定给付型与确定缴费型

papers.abstract_original: Why do consumers accept defaults (preset or suggested options)? This paper estimates a structural model that disentangles two frictions underlying default adherence: a deviation cost (the disutility when the final choice differs from the consumer’s ideal) and an opt-out cost (the effort to override the default). I estimate the model on 8.6 million tipping decisions from NYC Yellow taxi trips. A stated-preference survey identifies consumer tipping preferences independently of defaults. The central finding is friction complementarity: 84% of default adherence arises from the interaction of both frictions; remove either friction and the remaining one alone cannot sustain default adherence. Structural parameters are approximately stable when default options change, consistent with defaults channeling behavior through choice frictions rather than reshaping preferences. Counterfactual analysis shows that adding a 15% tip option below the existing 20%–25%–30% menu captures 69% of the achievable consumer welfare gain at a 5.4% revenue cost.This paper was accepted by Dube, Jean-Pierre, marketing.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05272.
papers.abstract_zh: 消费者为何接受默认选项（预设或建议选项）？本文估计了一个结构模型，该模型区分了默认依从背后的两种摩擦：偏离成本（当最终选择与消费者理想选择不同时的负效用）和退出成本（推翻默认选项的努力）。我在来自纽约市黄色出租车行程的8.6百万次小费决策上估计该模型。一项陈述性偏好调查独立于默认选项识别消费者的小费偏好。核心发现是摩擦互补性：默认依从的84%源于两种摩擦的交互作用；移除任一摩擦，剩下的摩擦单独无法维持默认依从。当默认选项变化时，结构参数大致稳定，这与默认选项通过选择摩擦引导行为而非重塑偏好相一致。反事实分析表明，在现有20%–25%–30%菜单下方增加一个15%小费选项，以5.4%的收入成本捕获了可实现消费者福利收益的69%。本文由市场营销领域的Dube, Jean-Pierre接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05272获取。
papers.title_original: Defaults and Decisions: Choice Architecture and Consumer Opt-Out
papers.title_zh: 默认选项与决策：选择架构与消费者退出

papers.abstract_original: We examine how privacy restrictions affect online content creation and consumption by evaluating the impact of YouTube’s settlement with the Federal Trade Commission over violating the Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act. Under the settlement, YouTube limited personalization for made-for-kids (MFK) content starting in January 2020, and this included personalized ads and content engagement features such as subscriber notifications and playlists. We study the resulting impact on 5,066 top American YouTube channels by comparing the MFK content creators to their non-MFK counterparts using a difference-in-differences design. On the supply side, MFK content creators produce 18% less content and pivot toward non-MFK content production. MFK content creators also invest less in content quality: the proportion of original content falls by 9% and manual captioning drops by 28%, whereas viewer content ratings fall by 9%. On the demand side, views of MFK channels fall by 20%. The restrictions also affected market competition, increasing concentration of both content creation and viewership among top MFK channels.This paper was accepted by Jean-Pierre Dubé, marketing.Funding: This work was supported by the Questrom School of Business Digital Business Institute, the Program on Economics & Privacy at George Mason University, and the “Economics of Digital Services” initiative by the University of Pennsylvania’s Center of Technology, Innovation & Competition and Warren Center.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05295.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们通过评估YouTube就违反《儿童在线隐私保护法》与联邦贸易委员会达成的和解协议的影响，考察隐私限制如何影响在线内容创作和消费。根据该和解协议，YouTube自2020年1月起限制了面向儿童（MFK）内容的个性化，这包括个性化广告以及订阅者通知和播放列表等内容参与功能。我们使用双重差分设计，将MFK内容创作者与其非MFK对应者进行比较，研究由此对5,066个美国顶级YouTube频道产生的影响。在供给侧，MFK内容创作者制作的内容减少了18%，并转向非MFK内容生产。MFK内容创作者在内容质量上的投入也更少：原创内容的比例下降了9%，人工字幕下降了28%，而观众内容评分下降了9%。在需求侧，MFK频道的观看量下降了20%。这些限制还影响了市场竞争，提高了顶级MFK频道之间内容创作和观看的集中度。本文由Jean-Pierre Dubé（市场营销学）接受。资助：本工作得到了Questrom商学院数字商业研究所、乔治梅森大学经济与隐私项目，以及宾夕法尼亚大学技术、创新与竞争中心和沃伦中心发起的“数字服务经济学”倡议的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05295获取。
papers.title_original: COPPAcalypse? The YouTube Settlement’s Impact on Kids’ Content
papers.title_zh: COPPA末日？YouTube和解协议对儿童内容的影响

papers.abstract_original: The U.S. Security and Exchange Commission’s (SEC’s) Division of Enforcement is frequently criticized for its ineffective oversight, and certain vocal critics attribute this to a lack of financial experience within the SEC. Using novel hand-collected data on SEC regional directors, I find that most of these senior SEC officials lack practical financial experience. I then use a staggered difference-in-differences research design and find that directors with financial experience open 62% more investigations (i.e., four to five additional investigations per office-year). This result is consistent with their financial experience impacting investigations. Additional analyses reveal that this effect is stronger when financial acumen likely matters more and that financial directors conduct more efficient and consequential investigations. Importantly, these results do not appear to be explained by the experience of other directors or by financial regional directors handling more cases. This study answers recent calls for more research on individual regulators and presents timely evidence as the SEC seeks to improve its investigation process. More generally, these findings provide new insights into the SEC’s oversight process and should be of interest to regulators and market participants concerned with the SEC’s policing of financial misreporting.This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting.Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05302.
papers.abstract_zh: 美国证券交易委员会（SEC）的执法部门经常因其监管不力而受到批评，一些直言不讳的批评者将此归因于SEC内部缺乏金融经验。利用新近手工收集的关于SEC地区主管的数据，我发现这些SEC高级官员中的大多数缺乏实际金融经验。随后，我采用交错双重差分研究设计，发现具有金融经验的主管多发起62%的调查（即每个办公室-年度多进行四到五次调查）。这一结果与他们的金融经验影响调查相一致。进一步分析显示，当金融敏锐度可能更为重要时，这一效应更强，并且具有金融经验的主管所进行的调查更有效率且更具影响力。重要的是，这些结果似乎并不能由其他主管的经验或具有金融经验的地区主管处理更多案件来解释。本研究回应了近期对更多个体监管者研究的呼吁，并在SEC寻求改进其调查程序之际提供了及时的证据。更一般地说，这些发现为SEC的监管过程提供了新的见解，并且应当引起关注SEC对财务错报进行监管的监管者和市场参与者的兴趣。本文由会计领域编辑Suraj Srinivasan接受。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05302获取。
papers.title_original: Does the Financial Experience of SEC Regional Directors Impact SEC Investigations?
papers.title_zh: SEC地区主管的金融经验是否影响SEC调查？

papers.abstract_original: We examine whether loan loss provision validity (i.e., the extent of loan loss provisions mapping into future charge offs) within the bank holding company (BHC) is associated with internal capital allocation efficiency. Exploiting the filing requirements for subsidiary banks, we find that within-BHC provision validity, our measure of internal information quality, is positively associated with internal capital market efficiency. We also find that this association is concentrated in BHCs more likely to allocate capital to take advantage of subsidiary lending opportunities and BHCs with higher internal information asymmetry. These findings suggest that within-BHC accounting information that better reflects subsidiary bank loan performance mitigates information problems between headquarters and subsidiary managers in internal capital allocation. This study contributes to our understanding of how loan loss provision information of lower-level entities within the organization is associated with headquarters capital allocation and helps mitigate internal information asymmetry within banking organizations.This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting.Funding: The authors thank the University of Toronto, Wharton School, and Temple University for financial support. A. Nicoletti gratefully acknowledges financial support from the Alfred H. Williams Faculty Scholar Award.Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05313.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察银行控股公司（BHC）内部的贷款损失准备有效性（即贷款损失准备映射到未来核销的程度）是否与内部资本配置效率相关。利用对子银行的申报要求，我们发现，BHC内部准备有效性——我们对内部信息质量的衡量——与内部资本市场效率正相关。我们还发现，这种关联集中在更可能配置资本以利用子银行贷款机会的BHC以及内部信息不对称更高的BHC中。这些发现表明，更能反映子银行贷款表现的BHC内部会计信息，缓解了总部与子银行经理之间在内部资本配置中的信息问题。本研究有助于我们理解组织内较低层级实体的贷款损失准备信息如何与总部资本配置相关，并有助于缓解银行组织内部的内部信息不对称。本文由会计学领域的Ranjani Krishnan接受。资助：作者感谢多伦多大学、沃顿商学院和天普大学的财务支持。A. Nicoletti衷心感谢Alfred H. Williams教职学者奖的财务支持。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05313获取。
papers.title_original: Within–Bank Holding Company Accounting Information and Internal Capital Allocation
papers.title_zh: 银行控股公司内部会计信息与内部资本配置

papers.abstract_original: Choice inconsistency is ubiquitous in economic decision making. Standard random utility models as well as sequential sampling models account for it and predict a relation between inconsistency rates and utility differences (strength-of-preference effects). The latter phenomenon is well-established empirically. However, recent literature argues that inconsistency might be the outcome of a deliberate attempt to implement an explicit preference for randomization. We collected new data in three preregistered experiments and also reanalyzed the previous evidence for this explanation. Our evidence is generally well-explained by strength-of-preference effects. That is, people are less consistent for choices that are closer to indifference. When an option to randomize is made explicit and salient, this option is sometimes chosen. However, in a within-subject design, we statistically reject the hypothesis that explicit mixing in one-shot decisions (revealed preference for randomization) equals choice proportions in repeated decisions (choice inconsistency). The deliberate choice of randomization devices is influenced both by explicit costs (if any) and whether decision makers are close to indifference between the nonrandomized alternatives. The latter effect might create a correlation with choice inconsistency at the aggregate level.This paper was accepted by Dorothea Kübler, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Funding: Financial support from the Spanish Ministry of Science and Innovation [Grant PID2022-136977NB-I00] is gratefully acknowledged.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05415.
papers.abstract_zh: 选择不一致在经济决策中普遍存在。标准随机效用模型以及序贯抽样模型都对此加以解释，并预测不一致率与效用差异之间存在关系（偏好强度效应）。后一现象在实证上已得到充分确立。然而，近期文献认为，不一致可能是刻意尝试实施对随机化的明确偏好的结果。我们在三项预注册实验中收集了新数据，并重新分析了先前支持这一解释的证据。我们的证据总体上可由偏好强度效应很好地解释。也就是说，人们对于更接近无差异的选择更不一致。当随机化选项被明确且显著地呈现时，该选项有时会被选择。然而，在受试者内设计中，我们在统计上拒绝以下假设：一次性决策中的显式混合（显示性随机化偏好）等于重复决策中的选择比例（选择不一致）。对随机化装置的刻意选择既受显式成本（如果有的话）影响，也受决策者是否接近非随机化备选项之间的无差异影响。后一效应可能在总体层面造成与选择不一致的相关性。本文由Dorothea Kübler，行为经济学与决策分析领域接受。资助：感谢西班牙科学与创新部提供的财务支持[资助号PID2022-136977NB-I00]。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05415获取。
papers.title_original: Why Is Choice Stochastic? Deliberate Randomization vs. Strength of Preference
papers.title_zh: 选择为何是随机的？刻意随机化与偏好强度

papers.abstract_original: We study third-party quality certification in the market for financial advice. Using Barron’s Top Financial Advisors rankings and multiple identification strategies, we find evidence that being named a top advisor increases both assets under management and accounts for individuals and their firms. The effects increase sharply around state-level thresholds for certification, suggesting that clients value the certification itself and not solely the underlying quality. Contrary to industry folklore about a “Barron’s curse,” we find that after certification, advisors are less likely to engage in misconduct, consistent with reputational models. The certification effect is robust to controlling for increased media attention and operates primarily through certification value rather than visibility, with larger effects for advisors from smaller firms and those with less experience.This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance.Funding: The authors acknowledge the support of the Institute for the Study of Free Enterprise.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05423.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究金融咨询市场中的第三方质量认证。使用Barron’s顶级财务顾问排名和多种识别策略，我们发现证据表明，被命名为顶级顾问会增加个人及其公司的管理资产和账户数量。这些效应在州级认证门槛附近急剧增加，表明客户重视认证本身，而不仅仅是其背后的质量。与关于“Barron’s诅咒”的行业传说相反，我们发现认证后，顾问更不可能从事不当行为，这与声誉模型一致。认证效应在控制媒体关注增加后仍然稳健，并且主要通过认证价值而非可见性发挥作用，对于来自较小公司和经验较少的顾问，效应更大。本文由Camelia Kuhnen接受，金融。资助：作者感谢自由企业研究所的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05423获取。

papers.abstract_original: The design of online algorithms for matching markets and revenue management settings is usually bound by the assumption that the demand process is formed by a fixed-length sequence of queries with unknown types, each drawn independently. This notion of serial independence implies that the demand of each type, that is, the number of queries of a given type, has low variance and is approximately Poisson distributed. This paper proposes a nonparametric framework for modeling arrival sequences in online stochastic matching that departs from the serial independent assumption. We propose two models, Indep and Correl, that capture different forms of serial correlations by combining a nonparametric distribution for the demand with standard assumptions on the arrival patterns: adversarial or random order. The Indep model can capture arbitrary serial correlations within each customer type but assumes cross-sectional independence across types, whereas the Correl model captures common shocks across customer types. We demonstrate that fluid relaxations, which rely solely on demand expectations, have arbitrarily bad performance guarantees. In contrast, we develop new algorithms that achieve optimal (constant factor) performance guarantees in each model. Our mathematical analysis includes tighter linear programming (LP) relaxations that leverage distribution knowledge and a new lossless randomized LP rounding scheme for Indep. We test our new LP relaxations and rounding scheme in simulations on real and synthetic data and find that they consistently outperform well-established matching algorithms, especially on real data sequences that exhibit greater demand variance.This paper was accepted by Itai Ashlagi, revenue management and market analytics.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05424.
papers.abstract_zh: 匹配市场和收益管理情境中在线算法的设计通常受限于这样一个假设：需求过程由固定长度的未知类型查询序列构成，每个查询独立抽取。这种序列独立性的概念意味着每种类型的需求，即给定类型的查询数量，具有低方差且近似服从泊松分布。本文提出了一个非参数框架，用于对在线随机匹配中的到达序列进行建模，该框架偏离了序列独立假设。我们提出了两个模型，Indep和Correl，它们通过将需求的非参数分布与关于到达模式的标准假设（对抗性顺序或随机顺序）相结合，捕捉不同形式的序列相关性。Indep模型可以捕捉每个客户类型内的任意序列相关性，但假设类型之间横截面独立，而Correl模型则捕捉客户类型之间的共同冲击。我们证明，仅依赖需求期望的流体松弛具有任意差的性能保证。相比之下，我们开发了新算法，在每个模型中实现了最优（常数因子）性能保证。我们的数学分析包括利用分布知识的更紧的线性规划（LP）松弛，以及针对Indep的一种新的无损随机LP舍入方案。我们在真实和合成数据的模拟中测试了我们的新LP松弛和舍入方案，发现它们始终优于成熟的匹配算法，尤其是在表现出更大需求方差的真实数据序列上。本文由Itai Ashlagi（收益管理与市场分析领域）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05424获取。

papers.abstract_original: We examine whether U.S. media sentiment on foreign countries influences domestic investors’ international asset allocation. Using flows to country-specific mutual funds as a proxy for investor demand, we find that negative media sentiment, measured by the interaction of negative tone and media attention given to foreign countries, is strongly associated with reduced investor flows into funds targeting those countries. This relationship is driven, at least in part, by media sentiment that is unrelated to the economic fundamentals of the targeted countries. We employ The Wall Street Journal’s acquisition by News Corp to support the causal interpretation of our findings. Our results highlight the perception-shaping role of media narratives in driving global investment decisions.This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance.Funding: L. Ma acknowledges funding support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72103008].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05504.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察美国媒体对外国的情绪是否影响国内投资者的国际资产配置。以流向特定国家共同基金的资金流作为投资者需求的代理变量，我们发现，负面媒体情绪——以负面语气与媒体对外国关注度的交互项衡量——与投资者流向以这些国家为目标的基金的资金减少密切相关。这一关系至少部分是由与被投资国经济基本面无关的媒体情绪所驱动的。我们利用新闻集团收购《华尔街日报》这一事件来支持我们研究结果的因果解释。我们的结果凸显了媒体叙事在驱动全球投资决策中的塑造认知作用。本文由金融领域编辑Will Cong接受。资助：L. Ma感谢国家自然科学基金[批准号72103008]的资助支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05504获取。

papers.abstract_original: We explore the tweeting behavior of S&P 1500 firms’ chief executive officers and chief financial officers and its market reactions from 2011 to 2018. Executives post a variety of content on Twitter, with slightly less than half of their tweets relating to business matters. We find that most executive tweets do not elicit market reactions. However, the subset of executive tweets about financial information appears to be associated with market reactions incremental to the responses to firm-issued tweets. These reactions coincide with increases in trading volume and retail investor activity. To assess whether market responses are driven by new information or by changes in perceived credibility, we develop an innovative machine-learning-based measure of content similarity between executive and firm tweets. We find stronger investor reactions when executive financial tweets are more similar to prior firm tweets, consistent with the perceived credibility mechanism. At the same time, executive financial tweets also generate market reactions in the absence of firm disclosures, supporting the new information mechanism.This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting.Funding: This work is supported by a grant from the Research Grants Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China [Project GRF 15502618]. This works was supported by the Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Canada [Grant 435-2019-0292].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05510.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了标普1500家公司首席执行官和首席财务官的推文行为及其从2011年到2018年的市场反应。高管在Twitter上发布各种内容，其中略少于一半的推文与商业事务相关。我们发现大多数高管推文并未引发市场反应。然而，关于财务信息的高管推文子集似乎与市场反应相关，且该反应是在对公司发布推文的反应之外的增量反应。这些反应与交易量和散户投资者活动的增加同时发生。为了评估市场反应是由新信息驱动还是由感知可信度变化驱动，我们开发了一种基于机器学习的创新度量，用于衡量高管推文与公司推文之间的内容相似性。我们发现，当高管财务推文与先前公司推文更相似时，投资者反应更强，这与感知可信度机制一致。同时，在公司没有披露的情况下，高管财务推文也会产生市场反应，支持新信息机制。本文由Suraj Srinivasan（会计领域）接受。资助：本工作得到中国香港特别行政区研究资助局资助[项目GRF 15502618]的支持。本工作得到加拿大社会科学与人文研究理事会[资助号435-2019-0292]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05510获取。

papers.abstract_original: In this research, we focus on improving service-oriented routing by addressing the nuanced challenge of punctuality through the consideration of couriers’ ability to ensure on-time deliveries. We utilize a comprehensive real-world data set from a cold chain logistics firm for analysis. Our empirical investigation indicates that relying solely on travel distance is inadequate for accurate delivery time prediction. We highlight critical elements, including couriers’ fixed effects and workload, as key covariates to improve prediction performance. Distinguishing our work from existing literature, we integrate couriers’ workload and location familiarity into our service-oriented routing model to enhance predictions of delivery times. We introduce the courier-assigned location mismatch (CALM) metric as a less intrusive approach to incorporating couriers’ location familiarity into their delivery efficiency. We propose the novel service-oriented considerate routing (SOCR) model; by minimizing the CALM metric, couriers are assigned routes within familiar territories to the extent possible within the total routing distance constraint. The considerate routing strategies could potentially reduce the stress couriers face when delivering in unfamiliar areas. Additionally, we develop the connection of the SOCR model with a robust satisficing approach. This strategy guarantees timely deliveries by effectively mitigating the effects of predictive inaccuracies and potential model misspecifications. To solve the SOCR model, we apply Benders decomposition for an exact solution and tabu search for a heuristic approach, demonstrating their effectiveness and superior out-of-sample performance. Notably, our heuristic solutions significantly outperform exact solutions of classical vehicle routing problems with deadlines, resulting in substantial improvements in timely delivery performance.This paper was accepted by Wolfram Wiesemann, data science.Funding: Y. Zhao and M. Sim were partially supported by the Ministry of Education, Singapore, under its 2019 Academic Research Fund Tier 3 [Grant MOE-2019-T3-1-010]. Z. Luo was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72222011, 72171112, and 72442006]. C. Chen was supported in part by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72394363, 12431011, and 72394364].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05530.
papers.abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们通过考虑快递员确保准时送达的能力，应对准时性这一细微挑战，从而改进面向服务的路径规划。我们利用一家冷链物流公司的全面真实世界数据集进行分析。我们的实证研究表明，仅依赖行驶距离不足以准确预测送达时间。我们强调关键要素，包括快递员的固定效应和工作量，作为提升预测表现的关键协变量。与现有文献不同，我们将快递员的工作量和地点熟悉度纳入面向服务的路径规划模型，以增强对送达时间的预测。我们引入快递员指派地点错配（CALM）指标，作为一种侵入性较低的方法，将快递员的地点熟悉度纳入其配送效率。我们提出新颖的面向服务的体贴路径规划（SOCR）模型；通过最小化CALM指标，在总路径距离约束内尽可能将快递员分配到熟悉区域内的路线。体贴的路径规划策略可能减少快递员在陌生区域配送时面临的压力。此外，我们建立了SOCR模型与稳健满意化方法的联系。该策略通过有效缓解预测不准确和潜在模型设定错误的影响，保证准时送达。为求解SOCR模型，我们应用Benders分解求精确解，并应用禁忌搜索作为启发式方法，展示了它们的有效性及优越的样本外表现。值得注意的是，我们的启发式解显著优于带截止时间的经典车辆路径问题的精确解，在准时送达表现上带来实质性改善。本文由数据科学领域编辑Wolfram Wiesemann接受。资助：Y. Zhao和M. Sim部分受到新加坡教育部在其2019年学术研究基金第3级[资助编号MOE-2019-T3-1-010]下的支持。Z. Luo受到国家自然科学基金[资助编号72222011、72171112和72442006]的支持。C. Chen部分受到国家自然科学基金[资助编号72394363、12431011和72394364]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05530 获取。

papers.abstract_original: In this paper, we analyze how one of the most fundamental behavioral biases in investing—people’s preference for buying specific stocks rather than holding the market portfolio—affects their life-cycle consumption, savings, and stock market participation. We first show that when investors receive stocks from specific companies, they increase their spending in those companies’ stores. Although specific stock ownership increases total spending in the short run, individuals’ overall stock market investments increase in the long run. For identification, we use the staggered allocation of brokerage accounts to individuals over time as well as quasirandomly distributed stock grants.This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05567.
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们分析投资中最基本的行为偏差之一——人们偏好购买特定股票而非持有市场组合——如何影响其生命周期消费、储蓄和股票市场参与。我们首先表明，当投资者收到来自特定公司的股票时，他们会增加在这些公司商店中的支出。尽管特定股票所有权在短期内增加了总支出，但个人的整体股票市场投资在长期内增加。为了识别，我们使用随时间向个人交错分配经纪账户以及准随机分配的股票授予。本文由Will Cong（金融）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05567获取。

papers.abstract_original: The literature has documented qualitative evidence of disparities in physician diagnoses, which can lead to disparities in healthcare delivery, patients’ perception of care, and health outcomes. In this research, we seek to understand whether (a) disparities in physician diagnoses can be attributed to disparate impact based on patient race, and (b) information technology–enabled health information sharing among healthcare providers can mitigate such disparate impact. Our empirical context focuses on racial disparities in diagnoses of heart disease between Hispanic patients and non-Hispanic, White patients. Utilizing patient-level, emergency room (ER) encounter data from 2015 to 2022, we find statistical evidence of diagnostic disparate impact where the likelihood of Hispanic patients being diagnosed with heart disease is around three percentage points lower than White patients after accounting for their underlying race-specific risk of heart disease. However, we find that health information sharing can reduce the level of diagnostic disparate impact against Hispanic patients by 18% and the likelihood of severe disparate impact by seven percentage points. We evaluate the robustness of our results using a range of specifications, such as instrumental variable estimation, falsification tests, and alternative measures of disparate impact. We also highlight the underlying mechanism that explains the role of health information sharing in mitigating diagnostic disparate impact. Specifically, we show that health information sharing between healthcare providers can reduce diagnostic uncertainty, especially for Hispanic patients, and low-skilled physicians benefit more from health information sharing compared with highly skilled physicians.This paper was accepted by D. J. Wu, information systems.Funding: The authors gratefully acknowledge the McCombs Dean’s Excellence Research Grant for this research.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05617.
papers.abstract_zh: 文献记录了医生诊断中存在差异的定性证据，这可能导致医疗服务提供、患者对医疗的感知以及健康结果方面的差异。在本研究中，我们试图理解（a）医生诊断中的差异是否可归因于基于患者种族的差异性影响，以及（b）医疗提供者之间由信息技术支持的健康信息共享能否缓解此类差异性影响。我们的实证背景聚焦于西班牙裔患者与非西班牙裔白人患者之间心脏病诊断的种族差异。利用2015年至2022年的患者层面急诊室（ER）就诊数据，我们发现了诊断差异性影响的统计证据，即在考虑其潜在的种族特异性心脏病风险后，西班牙裔患者被诊断为心脏病的可能性比白人患者低约三个百分点。然而，我们发现健康信息共享可以将针对西班牙裔患者的诊断差异性影响水平降低18%，并将严重差异性影响的可能性降低七个百分点。我们使用一系列设定评估了结果的稳健性，如工具变量估计、证伪检验以及差异性影响的替代度量。我们还强调了解释健康信息共享在缓解诊断差异性影响中作用的潜在机制。具体而言，我们表明医疗提供者之间的健康信息共享可以减少诊断不确定性，尤其是对西班牙裔患者而言，并且与高技能医生相比，低技能医生从健康信息共享中获益更多。本文由信息系统领域编辑D. J. Wu接受。资助：作者们感谢McCombs院长卓越研究基金对本研究的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05617获取。

papers.title_original: Can Information Sharing Reduce Diagnostic Disparate Impact? Evidence from a Health Information Exchange
papers.title_zh: 信息共享能否减少诊断差异性影响？来自健康信息交换的证据

papers.abstract_original: Fair Workweek Laws (FWLs) aim to improve the predictability and stability of employee work schedules. They do so by requiring employers to provide work schedules with sufficient advance notice or to compensate workers when such notice is not provided. Despite the growing number of U.S. jurisdictions with active FWLs (currently more than 10), there is little empirical evidence of their effects on work schedules. This paper examines the impact of Los Angeles’s FWL on the predictability and stability of work schedules, using administrative data from seven independent retail chains operating in Los Angeles, CA. We find that Los Angeles’s FWL increased the predictability of work schedules: shift-level advance notice increased by 8.6% in the log specification, and the levels specification implies an increase of 1.31 days per shift. Furthermore, the share of shifts scheduled with less than 14 days’ notice decreased from 49.9% to 34.8%. However, we find that the law did not improve several commonly used measures of schedule stability, such as consistency in shift start times and hours worked. Our analysis also does not find evidence to support several commonly raised concerns about FWLs, including reduced work hours, increased employee turnover, reduced hiring, increased use of part-time workers, and reduced store operating hours. Overall, our results suggest that although FWLs can lead to some improvements in schedule predictability without these commonly raised negative consequences, they may have limited potential to increase schedule stability.This paper was accepted by Karan Girotra, operations management.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05622.
papers.abstract_zh: 公平工作周法律（FWLs）旨在提高员工工作排班的可预测性和稳定性。其做法是要求雇主提供具有充分提前通知的工作排班，或在未提供此类通知时补偿工人。尽管美国有越来越多的司法管辖区实施有效的FWLs（目前超过10个），但关于其对工作排班影响的实证证据却很少。本文使用来自在加利福尼亚州洛杉矶运营的七家独立零售连锁店的行政数据，考察洛杉矶的FWL对工作排班可预测性和稳定性的影响。我们发现，洛杉矶的FWL提高了工作排班的可预测性：在对数设定中，班次层面的提前通知增加了8.6%，而水平设定意味着每班次增加1.31天。此外，提前通知少于14天的班次占比从49.9%下降到34.8%。然而，我们发现该法律并未改善若干常用的排班稳定性指标，例如班次开始时间和工作小时数的一致性。我们的分析也未发现证据支持关于FWLs的若干常见担忧，包括工作时间减少、员工流动率上升、招聘减少、兼职工人使用增加以及门店营业时间减少。总体而言，我们的结果表明，尽管FWLs可以在没有这些常见负面后果的情况下带来排班可预测性的一些改善，但其提高排班稳定性的潜力可能有限。本文由运营管理领域编辑Karan Girotra接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05622获取。
papers.title_original: The Real Effects of Fair Workweek Laws on Work Schedules: Evidence from Los Angeles
papers.title_zh: 公平工作周法律对工作排班的实际影响：来自洛杉矶的证据

papers.abstract_original: Many online platforms adopt a price alert mechanism to facilitate customers tracking price changes. This mechanism allows customers to register their valuation with the system if they find the price higher than their valuation. Once the price drops below the customers’ registered price, a message is sent to notify customers. This paper formulates the interaction between the seller and customers as a Markov decision process. We assume customers are patient and are willing to wait for K additional periods for the price to drop if the current price is high. We first analyze the model in which K=1 and find that the seller’s optimal policy has three properties: (i) the threshold property by which the seller uses a threshold to decide whether to accept or reject a registered price, (ii) the price-at-register property by which the seller sets the price at the customer’s registered level if the registered price exceeds the threshold, and (iii) the cyclic decreasing property by which the price trajectory under the optimal policy has a stochastic cyclic decreasing structure. Modified versions of these properties still hold for the general model in which K is large or when the waiting time is heterogeneous among customers. On the policy computation side, we propose a heuristic pricing policy based on the price-at-register property. Numerical results show that the policy achieves near-optimal performance on all cases tested. We also observe that the impact of the value of K on the optimal revenue is almost negligible in many cases, and this ensures that the policies derived under our model are robust to the misspecification of K. This policy can also be adapted to the model in which customer patience is different and achieves near-optimal performance. Lastly, we show the impact of the price alert mechanism on seller’s revenue, customer surplus, and social welfare.This paper was accepted by Omar Besbes, revenue management and market analytics.Funding: B. Jiang’s research is partially supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (NSFC) [Grants 72394364, 72171141, 72394363, and 72442013]. Z. papers.abstract_zh: 许多在线平台采用价格提醒机制来帮助顾客追踪价格变化。该机制允许顾客在发现价格高于其估值时向系统登记其估值。一旦价格降至顾客登记的价格以下，系统就会发送消息通知顾客。本文将卖方与顾客之间的互动构建为一个马尔可夫决策过程。我们假设顾客是有耐心的，并且如果当前价格较高，他们愿意再等待K个额外时期以期价格下降。我们首先分析K=1的模型，发现卖方的最优策略具有三个性质：（i）阈值性质，即卖方使用一个阈值来决定接受还是拒绝登记价格；（ii）登记时定价性质，即如果登记价格超过阈值，卖方将价格设定在顾客登记的水平；（iii）循环递减性质，即在最优策略下价格轨迹具有随机循环递减结构。这些性质的修正版本在K较大或顾客之间等待时间异质的一般模型中仍然成立。在策略计算方面，我们基于登记时定价性质提出一种启发式定价策略。数值结果表明，该策略在所有测试案例中均实现了接近最优的表现。我们还观察到，在许多情况下，K的取值对最优收益的影响几乎可以忽略不计，这确保了在我们的模型下推导出的策略对K的设定错误具有稳健性。该策略还可以适应顾客耐心不同的模型，并实现接近最优的表现。最后，我们展示了价格提醒机制对卖方收益、消费者剩余和社会福利的影响。本文由收益管理与市场分析领域编辑Omar Besbes接受。资助：B. Jiang的研究部分得到国家自然科学基金（NSFC）[资助号72394364、72171141、72394363和72442013]的支持。Z. Wang的研究部分得到国家自然科学基金（NSFC）[资助号72394361和72425013]、广东省人工智能数学基础重点实验室[2023B1212010001]以及1+1+1 CUHK-CUHK(SZ)-GDSTC联合协作基金[2025A0505000079]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05665获取。

papers.abstract_original: Social referral programs, in which individuals recommend products or services within their networks in return for rewards, have been widely adopted across digital platforms. This study explores the impact of incorporating uncertainty into the rewards of such programs, focusing on how senders and recipients perceive and react to uncertain rewards. We run a randomized experiment involving more than 160,000 users of a telecommunications operator in China and examine the effectiveness of different referral reward schemes. We find that referral programs are most successful when senders are incentivized with uncertain rewards and recipients are guaranteed certain rewards. Specifically, introducing uncertainty in the sender’s reward leads to a 20.9% increase in total referrals with recipients of these invitations more likely to engage in subsequent referrals and profitable in-app activities. In contrast, uncertainty in the recipient’s reward results in a 12.3% decrease in total referrals with invited recipients showing a lower propensity to make further referrals and reduced postreferral engagement. Additional online experiments identify distinct mechanisms driving these asymmetric effects: For senders, the uncertainty alleviates feelings of guilt, enhancing referral sharing and, thus, increasing the total number of referrals. For recipients, the adverse effects of uncertainty stem primarily from diminished perceptions of fairness and social pressure, and these deter engagement in the referral process. Our study sheds light on the complex dynamics of reward uncertainty in referral programs, offering novel insights into how it can be optimized to foster more engaged referral networks.This paper was accepted by Anindya Ghose, information systems.Funding: A.T. Li acknowledges support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72301269 and 72332007] and the Fundamental Research Funds for the Central Universities [Grant WK2040000085]. R. T. Li acknowledges support from the Erasmus Research Institute of Management (ERIM) Convergence AI, Data & Digitalisation (Convergence AI Lab – Immersive Tech) Gravitation Program Public Values in the Algorithmic Society (AlgoSoc).Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05685.
papers.abstract_zh: 社交推荐计划，即个人在自己的社交网络中推荐产品或服务以换取奖励，已在数字平台上被广泛采用。本研究探讨将不确定性引入此类计划奖励中的影响，重点关注发送者和接收者如何感知和应对不确定的奖励。我们开展了一项随机实验，涉及中国一家电信运营商的超过160,000名用户，并检验了不同推荐奖励方案的有效性。我们发现，当发送者受到不确定奖励的激励而接收者获得保证的确定奖励时，推荐计划最为成功。具体而言，在发送者的奖励中引入不确定性会使总推荐量增加20.9%，且这些邀请的接收者更有可能参与后续推荐和有利可图的应用内活动。相比之下，接收者奖励中的不确定性会导致总推荐量下降12.3%，被邀请的接收者表现出更低的进一步推荐倾向，且推荐后参与度降低。额外的在线实验识别出驱动这些不对称效应的不同机制：对于发送者而言，不确定性缓解了内疚感，增强了推荐分享，从而增加了总推荐数量。对于接收者而言，不确定性的不利影响主要源于公平感和社会压力的减弱，这些因素阻碍了他们对推荐过程的参与。我们的研究揭示了推荐计划中奖励不确定性的复杂动态，为如何优化奖励不确定性以培育参与度更高的推荐网络提供了新颖的见解。本文由信息系统领域的Anindya Ghose接受。资助：A.T. Li感谢国家自然科学基金[资助号72301269和72332007]以及中央高校基本科研业务费[资助号WK2040000085]的支持。R. papers.abstract_original: We study how three components of university science—university publications, PhD graduates, and university patents—influence both upstream and downstream innovation in U.S. publicly traded firms that conduct R&D. To measure the relevance of university science to corporate innovation activity, we use machine-learning algorithms and bibliometric data to link university publications, PhD dissertations, and university patents to corporate publications and patents. Identification exploits firm-specific exposure to shifts in federal agency R&D budgets. We find that university science affects corporate innovation primarily through PhD graduates and university patents: PhD graduates raise firm innovation, whereas university patents substitute for corporate patents and lower the need for internal research. In contrast, university publications elicit little direct contemporaneous response on average; however, this pattern varies substantially across sectors and firm capabilities, with stronger complementarities in the life sciences and among firms operating near the technology frontier. Because established firms account for more than three-quarters of all business R&D, understanding how their innovation responds to university publications, PhD graduates, and university patents is central to assessing the broader impact of university science on corporate innovation.This paper was accepted by Anita McGahan, Business Strategy.Funding: This work was supported by Qualcomm Incorporated, the Coller Foundation, the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation [Grant G-2023-21022], the Fuqua School of Business, the Freeman School of Business, and The Henry Crown Institute of Business Research. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05723.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究大学科学的三个组成部分——大学出版物、博士毕业生和大学专利——如何影响开展研发的美国上市公司的上游和下游创新。为了衡量大学科学与公司创新活动的相关性，我们使用机器学习算法和文献计量数据，将大学出版物、博士论文和大学专利与公司出版物和专利联系起来。识别利用了企业对联邦机构研发预算变动的特定暴露。我们发现，大学科学主要通过博士毕业生和大学专利影响企业创新：博士毕业生提升企业创新，而大学专利替代企业专利并降低对内部研究的需求。相比之下，大学出版物平均而言几乎不引起直接的同期反应；然而，这一模式在不同行业和企业能力之间差异很大，在生命科学领域以及处于技术前沿附近的企业中具有更强的互补性。由于成熟企业占所有企业研发的四分之三以上，理解其创新如何对大学出版物、博士毕业生和大学专利作出反应，对于评估大学科学对企业创新的更广泛影响至关重要。本文由Anita McGahan（商业战略）接受。资助：本工作得到Qualcomm Incorporated、Coller Foundation、Alfred P. Sloan Foundation [资助号G-2023-21022]、Fuqua商学院、Freeman商学院和The Henry Crown Institute of Business Research的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05723获取。

papers.abstract_original: The persistent imbalance between organ supply and demand poses a significant challenge for the lifesaving treatment of transplantation. This study introduces innovative targeted priority mechanisms inspired by the Eurotransplant Senior Program (ESP), designed to bridge the supply-demand gap while optimizing the matching between organs and recipients without mandating offer acceptance. These mechanisms diverge from traditional prioritization by offering voluntary participation and granting explicit priority to disadvantaged patients for a specified range of organs, provided they restrict their offer acceptance to this set. Using a comprehensive queueing model, our study analyzes the strategic decisions of waitlisted candidates under targeted priority mechanisms in equilibrium, establishing the optimal program design. Our evaluation of these mechanisms’ impact on social welfare underscores their potential to improve overall welfare without adversely affecting any patient group. The practical applicability and impact of these mechanisms are demonstrated through a case study within the U.S. kidney allocation system, using a clinically detailed simulation model targeting elderly patients aged 65 and above. Simulation outcomes reveal a significant participation rate (70%) even when the program offers priority over kidneys that are conventionally perceived as marginal. Furthermore, our findings highlight the mechanisms’ potential to increase transplants by up to 920, decrease nonuse by 25%, and prevent up to 193 waitlist deaths annually compared with the current system. Improvements in the outcomes of even nonelderly patients highlight the mechanisms’ potential to comprehensively address organ underutilization and improve organ-recipient matching in a real-world context.This paper was accepted by Nicos Savva, healthcare management.Funding: This work was supported by the Division of Civil, Mechanical and Manufacturing Innovation [Grant 2339767]. This work was supported in part by the Health Resources and Services Administration [Contract HHSH250-2019-00001C].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05724.
papers.abstract_zh: 器官供需之间持续存在的不平衡，对挽救生命的移植治疗构成了重大挑战。本研究引入了受欧洲移植高级计划（ESP）启发的创新性定向优先机制，旨在弥合供需缺口，同时优化器官与受者之间的匹配，而不强制要求接受分配。这些机制不同于传统优先排序，它们提供自愿参与，并针对特定范围的器官给予弱势患者明确优先权，前提是这些患者将其接受分配限制在该范围内。使用一个综合性的排队模型，我们的研究分析了等待名单候选人在定向优先机制下均衡中的策略性决策，并确立了最优方案设计。我们对这些机制社会福利影响的评估，强调了它们在不对任何患者群体造成不利影响的情况下改善整体福利的潜力。这些机制的实践适用性和影响通过美国肾脏分配系统中的一个案例研究得到展示，该研究使用一个针对65岁及以上老年患者的临床详细模拟模型。模拟结果揭示了显著的参与率（70%），即使该计划提供的优先权针对的是传统上被视为边缘性的肾脏。此外，我们的发现凸显了这些机制相较于当前系统，可将移植数量增加多达920，将未使用率降低25%，并每年最多避免193例等待名单死亡。即使是非老年患者结局的改善，也凸显了这些机制在现实世界背景下全面解决器官利用不足并改善器官-受者匹配的潜力。本文由医疗管理领域的Nicos Savva接受。资助：本工作得到土木、机械与制造创新部[资助编号2339767]的支持。本工作部分得到卫生资源与服务管理局[合同编号HHSH250-2019-00001C]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05724获取。
papers.title_original: Targeted Priority Mechanisms in Transplantation: Incentivizing, Not Enforcing, Efficient Matching of Organs
papers.title_zh: 移植中的定向优先机制：激励而非强制器官的有效匹配

papers.abstract_original: Many firms are pledging to reduce greenhouse gas emissions across their value chains. However, this requires their suppliers to also adopt more climate-friendly practices for decarbonization. This can involve addressing gaps in not only the suppliers’ ability but also, their willingness to adopt such practices, which can be challenging if the suppliers perceive the practices as risky or potentially detrimental to their economic well-being. We examine the effectiveness of relational investments to help mitigate this challenge, arguing that such investments can serve as a signal of the firm’s commitment toward joint value creation. In a field experiment conducted with supplier farmers in a multinational firm’s agricultural supply chain in India, we examine the impact of two kinds of relational investments in providing the farmers with customized agricultural services that they valued. In the first intervention, the firm’s field officers offered the farmers support specific to the crop that the firm sourced from them. The second intervention additionally involved bringing in expert agronomists to also provide the farmers with support on broader agricultural matters of interest to them. Relative to a control condition in which the farmers only received training on the relevant climate-friendly practices, both interventions improved the farmers’ adoption of the recommended practices. The second intervention was more impactful than the first in improving the farmers’ practice adoption as well as their retention with the firm. Exploratory mediation analysis and post-experiment field interviews suggest that these findings are partly driven by the farmers’ positive perception of the firm’s relational investments.This paper was accepted by Anita McGahan, business strategy.Funding: The authors acknowledge financial support from INSEAD [Kurt Björklund Research Fund].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05744.
papers.abstract_zh: 许多公司正在承诺减少其价值链中的温室气体排放。然而，这要求其供应商也采用更气候友好的做法以实现脱碳。这可能涉及不仅解决供应商能力方面的差距，还解决其采用此类做法的意愿方面的差距；如果供应商认为这些做法有风险或可能损害其经济福祉，这可能具有挑战性。我们考察关系型投资在帮助缓解这一挑战方面的有效性，认为此类投资可以作为公司致力于共同价值创造的信号。在一项与某跨国公司位于印度的农业供应链中的供应商农民开展的实地实验中，我们考察两类关系型投资在向农民提供其重视的定制化农业服务方面的影响。在第一项干预中，公司的田间官员向农民提供针对公司从其处采购的作物的支持。第二项干预还额外引入专家农艺师，也就农民感兴趣的更广泛农业事务向其提供支持。相对于农民仅接受相关气候友好做法培训的对照组，两项干预都提高了农民对推荐做法的采用。第二项干预在提高农民做法采用率以及其留在公司的留存率方面比第一项影响更大。探索性中介分析和实验后实地访谈表明，这些发现部分由农民对公司关系型投资的积极感知所驱动。本文由商业战略领域的Anita McGahan接受。资助：作者感谢INSEAD[Kurt Björklund研究基金]的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05744获取。

papers.abstract_original: We study the role of gender in corporate debt renegotiation. Using in-court reorganizations from Brazil, we find that male-led creditors are more likely to reject plans put forward by female-led debtors. Although we cannot definitively identify the underlying mechanism driving this pattern, our findings align more consistently with gender-based discrimination compared with alternative explanations. This behavior may be costly: Female-led debtors deliver higher recoveries under reorganization than under liquidation, implying that rejections potentially create deadweight losses. Supporting a miscalibrated-beliefs explanation, we observe that the gender-based rejection gap narrows when male creditors have prior exposure to successful female-led businesses, pointing to a potential path for mitigation.This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05802.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究性别在公司债务重新谈判中的作用。利用巴西的法庭内重组案例，我们发现男性主导的债权人更可能拒绝女性主导的债务人提出的方案。尽管我们无法明确识别驱动这一模式的潜在机制，但与替代性解释相比，我们的发现与基于性别的歧视更为一致。这种行为可能代价高昂：女性主导的债务人在重组下的回收率高于清算下的回收率，这意味着拒绝可能造成无谓损失。支持信念校准偏差解释的是，我们观察到当男性债权人事先接触过成功的女性主导企业时，基于性别的拒绝差距会缩小，这指向了一条潜在的缓解路径。本文由金融学领域的Bo Becker接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05802获取。

papers.abstract_original: We comprehensively examine the usefulness of machine learning technology to predict a firm’s earnings and offer three main findings. First, although prior literature suggests machine learning can offer better earnings forecasts than analysts, we show that this result is highly sensitive to machine learning model specification choices (i.e., 80% of evaluated machine forecasts fail to beat analysts). Second, we examine why the most accurate machine learning forecast consistently beats analysts, finding that they correct for predictable analyst biases that are both linear and nonlinear and largely relate to analysts’ prior forecast errors, forecasted earnings levels, and the firm’s stock price. Finally, we find that investors’ earnings expectations, as revealed through stock prices, largely—but do not fully—correct for these predictable analyst biases, with delayed price realization up to nine months. In additional analysis, we find that optimal machine learning specification choices remain stable over time and that, although the machine’s outperformance narrows in recent periods, it remains substantial among small-cap stocks. Overall, our study moves beyond the question of whether machine forecasts are superior to human forecasts and instead focuses on which machine forecast specifications matter, as well as when and why machine forecasts are most superior. In so doing, we provide code and estimates for the most accurate machine forecast specification and demonstrate that investors’ expectations appear to largely (but not fully) align with them.This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05808.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们全面考察了机器学习技术预测公司盈利的实用性，并提供了三个主要发现。第一，尽管先前文献表明机器学习能提供比分析师更好的盈利预测，但我们表明这一结果对机器学习模型设定选择高度敏感（即，80%的评估机器学习预测未能超越分析师）。第二，我们探究了为何最准确的机器学习预测能持续超越分析师，发现它们校正了可预测的分析师偏差，这些偏差既包括线性也包括非线性，且在很大程度上与分析师先前的预测误差、预测盈利水平以及公司股价相关。最后，我们发现投资者的盈利预期，如通过股价所揭示的，在很大程度上——但并非完全——校正了这些可预测的分析师偏差，价格实现延迟长达九个月。在额外分析中，我们发现最优机器学习设定选择随时间保持稳定，并且，尽管机器预测的优异表现在近期有所收窄，但在小盘股中仍然显著。总体而言，我们的研究超越了机器预测是否优于人类预测的问题，转而关注哪些机器预测设定重要，以及机器预测何时、为何最为优越。在此过程中，我们提供了最准确机器预测设定的代码和估计，并证明投资者的预期似乎在很大程度上（但并非完全）与之相符。本文由会计学领域Suraj Srinivasan接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05808获取。
