papers.abstract_original: Firms are exposed to litigation risk from various stakeholders, including investors, customers, and regulators, and prior research has shown that such risk shapes a range of corporate policies. In this study, we develop a simple and transparent measure of firm-level litigation risk by parsing SEC 10-K annual reports. This measure demonstrates strong predictability for lawsuits, even after controlling for firm characteristics, existing lawsuits, geographic factors, and various fixed effects, including firm fixed effects. This simple measure performs comparably to a more resource-intensive, AI-generated litigation risk measure. We further link our measure of litigation risk to a variety of corporate policies, including cash holdings, capital expenditures, R&D, and acquisitions, uncovering results consistent with the literature.This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance.Funding: C. Ham acknowledges financial support from the Blanche “Peg” Philpott Faculty Fellowship.Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05821.
papers.abstract_zh: 企业面临来自包括投资者、客户和监管机构等各类利益相关者的诉讼风险，既有研究表明此类风险会塑造一系列公司政策。在本研究中，我们通过解析美国证券交易委员会（SEC）的10-K年度报告，构建了一个简单且透明的企业层面诉讼风险测度指标。该指标对诉讼展现出很强的预测能力，即使在控制了企业特征、既有诉讼、地理因素以及包括企业固定效应在内的各种固定效应之后依然如此。这一简单指标的表现与一个更为资源密集、由人工智能生成的诉讼风险指标相当。我们进一步将我们的诉讼风险测度与一系列公司政策相联系，包括现金持有、资本支出、研发和并购，所得结果与文献一致。本文由Bo Becker（金融学）接受。资助：C. Ham感谢Blanche “Peg” Philpott Faculty Fellowship的财务支持。补充材料：互联网附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05821获取。

papers.abstract_original: Multisided platforms crucially rely on indirect network effects. When trying to strengthen these effects, platform owners face a fundamental challenge, namely, designing incentives to enhance developer effort and simultaneously ensuring the release of high-quality products on the platform. This paper highlights the costs associated with lowering royalty rates to boost developer effort, as such reductions increase the relative supply of lower-quality offerings, worsening information congestion problems and amplifying the importance of visibility-enhancing investments. We leverage the quasi random announcements made by Apple and Google, declaring their intention to reduce the royalty rate applied to small app developers from 30% to 15%. We analyze the implications of these reforms using a difference-in-differences approach, finding a substantial increase in small developers’ likelihood of releasing lower-quality and less original apps on iOS and Android after the announcements. These effects are neither paralleled by a comparable increase in high-quality app releases nor by an increase in small developers’ likelihood of launching venture-backed apps. Consistent with worsening information congestion problems because of an influx of low-quality apps, our findings show an increase in the marginal value of experienced user certifications and developers’ app store optimization efforts post announcement. Additionally, we observe that venture capitalists are increasingly concentrating their investments in ventures with higher (observable) quality.This paper was accepted by Anita McGahan, business strategy.Funding: This work was supported by the Spanish Ministry of Education [Project PID2022-138710NB-I00 funded by MCIU/AEI/10.13039/501100011033/FEDER, UE]. A. Conti acknowledges financial support from the Swiss National Science Foundation [Grant 100013_197807]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.0586.
papers.abstract_zh: 多边平台关键依赖于间接网络效应。在试图强化这些效应时，平台所有者面临一个根本挑战，即设计激励以增强开发者努力，同时确保在平台上发布高质量产品。本文强调了为提升开发者努力而降低版税率所带来的成本，因为此类降低会增加较低质量产品的相对供给，恶化信息拥堵问题，并放大可见度提升投资的重要性。我们利用苹果和谷歌发布的准随机公告，这些公告宣布其意图将适用于小型应用开发者的版税率从30%降至15%。我们使用双重差分方法分析这些改革的影响，发现公告后小型开发者在iOS和Android上发布较低质量和较不原创应用的可能性大幅增加。这些效应既没有伴随高质量应用发布的相应增加，也没有伴随小型开发者推出风险投资支持应用的可能性增加。与低质量应用涌入导致信息拥堵问题恶化相一致，我们的发现表明公告后经验用户认证和开发者应用商店优化努力的边际价值增加。此外，我们观察到风险投资家越来越多地将投资集中于具有更高（可观察）质量的企业。本文由商业战略领域的Anita McGahan接受。资助：本工作得到西班牙教育部[项目PID2022-138710NB-I00，由MCIU/AEI/10.13039/501100011033/FEDER, UE资助]的支持。A. Conti感谢瑞士国家科学基金会[资助号100013_197807]的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.0586获取。

papers.abstract_original: We document that larger firms pay substantially lower cash effective tax rates (cash effective tax rates (ETRs)) over the long run than smaller firms. Over a 10-year period, firms in the largest decile pay 10.4 percentage points (p.p.) (25%) lower cash taxes than those in the smallest decile, and this gap balloons to 14.4 p.p. (35%) for the largest 1% of firms. This pattern is robust to various specifications but vanishes when cash ETRs are measured annually. The relation between firm size and taxes over the long run cannot be explained by foreign operations, depreciation, research and development spending, or stock compensation, characteristics commonly associated with aggressive tax practices. Meanwhile, the observed tax inequality is strongly associated with the incidence of losses. Because smaller firms are more likely to incur significant losses, which are often not deductible against profits, they consequently face higher effective tax rates. A key finding of our paper is that the size effect reflects differences in loss rates, and consequently utilization, rather than political costs or benefits. A cross-country analysis supports these findings.This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting.Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05865.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们记录到，从长期来看，较大企业支付的现金有效税率（现金有效税率（ETRs））大幅低于较小企业。在10年期间，最大十分位组的企业比最小十分位组的企业支付的现金税低10.4个百分点（p.p.）（25%），而对于最大的1%企业，这一差距膨胀至14.4个百分点（35%）。这一模式在各种设定下均稳健，但当现金ETRs按年度衡量时则消失。长期来看企业规模与税收之间的关系无法由海外业务、折旧、研发支出或股票薪酬来解释，而这些特征通常与激进税收实践相关。同时，观察到的税收不平等与亏损的发生率密切相关。由于较小企业更可能发生重大亏损，而这些亏损通常不能抵扣利润，因此它们面临更高的有效税率。我们论文的一个关键发现是，规模效应反映的是亏损率以及由此导致的利用率的差异，而非政治成本或收益。一项跨国分析支持了这些发现。本文由Ranjani Krishnan接受，会计学。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05865获取。

papers.abstract_original: In the largest data set of crypto assets to date, we uncover a significant value effect based on the active-addresses-to-market-cap ratio. The corresponding novel value factor, together with the crypto market, size, and momentum factors adapted to our sample, forms a four-factor model that explains the cross-sectional return variations better than existing benchmarks. We show that the crypto value premium is plausibly driven by compensation for on-chain activity risk. We also provide the first comprehensive classification of major cryptocurrencies based on their economic functionality. Applying methodologies from international asset pricing, we document significant market segmentation across the token categories, with nonmonotone dynamics and implications for crypto investment strategy and regulation.This paper was accepted by Christoph Loch, finance.Conflict of Interest Statement: L. papers.abstract_zh: 在迄今为止最大的加密资产数据集中，我们基于活跃地址与市值之比发现了一个显著的价值效应。相应的新价值因子，连同适应我们样本的加密市场、规模与动量因子，构成了一个四因子模型，其解释横截面收益变异的能力优于现有基准。我们表明，加密价值溢价可能由对链上活动风险的补偿所驱动。我们还首次基于经济功能对主要加密货币进行了全面分类。应用国际资产定价的方法论，我们记录了代币类别之间显著的市场分割，其动态非单调，并对加密投资策略和监管具有启示。本文由Christoph Loch，金融领域接受。利益冲突声明：L. papers.abstract_original: Cooperativeness is essential to individual and organizational success. We exploit a unique feature of conference calls to study individual executives’ cooperativeness, indicated by their directly inviting colleagues to respond to analysts’ questions, and its relation with their career outcomes and firm performance. After validating our measure, we find that cooperativeness is associated with relevant executive characteristics. Older, more senior, and more experienced executives are more likely to display cooperativeness. We also find that cooperativeness persists but can be influenced by colleagues. Turning to the relation with career and firm outcomes, we find robust evidence of a positive association between cooperativeness and the likelihood of being promoted to chief executive officer (CEO). Appointing CEOs who are more cooperative than their predecessors is associated with an average three-day abnormal return of 0.6% around the announcement of the appointment.This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting.Funding: W. Cai gratefully acknowledges financial support from the Bernstein Center for Leadership and Ethics of Columbia Business School.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05902.
papers.abstract_zh: 合作性对个人和组织的成功至关重要。我们利用电话会议的一个独特特征来研究个体高管的合作性，其表现为他们直接邀请同事回答分析师的问题，并考察其与职业结果和公司绩效的关系。在验证了我们的测度之后，我们发现合作性与相关的高管特征有关。年龄更大、职位更高、经验更丰富的高管更可能表现出合作性。我们还发现，合作性具有持续性，但可能受到同事的影响。转向与职业和公司结果的关系，我们发现稳健的证据表明，合作性与被提升为首席执行官（CEO）的可能性之间存在正相关关系。任命比前任更合作的首席执行官，与任命公告前后平均0.6%的三日异常收益相关。本文由Ranjani Krishnan（会计学）接受。资助：W. Cai感谢哥伦比亚商学院Bernstein领导力与伦理中心的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05902获取。

papers.abstract_original: This paper examines the role of franchising in enabling firms to access valuable local market information. Using comprehensive data on U.S. franchised establishments, we show that franchisee-owned establishment openings robustly predict future local economic growth reflected by house price appreciation, whereas franchisor-owned outlets lack such predictive power. Franchisee investments are especially informative in markets with greater uncertainty and complexity and when facing higher investment hurdles. Franchisors appear sensitive to information frictions, avoiding direct investment in new markets that are geographically distant and lack direct flight connectivity. Our findings support the long-standing but untested assumption that franchisees possess superior private information.This paper was accepted by Maria Guadalupe, business strategy.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05903.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文考察了特许经营在使企业获取有价值的本地市场信息方面的作用。利用美国特许经营机构的综合数据，我们表明，加盟商拥有的门店开业能够稳健地预测未来由房价升值所反映的本地经济增长，而特许人拥有的门店则缺乏这种预测能力。加盟商投资在市场不确定性和复杂性更大以及面临更高投资障碍时尤其具有信息含量。特许人似乎对信息摩擦敏感，避免在地理上遥远且缺乏直飞连通性的新市场进行直接投资。我们的发现支持了一个长期存在但未经检验的假设，即加盟商拥有更优越的私人信息。本文由商业战略领域的Maria Guadalupe接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05903获取。

papers.abstract_original: A principal delegates a sequential search with finite search opportunities to an agent, who bears the search cost and controls how far to search. The termination payoff is split between them according to a prespecified proportion. In our setting, only the principal can evaluate the search outcomes and design a policy to decide what information to provide to the agent after each search. Formulating the principal’s problem as a dynamic information design, we obtain a complete analytical characterization of the principal’s optimal information policy featuring a sequence of deterministic acceptance standards. The agent is simply recommended to and will voluntarily continue the search if and only if the current termination payoff falls below the corresponding standard prespecified at the beginning of the search. This policy offers an easy-to-implement prescriptive guideline for how information can be used as an incentive device in delegated search, especially absent pecuniary instruments. For nonrecallable search, the acceptance standards are informative, descending, and determined recursively as the optimal stopping thresholds that the principal would employ if the principal were to search directly at a shadow cost. In contrast, for recallable search, the optimal policy features a regime change: for the first cutoff number of search opportunities, the principal can set a constant, possibly uninformative acceptance standard that would be attainable in a costless search; after the cutoff opportunity, the principal sets a sequence of descending acceptance standards, each independently determined by equating the agent’s marginal perceived return from one additional search with the cost.This paper was accepted by Ilia Tsetlin, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Funding: This work was supported by the Ministry of Education, Singapore, under its 2019 Academic Research Fund Tier 3 [Grant MOE-2019-T3-1-010].Supplemental Material: The online appendices are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05925.
papers.abstract_zh: 委托人将具有有限搜索机会的序贯搜索委托给代理人，代理人承担搜索成本并控制搜索的深度。终止收益按预先指定的比例在双方之间分配。在我们的设定中，只有委托人能够评估搜索结果并设计政策，以决定每次搜索后向代理人提供什么信息。将委托人的问题表述为动态信息设计，我们获得了委托人最优信息政策的完整解析刻画，其特征是一系列确定性接受标准。当且仅当当前终止收益低于搜索开始时预先指定的相应标准时，代理人被简单建议并且会自愿继续搜索。该政策为在委托搜索中如何将信息用作激励工具，尤其是在缺乏金钱工具的情况下，提供了易于实施的规范性指南。对于不可召回搜索，接受标准具有信息性、递减性，并作为委托人在以影子成本直接搜索时会采用的最优停止阈值递归确定。相比之下，对于可召回搜索，最优政策具有一种机制变化：在前若干个截止搜索机会内，委托人可以设定一个恒定的、可能无信息含量的接受标准，该标准在无成本搜索中是可以达到的；在截止机会之后，委托人设定一系列递减的接受标准，每个标准通过将代理人从额外一次搜索中感知到的边际收益与成本相等来独立确定。本文由Ilia Tsetlin（行为经济学与决策分析）接受。资助：本工作得到新加坡教育部在其2019学术研究基金第3级的支持[资助号MOE-2019-T3-1-010]。补充材料：在线附录可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05925获取。

papers.abstract_original: An emerging body of research on teams highlights the importance of implicit incentives for cooperation and/or collusion that rely on mutual monitoring among team members. Whereas prior research on mutual monitoring in team production settings typically assumes that agents have identical abilities, this paper examines how such incentives operate when team members differ in their productive abilities. We show that the role of productive heterogeneity depends on the nature of team production. In cross-functional teams, collusion does not arise, and productive heterogeneity does not alter the qualitative nature of cooperative incentives. In functional teams, heterogeneity introduces additional (binding) constraints that ensure that both more and less productive agents are motivated to cooperate. However, when collusion among team members is a concern, productive heterogeneity can be advantageous. The optimal means of preventing collusion in functional teams is to employ asymmetric contracts, where the more productive agent receives higher-powered collusion-proof incentives. Asymmetric contracts shift effort away from the more productive agent under potential collusion, which reduces the agents’ joint gains from collusion. Productive heterogeneity is advantageous in functional teams when there is a high degree of productive substitutability and/or a high discount factor. These conditions lead to a severe collusion problem, which is mitigated by productive heterogeneity. When the productive substitutability and/or the discount factor are low, the optimal productive heterogeneity is either small or none. We also study optimal team design, allowing the principal to choose between a functional team and a cross-functional team and the optimal level of productive heterogeneity.This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting.Funding: E. Kim acknowledges financial support from a PSC-CUNY Award [Cycle 56], jointly funded by the Professional Staff Congress and The City University of New York.
papers.abstract_zh: 一个新兴的团队研究文献强调了依赖于团队成员之间相互监督的合作和/或合谋的隐性激励的重要性。以往关于团队生产环境中相互监督的研究通常假设代理人具有相同的能力，而本文考察当团队成员的生产能力不同时，此类激励如何运作。我们表明，生产性异质性的作用取决于团队生产的性质。在跨职能型团队中，合谋不会出现，生产性异质性不会改变合作激励的定性性质。在职能型团队中，异质性引入了额外的（约束性）约束，以确保生产能力较高和较低的代理人都受到合作激励。然而，当团队成员之间的合谋成为一个问题时，生产性异质性可能是有利的。在职能型团队中防止合谋的最优手段是采用非对称合同，即生产能力较高的代理人获得更高强度的防合谋激励。非对称合同在潜在合谋下将努力从生产能力较高的代理人处转移开，从而降低了代理人从合谋中获得的联合收益。当生产性可替代性程度高和/或贴现因子高时，生产性异质性在职能型团队中是有利的。这些条件导致严重的合谋问题，而生产性异质性可缓解该问题。当生产性可替代性和/或贴现因子较低时，最优的生产性异质性要么很小，要么为零。我们还研究了最优团队设计，允许委托人选择职能型团队或跨职能型团队以及最优的生产性异质性水平。本文由会计学领域编辑Ranjani Krishnan接受。资助：E. Kim感谢PSC-CUNY奖[第56周期]的财务支持，该奖由专业职员大会和纽约城市大学联合资助。

papers.abstract_original: We model auditor switching through a tender process involving an incumbent auditor, who has private information about the client firm’s audit cost (driven by audit complexity or audit risk), and an uninformed prospective auditor. When a firm’s audit cost is high, the auditor is more susceptible to audit failure by erroneously attesting to the firm’s favorable report. We show that, in equilibrium, the client facing a high audit cost is more likely to switch to a prospective auditor because of the winner’s curse. Clients who switch auditors experience a reduction in the overall expected audit fee and are more likely to receive favorable audited reports from the new auditor than clients who do not switch. Our analytical findings collectively present a new information-based perspective on auditor switching, extending beyond the conventional “opinion shopping” explanation. We caution researchers to consider the potential influence of information asymmetry among auditors when examining auditor switching.This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting.Supplemental Material: The online appendices are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05977.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们通过一个招标过程对审计师更换进行建模，该过程涉及一名现任审计师（其拥有关于客户公司审计成本的私人信息，该成本由审计复杂性或审计风险驱动）和一名不知情潜在审计师。当公司的审计成本较高时，审计师更容易因错误地鉴证公司有利报告而遭遇审计失败。我们表明，在均衡中，面临高审计成本的客户由于赢家诅咒而更可能更换为潜在审计师。更换审计师的客户经历总体预期审计费用的下降，并且比不更换审计师的客户更可能从新审计师那里获得有利的已审计报告。我们的分析发现共同呈现了一种关于审计师更换的新的基于信息的视角，超越了传统的“意见购买”解释。我们提醒研究者在考察审计师更换时考虑审计师之间信息不对称的潜在影响。本文由Suraj Srinivasan（会计学）接受。补充材料：在线附录可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05977获取。
papers.title_original: An Information-Based Theory of Auditor Switching
papers.title_zh: 基于信息的审计师更换理论

papers.abstract_original: We document financial reporting effects of the 1934 Securities Exchange Act. Specifically, we find strong evidence that the act made the accounting of similar firms more similar. In contrast, we find no evidence that the act made the accounting of differing firms more similar. Together, these findings suggest that the act increased accounting comparability but not accounting uniformity. Further, the act increased information spillovers from earnings news released during bellwether firms’ earnings announcements to other firms within the same industry. We investigate possible mechanisms by which the act affected comparability and spillovers, and we identify the Securities and Exchange Commission’s financial reporting instructions and its financial reviews and comment letter process as the most likely drivers. Overall, our results provide evidence that the act improved financial reporting through increased accounting comparability and increased information spillovers, two features of accounting standards associated with numerous benefits for firms, investors, and capital markets.This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting.Funding: The authors acknowledge financial support from European School of Management and Technology Berlin and The Ohio State University.Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06043.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们记录了1934年证券交易法的财务报告效应。具体而言，我们发现强有力的证据表明，该法案使相似公司的会计更加相似。相比之下，我们没有发现证据表明该法案使不同公司的会计更加相似。总之，这些发现表明该法案提高了会计可比性，但没有提高会计统一性。此外，该法案增加了在领头羊公司收益公告期间发布的收益新闻向同行业其他公司的信息溢出。我们考察了该法案影响可比性和溢出的可能机制，并确定证券交易委员会的财务报告指令及其财务审查和意见函流程是最可能的驱动因素。总体而言，我们的结果提供了证据表明，该法案通过提高会计可比性和增加信息溢出改善了财务报告，这两个会计准则特征与企业、投资者和资本市场的诸多益处相关。本文由Suraj Srinivasan（会计）接受。资助：作者感谢欧洲管理与技术学院柏林和俄亥俄州立大学的财务支持。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06043获取。
papers.title_original: Financial Reporting Effects of the 1934 Securities Exchange Act
papers.title_zh: 1934年证券交易法的财务报告效应

papers.abstract_original: We study how intercommunity social networks influence loan demand and supply on fintech lending platforms. Demand for online loans rises following increases in online borrowing activity in geographically distant but socially connected areas. On the supply side, borrower area social proximity to deposit-rich regions increases funding likelihood and is associated with better ex post loan performance. We establish causality with shift-share instrumental variables (SSIVs) obtained from natural disasters (demand side) and financial adviser misconduct (supply side). Social connectedness expands both loan demand and supply in disadvantaged communities without increasing delinquency rates. Intercommunity social networks raise awareness of alternative lending platforms and transmit hard-to-obtain information that mitigates community-level information asymmetry.This paper has been accepted by Will Cong for the Virtual Special Issue on Digital Finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06050.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究社区间社会网络如何影响金融科技借贷平台上的贷款需求和供给。在线贷款需求在地理上遥远但社会联系的地区在线借贷活动增加后上升。在供给方面，借款人所在地区与存款充裕地区的社会邻近性提高了融资可能性，并与更好的事后贷款表现相关。我们利用从自然灾害（需求侧）和财务顾问不当行为（供给侧）获得的移动份额工具变量（SSIVs）建立因果关系。社会连通性扩大了弱势社区的贷款需求和供给，而未增加违约率。社区间社会网络提高了对替代借贷平台的认识，并传递了难以获得的信息，从而缓解了社区层面的信息不对称。本文已由Will Cong接受，用于数字金融虚拟特刊。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06050获取。
papers.title_original: Social Networks as Information Conduits for Online Credit Supply and Demand
papers.title_zh: 社会网络作为在线信贷供需的信息渠道

papers.abstract_original: This paper investigates how environmental regulatory uncertainty affects green innovation in polluting firms. The findings suggest that, instead of adopting a passive “wait-and-see” strategy, polluting firms proactively engage in green innovation and R&D activities. To address endogeneity, I employ an instrumental variable approach using political polarization in roll-call votes on environmental and climate issues in the U.S. House of Representatives. I also exploit the proposal of the Affordable Clean Energy rule in 2018 as an exogenous shock in a difference-in-differences framework. The results are consistent with the growth options view of green innovation in polluting firms. Additional evidence suggests that environmental regulatory uncertainty leads to reductions in toxic emissions.This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06051.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文研究环境监管不确定性如何影响污染企业的绿色创新。研究结果表明，污染企业并非采取被动的“观望”策略，而是主动参与绿色创新和研发活动。为解决内生性，我采用工具变量方法，使用美国众议院关于环境和气候问题唱名投票中的政治极化作为工具变量。我还在双重差分框架中利用2018年《可负担清洁能源规则》的提案作为外生冲击。结果与污染企业绿色创新的增长期权观点一致。额外证据表明，环境监管不确定性导致有毒排放减少。本文由Camelia Kuhnen，金融学接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06051获取。
papers.title_original: Waiting or Acting: The Effects of Environmental Regulatory Uncertainty on Green Innovation
papers.title_zh: 等待还是行动：环境监管不确定性对绿色创新的影响

papers.abstract_original: We examine the prevalence, determinants, and consequences of cheap stock. Practitioners have adopted the label “cheap stock” to refer to equity-based compensation granted before a firm’s IPO that uses a share price below the IPO price. Cheap stock grants have drawn regulators’ attention with the Securities and Exchange Commission frequently commenting on issues related to cheap stock when reviewing firms’ IPO registration statements. We find that the average firm’s IPO price is more than five times the exercise price of options issued in the fiscal year before the IPO. This divergence between the IPO price and the exercise price of recently granted options is greater for firms that grant more options, have larger public offerings, and have venture capital backing. Finally, cheap stock options are associated with higher CEO compensation, lower post-IPO investment, lower post-IPO stock returns, and greater IPO underpricing. Collectively, our results illustrate the extent of cheap stock option grants and how these grants influence firms’ post-IPO behavior.This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting.Funding: We thank Deloitte, the Mendoza College of Business, the Danish Finance Institute (DFI), and the Wharton-INSEAD Centre for Global Research and Education for financial support.Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06121.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察了廉价股票的普遍性、决定因素和后果。实务界采用“廉价股票”这一标签来指称在公司IPO之前授予的、使用低于IPO价格的股价的股权激励。廉价股票授予已引起监管机构的关注，美国证券交易委员会在审阅公司IPO注册声明时经常就与廉价股票相关的问题发表意见。我们发现，公司IPO前一个财政年度所发行期权的平均行权价不到IPO价格五分之一。对于授予更多期权、公开发行规模更大以及有风险资本支持的公司，IPO价格与近期授予期权行权价之间的这种背离更大。最后，廉价股票期权与更高的CEO薪酬、更低的IPO后投资、更低的IPO后股票回报以及更大的IPO抑价相关。总体而言，我们的结果说明了廉价股票期权授予的普遍程度，以及这些授予如何影响公司的IPO后行为。本文由会计学Suraj Srinivasan接受。资助：我们感谢德勤、门多萨商学院、丹麦金融研究所（DFI）以及沃顿-INSEAD全球研究与教育中心提供的财务支持。补充材料：数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06121 获取。
papers.title_original: Cheap Stock Options: Antecedents and Outcomes
papers.title_zh: 廉价股票期权：前因与后果

papers.abstract_original: We provide a systematic, data-driven methodology for choosing test scenarios among a set of potential scenarios. The test scenarios can be used to accurately estimate measures of tail risk of financial institutions, such as conditional value at risk (CVaR), and can also simultaneously be used for stress testing, that is, to identify conditions for large losses. We validate the methodology on historical data used in stress tests by the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Federal Reserve and connect it to the design of experiments methodology with a risk-based objective. The methodology does not require detailed knowledge of financial institutions’ portfolios and can aid regulators in evaluating the resilience of multiple institutions using uniform risk assessment standards.This paper was accepted by Giesecke Kay, finance.Supplemental Material: The electronic companion and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06126.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提供了一种系统性的、数据驱动的方法，用于在一组潜在情景中选择测试情景。这些测试情景可用于准确估计金融机构的尾部风险度量，例如条件风险价值（CVaR），并且还可同时用于压力测试，即识别造成大额损失的条件。我们在商品期货交易委员会和美联储用于压力测试的历史数据上验证了该方法，并将其与具有基于风险目标的实验设计方法联系起来。该方法不要求详细了解金融机构的投资组合，并可帮助监管机构使用统一的风险评估标准评估多家机构的韧性。本文由金融学领域的Giesecke Kay接受。补充材料：电子附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06126获取。
papers.title_original: Choosing Scenarios to Estimate Resilience and Stress Test Financial Institutions
papers.title_zh: 选择情景以估计韧性和对金融机构进行压力测试

papers.abstract_original: What makes independent directors perform their duty? One possible reason is that they are concerned about being punished if they do not fulfill their duties diligently. Using unique features of the Chinese capital market, we estimate the extent to which independent directors’ subjective perceptions of penalty risk affect their voting on proposals. Our results suggest that they are more likely to vote against management after observing how another director in their board network received a regulatory penalty related to negligence. This effect is long lasting and stronger if the observing and penalized directors share personal characteristics and if the observing director is at a firm that is more likely to be penalized. These results provide novel evidence suggesting that the salience of penalty risk is an important factor motivating directors, which provides regulators with a powerful and cost-effective tool to improve firms’ governance.This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance.Funding: C. Lin acknowledges financial support from the National Social Science Fund of China Major Project [Grant 24&ZD094].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06141.
papers.abstract_zh: 是什么促使独立董事履行职责？一个可能的原因是，他们担心如果不勤勉履职就会受到处罚。利用中国资本市场的独特特征，我们估计了独立董事对处罚风险的主观感知在多大程度上影响他们对提案的投票。我们的结果表明，在观察到其董事会网络中另一位董事因疏忽而受到监管处罚后，他们更可能投票反对管理层。这种效应持续时间长，并且如果观察到的董事与被处罚董事具有个人特征相似性，以及如果观察到的董事所在公司更可能被处罚，则效应更强。这些结果提供了新的证据，表明处罚风险的显著性是一个激励董事的重要因素，这为监管者提供了一个强大且成本有效的工具来改善公司治理。本文由Kay Giesecke，金融领域接受。资助：C. Lin感谢国家社会科学基金重大项目[批准号24&ZD094]的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06141获取。
papers.title_original: Directors’ Incentives from Potential Penalties: Evidence from Their Voting
papers.title_zh: 潜在处罚对董事的激励：来自其投票的证据

papers.abstract_original: We return to the theoretical foundations of absorptive capacity and test the idea that personal experience in a field makes it easier for a firm’s inventors to recognize and build upon knowledge in that field from other local firms. We propose a new empirical model of localized knowledge diffusion, which (1) measures a firm’s absorptive capacity by its inventors’ prior experience in a field, (2) uses a death instrument to exogenously vary the availability of knowledge of the same collaborative patent in different regions, and (3) estimates the difference in citation likelihood from all subsequent inventors across both regions as a function of a potentially citing inventor’s prior experience in the field. Consistent with the original theory of absorptive capacity, firms whose inventors have prior experience in a field are more likely to use locally available interpersonal knowledge from other firms; furthermore, this effect declines monotonically with distance. Although the effects strengthen for more recent experience and multidisciplinary knowledge, the greatest benefits accrue to firms in the interaction—those whose inventors have more recent experience and that seek to absorb multidisciplinary knowledge. Interpersonal absorptive capacity within firms does not appear to localize.This paper was accepted by Anita McGahan, business strategy.Funding: The authors acknowledge financial support from the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation and the National Science Foundation [Grant 1360228].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06147.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们回到吸收能力的理论基础，并检验这样一个观点：某一领域的个人经验使企业发明人更容易识别并利用来自其他本地企业在该领域的知识。我们提出一种新的本地化知识扩散实证模型，该模型（1）以企业发明人在某一领域的先前经验来衡量企业的吸收能力，（2）使用死亡工具变量来外生地改变同一合作专利在不同地区的知识可获得性，（3）估计两个地区所有后续发明人的引用可能性差异，作为潜在引用发明人在该领域先前经验的函数。与吸收能力的原始理论一致，其发明人在某一领域具有先前经验的企业更可能利用来自其他企业的本地可获得的人际知识；此外，这一效应随距离单调递减。尽管对于更近期的经验和多学科知识，这些效应会增强，但最大的收益归于处于交互作用中的企业——即那些发明人具有更近期经验且寻求吸收多学科知识的企业。企业内的人际吸收能力似乎并不本地化。本文由商业战略领域编辑Anita McGahan接受。资助：作者感谢Alfred P. Sloan基金会和国家科学基金会[批准号1360228]的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06147获取。
papers.title_original: Microfoundations of Absorptive Capacity as Revealed by Inventor Deaths
papers.title_zh: 发明人去世所揭示的吸收能力的微观基础

papers.abstract_original: In economies without monetary transfers, token systems serve as an alternative to sustain cooperation and increase efficiency. This paper studies whether a token-based economy can be effective in marketplaces with thin exogenous supply. We consider a marketplace in which at each time period one agent requests a service, one agent provides the service, and one token (artificial currency) is used to pay for service provision. The number of tokens each agent has represents the difference between the amount of service provisions and service requests by the agent. We are interested in the behavior of this economy when very few agents are available to provide the requested service. Because balancing the number of tokens across agents is key to sustain cooperation, the agent with the minimum number of tokens is selected to provide service among the available agents. When exactly one random agent is available to provide service, we show that the token distribution is unstable. However, already when just two random agents are available to provide service, the token distribution is stable, in the sense that agents’ token balance is unlikely to deviate much from their initial endowment, and agents return to their initial endowment in finite expected time. Our results mirror the power-of-two-choices paradigm in load balancing problems. Supported by numerical simulations using kidney exchange data, our findings suggest that token systems may generate efficient outcomes in kidney exchange marketplaces by sustaining cooperation between hospitals.This paper was accepted by Peng Sun, optimization and decision analytics.Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06176.
papers.abstract_zh: 在没有货币转移的经济体中，代币系统是维持合作和提高效率的一种替代方案。本文研究基于代币的经济体在外生供给稀缺的市场中是否有效。我们考虑这样一个市场：在每个时间段内，一名代理人请求服务，一名代理人提供服务，并使用一枚代币（人造货币）来支付服务提供。每名代理人拥有的代币数量代表该代理人提供服务量与服务请求量之间的差额。我们关注当可用于提供所请求服务的代理人非常少时该经济体的行为。由于在代理人之间平衡代币数量是维持合作的关键，因此在可用代理人中选择代币数量最少的代理人来提供服务。当恰好有一名随机代理人可提供服务时，我们证明代币分布是不稳定的。然而，当仅有两名随机代理人可提供服务时，代币分布就是稳定的，其含义是代理人的代币余额不太可能大幅偏离其初始禀赋，且代理人在有限的期望时间内回到其初始禀赋。我们的结果呼应了负载均衡问题中的二选一（power-of-two-choices）范式。在利用肾脏交换数据进行的数值模拟支持下，我们的发现表明，代币系统可能通过维持医院之间的合作，在肾脏交换市场中产生有效的结果。本文由优化与决策分析领域的Peng Sun接受。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06176获取。

papers.abstract_original: Using a quasi-experimental setting, we study whether mutual fund investors respond to a purely mechanical change in environmental, social, and governance (ESG) ratings—that is, a change independent of concurrent changes in firms’ actual ESG activities. We find that when a firm experiences a mechanical increase in ESG ratings, the probability of being selected by an ESG fund increases (extensive margin). In contrast, if the firm is already in the fund’s portfolio, its holdings do not change (intensive margin), consistent with portfolio weighting being based on market capitalization. The selection effect is observable not only among funds that follow an ESG index but also among active ESG funds, which presumably should have the resources and ability to identify and filter out the mechanical increase in ESG ratings. Among active ESG funds, the selection effect is stronger for funds with less assets under management, larger portfolios of firms, and lower expense ratios, consistent with the notion that resource constraints may impede a fund’s screening ability. Our findings imply that passive investing based on commercial ESG ratings—whether due to resource constraints or portfolio indexing—might result in portfolio allocations that do not reflect the actual ESG activities of firms.This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06184.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们利用一个准实验情境，研究共同基金投资者是否会对环境、社会和治理（ESG）评级的纯粹机械性变化——即独立于企业实际ESG活动同期变化的变化——作出反应。我们发现，当一家企业经历ESG评级的机械性上升时，其被ESG基金选中的概率增加（外延边际）。相比之下，如果该企业已在基金的投资组合中，其持仓并不发生变化（内涵边际），这与投资组合权重基于市值相一致。这种选择效应不仅在跟踪ESG指数的基金中可以观察到，在主动型ESG基金中也可以观察到，而后者按理说应当拥有资源和能力来识别并过滤掉ESG评级的机械性上升。在主动型ESG基金中，对于管理资产规模较小、企业投资组合较大以及费用比率较低的基金，选择效应更强，这与资源约束可能妨碍基金筛选能力的观点相一致。我们的发现意味着，基于商业ESG评级的被动投资——无论是由于资源约束还是投资组合指数化——可能导致并不反映企业实际ESG活动的投资组合配置。本文由会计领域编辑Suraj Srinivasan接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06184获取。

papers.abstract_original: When determining whom to hire, employers care about how quickly they receive replies from the job seekers and service providers they contact. Across transaction data from a large real-world marketplace (N = ∼11.66 million) and experiments (three main studies (total n = 3,603) and five supplemental studies (total n = 5,039)), we show that providers benefit from responding to employers’ messages quickly. First, we document substantial real-world consequences of reply speed in Fiverr marketplace transaction data (Study 1), finding a strong negative relationship between the length of delay in replying to a service request and the likelihood of securing a contract. Even delays of just 5–10 minutes dramatically reduce providers’ likelihood of being hired. In our experimental studies, providers who take less (versus more) time to reply are seen as more likely to be responsive in the future (Studies 2–4), make more positive impressions than slower responders (Study 3), and in turn, are more likely to be hired (Studies 2–4). Fast replies signal a provider’s future responsiveness and increase hiring likelihood independently from other signals of future responsiveness, such as a worker’s quality (Study 2) or the content of the message sent (Study 4). Together, our studies identify a distinct signal that employees can control to increase their hireability: replying to messages quickly. Empirically, every minute counts.This paper was accepted by Jack Soll, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06185.
papers.abstract_zh: 在决定雇佣谁时，雇主关心他们从所联系的求职者和服务提供者那里收到回复的速度。基于来自一个大型真实世界市场（N = ∼11.66百万）的交易数据以及实验（三项主要研究（总n = 3,603）和五项补充研究（总n = 5,039）），我们表明，提供者从快速回复雇主消息中获益。首先，我们在Fiverr市场交易数据中记录了回复速度在真实世界中的重大后果（研究1），发现回复服务请求的延迟时长与获得合同的可能性之间存在强烈的负相关关系。即使仅延迟5–10分钟，也会大幅降低提供者被雇佣的可能性。在我们的实验研究中，回复所用时间较少（相对于较多）的提供者被认为未来更有可能及时响应（研究2–4），比回复较慢者给人留下更积极的印象（研究3），并因此更有可能被雇佣（研究2–4）。快速回复传递了提供者未来响应性的信号，并独立于其他未来响应性信号（如工作者质量（研究2）或所发送消息的内容（研究4））提高被雇佣的可能性。总之，我们的研究识别出一种员工可以控制以提高自身可雇佣性的独特信号：快速回复消息。从经验上看，每一分钟都很重要。本文由Jack Soll（行为经济学与决策分析）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06185获取。

papers.abstract_original: This paper examines how the need for immediate cash by smallholder farmers may lead to undesirable selling decisions that hurt their revenue and analyzes the efficacy of government loan policies in tackling this challenge. We develop a game-theoretic model to characterize the base scenario of no loan, uncovering the impacts of cash needs on farmers’ revenue. We then examine how a government loan, under which farmers store some of their production at government warehouses in exchange for immediate cash, may counteract these negative impacts. We analyze and optimize two types of policies: one in which all farmers are eligible (a homogeneous loan) and another in which the loan is offered only to farmers whose production is below a certain threshold (a heterogeneous loan). Our results demonstrate that, when designed properly, both loans simultaneously increase aggregate farmer revenue and generate a more equitable revenue distribution among farmers. Nonetheless, overly generous loans can be counterproductive and harm farmers. We further show that heterogeneous loans achieve optimal market outcomes with lower government expenditure when cash needs are moderately high. We then contrast the two policies across key metrics related to farmers. Whereas the homogeneous loan better mitigates inequity among farmers, the heterogeneous loan helps more farmers meet cash needs. These results underscore that government loan design must carefully account for farmers’ strategic responses to the policy to generate positive societal outcomes. Finally, we use field data from India to numerically illustrate our insights and demonstrate the economic impacts of the policies studied.This paper was accepted by Jeannette Song, operations management.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06206.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文考察小农户对即时现金的需求如何可能导致损害其收入的不利销售决策，并分析政府贷款政策在应对这一挑战方面的有效性。我们建立一个博弈论模型来刻画无贷款的基础情景，揭示现金需求对农户收入的影响。然后，我们考察政府贷款——即农户将部分产出储存在政府仓库以换取即时现金——如何可能抵消这些负面影响。我们分析和优化两类政策：一类是所有农户均有资格（同质性贷款），另一类是贷款仅提供给产出低于某一阈值的农户（异质性贷款）。我们的结果表明，若设计得当，两类贷款都能同时提高农户的总收入，并在农户之间产生更公平的收入分配。然而，过于慷慨的贷款可能适得其反并损害农户利益。我们进一步表明，当现金需求处于中等偏高水平时，异质性贷款能以更低的政府支出实现最优市场结果。随后，我们围绕与农户相关的关键指标对两类政策进行对比。同质性贷款能更好地缓解农户之间的不平等，而异质性贷款则帮助更多农户满足现金需求。这些结果凸显出，政府贷款设计必须仔细考虑农户对政策的策略性反应，以产生积极的社会结果。最后，我们使用来自印度的实地数据对我们的洞见进行数值说明，并展示所研究政策的经济影响。本文由运营管理领域的Jeannette Song接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06206 获取。
papers.title_original: Improving Cash-Constrained Smallholder Farmers’ Revenue: The Role of Government Loans
papers.title_zh: 提高受现金约束的小农户收入：政府贷款的作用

papers.abstract_original: Understanding how preferences are formed in commonplace and natural situations is highly valuable for researchers and practitioners. Here, I develop scroll tracking, a process-tracing method that uses a touch scroll–based responsive mobile web design well suited for studying the cognitive processes behind decision making. The method follows the decision maker’s scrolling behavior and records a response curve in the pixel–millisecond coordinate space. To demonstrate the value of response curve analysis in decision research, different metrics are proposed that are derived from the response curve and rooted in the motor response and gaze dwell metrics presented in the literature. An experimental study framed as a consumer choice problem is used to validate the method and test predictions made by attentional evidence accumulation models using the response curve metrics. The way the decision maker interacts in the app can be used to predict subjective valuations as well as latent individual difference measures and risk attitudes as a complementary risky choice study shows. I then compare the predictive ability of different drift diffusion models stocked with the scroll-tracking response metrics. The scroll-tracking metrics improve all the models. These findings show the potential of naturalistic process-tracing methods in responsive digital applications. These designs can be used to covertly study decision processes and are applicable to different practical settings.This paper was accepted by John Beshears, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06264.
papers.abstract_zh: 理解偏好如何在日常和自然情境中形成，对研究者和实务工作者都极具价值。在此，我开发了滚动追踪，这是一种过程追踪方法，使用基于触摸滚动的响应式移动网页设计，非常适合研究决策背后的认知过程。该方法跟踪决策者的滚动行为，并在像素-毫秒坐标空间中记录一条响应曲线。为展示响应曲线分析在决策研究中的价值，本文提出了不同的指标，这些指标源自响应曲线，并植根于文献中提出的运动反应和注视停留指标。一项被设定为消费者选择问题的实验研究被用来验证该方法，并使用响应曲线指标检验注意力证据累积模型所做的预测。正如一项补充的风险选择研究所表明的，决策者在应用中互动的方式可用于预测主观估值以及潜在的个体差异测量和风险态度。随后，我比较了配备滚动追踪响应指标的不同漂移扩散模型的预测能力。滚动追踪指标改善了所有模型。这些发现显示了自然主义过程追踪方法在响应式数字应用中的潜力。这些设计可用于隐蔽地研究决策过程，并适用于不同的实际情境。本文由行为经济学与决策分析领域的John Beshears接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06264 获取。
papers.title_original: Attention in Motion: Using Scroll Tracking to Measure the Dynamics of Preferential Choice
papers.title_zh: 运动中的注意力：使用滚动追踪测量偏好选择的动态过程

papers.abstract_original: Healthcare organizations have been adopting video visits as an alternative care channel that offers greater convenience and holds promise for improving patients’ access to care. Despite the growing use, the impact of a new digital channel on care demand within existing physical channels has not been investigated in detail, especially in the primary care context of a traditional healthcare organization. We study a large healthcare system that made video visits available to a subset of its patients for primary care needs prior to the COVID-19 pandemic. Using a difference-in-differences approach and visit data spanning more than 1.2 million patient–period observations, we find that, when video visits are available, patients make 21% more in-person primary care provider visits and 30% more emergency department visits. When considering only patient-initiated visits, we find that patients initiate more care overall, whereas their in-person care initiations do not change, suggesting that patients initiate care through video visits for needs that may have otherwise gone unattended. Furthermore, we find that the increase in care initiations arises primarily from patients who have poorer access to in-person care. Lastly, compared with in-person visits, we find that video visits are more likely to result in an immediate subsequent in-person visit for acute conditions, particularly those with low virtualizability, but not for chronic conditions regardless of virtualizability. Our findings have important capacity and revenue implications for healthcare organizations considering video visits as an additional channel of care delivery.This paper was accepted by Stefan Scholtes, healthcare management.Funding: This work was supported by the Mack Institute for Innovation Management.Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06271.
papers.abstract_zh: 医疗机构一直在采用视频问诊作为一种替代护理渠道，它提供了更大的便利性，并有望改善患者获得护理的机会。尽管使用日益增多，但新数字渠道对现有实体渠道内护理需求的影响尚未得到详细研究，尤其是在传统医疗机构的初级护理情境中。我们研究了一个大型医疗系统，该系统在COVID-19大流行之前就向其部分患者提供了用于初级护理需求的视频问诊。使用双重差分方法和涵盖超过1.2百万患者-时期观察值的问诊数据，我们发现，当视频问诊可用时，患者会多进行21%次面对面初级护理提供者问诊和30%次急诊科问诊。当仅考虑患者发起的问诊时，我们发现患者总体上发起了更多护理，而他们面对面护理的发起没有变化，这表明患者通过视频问诊为那些原本可能得不到关注的需 求发起了护理。此外，我们发现护理发起的增加主要来自面对面护理可及性较差的患者。最后，与面对面问诊相比，我们发现视频问诊更可能导致急性病症随后立即进行面对面问诊，尤其是那些虚拟化程度低的病症，但对于慢性病症则不然，无论其虚拟化程度如何。我们的发现对考虑将视频问诊作为额外护理提供渠道的医疗机构具有重要的容量和收入影响。本文由医疗管理领域的Stefan Scholtes接受。资助：本研究由Mack创新管理研究所资助。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06271获取。
papers.title_original: Multichannel Healthcare Operations: The Impact of Video Visits on the Usage of In-Person Care
papers.title_zh: 多渠道医疗运营：视频问诊对面对面医疗服务使用的影响

papers.abstract_original: Digital platforms increasingly curate their content through personalized algorithmic feeds. Platforms have an incentive to promote content that increases the predicted engagement of each user to lift advertising revenues. This paper studies how ranking content to maximize engagement affects the credibility of news content with which users engage. In addition, I evaluate how the ranking algorithm itself can be designed to promote engagement with high-credibility content. Using data from the Reddit politics community, I exploit a novel discontinuity in the ranking algorithm to identify the causal effect of a post’s rank on the number of comments it receives. I use this discontinuity to identify a model of user comment decisions and estimate the credibility of news content that users engage with under a personalized engagement-maximizing algorithm. The personalized engagement-maximizing algorithm exacerbates differences in the credibility of news content with which users engage. I then evaluate a credibility-aware algorithm that explicitly promotes credible news publishers and find the platform can substantially increase the share of engagement with high-credibility publishers for a small reduction in total engagement. These findings suggest algorithmic interventions can be a useful tool for managers to balance engagement quantity and content quality.This paper was accepted by Hemant Bhargava, information systems.Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06298.
papers.abstract_zh: 数字平台越来越多地通过个性化算法推送来策划其内容。平台有动机推广能够提高每个用户预测参与度的内容，以提升广告收入。本文研究将内容排序以最大化参与度如何影响用户所接触的新闻内容的可信度。此外，我评估了排序算法本身如何设计以促进与高可信度内容的参与。利用Reddit政治社区的数据，我利用排序算法中的一个新颖断点来识别帖子排名对其收到评论数量的因果效应。我利用这一断点识别了一个用户评论决策模型，并估计了在个性化参与度最大化算法下用户所接触的新闻内容的可信度。个性化参与度最大化算法加剧了用户所接触的新闻内容可信度的差异。然后我评估了一种可信度感知算法，该算法明确推广可信的新闻发布者，并发现平台可以在总参与度小幅下降的情况下大幅提高与高可信度发布者的参与份额。这些发现表明，算法干预可以成为管理者平衡参与数量与内容质量的有用工具。本文由信息系统领域的Hemant Bhargava接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06298获取。

papers.abstract_original: We study an auction model for selling multiple heterogeneous objects, in which (i) each agent gets at most one object and has utility functions that accommodate wealth effects, and (ii) prices are adjusted discretely via some prefixed increment. A Walrasian equilibrium may not exist in the discrete price setting. We instead propose a novel equilibrium concept, tight equilibrium, that is compatible with discrete prices. A descending-price auction, requiring only partial demand information and featuring a clear price discovery process, is constructed to yield a tight equilibrium. Tight equilibrium ensures efficiency and generalizes the well-known minimum price equilibrium in the continuous price setting to the discrete price setting. We estimate the deviation bound on prices between tight equilibrium and minimum price equilibrium, which depends on the magnitude of wealth effects, the increment size, and the number of objects. Based on this result, we introduce a notion of approximate incentive compatibility and show that our auction is both efficient and approximately incentive compatible.This paper was accepted by Martin Bichler, market design, platform, and demand analytics.Funding: Y. Zhou gratefully acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72394391], the Grant-in-aid for Research Activity, Japan Society for the Promotion of Science [Grants 26H01960 and 22H00062], the Nagoya University Kitankai Fund (2024), and JST ERATO [Grant JPMJER2301].
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个出售多个异质物品的拍卖模型，其中（i）每个代理人最多获得一个物品，并且其效用函数考虑了财富效应；（ii）价格通过某个预先设定的增量进行离散调整。在离散价格设定下，瓦尔拉斯均衡可能不存在。我们转而提出一个新的均衡概念——紧均衡，它与离散价格相容。我们构建了一个降价拍卖，该拍卖仅需要部分需求信息，并具有清晰的价格发现过程，以产生紧均衡。紧均衡确保效率，并将连续价格设定中著名的最低价格均衡推广到离散价格设定。我们估计了紧均衡与最低价格均衡之间价格的偏差界，该界取决于财富效应的大小、增量大小以及物品数量。基于这一结果，我们引入了近似激励相容的概念，并表明我们的拍卖既有效率又近似激励相容。本文由Martin Bichler（市场设计、平台与需求分析领域）接受。资助：Y. Zhou感谢国家自然科学基金[资助号72394391]、日本学术振兴会科研活动补助金[资助号26H01960和22H00062]、名古屋大学Kitankai基金（2024）以及JST ERATO[资助号JPMJER2301]的财务支持。
papers.title_original: Discrete Pricing in Multiobject Auctions with Unit Demand and Wealth Effects
papers.title_zh: 单位需求与财富效应下多物品拍卖中的离散定价

papers.abstract_original: Ratings play a crucial role in online marketplaces, shaping consumer decisions and firm strategies. We investigate how firms strategically use pricing to influence ratings, and how this undermines ratings as signals of product quality. We develop a two-period model of price competition between an established firm and a potentially high- or low-quality entrant, capturing the challenge high-quality newcomers face in building reputation. Consumers rate based on value-for-money, but cannot distinguish whether positive ratings result from genuine quality or discounted prices. Low-quality entrants take advantage of this and may offer low prices to harvest good ratings in the future, or mimic high prices to signal high quality. We show that ratings harvesting inflates positive ratings, reducing their informativeness. This exacerbates the cold-start problem and discourages high-quality entry. Our results mirror empirical patterns and generate implications for how rating design affects market outcomes: reducing effort costs to rate induces more but less-informative ratings, and discourages entry. Thus, actions by major marketplaces to encourage ratings could backfire and induce less precise ratings that discourage entry. To mitigate these effects, policymakers can consider balancing rating effort costs to preserve informativeness, discouraging excessive discounts for new sellers, and incorporating price paid into rating displays. Although the effects of individual entrants’ harvesting may appear temporary, harvesting hinders high-quality entrants from building reputation, discouraging entry and causing lasting distortions.This paper was accepted by Maria Guadalupe, business strategy.Funding: This work was supported by Fédération Wallonie-Bruxelles [Grant 19/24-101 PROSEco], Fonds De La Recherche Scientifique - FNRS [Grant FC46885], and Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (CRC TR 224 (Project B05), SSRC-SMU Graduate Research Fellowship).Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06335.
papers.abstract_zh: 评分在在线市场中起着至关重要的作用，影响消费者决策和企业策略。我们研究企业如何策略性地利用定价来影响评分，以及这如何削弱评分作为产品质量信号的作用。我们构建了一个两期价格竞争模型，参与竞争的是一家已成立企业和一家可能高质量或低质量的进入者，该模型刻画了高质量新进入者在建立声誉时面临的挑战。消费者基于性价比进行评分，但无法区分正面评分是源于真实质量还是折扣价格。低质量进入者利用这一点，可能提供低价以在未来收割好评，或者模仿高价以发出高质量信号。我们表明，评分收割会抬高正面评分，降低其信息含量。这加剧了冷启动问题，并抑制高质量进入。我们的结果与经验模式相符，并对评分设计如何影响市场结果产生启示：降低评分的努力成本会诱导更多但信息含量更低的评分，并抑制进入。因此，主要市场平台鼓励评分的行动可能适得其反，导致评分更不精确并抑制进入。为缓解这些影响，政策制定者可以考虑平衡评分努力成本以保持信息含量，抑制新卖家的过度折扣，并将支付价格纳入评分展示。尽管个体进入者的收割效应可能看似暂时，但收割会阻碍高质量进入者建立声誉，抑制进入并造成持久扭曲。本文由商业战略领域的Maria Guadalupe接受。资助：本工作得到瓦隆-布鲁塞尔联邦[Grant 19/24-101 PROSEco]、比利时国家科学研究基金 - FNRS [Grant FC46885]以及德国研究基金会（CRC TR 224 (Project B05)、SSRC-SMU Graduate Research Fellowship）的支持。补充材料：在线附录可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06335获取。
papers.title_original: Harvesting Ratings
papers.title_zh: 收割评分

papers.abstract_original: Credit card use among college students declined sharply following the enactment of the Credit Card Accountability, Responsibility, and Disclosure Act of 2009. Title 3, Section 304 of the Act specifically restricted the marketing and sale of credit cards on college campuses. Using a difference-in-differences approach that treats incoming freshmen who would have been unaffected by this marketing as the control group, we document an apparent spillover that increased student loan borrowing by 8.4%, and by 14% for less affluent students. A survey of students matched to their administrative records finds evidence of this substitutability between credit cards and student loans; further, it reveals that a lack of financial literacy and knowledge of financial history are correlated with the misallocation of debt between them. Using these combined empirical findings, we develop and calibrate a model of optimal student borrowing to assess the benefits of the spillovers and find the policy increased welfare. A complementary analysis indicates improvements in grade point averages and on-time graduation rates subsequent to the Act.This paper was accepted by John Beshears, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06339.
papers.abstract_zh: 在2009年《信用卡问责、责任与披露法案》颁布后，大学生的信用卡使用量急剧下降。该法案第3编第304条专门限制了在大学校园内对信用卡的营销和销售。采用双重差分方法，将本不会受此营销影响的入校新生作为对照组，我们记录了一种明显的溢出效应，使助学贷款借款增加了8.4%，而对于较不富裕的学生则增加了14%。一项将学生与其行政记录相匹配的调查发现了信用卡与助学贷款之间这种替代性的证据；此外，该调查还揭示，金融素养和金融历史知识的缺乏与两者之间债务的错配相关。利用这些综合实证发现，我们开发并校准了一个最优学生借款模型，以评估溢出效应的收益，并发现该政策提高了福利。一项补充分析表明，该法案之后，平均绩点和按时毕业率均有所改善。本文由行为经济学与决策分析领域的John Beshears接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06339 获取。
papers.title_original: When Consumer Financial Protection Spills Over: Student Loan Borrowing Under the CARD Act
papers.title_zh: 当消费者金融保护产生溢出效应：CARD法案下的学生贷款借款

papers.abstract_original: Electricity grids form the backbone of modern economies, but the utilities responsible for maintaining them face new energy management challenges associated with both aging infrastructure and climate change. Growing evidence suggests that digital technologies and data-driven decision-making may improve firm performance. However, existing work focuses on the private sector. Organizations providing public services have different incentives and constraints. In this paper, we narrow this gap through a study of the U.S. power sector. We construct a rich utility-level data set and estimate the effects of “smart” meters on electricity losses, a key indicator of system and utility performance. Implementing an augmented staggered difference-in-differences design, we find that electricity losses decrease by 4%–7% following smart meter deployment, on average. Utilities’ annual revenue increases by 1%–2%. We show that the underlying mechanisms relate to changes in energy management. Consumption measurement and billing accuracy improve, as indicated by an increase in sales, giving utilities a clearer understanding of the system to enhance decision-making. Utilities invest in complementary organizational capital that is important for fully realizing the benefits of digitalization, such as hiring “quants.” They also offer new products, like demand response programs, which attenuates the increase in sales but does not drive the reduction in losses. Power outage duration declines, suggesting that utilities use smart meters to improve reliability by restoring service faster after disruptions. Outage frequency remains unchanged.This paper was accepted by Caroline Flammer, sustainability.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06349.
papers.abstract_zh: 电网构成现代经济的骨干，但负责维护电网的公用事业公司面临与基础设施老化和气候变化相关的新能源管理挑战。越来越多的证据表明，数字技术和数据驱动决策可能改善企业绩效。然而，现有工作聚焦于私营部门。提供公共服务的组织具有不同的激励和约束。在本文中，我们通过研究美国电力部门来缩小这一差距。我们构建了一个丰富的公用事业层面数据集，并估计“智能”电表对电力损耗的影响，电力损耗是系统和公用事业绩效的关键指标。采用增强的交错双重差分设计，我们发现智能电表部署后，电力损耗平均下降4%–7%。公用事业的年收入增加1%–2%。我们表明，潜在机制与能源管理的变化有关。消费计量和计费准确性提高，表现为销售额增加，使公用事业公司更清晰地理解系统以增强决策。公用事业公司投资于对充分实现数字化收益至关重要的互补组织资本，例如雇用“量化分析师”。他们还提供新产品，如需求响应计划，这减弱了销售额增长，但并未驱动损耗下降。停电持续时间下降，表明公用事业公司利用智能电表通过更快恢复服务来提高可靠性。停电频率保持不变。本文由可持续发展领域的Caroline Flammer接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06349获取。
papers.title_original: Can Digitalization Improve Public Services? Evidence from Innovation in Energy Management
papers.title_zh: 数字化能否改善公共服务？来自能源管理创新的证据

papers.abstract_original: Multiproduct inventory and pricing problems are traditionally approached by estimating a presumed sufficiently accurate demand model and then optimizing with this specified model to determine optimal inventory and pricing decisions. However, obtaining an accurate demand model is nearly impossible because of unobservable parameters, resulting in parameter uncertainty; meanwhile, the unknown distribution of the error term in the stochastic demand model raises residual ambiguity. Additionally, the predicted demand is endogenously affected by pricing, leading to decision-dependent prediction that often brings about intractable optimization problems. We introduce a contextual robust optimization model that simultaneously addresses these challenges. Our proposed model possesses attractive finite-sample performance guarantees and can be effectively approached using an enhanced affine recourse adaptation to resolve the issue of intractability, and it can be extended to broader contextual decision-making problems under mild conditions. Extensive numerical studies demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, showing that it outperforms the conventional estimate-then-optimize approach and the residual-based robust optimization approach that does not account for parameter uncertainty, particularly when the available data are limited. Notably, our proposed model exhibits greater resilience when contextual information is disregarded, reflecting practical situations in which collecting such information might be impossible or costly.This paper was accepted by Peng Sun, optimization and decision analytics.Funding: The research of X. Zhang is supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72501273], the Anhui Provincial Natural Science Foundation [Grant 2408085QG222], and the Fundamental Research Funds for the Central Universities [Grant BJ2040160100]. The research of Q. Tang was supported by the Ministry of Education, Singapore [Tier 1 Grants RG47/24, RG139/25]. Z. Chen is funded in part by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72422002, 72394395], the Hong Kong Research Grants Council General Research Fund [Grant CUHK-11502422], and the Asian Institute of Supply Chains and Logistics. L. Chen acknowledges support from the Emerging Scholar Research Fellowships, The University of Sydney Business School.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06402.
papers.abstract_zh: 多产品库存与定价问题传统上通过估计一个假定足够准确的需求模型，然后用该指定模型进行优化以确定最优库存与定价决策来处理。然而，由于存在不可观测的参数，获得准确的需求模型几乎是不可能的，这导致参数不确定性；同时，随机需求模型中误差项的未知分布引发了残差模糊性。此外，预测需求受到定价的内生影响，导致依赖决策的预测，这往往带来难以处理的优化问题。我们引入一个情境鲁棒优化模型，同时应对这些挑战。我们提出的模型具有有吸引力的有限样本性能保证，并且可以通过增强的仿射追索适应有效地处理以解决难处理性问题，且在温和条件下可以扩展到更广泛的情境决策问题。大量数值研究表明了我们方法的有效性，显示其优于传统的先估计后优化方法以及未考虑参数不确定性的基于残差的鲁棒优化方法，尤其是在可用数据有限时。值得注意的是，我们提出的模型在忽略情境信息时表现出更强的韧性，这反映了收集此类信息可能不可能或成本高昂的实际情形。本文由Peng Sun，优化与决策分析领域接受。资助：X. Zhang的研究得到国家自然科学基金[资助号72501273]、安徽省自然科学基金[资助号2408085QG222]以及中央高校基本科研业务费[资助号BJ2040160100]的支持。Q. Tang的研究得到新加坡教育部[Tier 1 Grants RG47/24, RG139/25]的支持。Z. Chen部分得到国家自然科学基金[资助号72422002, 72394395]、香港研究资助局优配研究金[资助号CUHK-11502422]以及亚洲供应链与物流研究所的资助。L. Chen感谢悉尼大学商学院新兴学者研究奖学金的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06402获取。

papers.title_zh: 基于情境鲁棒优化的库存与定价管理

papers.abstract_original: This study considers a voluntary hospital certification program and how it shapes patient health outcomes. The Baby-Friendly Hospital Initiative designates participating hospitals as “Baby-Friendly” if they adhere to various practices thought to promote breastfeeding. We estimate the effect of being born in a Baby-Friendly hospital on breastfeeding initiation and infant health. Identification relies on a within-mother analysis that compares siblings who were born in the same hospital: one when the hospital was not certified and another when the hospital was certified. Data come from South Carolina birth certificates from 2010 to 2019 linked to subsequent emergency department records, hospital records, and death certificates. The results indicate that Baby-Friendly accreditation has no widespread effects on breastfeeding initiation. It does, however, increase breastfeeding rates among a subset of Black mothers with a history of bottle-feeding. Infants exposed to the designation are more likely to leave the hospital in under two days, and there is also some evidence of subsequent reductions in healthcare utilization in the next year. We do not find precise changes in all-cause one-year mortality, although we do observe a marginally significant reduction in deaths caused by “extreme immaturity.”This paper was accepted by Anita Carson, healthcare management.Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06422.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究考察一项自愿性医院认证项目及其如何塑造患者健康结果。爱婴医院倡议将参与医院认证为“爱婴”，如果它们遵守被认为可促进母乳喂养的各种做法。我们估计在爱婴医院出生对母乳喂养启动和婴儿健康的影响。识别依赖于一项母亲内部分析，该分析比较在同一家医院出生的兄弟姐妹：一个是在医院未获认证时出生，另一个是在医院获认证时出生。数据来自2010年至2019年南卡罗来纳州出生证明，并与随后的急诊科记录、医院记录和死亡证明相链接。结果表明，爱婴认证对母乳喂养启动没有广泛影响。然而，它确实提高了有奶瓶喂养史的一部分黑人母亲中的母乳喂养率。暴露于该认证的婴儿更可能住院不到两天离院，并且也有一些证据表明随后一年医疗保健利用减少。我们没有发现全因一年死亡率方面的精确变化，尽管我们确实观察到由“极度不成熟”导致的死亡有边际显著减少。本文由医疗管理领域的Anita Carson接受。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06422获取。
papers.title_original: The Impacts of “Baby-Friendly” Hospital Designations
papers.title_zh: “爱婴”医院认证的影响

papers.abstract_original: This paper examines the impact of female analyst coverage on firms’ environmental and social (E&S) performance. Exploiting broker closures as a quasi-exogenous shock to analyst coverage, we find that firms experiencing an exogenous decline in female analyst coverage subsequently show a significantly larger drop in E&S scores than those experiencing an equivalent decline in male analyst coverage. To explore the underlying mechanisms, we develop novel machine-learning models to analyze more than 2.4 million analyst reports and 120,000 earnings call transcripts. Our analysis shows that, compared with their male counterparts, female analysts are more likely to address E&S issues, particularly those involving regulatory compliance, stakeholders, and the environment, in both research reports and earnings conference calls. They also display distinct cognitive and linguistic patterns when discussing E&S issues. Furthermore, female analysts are more likely to issue lower stock recommendations and target prices (lower stock recommendations) following negative E&S discussions in their reports (E&S incidents) than male analysts. Finally, investors respond more strongly to female analysts’ negative tones when discussing E&S issues. Overall, our findings suggest that gender diversity among analysts plays a significant role in shaping corporate E&S practices and provide new insights into the origins of gender differences in skills within the equity analyst profession.This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance.Funding: We acknowledge financial support from the Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Canada [Grant 435-2022-0285] and the Sauder Exploratory Research Grants Program. K. Li acknowledges financial support from the Canada Research Chair in Corporate Governance. T. Zhang acknowledges data support from the Whitcomb Center for Research in Financial Services at Rutgers University.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06429.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文考察女性分析师覆盖对企业环境和社会（E&S）绩效的影响。利用券商关闭作为分析师覆盖的准外生冲击，我们发现，经历女性分析师覆盖外生下降的公司，其随后的E&S得分下降幅度显著大于经历男性分析师覆盖同等下降的公司。为探究其潜在机制，我们开发了新颖的机器学习模型，分析了超过2.4百万份分析师报告和120,000份收益电话会议记录。我们的分析表明，与男性同行相比，女性分析师在研究报告中以及在收益电话会议中，都更有可能涉及E&S议题，尤其是那些涉及监管合规、利益相关者和环境的议题。她们在讨论E&S议题时还表现出独特的认知和语言模式。此外，与男性分析师相比，女性分析师在其报告中出现负面E&S讨论（E&S事件）后，更有可能给出更低的股票推荐和目标价格（更低的股票推荐）。最后，当讨论E&S议题时，投资者对女性分析师的负面语气反应更强烈。总体而言，我们的发现表明，分析师中的性别多样性在塑造企业E&S实践方面发挥着重要作用，并为股票分析师职业中技能性别差异的起源提供了新的见解。本文由金融领域编辑Will Cong接受。资助：我们感谢加拿大社会科学与人文研究理事会[资助号 435-2022-0285]和Sauder探索性研究资助计划提供的财务支持。K. Li 感谢加拿大公司治理研究主席提供的财务支持。T. Zhang 感谢罗格斯大学Whitcomb金融服务研究中心提供的数据支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06429 获取。

papers.abstract_original: Knowledge sharing is central to strategy and organizational learning, yet its effect on knowledge production remains underexplored. When knowledge diffuses too easily, individuals may free ride on others’ costly knowledge production, creating a suboptimal equilibrium in which knowledge sharing persists but the average payoff is no greater than if everyone produced knowledge independently—the so-called Rogers’ paradox. We develop a game-theoretic model to re-examine this puzzle. In our baseline model, we reproduce Rogers’ paradox; frictionless sharing does not increase performance beyond individual knowledge production alone. We then extend the model to incorporate absorptive capacity—the need for prior investment in one’s own knowledge before learning from others. Absorptive capacity discourages pure free riding. Counterintuitively, although it introduces frictions in knowledge sharing, absorptive capacity increases collective knowledge production beyond the level attainable through individual knowledge production alone. This explains why extensive knowledge sharing in domains such as academia does not erode incentives for knowledge production. It also contributes to knowledge-based theories of the firm by showing that although hierarchical control may be crucial in contexts where knowledge is simple and codifiable, it may not be necessary where knowledge is complex and tacit. More broadly, our analysis illustrates how formal modeling can uncover overlooked mechanisms and integrate insights across cultural evolution, organizational learning, and strategy.This paper was accepted by Alfonso Gambardella, business strategy.Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06471.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识共享是战略和组织学习的核心，但其对知识生产的影响仍未得到充分探索。当知识过于容易扩散时，个体可能对他人 costly 的知识生产搭便车，从而形成一个次优均衡：知识共享持续存在，但平均收益并不高于每个人都独立生产知识的情形——即所谓的罗杰斯悖论。我们建立一个博弈论模型来重新审视这一谜题。在我们的基准模型中，我们重现了罗杰斯悖论；无摩擦的共享并不会使绩效超过仅靠个体知识生产所能达到的水平。然后我们扩展模型以纳入吸收能力——即从他人处学习之前需要先对自身知识进行投资。吸收能力抑制了纯粹的搭便车行为。与直觉相反，尽管吸收能力在知识共享中引入了摩擦，但它使集体知识生产超过仅靠个体知识生产所能达到的水平。这解释了为什么在学术界等领域中广泛的知识共享并未侵蚀知识生产的激励。它也为基于知识的企业理论做出贡献，表明尽管在知识简单且可编码的情境中层级控制可能至关重要，但在知识复杂且默会的情境中可能并不必要。更广泛地说，我们的分析说明了正式建模如何能够揭示被忽视的机制，并整合文化演化、组织学习和战略方面的洞见。本文由商业战略领域的Alfonso Gambardella接受。补充材料：在线附录可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06471获取。
papers.title_original: The Need for Absorptive Capacity Alleviates the Free-Rider Problem in Knowledge Production
papers.title_zh: 吸收能力的必要性缓解了知识生产中的搭便车问题

papers.abstract_original: The United States Food and Drug Administration (FDA)’s 510(k) pathway allows manufacturers to gain medical device approval by demonstrating substantial equivalence to a legally marketed device. However, the inherent ambiguity of this regulatory procedure has been associated with high recall among many devices cleared through this pathway, raising significant safety concerns. In this paper, we develop a combined human-algorithm approach to assist the FDA in improving its 510(k) medical device clearance process by reducing recall risk and regulatory workload. We first develop machine learning methods to estimate the risk of recall of 510(k) medical devices based on the information available at the time of submission. We then propose a data-driven clearance policy that recommends acceptance, rejection, or deferral to FDA’s committees for in-depth evaluation. We conduct an empirical study using a unique data set of over 31,000 submissions that we assembled based on data sources from the FDA and Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services. Compared to the FDA’s current practice, which has a recall rate of 10.3% and a normalized workload measure of 100%, a conservative evaluation of our policy shows a 32.9% improvement in the recall rate and a 40.5% reduction in the workload. Our analyses further suggest annual cost savings of approximately $1.7 billion for the healthcare system driven by avoided replacement costs, which is equivalent to 1.1% of the entire United States annual medical device expenditure. Our findings highlight the value of a holistic and data-driven approach to improve the FDA’s current 510(k) pathway.This paper was accepted by Stefan Scholtes, healthcare management.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06477.
papers.abstract_zh: 美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）的510(k)途径允许制造商通过证明与合法上市器械的实质等同性来获得医疗器械批准。然而，这一监管程序固有的模糊性与通过该途径许可的许多器械的高召回率相关，引发了重大的安全担忧。在本文中，我们开发了一种人机结合的方法，通过降低召回风险和监管工作量，帮助FDA改进其510(k)医疗器械许可流程。我们首先开发机器学习方法，基于提交时可获得的信息来估计510(k)医疗器械的召回风险。然后，我们提出一种数据驱动的许可政策，建议接受、拒绝或推迟至FDA委员会进行深入评估。我们使用一个独特的数据集进行了实证研究，该数据集包含超过31,000份提交，是我们基于FDA和医疗保险与医疗补助服务中心的数据来源汇编而成。与FDA当前实践（召回率为10.3%，标准化工作量指标为100%）相比，对我们政策的保守评估显示召回率改善了32.9%，工作量减少了40.5%。我们的分析进一步表明，由于避免了更换成本，医疗系统每年可节省约1.7十亿美元，相当于美国全年医疗器械支出的1.1%。我们的发现凸显了采用整体性、数据驱动方法来改进FDA当前510(k)途径的价值。本文由Stefan Scholtes，医疗管理接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06477获取。
papers.title_original: Harmonizing Safety and Speed: A Human-Algorithm Approach to Enhance the FDA’s Medical Device Clearance Policy
papers.title_zh: 协调安全与速度：一种增强FDA医疗器械许可政策的人机算法方法

papers.abstract_original: In many situations, an abundance of misleading evidence—such as fake customer reviews—can lead to false or deceptive conclusions. We experimentally investigate individual and collective decision-making in an information structure in which signals can be correlated, depending on the state of the world. In this setting, too much evidence pointing in one direction has the potential to mislead, necessitating a level of sophistication for rational decision-making. Overall, participants’ performance is poor with only small differences in collective and individual decision-making accuracy. Interestingly, the more complex environment tends to encourage greater honesty within heterogeneous groups than a benchmark setting with independent signals, thus corroborating a rather subtle game-theoretic prediction.This paper was accepted by Dorothea Kübler, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Funding: The authors received financial support from Tamkeen under NYU Abu Dhabi Research Institute Award CG005, from the Juniorprofessorenprogramm Baden-Württemberg, and from the Federal Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs (Germany) through the funding network Interdisciplinary Social Policy Research (BMAS-FIS).Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06504.
papers.abstract_zh: 在许多情境中，大量误导性证据——例如虚假的顾客评论——可能导致错误或具有欺骗性的结论。我们通过实验研究了在一种信息结构下的个体与集体决策，其中信号可能根据世界状态而相关。在这种设定下，过多指向同一方向的证据有可能产生误导，因此理性决策需要一定程度的精细辨别能力。总体而言，参与者的表现较差，集体与个体决策准确性之间仅有很小差异。有趣的是，与信号相互独立的基准设定相比，更复杂的环境往往会在异质性群体内促成更高的诚实水平，从而印证了一个相当微妙的博弈论预测。本文由行为经济学与决策分析领域的Dorothea Kübler接受。资助：作者获得了来自Tamkeen在纽约大学阿布扎比研究所奖CG005下的财务支持，来自巴登-符腾堡州青年教授计划的支持，以及来自德国联邦劳动和社会事务部通过资助网络“跨学科社会政策研究”（BMAS-FIS）的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06504获取。

papers.abstract_original: Carried interest (carry) is the main performance-based component of compensation for private capital fund managers. Using fund-level cash flows and fee terms for more than 12,000 funds, we estimate which funds are in the carry and the total amount earned. Aggregate carry exceeds one trillion dollars and accounts for 18% of investor profits, about equal the contractual value-weighted rate of 19%. The difference reflects the role of hurdle rates and the relatively smooth distribution of fund outcomes. Carry is strongly related to both performance and fund size, and past carry is a stronger predictor of future performance than past returns.This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance.
papers.abstract_zh: 附带权益（carry）是私募资本基金管理者薪酬中主要的基于业绩的组成部分。利用超过12,000只基金的基金层面现金流和费用条款，我们估计了哪些基金处于附带权益状态以及赚取的总金额。总附带权益超过一万亿美元，占投资者利润的18%，大约等于按合同价值加权的19%费率。这一差异反映了门槛收益率的作用以及基金结果相对平滑的分布。附带权益与业绩和基金规模都密切相关，并且过去的附带权益比过去的回报更能预测未来业绩。本文由金融学领域的Lukas Schmid接受。

papers.abstract_original: This paper introduces a new approach to identify competitors using company websites to map competitive relationships among public and private firms. We apply representation learning techniques to create embeddings of companies based on website content, emphasizing information about industry-specific products and services. By placing all firms, public and private, within the same embedding space, we construct a peer competitor network that supports analysis of company interactions and market evolution. We label this new approach and set of network competitors as the website text-based network industry classification (WTNIC). We evaluate the quality of the network using multiple ground truth datasets and benchmarks and show that it offers a robust alternative for understanding competition at scale. Despite using noisy website data, WTNIC matches or outperforms prior approaches that rely on curated data. We demonstrate the value of WTNIC through a case study examining how competition from China affects the public and private peers of a focal firm, highlighting the importance of placing both public and private companies within the same embedding space.Funding: This work was supported by the National Science Foundation [Grants 1561068 and 1937153], the Tuck School of Business at Dartmouth College, the USC Marshall Institute for Outlier Research in Business (iORB), and the Smith School of Business at the University of Maryland.Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06516.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种利用公司网站识别竞争对手的新方法，以映射上市公司和非上市公司之间的竞争关系。我们应用表示学习技术，基于网站内容创建公司嵌入，强调关于行业特定产品和服务的信息。通过将所有公司（无论上市还是非上市）置于同一嵌入空间，我们构建了一个同行竞争对手网络，支持对公司互动和市场演化的分析。我们将这种新方法和网络竞争对手集合称为基于网站文本的网络行业分类（WTNIC）。我们使用多个真实基准数据集和基准评估网络的质量，并表明它为大规模理解竞争提供了一个稳健的替代方案。尽管使用了有噪声的网站数据，WTNIC仍能匹配或超越依赖精选数据的先前方法。我们通过一个案例研究展示了WTNIC的价值，该案例研究考察了来自中国的竞争如何影响焦点公司的上市和非上市同行，突显了将上市公司和非上市公司置于同一嵌入空间的重要性。资助：本工作得到了美国国家科学基金会[资助号1561068和1937153]、达特茅斯学院塔克商学院、南加州大学马歇尔商业异常研究研究所（iORB）以及马里兰大学史密斯商学院的支持。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06516获取。

papers.abstract_original: Despite the growing value of data in digital markets, data sharing across firms is constrained by increasingly stringent privacy regulations. Digital platforms with their extensive data and analytical capabilities can help overcome these constraints by sharing market information through advanced analytics rather than raw data. In collaboration with Alibaba’s Taobao Marketplace, we utilize a natural experiment and examine how platform-shared data affect retailers’ performance. We find that advanced data analytics increase retailer sales by 31.8% beyond the effects of descriptive analytics. Analytics leveraging platform-level market data generate larger and more persistent performance gains than those relying solely on firm-level data, with small retailers benefiting disproportionately as market data help bridge their information gaps. Mechanism analyses reveal no effect on price and advertising expenditures; instead, platform-shared data enable retailers to innovate their product assortments, expanding category scope by 6.8% and increasing new stock-keeping unit introductions by 10.5%. This study contributes to the data economy literature by demonstrating that platform-shared market data can serve as a critical input to firm innovation, fostering more effective product assortment innovation and sustained performance improvements. Our findings also inform ongoing debates on data and platforms regulation by offering managerial and policy insights into how nonrival market data can be shared by platforms through data analytics to empower traditional businesses.This paper was accepted by Duncan Simester, marketing.Funding: Y. Chen and L. Yang acknowledge the financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 71991461] and Tsinghua University School of Economics and Management Research Grant. X. Cui acknowledges the financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72002096]. B. Wu acknowledges the financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72372109 and 71902148] and Guanghua Talent Project of Southwestern University of Finance and Economics.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06633.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管数据在数字市场中的价值日益增长，但企业间的数据共享受到日益严格的隐私法规的限制。拥有大量数据和分析能力的数字平台可以通过高级分析而非原始数据共享市场信息，从而帮助克服这些限制。我们与阿里巴巴的淘宝市场合作，利用一项自然实验，考察平台共享数据如何影响零售商的绩效。我们发现，高级数据分析使零售商销售额提高了31.8%，超出了描述性分析的效果。利用平台级市场数据的分析比仅依赖企业级数据的分析产生更大且更持久的绩效收益，小型零售商受益不成比例，因为市场数据有助于弥合他们的信息差距。机制分析显示，对价格和广告支出没有影响；相反，平台共享数据使零售商能够创新其产品组合，将品类范围扩大6.8%，并将新库存单位引入增加10.5%。本研究通过证明平台共享的市场数据可以作为企业创新的关键投入，促进更有效的产品组合创新和持续的绩效改进，为数据经济文献做出了贡献。我们的发现还为正在进行的关于数据和平台监管的辩论提供了信息，通过提供管理和政策见解，说明平台如何通过数据分析共享非竞争性市场数据以赋能传统企业。本文由市场营销领域的Duncan Simester接受。资助：Y. Chen和L. Yang感谢国家自然科学基金[Grant 71991461]和清华大学经济管理学院研究基金的财务支持。X. Cui感谢国家自然科学基金[Grant 72002096]的财务支持。B. Wu感谢国家自然科学基金[Grants 72372109和71902148]以及西南财经大学光华人才项目的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06633获取。

papers.abstract_original: Considering the importance of corporate carbon emissions, the Supreme Court of the United States ruled against the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) and curtailed EPA’s regulatory powers by unprecedentedly invoking the “major questions doctrine” in its judgment of West Virginia v. EPA in 2022. We find that the stock prices of firms with greater exposure to carbon risk increased relative to firms with lower exposure after the Supreme Court verdict. The results are more pronounced for firms subject to higher federal climate enforcement intensity prior to the court ruling. Long-term climate commitments by state governments and carbon-sensitive institutional investors attenuate the effect. Both cash flow and discount rate contribute to the climate risk effect in firm value. Overall, our findings from this landmark climate litigation suggest that climate transition risks can affect stock prices.This paper was accepted by Lin William Cong, finance.Funding: Funding support by Hong Kong General Research Fund [Grant 17501825] is gratefully acknowledged. This work was supported by National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72172082 and 72342021 (C. Shan)].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06732.
papers.abstract_zh: 考虑到企业碳排放的重要性，美国最高法院在2022年的西弗吉尼亚州诉环保署（EPA）案判决中，史无前例地援引“重大问题原则”，判环保署败诉并削减了其监管权力。我们发现，在最高法院裁决之后，碳风险暴露较大的公司的股价相对于暴露较低的公司有所上升。对于在法院裁决之前受联邦气候执法强度较高的公司，结果更为显著。州政府的长期气候承诺和碳敏感型机构投资者减弱了这一效应。现金流和折现率都对企业价值中的气候风险效应有所贡献。总体而言，我们来自这一里程碑式气候诉讼的发现表明，气候转型风险能够影响股票价格。本文由Lin William Cong接受，金融领域。资助：香港研究资助局[资助号17501825]的资助支持谨此致谢。本工作获得国家自然科学基金[资助号72172082和72342021（C. Shan）]的资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06732获取。
