papers.abstract_original: We examine how different generations of artificial intelligence (AI) substitute for human knowledge worker tasks, leveraging two sequential natural experiments in the translation industry. We study the introduction of Google Neural Machine Translation (GNMT), a predictive, task-specific AI, as well as ChatGPT, a broad, general-purpose generative AI, in a major online labor market. Distinguishing between analytical tasks (regular translations) and intuitive tasks (transcreations, which require creative and cultural adaptation), we estimate difference-in-differences models on transaction-level data from 2016 to 2017 and 2022 to 2023. We find that GNMT reduced the demand for analytical tasks by economically meaningful magnitudes, while having no detectable effect on intuitive tasks. By contrast, ChatGPT produced substantially larger and more uniform reductions for both analytical and intuitive tasks, indicating a marked expansion in the scope and magnitude of AI substitution. By comparing these two technological shocks within the same labor market, we show that conclusions about which types of human work are resilient to automation do not straightforwardly generalize from predictive to generative AI.This paper was accepted by Joshua Gans, business strategy.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06740.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们利用翻译行业中的两个序贯自然实验，考察不同代际的人工智能（AI）如何替代人类知识工作者的任务。我们研究了一个大型在线劳动力市场中谷歌神经机器翻译（GNMT）——一种预测性的、任务特定型AI——以及ChatGPT——一种广泛的、通用型生成式AI——的引入。我们区分分析型任务（常规翻译）与直觉型任务（创译，需要创造性和文化适应），并基于2016至2017年以及2022至2023年的交易层面数据估计双重差分模型。我们发现，GNMT以具有经济意义的幅度降低了对分析型任务的需求，而对直觉型任务没有可检测到的影响。相比之下，ChatGPT对分析型任务和直觉型任务都产生了大幅且更为一致的减少，表明AI替代的范围和幅度显著扩大。通过在同一劳动力市场内比较这两次技术冲击，我们表明，关于哪些类型的人类工作对自动化具有韧性的结论，并不能从预测性AI直接推广到生成式AI。本文由Joshua Gans（商业战略）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06740获取。

papers.abstract_original: In recent years, chief financial officer (CFO) responsibilities and resignations have increased. Given these trends, we examine whether delegating accounting is associated with CFO retention. We develop a methodology to identify voluntary CFO departures using the firm’s public messaging around the CFO’s exit. Our results suggest that CFOs are less likely to voluntarily depart when accounting is delegated. Further, we find evidence that the negative association between delegating accounting and voluntary CFO departures is stronger when accounting demands are higher. Moreover, we find evidence that delegating accounting increases the CFO’s human capital. When CFOs do leave, they are more likely to become a chief executive officer and less likely to make a lateral move to another CFO position. Taken together, this study finds evidence consistent with the delegation of accounting increasing CFO retention and human capital.This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting.Funding: The authors appreciate research funding support from Coggin College of Business, University of North Florida and Tippie College of Business, University of Iowa. A. Rhodes gratefully acknowledges support from the Michael and Sandra Rocca Fellowship in Accounting.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06802.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，首席财务官（CFO）的职责和辞职人数均有所增加。鉴于这些趋势，我们考察将会计职能授权出去是否与CFO留任相关。我们开发了一种方法，利用公司围绕CFO离职的公开信息来识别自愿离职的CFO。我们的结果表明，当会计职能被授权出去时，CFO更不可能自愿离职。此外，我们发现有证据表明，当会计需求更高时，授权会计与CFO自愿离职之间的负相关关系更强。而且，我们发现有证据表明，授权会计会增加CFO的人力资本。当CFO确实离职时，他们更有可能成为首席执行官，而不太可能横向跳槽到另一个CFO职位。综合来看，本研究发现有证据与授权会计提高CFO留任率和人力资本相一致。本文由会计领域编辑Suraj Srinivasan接受。资助：作者感谢北佛罗里达大学Coggin商学院和爱荷华大学Tippie商学院的研究资助支持。A. Rhodes 衷心感谢 Michael and Sandra Rocca Fellowship in Accounting 的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06802 获取。

papers.abstract_original: I study depositor behavior in panic-driven bank runs using an LLM-based survey simulation. I build a representative population of synthetic agents by assigning demographic attributes, expose them to a viral panic post, and randomize bank communication interventions. I validate model responses against human benchmarks and then generate systematic message variants that vary tone, strength, and content within the validated design space. I then include the estimated withdrawal propensities into a contagion model, which maps network nodes to depositor personas and propagates withdrawals through a single layer proximity network. Direct, personalized bank communications with strong reassurances and explicit survival clauses substantially reduce withdrawal intent. This framework offers an efficient, inexpensive method for testing crisis messages and projecting how runs may unfold under alternative communication strategies.This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06807.
papers.abstract_zh: 我使用基于LLM的调查模拟研究恐慌驱动的银行挤兑中的存款人行为。我通过分配人口统计属性构建了一个具有代表性的合成代理人群，让他们接触一个病毒式恐慌帖子，并随机化银行沟通干预措施。我根据人类基准验证模型响应，然后在已验证的设计空间内生成系统性的消息变体，这些变体在语气、强度和内容上有所不同。然后，我将估计的提取倾向纳入一个传染模型，该模型将网络节点映射到存款人角色，并通过单层邻近网络传播提取行为。直接的、个性化的银行沟通，带有强有力的保证和明确的生存条款，大幅降低了提取意图。该框架提供了一种高效、廉价的方法来测试危机信息，并预测在替代沟通策略下挤兑可能如何展开。本文由金融学领域的Kay Giesecke接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06807获取。

papers.abstract_original: We find that the degree of extrapolative weighting in investors’ beliefs (DOX) has strong predictive power for a broad set of overreaction-related anomalies in the stock market. The average return spread of these anomalies is about 0.86% per month following high DOX periods and −0.31% per month following low DOX periods. In sharp contrast, DOX has opposite, but weaker, predictive power for underreaction-related anomalies. In addition, the predictive power of DOX is robust after controlling for a broad set of economic forces. Moreover, most of the DOX effect on long-short anomaly returns derives from the short legs of these overreaction-related anomalies, suggesting that time variation in DOX leads to more time variation in overpricing than in underpricing, probably because of short-sale impediments.This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance.Funding: Z. Su received financial support from Lingnan University [Faculty Research Grants DB25A5 and 103664]. Y. Wang received financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72503264]. J. Yu received financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72141304 and 72342020].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06850.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们发现，投资者信念中外推加权的程度（DOX）对股票市场中一系列广泛的过度反应相关异象具有强大的预测能力。在高DOX时期之后，这些异象的平均收益差约为每月0.86%，而在低DOX时期之后为每月−0.31%。与之形成鲜明对比的是，DOX对反应不足相关异象具有相反但较弱的预测能力。此外，在控制一系列广泛的经济力量后，DOX的预测能力仍然稳健。而且，DOX对多空异象收益的大部分影响源自这些过度反应相关异象的空头端，这表明DOX的时间变化导致高估定价的时间变化大于低估定价的时间变化，这可能是由于卖空障碍所致。本文由金融学领域的Lukas Schmid接受。资助：Z. Su获得了岭南大学[教职员研究资助DB25A5和103664]的财务支持。Y. Wang获得了国家自然科学基金[资助号72503264]的财务支持。J. Yu获得了国家自然科学基金[资助号72141304和72342020]的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06850获取。

papers.abstract_original: We study the impact of potentially inflated credit ratings in bond markets using experimental coordination games. Theoretical models featuring a feedback effect between capital markets and the real economy suggest that inflated ratings can have both positive and negative effects. Comparing markets with and without a credit rating agency, we find that ratings significantly influence investor behavior and capital allocation to firms. While we find evidence for both positive and negative real effects of potentially inflated ratings, the presence of a rating has an overall positive effect. We examine the mechanisms underlying these real effects and find that they operate mainly through investors’ beliefs about others’ behavior, and less so through beliefs about the firm’s fundamentals.This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance.Funding: A. Bayona acknowledges financial support from the Spanish Ministry of Science, Innovation and Universities and Agencia Nacional de Investigación [Grants ID2021-123748NB-I00 and PID2024-156339NA-I00], and Universitat Ramon Llull [Grant 2021-URL-Proj-068].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06886.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们使用实验性协调博弈研究债券市场中潜在虚高信用评级的影响。具有资本市场与实体经济之间反馈效应的理论模型表明，虚高评级可能既有正面影响也有负面影响。比较有和没有信用评级机构的市场，我们发现评级显著影响投资者行为和资本向公司的配置。虽然我们发现了潜在虚高评级既有正面实际效应也有负面实际效应的证据，但评级的存在总体上具有正面效应。我们考察了这些实际效应背后的机制，发现它们主要通过投资者对他人行为的信念发挥作用，而较少通过对企业基本面的信念发挥作用。本文由金融领域的Camelia Kuhnen接受。资助：A. Bayona感谢西班牙科学、创新与大学部以及国家研究局[资助编号2021-123748NB-I00和PID2024-156339NA-I00]，以及Universitat Ramon Llull[资助2021-URL-Proj-068]的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06886获取。

papers.abstract_original: Scalable and low-cost artificial intelligence (AI) assistance has the potential to improve firm decision making and economic performance, particularly in emerging markets. However, running a business involves a wide range of open-ended problems, making it unclear whether and how recent advances in AI can help business owners around the world make better decisions. In a field experiment with Kenyan entrepreneurs, we evaluated the impact of AI advice on small business revenues and profits by randomizing access to a GPT-4-powered AI business assistant. Although we are unable to reject the null hypothesis of no average treatment effect on firm revenues and profits, we find that the effect for entrepreneurs who were low performing at baseline is over 0.20-standard-deviations lower than for initial high performers. Subsample analyses show that low performers did nearly 10% worse because of the AI assistant, whereas high performers may have benefited by over 15%. This differential impact does not appear to result from differences in the questions posed to the AI or the advice that it provided but rather, from the advice that entrepreneurs chose to implement. More broadly, these results show that generative AI is already capable of impacting real-world business performance—although in uneven and sometimes unexpected ways.This paper was accepted by Anita McGahan, business strategy.Funding: This work was supported by the Weiss Fund, Harvard Business School, Berkeley Haas, the Cora Jane Flood Endowment at Berkeley Haas, the Agency Fund, the South Park Common Social Impact Fellowship, and the Digital Data Design Institute at Harvard.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06909.
papers.abstract_zh: 可扩展且低成本的人工智能（AI）辅助有可能改善企业决策和经济绩效，尤其是在新兴市场。然而，经营企业涉及广泛的开放式问题，这使得近期AI的进展是否以及如何帮助世界各地的企业主做出更好的决策尚不清楚。在一项与肯尼亚企业家进行的实地实验中，我们通过随机分配对由GPT-4驱动的AI商业助手的访问权限，评估了AI建议对小微企业收入和利润的影响。尽管我们无法拒绝企业收入和利润平均处理效应为零的原假设，但我们发现，基线表现低的企业家的效应比初始表现高的企业家低超过0.20个标准差。子样本分析显示，表现低的企业家因AI助手而差了近10%，而表现高的企业家可能获益超过15%。这种差异化影响似乎并非源于向AI提出的问题或AI提供的建议的差异，而是源于企业家选择实施的建议。更广泛地说，这些结果表明，生成式AI已经能够影响现实世界的企业绩效——尽管是以不均衡且有时出乎意料的方式。本文由Anita McGahan（商业战略）接受。资助：本工作得到了Weiss基金、哈佛商学院、伯克利哈斯、伯克利哈斯的Cora Jane Flood捐赠基金、Agency Fund、South Park Common Social Impact Fellowship以及哈佛数字数据设计研究所的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06909获取。

papers.abstract_original: Tax wash sale rules prohibit the recognition of capital losses when substantially identical securities are sold and immediately repurchased within short windows. This study examines whether institutional investors use exchange-traded funds (ETFs) to circumvent wash sale rules. Consistent with tax-motivated demand for ETFs, incumbent ETFs both create more shares and experience more trading volume upon the introduction of nearly identical ETFs, particularly when recent returns are negative. We show that tax-sensitive institutions’ investment in highly correlated ETFs has proliferated in recent years, exceeding a quarter of their assets under management. Furthermore, tax-sensitive institutions holding more ETFs are significantly more likely to engage in swapping nearly identical ETFs. This swapping behavior has become widespread, with tax-sensitive institutional investors swapping $417 billion of nearly identical ETFs since 2001. We estimate that tax-sensitive institutions realized more than $84 billion dollars in losses in highly correlated ETFs associated with the swapping activity since 2001.This paper was accepted by Shiva Rajgopal, accounting.Funding: The authors thank their institutions for financial support. M. Dambra thanks the Kenneth W. Colwell endowment for research support, C. M. C. Lee thanks the Kermit O. Hanson endowment for research support, and P. J. Quinn thanks PricewaterhouseCoopers for research support.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06944.
papers.abstract_zh: 税收洗售规则禁止在短期内卖出并立即回购实质相同证券时确认资本损失。本研究考察机构投资者是否利用交易所交易基金（ETF）来规避洗售规则。与出于税收动机的ETF需求相一致，在几乎相同的ETF推出后，现有ETF既会创设更多份额，也会经历更高的交易量，尤其是在近期收益为负时。我们表明，近年来，税收敏感型机构对高度相关ETF的投资激增，超过其管理资产的四分之一。此外，持有更多ETF的税收敏感型机构显著更可能从事几乎相同ETF的互换。这种互换行为已变得普遍，自2001年以来，税收敏感型机构投资者互换了417十亿美元几乎相同的ETF。我们估计，自2001年以来，税收敏感型机构在与互换活动相关的高度相关ETF中实现了超过84十亿美元的损失。本文由会计学领域的Shiva Rajgopal接受。资助：作者感谢其所在机构的财务支持。M. Dambra感谢Kenneth W. Colwell捐赠基金的研究支持，C. M. C. Lee感谢Kermit O. Hanson捐赠基金的研究支持，P. J. Quinn感谢普华永道的研究支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06944获取。

papers.abstract_original: Extreme weather from climate change creates unprecedented fluctuations in residential heating and cooling demand. Understanding how households use thermostats and react to ambient weather is key to achieving demand reductions and avoiding power crises. To this end, we analyze high-frequency microlevel time-series data from smart thermostat users to examine how households adjust their thermostat operations in response to outdoor temperature. Comparing households within a city, we find that households that automate their HVAC mode decisions exhibit reduced responsiveness to temperature shocks. In particular, their heating energy consumption remains elevated, even in the face of a changing climate, compared with households that rely on less automation. With respect to temperature setpoints, households that frequently override preprogrammed schedules show inertia, remaining at the overridden setpoints for long periods, and only partially revert to their preprogrammed setpoints. This can lead to higher energy use compared with those who stay in their preprogrammed schedules. To quantify the impact of these results, we conduct a set of simulations under hypothetical climate scenarios. These simulations reveal that by 2050, total cooling energy usage could rise by at least 67% and as high as 300%, depending on the climate scenario and geographical location, with peak usage and demand variability increasing by over 50%. Whereas heating consumption is reduced, this decrease is dominated by the increase in cooling energy usage. As a case study of the operational implications, we project total hourly loads and generation costs for Texas’ electricity grid in 2050. The increased heating and cooling demand alone could raise annual grid operating costs by 20%–25% and require 21,700 megawatts of additional capacity to maintain grid reliability.This paper was accepted by Jayashankar Swaminathan, operations management.Supplemental Material: The e-companion and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06952.
papers.abstract_zh: 气候变化引发的极端天气给住宅供暖和制冷需求带来了前所未有的波动。理解家庭如何使用恒温器以及对环境天气的反应，是实现需求削减和避免电力危机的关键。为此，我们分析了智能恒温器用户的高频微观时间序列数据，以考察家庭如何根据室外温度调整其恒温器操作。通过比较同一城市内的家庭，我们发现，将暖通空调模式决策自动化的家庭对温度冲击的反应性降低。特别是，与依赖较少自动化的家庭相比，即使面对不断变化的气候，其供暖能耗仍然居高不下。在温度设定点方面，频繁覆盖预编程时间表的家庭表现出惯性，长时间停留在被覆盖的设定点上，并且仅部分恢复到其预编程的设定点。与那些保持在预编程时间表中的家庭相比，这可能导致更高的能源使用。为了量化这些结果的影响，我们在假设的气候情景下进行了一系列模拟。这些模拟显示，到2050，总制冷能源使用量可能至少上升67%，最高可达300%，具体取决于气候情景和地理位置，而峰值使用量和需求变异性增加超过50%。尽管供暖消耗有所减少，但这一减少被制冷能源使用量的增加所主导。作为运营影响的一个案例研究，我们预测了2050德克萨斯州电网的总小时负荷和发电成本。仅供暖和制冷需求的增加就可能使年度电网运营成本上升20%–25%，并需要21,700兆瓦的额外容量来维持电网可靠性。本文由运营管理领域的Jayashankar Swaminathan接受。补充材料：电子附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06952获取。

papers.abstract_original: Disinformation detection is becoming increasingly important and relevant because it is easier than ever to create and disseminate disinformation. How does detection ability affect the incentive to generate disinformation? Given the practical constraints of classification technology, how should a detector be designed? To answer these questions, this paper studies the problem where a sender strategically communicates his type to a receiver, and a lie detector generates a noisy signal on the truthfulness of the sender’s message. The receiver then infers the sender’s type both through the message from the sender and through the signal from the detector. We find a nonmonotonic relationship between the probability that the low-type sender is lying and the accuracy of detection. More accurate detection increases the probability of lying when the true-positive rate is low, because of a persuasive effect. By contrast, more accurate detection decreases the probability of lying when the true-positive rate is high, because of a dissuasive effect. We also characterize the optimal detector design. The designer always chooses the lowest feasible false-positive rate for any true-positive rate. The possibility of false-positive alarms implies that the designer chooses an intermediate true-positive rate rather than the highest true-positive rate.This paper was accepted by Dmitri Kuksov, marketing.Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06956.
papers.abstract_zh: 虚假信息检测正变得越来越重要和相关，因为制造和传播虚假信息比以往任何时候都更容易。检测能力如何影响生成虚假信息的激励？鉴于分类技术的实际约束，检测器应如何设计？为回答这些问题，本文研究了这样一个问题：发送者策略性地向接收者传递其类型，而测谎器就发送者消息的真实性生成一个噪声信号。随后，接收者通过发送者的消息和检测器的信号来推断发送者的类型。我们发现，低类型发送者撒谎的概率与检测准确性之间存在非单调关系。当真阳性率较低时，更准确的检测会因说服效应而提高撒谎概率。相比之下，当真阳性率较高时，更准确的检测会因劝阻效应而降低撒谎概率。我们还刻画了最优检测器设计。对于任何真阳性率，设计者总是选择最低的可行假阳性率。假阳性警报的可能性意味着，设计者会选择中间水平的真阳性率，而不是最高的真阳性率。本文由市场营销领域的Dmitri Kuksov接受。补充材料：在线附录可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06956获取。

papers.abstract_original: The conditional return volatility barely drops at macro-announcements. This is at odds with the notion that high announcement returns are a manifestation of a large announcement premium. We show that models with an announcement premium cannot fully explain the joint patterns of returns and volatility over announcement days. Surprisingly, traditional models, which do not feature such a premium, can. Our estimation results based on a statistical setup indicate that the average announcement return is mostly attributable to the monetary policy surprise and pure small-sample components, which do not average out in-sample; the announcement premium is estimated to be small.This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06960.
papers.abstract_zh: 在宏观公告发布时，条件收益波动率几乎没有下降。这与高公告收益是巨大公告溢价之表现的观点相矛盾。我们表明，具有公告溢价的模型无法完全解释公告日前后收益与波动率的联合模式。令人惊讶的是，不具备此类溢价的传统模型却可以做到。我们基于统计框架的估计结果表明，平均公告收益主要归因于货币政策意外和纯小样本成分，这些成分在样本内不会相互抵消；公告溢价被估计为很小。本文由Lukas Schmid（金融学）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06960获取。

papers.abstract_original: This paper introduces a novel methodology for analyzing anomalies in conditional asset pricing models with time-varying risk exposures and premia. Our approach extends the conventional two-pass methodology to include both ordinary and weighted least-squares estimation in a conditional setting. We establish closed-form standard errors to statistically dissect anomalies, including a version robust to global misspecification. We introduce a novel R2 criterion to quantify the joint contribution of large anomaly sets in explaining cross-sectional stock return variations. Our analysis highlights the significant impact of anomalies during economic and financial crises, linking them closely with market conditions.This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance.Funding: This project has received funding from the postdoctoral fellowships programme Beatriu de Pinos, funded by the Secretary of Universities and Research (Government of Catalonia) and by the Horizon 2020 programme of research and innovation of the European Union under the [Marie Sktodowska-Curie Grant Agreement 801370].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06968.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文引入了一种新颖的方法论，用于分析具有时变风险暴露和风险溢价的条件资产定价模型中的异象。我们的方法将传统的两步法扩展至在条件设定中同时包含普通最小二乘和加权最小二乘估计。我们建立了闭式标准误，以在统计上剖析异象，其中包括一个对全局误设稳健的版本。我们引入了一个新颖的R2准则，以量化大型异象集合在解释横截面股票收益变动中的联合贡献。我们的分析凸显了经济和金融危机期间异象的显著影响，并将其与市场状况紧密联系起来。本文由Kay Giesecke（金融领域）接受。资助：本项目获得了Beatriu de Pinos博士后奖学金计划的资助，该计划由大学与研究秘书处（加泰罗尼亚政府）资助，并获得了欧盟Horizon 2020研究与创新计划的资助，依据[Marie Sktodowska-Curie资助协议801370]。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06968获取。

papers.abstract_original: This paper provides a general model of stablecoins, cryptocurrencies pegged to a traditional currency. We characterize the optimal design of a stablecoin protocol that generates seigniorage fees from issuance. We use this framework to assess the ability of various protocol designs to maintain the peg. Our model rationalizes algorithmic backing of stablecoins but highlights its greater fragility relative to collateralization. Immutable smart contracts improve stability because the issuer suffers from a commitment problem. Even under full collateralization, promises to repurchase stablecoins when demand drops are not credible. Alternatively, the protocol can restore commitment by decentralizing issuance, and this highlights a new benefit of DeFi protocols.This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06992.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文提供了一个稳定币的一般模型，稳定币是锚定传统货币的加密货币。我们刻画了通过发行产生铸币费收入的稳定币协议的最优设计。我们使用这一框架来评估各种协议设计维持锚定的能力。我们的模型为稳定币的算法支持提供了合理解释，但凸显了其相对于抵押化而言更大的脆弱性。不可变智能合约改善了稳定性，因为发行方面临承诺问题。即使在完全抵押化的情况下，当需求下降时回购稳定币的承诺也不可信。或者，协议可以通过去中心化发行来恢复承诺，这凸显了DeFi协议的一项新益处。本文由金融学Will Cong接受。补充材料：在线附录可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06992 获取。

papers.abstract_original: What happens if we train a new large language model (LLM) using data at least partially generated by other LLMs? The explosive success of LLMs means that content online will increasingly be generated by LLMs rather than humans, which inevitably enters the training data sets of next-generation LLMs. In this paper, we study the implications of such “regurgitative training” on LLM performance. Starting with the machine translation task (a representative language task with well-established evaluation criteria), we fine-tune LLMs with data generated either by themselves or by other LLMs, and we find strong evidence that regurgitative training handicaps the performance of fine-tuned LLMs. A comparison between LLM-generated data and real data reveals suggestive evidence that higher error rates and lower lexical diversity in LLM-generated data may be at play. Accordingly, we propose and evaluate three strategies to mitigate the performance loss by (i) prioritizing high-quality LLM-generated data, (ii) mixing data generated by multiple LLMs, and (iii) prioritizing LLM-generated data that most resemble real data. All three strategies can improve the performance of regurgitative training to some extent but cannot fully close the gap from training with real data. This highlights that real, human-generated data cannot be easily substituted by LLM-generated data in training LLMs. Additionally, we investigate regurgitative training on a creative ideation task with human judgement-based evaluations. Interestingly, we find that preference-based fine-tuning with human feedback on LLM-generated ideas can actually improve ideation performance. This showcases that human preference data when combined with LLM-generated data can bring performance gains.This paper was accepted by Hemant Bhargava, information systems.Funding: This work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72421001 and 72172070] and the Singapore Ministry of Education Academic Research Fund Tier 2 A-8003504 [Robert Brown Promising Researcher Award MOE-T2EP40].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07005.
papers.abstract_zh: 如果我们使用至少部分由其他大型语言模型（LLM）生成的数据来训练一个新的LLM，会发生什么？LLM的爆炸性成功意味着在线内容将越来越多地由LLM而非人类生成，这不可避免地进入下一代LLM的训练数据集。在本文中，我们研究了这种“反刍式训练”对LLM性能的影响。从机器翻译任务（一个具有成熟评估标准的代表性语言任务）出发，我们用由自身或其他LLM生成的数据微调LLM，并发现强有力的证据表明反刍式训练会损害微调后LLM的性能。对LLM生成数据与真实数据的比较揭示了提示性证据，即LLM生成数据中更高的错误率和更低的词汇多样性可能在其中起作用。据此，我们提出并评估了三种缓解性能损失的策略：（i）优先使用高质量的LLM生成数据，（ii）混合多个LLM生成的数据，以及（iii）优先使用最接近真实数据的LLM生成数据。这三种策略都能在一定程度上改善反刍式训练的性能，但无法完全弥合与使用真实数据训练之间的差距。这凸显了在训练LLM时，真实的、由人类生成的数据无法被LLM生成的数据轻易替代。此外，我们研究了在具有人类判断评估的创造性构思任务上的反刍式训练。有趣的是，我们发现对LLM生成的想法进行基于人类反馈的偏好微调实际上可以改善构思表现。这表明人类偏好数据与LLM生成数据相结合可以带来性能提升。本文由信息系统领域编辑Hemant Bhargava接受。资助：本工作得到国家自然科学基金[资助号72421001和72172070]以及新加坡教育部学术研究基金Tier 2 A-8003504[Robert Brown有前途研究者奖MOE-T2EP40]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07005获取。

papers.abstract_original: We study how working remotely impacts employee job satisfaction and retention using unique data on the remote work arrangements of nearly 165,000 employees. Our findings show that the positive association between working remotely more frequently and job satisfaction diminishes substantially after controlling for employee compensation, occupation, demographics, and workplace characteristics (e.g., feeling appreciated at work). Moreover, remote work is associated with a higher intention to leave the firm after considering these other factors. This suggests that workplace characteristics beyond remote work have a more consequential association with job satisfaction and retention than remote work itself. Using variation in job tasks and worker–manager relationships, we find that working remotely more frequently confers higher job satisfaction for employees in low-coordination roles or those who perceive their direct supervisors unfavorably. The findings suggest that remote work plays a more limited role in shaping job satisfaction and retention relative to broader workplace characteristics, and that its value depends on how well work arrangements are matched to employees’ strengths, coordination requirements, and managerial context.This paper was accepted by Shiva Rajgopal, accounting.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07017.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们利用近165,000名员工远程工作安排的独特数据，研究了远程工作如何影响员工工作满意度和留任。我们的发现表明，在控制了员工薪酬、职业、人口统计特征和工作场所特征（例如在工作中感到被赏识）后，更频繁地远程工作与工作满意度之间的正相关关系大幅减弱。此外，在考虑这些其他因素后，远程工作与更高的离职意向相关。这表明，除远程工作之外的工作场所特征与工作满意度和留任的关联比远程工作本身更为重要。利用工作任务和员工-管理者关系的变异，我们发现，对于处于低协调角色或对其直接主管评价不佳的员工，更频繁地远程工作带来更高的工作满意度。这些发现表明，相对于更广泛的工作场所特征，远程工作在塑造工作满意度和留任方面的作用更为有限，其价值取决于工作安排与员工优势、协调要求和管理情境的匹配程度。本文由会计学领域Shiva Rajgopal接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07017获取。
papers.title_original: How Do Different Remote Work Arrangements Impact Employee Job Satisfaction and Retention?

papers.abstract_original: Screening human capital based on signals such as job applications or entrepreneurial pitches is crucial for organizations. Signals are often informative insofar as they require differential knowledge and effort to produce. Generative AI (GAI) complicates screening by lowering the cost of producing impressive signals. We model the informational effects of GAI, showing that applicants’ access to GAI can increase—and also decrease—an evaluator’s screening mistakes. This result depends on how GAI affects experts’ signals compared with nonexperts’. Using experiments in hiring and start-up investing, we estimate that senders’ access to GAI (ChatGPT) lowers screening accuracy by 4%–9% for employers and start-up investors. Consistent with our model, senders’ access to GAI also improves screening accuracy in some settings, in our case, among senders from non–English-speaking countries. These results show that GAI can profoundly shape screening accuracy.This paper was accepted by Anindya Ghose, information systems.Funding: We are grateful for the Columbia Business School Digital Future Initiative Grant for helping fund this project. B. Cowgill thanks the Kauffman Foundation Emerging Scholars Program, the Columbia Center for Political Economy, the NET Institute, and the Stellar Development Foundation. P. Hernandez-Lagos thanks the Yeshiva University Sy Syms Dean’s Research Fund.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07027.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于求职申请或创业推介等信号来筛选人力资本对组织至关重要。信号之所以往往具有信息含量，是因为它们需要差异化的知识和努力才能产生。生成式人工智能（GAI）通过降低产生令人印象深刻信号的成本，使筛选变得复杂。我们对GAI的信息效应进行建模，表明申请人能够使用GAI可能增加——也可能减少——评估者的筛选错误。这一结果取决于GAI如何影响专家的信号相对于非专家的信号。利用招聘和初创企业投资中的实验，我们估计，发送者能够使用GAI（ChatGPT）使雇主和初创企业投资者的筛选准确性降低4%–9%。与我们的模型一致，发送者能够使用GAI在某些情境下也提高了筛选准确性，在我们的案例中，是来自非英语国家的发送者。这些结果表明，GAI能够深刻影响筛选准确性。本文由Anindya Ghose（信息系统）接受。资助：我们感谢哥伦比亚商学院数字未来倡议基金为本项目提供资助。B. Cowgill感谢Kauffman Foundation Emerging Scholars Program、哥伦比亚政治经济学中心、NET Institute以及Stellar Development Foundation。P. Hernandez-Lagos感谢叶史瓦大学Sy Syms院长研究基金。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07027获取。

papers.abstract_original: Decentralized autonomous organizations (DAOs) are entities without central leadership and operate based on a set of decision-making rules encoded into smart contracts using blockchain technology. In this study, we develop a theoretical model of DAO governance featuring strategic token trading under token-based voting to investigate potential conflicts of interest between a large participant (a “whale”) and many small participants. Our results show that ownership concentration has a negative effect on platform growth, but platform size, token illiquidity, and long-term incentives can mitigate this negative effect. We confirm these predictions using novel voting data on major DAOs from 2020 and 2024.This paper has been accepted by Lin William Cong for the Virtual Special Issue on Digital Finance.Funding: J. Han and J. Lee received financial support from the Institute of Management Research at Seoul National University.Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07033.
papers.abstract_zh: 去中心化自治组织（DAO）是没有中央领导层、并基于一套使用区块链技术编码进智能合约的决策规则运作的实体。在本研究中，我们构建了一个DAO治理的理论模型，其特征是在基于代币的投票下进行策略性代币交易，以考察一名大型参与者（“鲸鱼”）与许多小型参与者之间潜在的利益冲突。我们的结果表明，所有权集中对平台增长具有负面影响，但平台规模、代币非流动性和长期激励可以缓解这种负面影响。我们使用来自2020年和2024年主要DAO的新颖投票数据证实了这些预测。本文已被Lin William Cong接受，用于数字金融虚拟特刊。资助：J. Han和J. Lee获得首尔国立大学管理研究所的财务支持。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07033获取。
papers.title_original: Decentralized Autonomous Organization Governance

papers.abstract_original: Gender-anonymous hiring practices have been widely advocated as a means to reduce labor market inequalities, such as the gender wage gap and the underrepresentation of women in leadership. However, their effectiveness remains debated. This paper studies an experimental labor market where employee candidates set their own performance targets for a real-effort task and employers hire based on these self-set targets. In many professional settings, such targets serve as performance indicators and influence hiring and promotion decisions. In an online experiment with 4,674 participants, we vary in a 2 × 2 design (1) whether employers know the candidates’ genders and (2) the severity of the payoff consequences if the hired employee misses their target. This allows us to examine the interaction effects of gender anonymity in hiring and the performance target’s payoff relevance. We find that given equal ability, women set lower targets than men. Higher targets increase the likelihood of being hired, whereas a larger expected target-performance gap reduces hiring chances, particularly when missing the target has severe consequences for the employer. Importantly, our findings suggest that gender-anonymous applications may have unintended consequences. When gender is revealed, employers appear to adjust for gender differences in target setting, expecting a smaller target-performance gap for women than for men. As a result, women are more likely to be hired and receive higher payoffs when their gender is known. These results indicate that gender-anonymous hiring may backfire for women by preventing employers from accounting for behavioral gender differences (e.g., in self-promotion), ultimately reducing women’s hiring prospects.This paper was accepted by Dorothea Kübler, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Funding: This work was supported by the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG, German Research Foundation) under Germany’s Excellence Strategy [Grant EXC 2126/1–390838866].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07050.
papers.abstract_zh: 性别匿名招聘实践被广泛提倡，作为减少劳动力市场不平等（如性别工资差距和女性在领导层中代表性不足）的一种手段。然而，其有效性仍存在争议。本文研究了一个实验性劳动力市场，其中雇员候选人为一项真实努力任务设定自己的绩效目标，雇主基于这些自我设定的目标进行招聘。在许多职业环境中，此类目标作为绩效指标，影响招聘和晋升决策。在一项有4,674名参与者参与的在线实验中，我们在一个2×2设计（1）中变化（2）雇主是否知道候选人的性别，以及（2）如果被录用的员工未达到其目标时薪酬后果的严重程度。这使我们能够考察招聘中性别匿名性与绩效目标薪酬相关性的交互效应。我们发现，在能力相同的情况下，女性设定的目标低于男性。更高的目标增加了被录用的可能性，而更大的预期目标-绩效差距降低了录用机会，尤其是当未达到目标对雇主有严重后果时。重要的是，我们的发现表明，性别匿名申请可能产生意想不到的后果。当性别被揭示时，雇主似乎会针对目标设定中的性别差异进行调整，预期女性的目标-绩效差距小于男性。因此，当性别已知时，女性更有可能被录用并获得更高的薪酬。这些结果表明，性别匿名招聘可能对女性适得其反，因为它阻止雇主考虑行为上的性别差异（例如，在自我推销方面），最终降低了女性的录用前景。本文由Dorothea Kübler，行为经济学与决策分析接受。资助：本工作得到德国研究基金会（DFG，German Research Foundation）在德国卓越战略下的支持[资助号EXC 2126/1–390838866]。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07050获取。
papers.title_original: The Impact of Gender Information on Hiring Decisions Based on Self-Set Performance Targets
papers.title_zh: 性别信息对基于自我设定绩效目标的招聘决策的影响

papers.abstract_original: This paper investigates credit guarantees in a supply chain setting involving a supplier, a capital-constrained buyer, and a bank. We find that under complete information, credit guarantees increase order quantities but paradoxically raise wholesale prices, overall rendering the credit guarantee not useful for improving the operational efficiency. However, under information asymmetry, either a partial or full guarantee emerges in equilibrium, with the wholesale price maintained at its optimal full-information level. This underscores the pivotal role of credit guarantees in effective signaling and delineates the distinct functions of the wholesale price and the guarantee—the former on operational efficiency and the latter on signaling efficacy. Further comparative analysis of the supplier and buyer performances under the two contract types reveals that credit guarantees do not always benefit both parties.This paper was accepted by Jayashankar Swaminathan, operations management.Funding: H. Liu was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72272149 and 72394374]. H. Song was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72501259 and W2411062].Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07052.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文研究了涉及供应商、受资金约束的买方和银行的供应链环境中的信用担保。我们发现，在完全信息下，信用担保会增加订单数量，但矛盾的是会提高批发价格，总体上使得信用担保无助于提升运营效率。然而，在信息不对称下，部分担保或全额担保会在均衡中出现，批发价格维持在其最优的完全信息水平。这凸显了信用担保在有效信号传递中的关键作用，并界定了批发价格与担保的不同功能——前者作用于运营效率，后者作用于信号传递效力。对两种合同类型下供应商和买方绩效的进一步比较分析表明，信用担保并不总是使双方都受益。本文由运营管理领域的Jayashankar Swaminathan接受。资助：H. Liu获得国家自然科学基金[资助号72272149和72394374]的资助。H. Song获得国家自然科学基金[资助号72501259和W2411062]的资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07052获取。

papers.abstract_original: Socially driven organizations aiming to become more data driven often face practical barriers such as difficulties in measuring complex social objectives. We argue that, even when those practical barriers are addressed, social missions make it harder to foster a data-driven culture by exacerbating employee aversion to algorithms and hard data. Our theory is that emphasizing a social rather than profit-oriented mission increases employees’ concern for empathy, and this, in turn, makes them more averse to the cold, impersonal methods associated with using algorithms and hard data. Furthermore, if the aversion to algorithms and hard data in social organizations stems from empathy concerns as we predict, then designing fair data systems should mitigate this effect because fairness appeals to empathy concerns. Results of four experiments support these predictions. These findings suggest that, even when social organizations can accurately measure their objectives and attract employees with requisite data skills, they may still struggle to become data driven because prosocial employees avoid unempathetic decision approaches. However, social organizations can mitigate these effects by increasing the perceived empathy of data-driven decision making.This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting.Funding: Generous financial support was provided by the Institute of Management Accountants [Grant Number INC #6-2002], Tilburg University, and the Fynske Købstæders Fond.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07098.
papers.abstract_zh: 旨在变得更加数据驱动的社会导向型组织往往面临实际障碍，例如难以衡量复杂的社会目标。我们认为，即使这些实际障碍得到解决，社会使命也会加剧员工对算法和硬数据的抵触，从而使培育数据驱动文化变得更加困难。我们的理论是，强调社会使命而非利润导向的使命会增强员工对同理心的关注，而这反过来又使他们更加抵触与使用算法和硬数据相关的冷漠、非人性化方法。此外，如果社会型组织中对算法和硬数据的抵触如我们所预测的那样源于同理心关注，那么设计公平的数据系统应当能够缓解这一效应，因为公平诉求契合同理心关注。四项实验的结果支持了这些预测。这些发现表明，即使社会型组织能够准确衡量其目标并吸引具备必要数据技能的员工，它们仍可能难以实现数据驱动，因为亲社会的员工会回避缺乏同理心的决策方法。然而，社会型组织可以通过提高数据驱动决策的感知同理心来缓解这些效应。本文由会计学领域的Ranjani Krishnan接受。资助：管理会计师协会[资助编号INC #6-2002]、蒂尔堡大学和Fynske Købstæders Fond提供了慷慨的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07098获取。
papers.title_original: Mission Driven and Data Averse: How Empathy Fosters Resistance to Algorithms and Hard Data
papers.title_zh: 使命驱动与数据回避：同理心如何助长对算法和硬数据的抵触

papers.abstract_original: I study dynamic portfolio rebalancing in Collateralized Loan Obligations (CLOs) by developing an industry equilibrium model of nonbank lending, in which CLOs and loan funds arise endogenously in response to a premium for safe securities. When loans deteriorate after issuance, CLOs rebalance their portfolios to maintain collateral quality, which protects senior tranches at the expense of equity investors. This “self-healing” mechanism lowers CLOs’ ex ante funding costs by enabling the issuance of larger safe tranches. As more lenders operate CLOs, their portfolio rebalancing generates greater nonfundamental price pressures, incentivizing other lenders to operate loan funds. Overall, portfolio dynamics facilitate risk sharing across nonbank lenders and increase both total lending and the supply of safe securities relative to static portfolios.This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07100.
papers.abstract_zh: 我通过构建一个非银行贷款的行业均衡模型来研究担保贷款凭证（CLO）中的动态投资组合再平衡，在该模型中，CLO和贷款基金作为对安全证券溢价的反应而内生出现。当贷款在发行后质量恶化时，CLO会再平衡其投资组合以维持抵押品质量，这以牺牲股权投资者为代价保护了优先级份额。这种“自愈”机制通过使CLO能够发行更大规模的安全份额，降低了CLO的事前融资成本。随着更多贷款人经营CLO，其投资组合再平衡产生更大的非基本面价格压力，激励其他贷款人经营贷款基金。总体而言，相对于静态投资组合，投资组合动态促进了非银行贷款人之间的风险分担，并增加了总贷款规模和安全证券的供给。本文由金融学领域编辑Lukas Schmid接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07100获取。

papers.abstract_original: We study the relation between firms’ environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance and the aggregate stock market returns. Based on 38 individual ESG measures, we construct a market-level ESG index. With both the traditional predictive regression approach and two recently developed machine-learning methods, we find that the ESG index has strong and positive predictive power on the market both in- and out-of-sample, and both the cash flow and discount rate channels are the economic drivers of predictability. Our results are robust to a number of controls and set-ups. Our novel finding on the significant market-wide impact of the ESG provides support for the economy-wide importance of the ESG risk and for the central role played by governments.This paper was accepted by Caroline Flammer, sustainability.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07169.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究公司环境、社会和治理（ESG）表现与总体股票市场回报之间的关系。基于38个个体ESG指标，我们构建了一个市场层面的ESG指数。使用传统的预测回归方法和两种最近开发的机器学习方法，我们发现ESG指数在样本内和样本外都对市场具有强烈且正向的预测能力，并且现金流和折现率渠道都是可预测性的经济驱动因素。我们的结果在多种控制和设定下保持稳健。我们关于ESG显著市场范围影响的新发现，为ESG风险的经济范围重要性以及政府所发挥的核心作用提供了支持。本文由可持续发展领域的Caroline Flammer接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07169获取。
papers.title_original: ESG and the Stock Market: Is ESG Exposure Systematic?
papers.title_zh: ESG与股票市场：ESG暴露是系统性的吗？

papers.abstract_original: We study firms’ incentives to adopt a tracking technology to collect personal data that enable personalized pricing in an online market where some consumers have innate desires for privacy. In a model where two differentiated goods are sold under two different market structures (monopoly and duopoly), we find that the presence of these privacy-sensitive consumers alters the firms’ incentive to adopt personalized pricing. In particular, no firm uses personalized pricing in equilibrium if the proportion of privacy-sensitive consumers in the market is high. Competition, however, leads to wider use of personalized pricing. Privacy regulation that gives consumers control over whether a firm can track their online activities has the intended impact of protecting consumer privacy only if the proportion of privacy-sensitive consumers is low. Otherwise, the regulation makes the use of tracking technology more widespread. A key force that drives these results is the inability of a monopolist to commit to personalized prices that will give privacy-sensitive consumers a nonnegative net surplus. This deters these consumers from purchasing from the firm. If the proportion of privacy-sensitive consumers is high, the risk of losing these consumers induces the monopolist to adopt uniform pricing. Under duopoly, competition between firms alleviates the impact of the commitment problem because the rivals undercut each other’s prices. Privacy regulation also mitigates this impact because a firm can credibly commit to offering a uniform price to those consumers who reject tracking. Consequently, both competition and privacy regulation lead to increased use of tracking technology.This paper was accepted by Raphael Thomadsen, marketing.Funding: Z. Chen acknowledges financial support from the Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Canada [Grant 435-2019-0866].Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07170.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究企业采用追踪技术收集个人数据以实现个性化定价的激励，该场景为一个部分消费者具有内在隐私需求的在线市场。在一个两种差异化商品在两种不同市场结构（垄断和双寡头）下销售的模型中，我们发现这些隐私敏感消费者的存在改变了企业采用个性化定价的激励。特别地，如果市场中隐私敏感消费者的比例很高，则没有企业在均衡中使用个性化定价。然而，竞争会导致个性化定价的更广泛使用。赋予消费者控制企业是否可以追踪其在线活动的隐私监管，只有在隐私敏感消费者比例较低时才能产生保护消费者隐私的预期效果。否则，该监管会使追踪技术的使用更加普遍。驱动这些结果的一个关键力量是垄断者无法承诺给予隐私敏感消费者非负净剩余的个性化价格。这阻止了这些消费者从该企业购买。如果隐私敏感消费者的比例很高，失去这些消费者的风险会促使垄断者采用统一定价。在双寡头下，企业之间的竞争缓解了承诺问题的影响，因为竞争对手会相互压低价格。隐私监管也缓解了这一影响，因为企业可以可信地承诺向那些拒绝追踪的消费者提供统一价格。因此，竞争和隐私监管都导致追踪技术使用的增加。本文由市场营销领域编辑Raphael Thomadsen接受。资助：Z. Chen感谢加拿大社会科学与人文研究理事会[资助号435-2019-0866]的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07170获取。

papers.abstract_original: This paper examines the effect of crossborder carbon taxes on shareholder wealth. Using stock price reactions to key announcements of the European Union (EU) carbon border adjustment mechanism (CBAM), we find that EU purchasers of CBAM-covered products experience significantly lower returns than non-European producers of such products. The effect is strongest for EU purchasers with non-EU supply chains. Further cross-sectional analyses show that these negative reactions are more pronounced when CBAM-related costs are higher and when firms have a lower ability to pass them on to their trading partners. Overall, the evidence suggests that equity markets expect crossborder carbon pricing on imports to be costly for EU firms.This paper was accepted by Caroline Flammer, sustainability.Funding: G. Ormazabal thanks the Cátedra de Dirección de Instituciones Financieras y Gobierno Corporativo del Grupo Santander, the R + D + I Project [Reference PID2022-143016NB-I00 funded by MCIN/AEI/10.13039/501100011033], and ERDF “A way of making Europe” [Grant TED2021-132531B-I00 funded by MCIN/AEI/10.13039/501100011033, the European Union NextGeneration EU/PRTR, IESE’s High Impact Projects Initiative–2023, and the Social Trends Institute]. R. Raney acknowledges financial support from the Spanish Ministry of Science and Innovation [Grant PID2019-111143GB-C31 funded by MICIU/AEI/10.13039/501100011033] and [Grant PID2023-150744NB-C41 funded by MICIU/AEI/ 10.13039/501100011033].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07171.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文考察跨境碳税对股东财富的影响。利用股价对欧盟（EU）碳边境调节机制（CBAM）关键公告的反应，我们发现，CBAM覆盖产品的欧盟购买者所获得的回报显著低于此类产品的非欧洲生产商。这一效应对拥有非欧盟供应链的欧盟购买者最为强烈。进一步的横截面分析表明，当与CBAM相关的成本更高、且企业将其转嫁给贸易伙伴的能力更低时，这些负面反应更为明显。总体而言，证据表明，股票市场预期对进口征收跨境碳定价对欧盟企业而言代价高昂。本文由可持续发展领域的Caroline Flammer接受。资助：G. Ormazabal感谢桑坦德集团金融机构与公司治理讲席（Cátedra de Dirección de Instituciones Financieras y Gobierno Corporativo del Grupo Santander）、研发创新项目[参考编号PID2022-143016NB-I00，由MCIN/AEI/10.13039/501100011033资助]，以及ERDF“建设欧洲之路”[资助编号TED2021-132531B-I00，由MCIN/AEI/10.13039/501100011033、欧盟NextGeneration EU/PRTR、IESE高影响力项目倡议——2023以及社会趋势研究所资助]。R. papers.abstract_original: We conduct a series of laboratory experiments to examine whether the gradual exogenous revelation of sellers’ private information influences the occurrence of trades in a bilateral bargaining setting with a static lemon condition. We find that, although information does not increase efficiency, it reduces the likelihood that buyers incur losses when trading with low-quality sellers. Anticipating that additional signals will arrive, buyers hesitate to finalize deals immediately and exhibit a “waiting for news” effect, making sizable offer adjustments only when sufficient positive signals have accumulated. In contrast, informed sellers are less sensitive to news but appear to wait for the offer that they deem acceptable.This paper was accepted by Dorothea Kübler, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Funding: T. Ding initiated this project while at the Shanghai University of Finance and Economics and thanks the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72173076] for financial support. S. F. Lehrer thanks the Social Science and Humanities Research Council of Canada for research support.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07224.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们进行了一系列实验室实验，以考察在具有静态柠檬条件的双边议价环境中，卖方私人信息逐步外生披露是否会影响交易的发生。我们发现，尽管信息并未提高效率，但它降低了买方在与低质量卖方交易时遭受损失的可能性。由于预期到会有更多信号到来，买方不愿立即敲定交易，并表现出“等待消息”效应，只有在积累了足够多的正面信号时才做出大幅报价调整。相比之下，知情卖方对消息不那么敏感，但似乎会等待其认为可接受的报价。本文由行为经济学与决策分析领域的Dorothea Kübler接受。资助：T. Ding在上海财经大学期间启动了本项目，并感谢国家自然科学基金[资助号72173076]的财务支持。S. F. Lehrer感谢加拿大社会科学与人文研究理事会的研究支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07224获取。

papers.title_zh: 等待合适的报价：关于消息如何影响议价的实验室证据

papers.abstract_original: We examine whether ownership by benchmarked investors constrains short sellers’ ability to quickly cover their positions following positive earnings news and thereby exacerbates price pressure from short covering. We find that high benchmarked ownership is related to greater price overshooting in highly shorted stocks at positive earnings announcements. This effect is driven by benchmarked ownership amplifying both price and volume impacts of short covering. Exploring shocks from Russell index reconstitutions and examining other settings such as management guidance and analyst recommendation revisions yield similar inferences. Overall, our findings highlight a novel mechanism that benchmarked ownership can constrain short-selling activities.This paper was accepted by Eric So, accounting.Funding: The authors acknowledge financial assistance from their respective schools.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07231.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察基准化投资者的持股是否限制了卖空者在正面盈利消息后快速回补头寸的能力，从而加剧了空头回补带来的价格压力。我们发现，高基准化持股与高卖空股票在正面盈利公告时更大的价格超调相关。这一效应是由基准化持股放大空头回补的价格和成交量影响所驱动的。探索罗素指数重构带来的冲击，并考察管理层指引和分析师推荐修订等其他情境，得出了类似的推论。总体而言，我们的发现凸显了一种新颖的机制，即基准化持股可能限制卖空活动。本文由会计学领域的Eric So接受。资助：作者们感谢各自所在学校的财务援助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07231获取。

papers.title_zh: 寻找股票：基准化持股、空头回补与价格效率

papers.abstract_original: This paper examines the role of rational attention allocation in shaping private information acquisition, and its implications for price informativeness and real outcomes. Our setting exploits the listing of options on a stock as a source of variation in the relative value of acquiring information on its close industry peers. Consistent with the predictions of our theoretical model, we find that options listing on peer firms’ stocks is associated with declines in attention and price informativeness, and an increase in return volatility. These changes are accompanied by declines in investment-price sensitivity and profitability, indicating a deterioration of market feedback.This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07233.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文考察理性注意力配置在塑造私人信息获取中的作用，及其对价格信息含量和实际结果的影响。我们的研究设定利用某只股票期权的上市作为获取其密切行业同行信息相对价值变化的来源。与我们的理论模型预测一致，我们发现同行公司股票期权上市与注意力及价格信息含量的下降以及收益波动率的上升相关。这些变化伴随着投资-价格敏感性和盈利能力的下降，表明市场反馈恶化。本文由Camelia Kuhnen（金融领域）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07233获取。
papers.title_original: In Short Supply: Efficiency Implications of Rational Attention Allocation
papers.title_zh: 供给不足：理性注意力配置的效率含义

papers.abstract_original: We build a model of endogenous credit cycles arising from the dynamics of adverse selection. Heterogeneous entrepreneurs trade productive assets in an anonymous market subject to financial frictions. Cream-skimming rent-seekers create lemon assets that can be traded. Lemon assets are indistinguishable ex-ante from the productive assets but have no productive value ex-post. The average quality of assets is the key state variable of the economy. High asset prices today attract the creation of more lemons, thereby exacerbating adverse selection and depressing the future reallocation of productive assets and asset prices. Productive and lemon assets therefore exhibit predator-prey dynamics, and the quality of assets evolves endogenously over time. The equilibrium may feature endogenous cycles and chaos, with the credit market freezing and thawing recurrently and with deterministic ups and downs in asset prices and the volume of trades. We show that a social planner has incentives to tax credit market activities in order to reduce lemon assets and to eliminate endogenous cycles.This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance.Funding: F. Dong acknowledges the financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72525004].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07248.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个由逆向选择动态引起的内生信贷周期模型。异质性企业家在受金融摩擦影响的匿名市场中交易生产性资产。撇脂寻租者创造可交易的柠檬资产。柠檬资产在事前与生产性资产无法区分，但在事后没有生产价值。资产的平均质量是经济的关键状态变量。今天的高资产价格吸引更多柠檬的创造，从而加剧逆向选择并抑制未来生产性资产的再配置和资产价格。因此，生产性资产和柠檬资产表现出捕食者-猎物动态，资产质量随时间内生演变。均衡可能具有内生周期和混沌，信贷市场反复冻结和解冻，资产价格和交易量呈现确定性的起伏。我们表明，社会规划者有激励对信贷市场活动征税，以减少柠檬资产并消除内生周期。本文由金融学领域的Will Cong接受。资助：F. Dong感谢国家自然科学基金[资助号72525004]的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07248获取。
papers.title_original: Lemon Cycles
papers.title_zh: 柠檬周期

papers.abstract_original: This paper revisits the exchange rate predictability of commodity currencies through the lens of market efficiency. Focusing on currencies with strong contemporaneous exposure to commodity prices, we show that changes in country-specific commodity export or import prices predict exchange rate fluctuations both in sample and out of sample. We establish four empirical facts: (i) the sign of the predictive relationship runs counter to standard risk-based explanations; (ii) predictability is concentrated at short horizons; (iii) predictability is driven by a small set of thinly traded currencies; and (iv) even sophisticated speculative traders adjust positions sluggishly in response to commodity price shocks in these currencies. Together, these findings suggest that predictability arises from the slow incorporation of information in less actively traded currencies, which is likely due to liquidity and position-building constraints, rather than from compensation for risk. The results also clarify the sources of commodity-based predictability in carry trade returns.This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07249.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文从市场效率的视角重新审视商品货币的汇率可预测性。我们聚焦于与商品价格存在强同期暴露的货币，表明国别特定商品出口或进口价格的变化在样本内和样本外均能预测汇率波动。我们确立了四个经验事实：(i) 预测关系的符号与标准的基于风险的解释相悖；(ii) 可预测性集中于短期限；(iii) 可预测性由一小部分交易清淡的货币所驱动；(iv) 即便是成熟的投机交易者，在面对这些货币的商品价格冲击时，也会迟缓地调整头寸。综合来看，这些发现表明可预测性源于信息在交易较不活跃的货币中被缓慢纳入，这很可能归因于流动性和建仓约束，而非风险补偿。研究结果还厘清了利差交易收益中基于商品的可预测性的来源。本文由金融领域编辑Lukas Schmid接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07249 获取。

papers.abstract_original: This study evaluates whether employees have useful information about firms’ ESG (environmental, social, governance) practices. Analyzing over 10 million employee reviews, it reveals that 43% of reviews discuss ESG topics, with governance surprisingly receiving substantial attention. Assembling novel hard-to-manipulate ESG indicators, including emissions estimates from satellite imagery, the study finds that employees’ ESG inside view is more informative about these indicators than existing ESG ratings. Moreover, the inside view appears robust to ESG cheap talk, as low-cost changes in firms’ ESG commitments do not affect it, whereas costlier changes do. Thus, employee perspectives can help investors assess firms’ authentic ESG performance.This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07258.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究评估员工是否拥有关于公司ESG（环境、社会、治理）实践的有用信息。通过分析超过10百万条员工评论，研究发现43%的评论讨论了ESG话题，其中治理令人意外地获得了大量关注。通过汇编新颖的难以操纵的ESG指标，包括来自卫星图像的排放估计，研究发现员工对ESG的内部视角比现有ESG评级对这些指标更具信息含量。此外，内部视角似乎对ESG空谈具有稳健性，因为公司ESG承诺的低成本变化不会影响它，而成本更高的变化则会。因此，员工视角可以帮助投资者评估公司真实的ESG表现。本文由Will Cong，金融学领域接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07258获取。

papers.title_zh: 员工是否拥有关于公司ESG实践的有用信息？

papers.abstract_original: We examine how culture information in job postings influences firms’ hiring outcomes. We utilize machine learning methods to measure five core values present in job postings and demonstrate that culture information helps attract job seekers, as it is associated with higher worker inflows. The effect strengthens when job seekers value culture in their job searches and face frictions in learning about culture from other sources. Additional analyses indicate that individual cultural dimensions in job postings are more salient to job seekers when they have heightened preferences for that particular value. Finally, culture information is associated with a higher likelihood that interviews result in offers, and greater acceptance of those offers. Overall, our results suggest that culture information in job postings helps job seekers sort into culturally aligned firms.This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting.Conflict of Interest Statement: The authors declare that they have no relevant or material financial interests that relate to the research described in this paper.Funding: A. H. Huang acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72172079].Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07272.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察职位招聘信息中的文化信息如何影响企业的招聘结果。我们利用机器学习方法测量职位招聘信息中呈现的五种核心价值观，并证明文化信息有助于吸引求职者，因为它与更高的员工流入相关。当求职者在求职中重视文化，且在从其他来源了解文化时面临摩擦时，这一效应会增强。进一步分析表明，当求职者对某一特定价值有更强的偏好时，职位招聘信息中的个别文化维度对他们更为凸显。最后，文化信息与面试转化为录用通知的可能性更高以及对这些录用通知的接受度更高相关。总体而言，我们的结果表明，职位招聘信息中的文化信息有助于求职者分选进入文化契合的企业。本文由会计领域的Ranjani Krishnan接受。利益冲突声明：作者声明他们与本文所述研究没有相关或重大的经济利益。资助：A. H. Huang感谢国家自然科学基金[资助号72172079]的财务支持。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07272获取。
papers.title_original: Communicating Corporate Culture in Labor Markets: Evidence from Job Postings
papers.title_zh: 在劳动力市场中传递企业文化：来自职位招聘信息的证据

papers.abstract_original: This paper investigates whether news consumers react strategically to media slant. Using data from Microblog users and an online experiment that varies whether sources and stances are disclosed, we find that users are more likely to repost news consistent with their own attitudes, yet they also exhibit a higher propensity to repost news inconsistent with the reporting outlet’s general stance. Evidence suggests that this latter behavior reflects strategic inference: users recognize the outlet’s tradeoff between popularity and stance, and thus infer greater popularity for inconsistent news. Heterogeneity analysis indicates that users with stronger Bayesian updating and level-k reasoning abilities display larger strategic reactions. Finally, we show that simply reminding users of media slant can serve as an effective nudge to foster more strategic responses.This paper was accepted by John Beshears, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Funding: This work was supported by National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72225002, 72394393, 72225001, 72192843, 72531001].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07339.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文研究新闻消费者是否对媒体偏见做出策略性反应。使用来自微博用户的数据以及一个改变是否披露来源和立场的在线实验，我们发现用户更可能转发与自己态度一致的新闻，然而他们也表现出更高的倾向转发与报道媒体一般立场不一致的新闻。证据表明，后一种行为反映了策略性推断：用户认识到媒体在受欢迎程度与立场之间的权衡，从而推断不一致的新闻具有更高的受欢迎程度。异质性分析表明，具有更强贝叶斯更新和k阶推理能力的用户表现出更大的策略性反应。最后，我们表明，仅仅提醒用户媒体偏见就可以作为一种有效的助推，促进更具策略性的反应。本文由John Beshears，行为经济学与决策分析领域接受。资助：本工作得到国家自然科学基金[资助号72225002, 72394393, 72225001, 72192843, 72531001]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07339获取。
papers.title_original: How Awareness of Media Slant Affects Reaction to News: Field and Experimental Evidence from Microblog Users
papers.title_zh: 媒体偏见的意识如何影响对新闻的反应：来自微博用户的实地和实验证据

papers.abstract_original: Often advocated for the potential to reduce waste in fresh produce supply chains, sensor technologies enable firms to monitor the condition of each product unit and allocate them to markets at different transportation distances, thereby matching units with shorter shelf lives with closer markets. In this paper, we consider a firm purchasing and transporting a fresh produce product for sale in two destination markets. Postharvest processes cause a proportion of the product to be in risky condition, potentially becoming unsalable (“spoiled”) due to shelf-life deterioration during transportation. With monitoring technology, the firm first determines a purchase quantity and then decides how to allocate each unit (in either good or risky condition) between markets. We characterize the optimal allocation policies, which can be used to efficiently determine the optimal purchase quantity. Our analysis shows that such technology may inadvertently increase total waste by inducing larger purchase quantities; this increase is often, but not always, accompanied by a lower waste rate and improved distribution efficiency. As firms increasingly adopt monitoring technology for shipment allocation, additional policy and managerial attention may be required. Improvements in postharvest processes can strengthen the waste-reduction benefits of monitoring technology. Firms seeking to maintain their sustainability goals can capture most of the profit gains from monitoring by carefully moderating increases in purchase quantities.This paper was accepted by Jeannette Song, operations management.Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07382.
papers.abstract_zh: 传感器技术常因具有减少生鲜农产品供应链浪费的潜力而受到提倡，它使企业能够监测每个产品单元的状况，并将其分配到不同运输距离的市场，从而将保质期较短的单元与较近的市场相匹配。在本文中，我们考虑一家企业采购并运输一种生鲜农产品，在两个目的地市场销售。采后过程导致一部分产品处于风险状态，可能因运输过程中保质期恶化而变得无法销售（“变质”）。借助监测技术，企业首先确定采购数量，然后决定如何在市场之间分配每个单元（处于良好或风险状态）。我们刻画了最优分配策略，这些策略可用于高效地确定最优采购数量。我们的分析表明，此类技术可能通过诱导更大的采购数量而无意中增加总浪费；这种增加通常（但并非总是）伴随着更低的浪费率和更高的分配效率。随着企业越来越多地采用监测技术进行运输分配，可能需要额外的政策和管理关注。采后过程的改进可以增强监测技术的减废效益。寻求维持其可持续发展目标的企业，可以通过谨慎地节制采购数量的增加，获取监测所带来的大部分利润收益。本文由运营管理领域的Jeannette Song接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07382获取。

papers.abstract_original: Digital platforms that connect customers with service providers often monetize by selling customer leads to interested providers. Examples include Bark, Google Local Services, HomeAdvisor, Modernize, Porch, and Thumbtack. This paper develops a game-theoretic model to analyze how lead pricing affects customer and provider welfare. When the platform raises the fee-per-lead for a customer-type, those customers—conditional on receiving the same number of provider quotes—are quoted lower prices. However, if the fee is sufficiently high, providers purchase fewer of these leads, which can reduce the number of quotes and diminish customer surplus. To maximize social welfare, a simple policy that sets a market-clearing fee-per-lead for each customer-type guarantees at least 1/(e−1)≈58.19% of the first-best welfare and at least 79.15% of the welfare under the welfare-optimal fees. The first-best outcome can be achieved by subsidizing providers for each job well done, so that experienced providers with cheaper sources of leads do not exit the platform. Understanding these welfare trade-offs can help platforms design policies that support balanced marketplace growth and preserve a sustainable revenue stream.This paper was accepted by Srikanth Jagabathula, market design, platform, and demand analytics.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07399.
papers.abstract_zh: 连接客户与服务提供商的数字平台通常通过向感兴趣的提供商出售客户线索来变现。例子包括Bark、Google Local Services、HomeAdvisor、Modernize、Porch和Thumbtack。本文建立了一个博弈论模型，以分析线索定价如何影响客户和提供商的福利。当平台提高某一客户类型的每条线索费用时，这些客户——在获得相同数量的提供商报价的条件下——会得到更低的报价。然而，如果费用足够高，提供商会购买更少的此类线索，这可能减少报价数量并降低客户剩余。为了实现社会福利最大化，一项简单的政策为每一客户类型设定市场出清的每条线索费用，可保证至少达到第一最优福利的1/(e−1)≈58.19%，以及至少达到福利最优费用下福利的79.15%。第一最优结果可以通过对每项完成良好的工作向提供商提供补贴来实现，从而使拥有更便宜线索来源的经验丰富的提供商不会退出平台。理解这些福利权衡可以帮助平台设计支持市场平衡增长并保持可持续收入流的政策。本文由Srikanth Jagabathula（市场设计、平台与需求分析）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07399获取。

papers.abstract_original: We examine how users respond to winning symbolic awards in online crowdsourcing contests. Our setting is a machine learning competition platform that grants symbolic medals to recognize participants’ contest achievements. Employing a regression discontinuity design, we find that gold medal winners participate less in subsequent contests but engage more in prosocial activities, evidenced by a greater volume and length of posts, as well as more substantial and frequent code contributions. In contrast, bronze and silver medals do not seem to exert a significant influence on recipients’ subsequent behaviors. Drawing on self-determination theory and the needs-as-motives hypothesis, we provide evidence that need-driven goal shifting plays an important role in driving the dual effects of gold medals—diminished contest participation but enhanced prosocial contributions. Further analyses reveal that winners with previous competition medals are more likely to favor contributing content over competing again, whereas winners with more prior contribution medals are less inclined to further increase contributions. Moreover, team winners exhibit a lower tendency than solo winners to shift their efforts from competition to contribution. We add to the symbolic awards literature by uncovering a novel goal-shifting effect induced by contest medals, where award receipt redirects user effort from the focal rewarded domain to other forms of platform engagement.This paper was accepted by D. J. Wu, information systems.Funding: Financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72032006, W2611101, and 72371192] and the “Digital-Intelligent Operations Risk Management” Innovation and Entrepreneurship Team Project of the Sanqin Talent Special Support Program in Shaanxi Province [2025STD03] is gratefully acknowledged.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07419.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察用户如何回应在线众包竞赛中赢得象征性奖项。我们的研究场景是一个机器学习竞赛平台，该平台授予象征性奖牌以表彰参赛者的竞赛成就。采用断点回归设计，我们发现金牌获奖者参与后续竞赛更少，但更多参与亲社会活动，这体现在发帖数量和长度更大，以及代码贡献更实质且更频繁。相比之下，铜牌和银牌似乎对获奖者后续行为没有显著影响。基于自我决定理论和需求即动机假说，我们提供证据表明，需求驱动的目标转移在推动金牌的双重效应——竞赛参与减少但亲社会贡献增强——中发挥重要作用。进一步分析显示，此前获得过竞赛奖牌的获奖者更倾向于贡献内容而非再次参赛，而此前获得更多贡献奖牌的获奖者则不太倾向于进一步增加贡献。此外，团队获奖者比个人获奖者更不倾向于将努力从竞赛转向贡献。我们通过揭示竞赛奖牌引发的一种新颖的目标转移效应，为象征性奖项文献作出贡献，即获奖将用户努力从受奖励的焦点领域重新导向平台参与的其他形式。本文由信息系统领域的D. J. Wu接受。资助：感谢国家自然科学基金[资助号72032006、W2611101和72371192]以及陕西省三秦人才特殊支持计划“数字智能运营风险管理”创新创业团队项目[2025STD03]的资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07419获取。

papers.abstract_original: Using confidential information on banks’ portfolios, we show that banks that emphasize the sustainability of their lending policies in their disclosures do not exhibit a reduced environmental impact and, if anything, they extend a higher volume of credit to brown borrowers, without charging higher interest rates, shortening debt maturity, or requiring more collateral. These results cannot be attributed to the financing of borrowers’ transition toward greener technologies. Examining the mechanisms behind the strategic disclosure choices reveals that banks extend credit to existing brown borrowers, especially those who are financially underperforming.This paper was accepted by Caroline Flammer, sustainability.Funding: M. papers.abstract_zh: 利用银行投资组合的机密信息，我们表明，在披露中强调其贷款政策可持续性的银行并未表现出降低的环境影响，而且如果有的话，它们向棕色借款人提供了更高额度的信贷，且不收取更高利率、不缩短债务期限或要求更多抵押品。这些结果不能归因于为借款人向更绿色技术转型提供融资。考察战略披露选择背后的机制发现，银行向现有棕色借款人提供信贷，尤其是那些财务表现不佳的借款人。本文由可持续发展领域的Caroline Flammer接受。资助：M. Loumioti感谢德克萨斯大学达拉斯分校的财务支持。本文表达的观点是作者的观点，不一定反映欧洲央行或欧元体系的观点。所有错误均为作者自身错误。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07420获取。

papers.abstract_original: Explainable artificial intelligence (AI) models have been proposed to mitigate overreliance and underreliance on AI, which reduce the effectiveness of human-AI collaborative tools. Yet, empirical evidence is mixed, and the impact of explainable AI on the cognitive effort and fatigue of a decision maker (DM) is often overlooked. This paper offers a theoretical perspective on these issues. We develop an analytical model that incorporates the defining features of human and machine intelligence, capturing the limited but flexible nature of human cognition with imperfect machine recommendations. Crucially, we represent how AI-based explanations influence the DM’s belief in the algorithm’s predictive quality. Our results indicate that explainable AI has varying effects depending on the level of explainability provided. Although low explainability levels have no impact on decision accuracy and reliance behavior, they lessen the cognitive burden on the DM. In contrast, higher explainability levels enhance accuracy by improving overreliance but at the expense of increased underreliance. Further, the relative impact of explainability is higher when the DM is more cognitively constrained, when the decision task is sufficiently complex, or when the stakes are lower. Importantly, higher explainability levels can escalate the DM’s cognitive burden (and hence, overall processing time and fatigue) precisely when explanations are most needed (i.e., when the DM is pressed for time to complete a complex task and doubts the machine’s quality). Our study clarifies how explainability affects decision outcomes and cognitive effort, informing the design of effective human-AI systems across decision environments.This paper was accepted by Jeannette Song, operations management.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07450.
papers.abstract_zh: 可解释人工智能（AI）模型被提出来以缓解对AI的过度依赖和依赖不足，这两者都会降低人机协作工具的有效性。然而，实证证据不一，且可解释AI对决策者（DM）认知努力和疲劳的影响往往被忽视。本文就这些问题提供了一个理论视角。我们开发了一个分析模型，纳入人类智能和机器智能的决定性特征，刻画了人类认知的有限但灵活的性质以及不完美的机器建议。至关重要的是，我们刻画了基于AI的解释如何影响决策者对算法预测质量的信念。我们的结果表明，可解释AI的效果因所提供的可解释性水平而异。尽管低可解释性水平对决策准确性和依赖行为没有影响，但它们减轻了决策者的认知负担。相比之下，较高的可解释性水平通过改善过度依赖来提高准确性，但代价是增加了依赖不足。此外，当决策者认知更受限、决策任务足够复杂或利害关系较低时，可解释性的相对影响更大。重要的是，恰恰在解释最被需要时（即当决策者时间紧迫以完成复杂任务且怀疑机器质量时），较高的可解释性水平可能加剧决策者的认知负担（从而增加总体处理时间和疲劳）。我们的研究阐明了可解释性如何影响决策结果和认知努力，为跨决策环境设计有效的人机系统提供了启示。本文由运营管理领域编辑Jeannette Song接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07450获取。

papers.abstract_original: Tackling hospital emergency department (ED) overcrowding is a paramount challenge for healthcare systems. To combat this issue, an innovative approach is to identify patients who can be served vertically (i.e., in a seated position) and route them to a dedicated area termed the vertical processing pathway (VPP). Successfully implementing this design requires understanding which patients should be routed to the VPP and when. Currently, the decision to leverage the VPP is made in an ad hoc fashion. To assist our partner hospital and other EDs in capturing the value of the VPP, we develop a machine learning model that provides personalized risk scores predicting whether each arriving patient needs an ED bed. We use these scores as input to a stochastic patient flow model and analytically characterize the optimal VPP policy that minimizes length of stay. We then combine our results to derive an interpretable VPP patient streaming protocol suitable for implementation in practice and conduct a before-and-after experiment in which we leverage empirical analyses to evaluate the impact of integrating it into practice. The implemented protocol led to an 11-minute (4.2%) reduction in ED length of stay in our partner hospital without any adverse effect on quality-of-care outcomes. This effect was statistically significant and remained robust after controlling for various confounding factors and potential sources of endogeneity. Our VPP protocol can also be utilized in other EDs, offering operational improvements without requiring additional resources.This paper was accepted by Stefan Scholtes, healthcare management.Funding: S. Saghafian received financial support from the NSF [Grant CMMI-15 62645], “Data-Driven Management of Post-Transplant Medications,” which partially enabled this work, as well as funding and support from the Harvard Data Science Initiative and the Harvard Mossavar-Rahmani Center for Business and Government.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07517.
papers.abstract_zh: 解决医院急诊科（ED）过度拥挤是医疗系统面临的首要挑战。为应对这一问题，一种创新方法是识别可以垂直（即以坐姿）服务的患者，并将其分流到称为垂直处理路径（VPP）的专用区域。成功实施这一设计需要了解哪些患者应被分流到VPP以及何时分流。目前，利用VPP的决策是以临时方式做出的。为帮助我们的合作医院和其他急诊科获取VPP的价值，我们开发了一个机器学习模型，提供个性化风险评分，预测每位到达患者是否需要急诊科床位。我们将这些评分作为随机患者流模型的输入，并分析性地刻画了最小化停留时间的最优VPP策略。然后，我们结合结果推导出适合在实践中实施的可解释VPP患者分流协议，并进行了一项前后实验，利用实证分析评估将其整合到实践中的影响。实施的协议使我们的合作医院急诊科停留时间减少了11分钟（4.2%），且对护理质量结果没有任何不利影响。这一效应在统计上显著，并且在控制各种混杂因素和潜在内生性来源后仍然稳健。我们的VPP协议也可用于其他急诊科，无需额外资源即可提供运营改善。本文由Stefan Scholtes（医疗管理）接受。资助：S. Saghafian获得了NSF[资助号CMMI-15 62645]“数据驱动的移植后药物管理”的财务支持，该资助部分促成了这项工作，以及哈佛数据科学倡议和哈佛Mossavar-Rahmani商业与政府中心的资助和支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07517获取。

papers.abstract_original: Using a proprietary data set that documents corporate bond issuances in China, we find that bond regulators’ comment letters (CLs) on issuers’ public disclosures generally target opaque firms and reduce bond issuance success. We also find, however, that connected investors—financial institutions with prior business relationships with the issuers—purchase a relatively larger share of bond issuances from CL recipients than from non-CL recipients, and this greater participation contributes to overpricing. Further analysis shows that connected investors support CL recipients because they possess superior private information and obtain private benefits from their connections.This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting.Funding: R. Zhang acknowledges financial support from the Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Canada [Grant 31-R833984].Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07607.
papers.abstract_zh: 利用一套记录中国公司债券发行的专有数据集，我们发现债券监管机构对发行人公开披露发出的意见函（CLs）通常针对不透明的公司，并降低债券发行的成功率。然而，我们还发现，关联投资者——与发行人存在先前业务关系的金融机构——从意见函接收方购买的债券发行份额相对高于非意见函接收方，而这种更大的参与导致了定价过高。进一步分析表明，关联投资者支持意见函接收方，是因为他们拥有更优越的私人信息，并从其关联关系中获得私人利益。本文由会计学领域的Ranjani Krishnan接受。资助：R. Zhang感谢加拿大社会科学与人文研究理事会[资助号31-R833984]提供的财务支持。补充材料：互联网附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07607获取。

papers.abstract_original: We examine the value of skilled immigrants in finance by exploiting evidence from visa lotteries. We find that hedge fund management companies that secure more H-1B visas in random lotteries deliver higher alphas, Sharpe ratios, and information ratios. The superior performance of funds with high H-1B visa allocations can be attributed to well-paid and highly educated H-1B workers with quantitative skills. H-1B workers add value by helping hedge funds develop distinctive investment strategies, arbitrage prominent stock anomalies, and overcome capacity constraints. Hedge funds appear to exploit labor market frictions as alpha generation is greatest by workers from countries with the longest wait times for U.S. permanent residency.This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07615.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们通过利用签证抽签的证据来考察金融领域技术移民的价值。我们发现，在随机抽签中获得更多H-1B签证的对冲基金管理公司能实现更高的阿尔法、夏普比率和信息比率。拥有高H-1B签证配额的基金的优异表现可归因于薪酬丰厚且受过高等教育、具备定量技能的H-1B员工。H-1B员工通过帮助对冲基金开发独特的投资策略、套利显著的股票异象以及克服容量约束来增加价值。对冲基金似乎利用了劳动力市场摩擦，因为来自美国永久居留等待时间最长国家的员工产生的阿尔法最大。本文由Lukas Schmid，金融学接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07615获取。

papers.abstract_original: I propose a general simulation scheme for multivariate polynomial processes, a class of stochastic processes for which the calculation of moments up to a fixed order requires only the computation of matrix exponentials. The methodology is based on the approximate computation of conditional moments given joint moments and on performing random sampling given such conditional moments. The general methodology can be adapted to the simulation of many stochastic models of practical relevance in financial engineering. It turns out to be very useful because it can be applied to stochastic volatility models (e.g., the Jacobi model) and commodity price models (e.g., the Pilipović model), for which semi-analytical European option pricing formulas or exact simulation schemes are not available, rendering it necessary to use approximations. I compare the proposed simulation schemes against various benchmarks and find that the new methodology improves the runtime/accuracy performances with respect to existing methods.This paper was accepted by Ata Baris, stochastic models and simulation.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07645.
papers.abstract_zh: 我提出了一种针对多元多项式过程的通用模拟方案，这类随机过程在计算至某一固定阶数的矩时仅需计算矩阵指数。该方法基于给定联合矩下条件矩的近似计算，以及在给定此类条件矩下进行随机抽样。该通用方法可适用于金融工程中许多具有实际相关性的随机模型的模拟。事实证明它非常有用，因为它可以应用于随机波动率模型（例如Jacobi模型）和商品价格模型（例如Pilipović模型），对于这些模型，不存在半解析的欧式期权定价公式或精确模拟方案，因而有必要使用近似方法。我将所提出的模拟方案与各种基准进行比较，发现新方法相对于现有方法改进了运行时间/准确性表现。本文由随机模型与模拟领域的Ata Baris接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07645获取。

papers.abstract_original: Studying a large set of macroeconomic announcements (MAs) and disentangling their news content, we show that a portfolio of stocks that pays off around MAs that negatively impact the aggregate stock market commands a positive risk premium. Adding this portfolio to a position in the aggregate market substantially increases Sharpe ratio while reducing MA risk exposure, which implies a rejection of the CAPM. Using state-of-the-art measures of cash flow and discount rate news and consistent with prominent intertemporal CAPM specifications, we argue that the portfolio’s risk premium compensates investors for large reinvestment risk. Thus, we conclude that the MA news that matters most to investors is discount rate news and not cash flows news.This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance.Funding: This paper is based upon work supported by the Dutch Research Council [NWO Vidi Grant 201005], Fundação para a Ciência e a Tecnologia [UID/ECO/00124/2020], and POR Lisboa and POR Norte [Social Sciences DataLab, Project 22209].Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07650.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过研究大量宏观经济公告（MAs）并分离其新闻内容，我们表明，一个在负面冲击总体股票市场的MAs前后获得收益的股票组合具有正的风险溢价。将该组合加入总体市场头寸会大幅提高夏普比率，同时降低MA风险暴露，这意味着拒绝CAPM。使用最先进的现金流和贴现率新闻度量，并与著名的跨期CAPM设定一致，我们认为该组合的风险溢价补偿了投资者面临的巨大再投资风险。因此，我们得出结论，对投资者最重要的MA新闻是贴现率新闻，而不是现金流新闻。本文由金融领域的Lukas Schmid接受。资助：本文基于荷兰研究理事会[NWO Vidi Grant 201005]、Fundação para a Ciência e a Tecnologia [UID/ECO/00124/2020]以及POR Lisboa和POR Norte [Social Sciences DataLab, Project 22209]支持的工作。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07650获取。

papers.abstract_original: Over 85% of all foreign exchange (FX) transactions involve the U.S. dollar, whereas the United States accounts for a much smaller fraction of global economic activity. My paper attributes the dominance of the dollar in FX trading to strategic avoidance of price impact. Using a novel identification strategy, I show that, on average, 13% of the volume in dollar pairs arises from using the dollar as a vehicle currency to indirectly exchange two nondollar currencies. To rationalise this result, I derive three model-based conditions for dollar dominance. I empirically test these conditions and provide evidence consistent with the theoretical framework.This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance.Funding: F. Somogyi acknowledges financial support from the Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF) [Grant 195095].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07656.
papers.abstract_zh: 在所有外汇（FX）交易中，超过85%涉及美元，而美国在全球经济活动中的占比要小得多。我的论文将美元在外汇交易中的主导地位归因于对价格影响的策略性规避。使用一种新颖的识别策略，我表明，平均而言，美元货币对中13%的交易量源于将美元作为载体货币来间接兑换两种非美元货币。为解释这一结果，我推导出美元主导地位的三个基于模型的条件。我对这些条件进行了实证检验，并提供了与理论框架一致的证据。本文由Lukas Schmid（金融学）接受。资助：F. Somogyi感谢瑞士国家科学基金会（SNSF）的财务支持[资助号195095]。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07656获取。
