papers.abstract_original: We analyze the market quality of centralized crypto exchanges and decentralized blockchain-based venues (DEXs) using a unique and comprehensive data set. Focusing on two fundamental aspects, transaction costs and deviations from the no-arbitrage condition, we estimate the causal effect of gas fees on DEX market quality. We show that these fixed costs impose a significant burden on relatively small trades and cause persistent arbitrage deviations. Conversely, DEXs offer more competitive transaction costs for larger trades, offering a more favorable environment for institutional investors. Furthermore, we provide causal evidence that innovations aimed at enhancing the flexibility of liquidity provision in DEX markets lead to sizeable improvements in market quality. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Funding: A. Ranaldo acknowledges financial support from the Swiss National Science Foundation nccr–on the move [Grant 204721]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07703.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们使用一个独特而全面的数据集分析中心化加密货币交易所和基于区块链的去中心化交易场所（DEX）的市场质量。聚焦于交易成本和无套利条件偏离这两个基本方面，我们估计gas费用对DEX市场质量的因果效应。我们表明，这些固定成本对相对较小的交易构成显著负担，并导致持续的套利偏离。相反，DEX对较大交易提供更具竞争力的交易成本，为机构投资者提供了更有利的环境。此外，我们提供因果证据表明，旨在增强DEX市场流动性提供灵活性的创新会带来市场质量的大幅改善。本文由金融学领域的Agostino Capponi接受。资助：A. Ranaldo感谢瑞士国家科学基金会nccr–on the move的财务支持[资助号 204721]。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07703 获取。

papers.abstract_original: The asset-pricing literature emphasizes factor models that minimize pricing errors but overlooks unselected candidate factors that could enhance the performance of test assets. This paper proposes a framework for factor model selection and testing by (i) selecting the optimal model that spans the joint efficient frontier of test assets and all candidate factors and (ii) testing pricing performance on both test assets and unselected candidate factors. Our framework updates a baseline model (e.g., capital asset-pricing model) sequentially by adding or removing factors based on asset-pricing tests. Ensuring model selection consistency, our framework utilizes the asset-pricing duality; minimizing cross-sectionally unexplained pricing errors aligns with maximizing the Sharpe ratio of the selected factor model. Empirical evidence shows that workhorse factor models fail asset-pricing tests, whereas our proposed eight-factor model is not rejected and exhibits robust out-of-sample performance.This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance.Funding: G. Feng acknowledges financial support from the Hong Kong Research Grants Council [Grant GRF11502023] and the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72203190]. G. Feng is partially supported by the InnoHK Initiative of the Innovation and Technology Commission of the Hong Kong SAR and the Laboratory for AI-Powered Financial Technologies. The research of W. Lan was supported by the National Key R&D Program of China [Grant 2022YFA1003702]; the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72422020, 72333001, and 12531011]; and the Joint Lab of Data Science and Business Intelligence at Southwestern University of Finance and Economics. The research of H. Wang was partially supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72495123 and 12271012].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07804.
papers.abstract_zh: 资产定价文献强调最小化定价误差的因子模型，但忽视了可能增强测试资产表现的未选候选因子。本文提出了一个因子模型选择与检验框架，通过（i）选择跨越测试资产和所有候选因子的联合有效前沿的最优模型，以及（ii）在测试资产和未选候选因子上检验定价表现。我们的框架基于资产定价检验，通过添加或移除因子来顺序更新基线模型（例如资本资产定价模型）。确保模型选择一致性，我们的框架利用资产定价对偶性；最小化横截面未解释定价误差与最大化所选因子模型的夏普比率相一致。实证证据表明，主力因子模型未能通过资产定价检验，而我们提出的八因子模型未被拒绝，并表现出稳健的样本外表现。本文由金融学领域的Lukas Schmid接受。资助：G. papers.abstract_original: Motivated by our collaboration with a major refugee resettlement agency in the United States, we study a dynamic matching problem where each new arrival (a refugee case) must be matched immediately and irrevocably to one of the static resources (a location with a fixed annual quota). In addition to consuming the static resource, each case requires postallocation service from a server, such as a translator. Given the time-consuming nature of service, a server may not be available at a given time, thus we refer to it as a dynamic resource. Upon matching, the case will wait to avail service in a first-come-first-serve manner. Bursty matching to a location may result in undesirable congestion at its corresponding server. Consequently, the central planner (the agency) faces a dynamic matching problem with an objective that combines the matching reward (captured by pair-specific employment outcomes) with the cost for congestion for dynamic resources and overallocation for the static ones. Motivated by the observed fluctuations in the composition of refugee pools across the years, we design algorithms that do not rely on distributional knowledge constructed based on past years’ data. To that end, we develop learning-based algorithms that are asymptotically optimal in certain regimes, easy to interpret, and computationally fast. Our design is based on learning the dual variables of the underlying optimization problem; however, the main challenge lies in the time-varying nature of the dual variables associated with dynamic resources. To overcome this challenge, our theoretical development brings together techniques from Lyapunov analysis, adversarial online learning, and stochastic optimization. On the application side, when tested on real data from our partner agency and incorporating practical considerations, our method outperforms existing ones, making it a viable candidate for replacing the current practice upon experimentation.This paper was accepted by Martin Bichler, market design, platform, and demand analytics.Funding: This work was supported by the Stanford Impact Lab [Stage 2 Grant], Google.org [AI for Social Good Grant TF2111-103726], the Charles Koch Foundation, and the Stanford Institute for Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence [Hoffman-Yee Research Grant].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07817.
papers.abstract_zh: 受我们与美国一家主要难民安置机构合作的启发，我们研究了一个动态匹配问题，其中每个新到达者（一个难民案件）必须立即且不可撤销地匹配到某个静态资源（一个具有固定年度配额的地点）。除了消耗静态资源外，每个案件还需要来自服务器（如翻译员）的分配后服务。鉴于服务耗时较长，服务器在给定时间可能不可用，因此我们将其称为动态资源。匹配后，案件将按先到先得的方式等待获得服务。对某个地点的突发性匹配可能导致其对应服务器出现不良拥堵。因此，中央规划者（该机构）面临一个动态匹配问题，其目标结合了匹配奖励（由配对特定的就业结果所体现）与动态资源的拥堵成本和静态资源的过度分配成本。受多年来观察到的难民池构成波动的启发，我们设计了不依赖于基于过去年份数据构建的分布知识的算法。为此，我们开发了基于学习的算法，这些算法在某些情形下渐近最优、易于解释且计算快速。我们的设计基于学习底层优化问题的对偶变量；然而，主要挑战在于与动态资源相关的对偶变量的时变性质。为克服这一挑战，我们的理论发展汇集了李雅普诺夫分析、对抗性在线学习和随机优化的技术。在应用方面，当在我们合作机构的真实数据上进行测试并纳入实际考虑时，我们的方法优于现有方法，使其成为在实验后替代当前做法的可行候选方案。本文由市场设计、平台与需求分析领域的Martin Bichler接受。资助：本工作得到斯坦福影响实验室[第二阶段2资助]、Google.org[人工智能公益资助TF2111-103726]、查尔斯·科赫基金会以及斯坦福以人为本人工智能研究院[霍夫曼-叶研究资助]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07817获取。

papers.abstract_original: We study how acquisitions by a dominant incumbent affect entry and R&D incentives in markets with multiple startups. We show that acquisitions can create a kill zone, which suppresses entry and distorts the innovation direction of nontargeted startups. The resulting reduced threat of entry may lead the incumbent to shelve the acquired technology. The kill zone effect strengthens targeted startups’ incentives to enter primarily to be bought out and makes acquisitions more attractive to the incumbent than in-house R&D. To balance kill zone distortions to innovation against the potential synergies from acquisitions, a consumer welfare–maximizing merger policy may involve blocking some, but not all, acquisitions.This paper was accepted by Anita McGahan, strategy.Funding: C. Wang thanks the Australian Research Council Discovery Project [Grant DP210102015] for the generous financial support. C. Teh thanks the European Research Council (ERC) [Grant 101088307] for the generous financial support.Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07841.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究主导在位者的收购如何影响拥有多家初创企业的市场中的进入和研发激励。我们表明，收购可能创造杀伤区，抑制进入并扭曲非目标初创企业的创新方向。由此导致的进入威胁降低可能使在位者搁置所收购的技术。杀伤区效应增强了目标初创企业主要为了被收购而进入的激励，并使收购对在位者比内部研发更具吸引力。为了在杀伤区对创新的扭曲与收购的潜在协同效应之间取得平衡，消费者福利最大化的合并政策可能涉及阻止部分但非全部收购。本文由Anita McGahan（战略领域）接受。资助：C. Wang感谢澳大利亚研究理事会发现项目[资助号DP210102015]的慷慨财务支持。C. Teh感谢欧洲研究理事会（ERC）[资助号101088307]的慷慨财务支持。补充材料：在线附录可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07841获取。

papers.abstract_original: We study the impact of alternative data on credit access and borrower outcomes using anonymized data from a major U.S. financial technology (fintech) platform that incorporates education, employment, and other nontraditional variables into its underwriting algorithm. The platform approves 15%–30% of low-credit-score applicants rejected by traditional models and offers them lower rates. It particularly benefits “invisible primes”—borrowers with thin credit files and low credit scores but low default risk. We show that gains for invisible primes are primarily driven by alternative data, while model sophistication yields additional improvements in segments where traditional credit report information is more extensive. Using exogenous variation, we find that expanded credit access improves borrowers’ subsequent financial outcomes.This paper has been accepted by Kay Giesecke for the Virtual Special Issue on Digital Finance.Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07854.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们利用一家美国主要金融科技（fintech）平台的匿名数据，研究替代数据对信贷获取和借款人结果的影响，该平台将教育、就业和其他非传统变量纳入其承销算法。该平台批准了15%–30%被传统模型拒绝的低信用评分申请人，并为他们提供更低的利率。它尤其惠及“隐形优质客户”——信用档案薄弱、信用评分低但违约风险低的借款人。我们表明，隐形优质客户的收益主要由替代数据驱动，而模型精细化在传统信用报告信息更广泛的部分则带来额外改进。利用外生变异，我们发现信贷获取的扩大改善了借款人随后的财务结果。本文已被Kay Giesecke接受，用于数字金融虚拟特刊。补充材料：互联网附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07854获取。

papers.abstract_original: Pay inequality can arise from unequal earnings for the same job or an unequal workload for the same earnings. Although existing research focuses on aversion to unequal earnings, little is known about aversion to unequal workloads, particularly gender differences. We show that female workers are more willing to accept unequal workload than unequal earnings allocations. By contrast, male workers exhibit similar responses to the workload and earnings inequality. The findings highlight that women’s lower aversion to unequal workloads can contribute to the gender earnings gap. Promoting equal workload allocation can be crucial in addressing the gender gap in the labor market.This paper was accepted by Marie Claire Villeval, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Funding: This research was supported by research grants from Bryant University and the Department of Economics at Monash University.Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07896.
papers.abstract_zh: 收入不平等可能源于同一工作获得不平等收入，或同一收入承担不平等工作量。尽管现有研究聚焦于对不平等收入的厌恶，但对不平等工作量的厌恶，尤其是性别差异，却知之甚少。我们表明，女性工作者比接受不平等收入分配更愿意接受不平等工作量。相比之下，男性工作者对工作量不平等和收入不平等的反应相似。这些发现凸显，女性对不平等工作量的较低厌恶可能助长性别收入差距。促进工作量平等分配对于解决劳动力市场中的性别差距可能至关重要。本文由Marie Claire Villeval（行为经济学与决策分析）接受。资助：本研究得到布莱恩特大学和莫纳什大学经济系的研究资助。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07896获取。

papers.abstract_original: We document that interactions with manipulated clinical decision support (CDS) systems can induce not only short-term, but also long-term changes in physicians’ opioid prescribing behavior. Physicians in our sample adopted electronic health record software from a list of federally certified vendors in 2011. Between 2016 and Spring 2019, one vendor secretly embedded a biased CDS function designed to promote extended-release opioid sales. Affected physicians not only increased opioid claims relative to the control group during the treatment window, but also maintained a higher propensity to prescribe opioids, even after the biased function was removed. This long-term behavioral change persisted even after affected physicians moved to new locations, changed their affiliations, or faced stricter state-level opioid regulations. Increasing physician awareness helped mitigate this impact. Using machine-learning algorithms, we estimate that decision-making distortion accounts for approximately 54% of the treatment effects in a physician decision model with dynamic learning.This paper was accepted by Hemant Bhargava, information systems.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07930.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们记录到，与被操纵的临床决策支持（CDS）系统的交互不仅会引发医生阿片类药物处方行为的短期变化，还会引发长期变化。我们样本中的医生于2011年从联邦认证供应商名单中采用了电子健康记录软件。在2016年至2019年春季期间，一家供应商秘密嵌入了一个有偏的CDS功能，旨在促进缓释阿片类药物的销售。受影响的医生不仅在处理窗口期内相对于对照组增加了阿片类药物索赔，而且在有偏功能被移除后，仍保持了更高的阿片类药物处方倾向。即使在受影响医生搬迁到新地点、更换所属机构或面临更严格的州级阿片类药物监管之后，这种长期行为变化仍然持续存在。提高医生意识有助于减轻这一影响。使用机器学习算法，我们估计，在一个具有动态学习的医生决策模型中，决策扭曲约占处理效应的54%。本文由信息系统领域的Hemant Bhargava接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07930 获取。

papers.abstract_original: This paper documents post-earnings announcement drift (PEAD) in corporate bond prices using transaction data. We find a counterintuitive relationship between the drift and trading volume: PEAD is more pronounced for more heavily traded bonds than for less frequently traded bonds. Across markets, PEAD is observed for credit default swaps but not for stocks. We explain these findings using a unified model that incorporates both debt and equity trading, where investors possess private information about the underlying firm’s cash flows and may hold differing opinions. Our empirical evidence supports the model’s prediction that payoff structures and investor disagreement account for the distinct price dynamics across asset classes.This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance.Funding: The authors acknowledge research support from the Center for Investing at HKUST. Y. Xiong thanks the support by National Natural Science Foundation of China [NSFC 72422007] and the Research Grants Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China [Project 16501523].Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07966.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文利用交易数据记录了公司债券价格中的盈余公告后漂移（PEAD）。我们发现漂移与交易量之间存在一个反直觉的关系：PEAD在交易更活跃的债券中比在交易较不频繁的债券中更为显著。跨市场来看，PEAD在信用违约互换中被观察到，但在股票中未被观察到。我们用一个统一模型来解释这些发现，该模型同时纳入债务和股权交易，其中投资者拥有关于标的公司现金流的私人信息，并可能持有不同意见。我们的经验证据支持该模型的预测，即收益结构和投资者分歧解释了不同资产类别之间截然不同的价格动态。本文由Lukas Schmid（金融学）接受。资助：作者感谢香港科技大学投资中心的研究支持。Y. papers.abstract_original: This paper investigates the optimal design of information disclosure at debt rollover to maximize an entrepreneur’s ex ante borrowing capacity and social welfare. We develop a model where an entrepreneur secures a startup loan for project experimentation and must refinance for production. Borrowing capacity is limited by the pledgeability of project cash flows, which is eroded by three interacting forces: the entrepreneur’s moral hazard, premature liquidation risk following a liquidity shock, and rent dissipation arising from creditor competition. We show that a coarse “pass-or-fail” signal structure maximizes borrowing capacity. This binary structure is informative to balance incentive provision against liquidation risk, yet sufficiently coarse to mitigate rent dissipation. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the welfare-maximizing signal structure remains a pass-or-fail form, with an optimal threshold that tightens as the entrepreneur’s borrowing need increases.This paper was accepted by Lin William Cong, finance.Funding: H. Xu acknowledges support from the National Social Science Fund of China [Project Code: 23BJY251].Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07999.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文研究了债务展期时信息披露的最优设计，以最大化企业家的事前借款能力和社会福利。我们构建了一个模型，其中企业家获得创业贷款用于项目试验，并且必须为生产进行再融资。借款能力受到项目现金流可抵押性的限制，而这一可抵押性受到三种相互作用的力量的侵蚀：企业家的道德风险、流动性冲击后过早清算的风险，以及债权人竞争所导致的租金耗散。我们表明，一种粗略的“通过或失败”信号结构能够最大化借款能力。这种二元结构在信息上足以平衡激励提供与清算风险，同时又足够粗略以缓解租金耗散。此外，我们证明，福利最大化的信号结构仍然是一种通过或失败形式，其最优阈值随着企业家借款需求的增加而收紧。本文由金融领域的Lin William Cong接受。资助：H. Xu感谢国家社会科学基金中国[项目编号：23BJY251]的支持。补充材料：在线附录可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07999获取。

papers.abstract_original: This study examines the impact of consumers’ personal data management on firm competition in the data collection and application markets, as well as on welfare outcomes. Consumers purchase products from differentiated firms in these two markets. Initially, in the data collection market, firms compete to collect consumer data to predict preferences in the data application market, enabling them to offer personalized prices to their targeted customers. Before firms set prices in the data application market, targeted consumers can erase their data at a fixed cost, thereby becoming untargeted. We show that personal data management leads to higher prices, lower firm profits, negative externalities among consumers, and reduced consumer surplus in the data application market. In the data collection market, personal data management intensifies competition and improves consumer surplus. Our analysis further explores extended scenarios of personal data management—including the rights to opt out of data collection, data portability, and data ownership—and reveals that firms’ two-market profits and total consumer surplus change nonmonotonically with consumers’ data rights. Specifically, granting consumers data rights beyond simple data erasure can reverse the effects of erasure alone, benefiting firms while harming consumers. Moreover, data management influences cross-market competition quite differently depending on which market consumers exercise their data rights. Finally, we discuss proactive strategies firms can employ to maintain profitability under personal data laws.This paper was accepted by Dmitri Kuksov, marketing.Funding: J. Cong acknowledges the financial support from National Natural Science Foundation of China (Projects 72473024, 72192845) and support from the Shenzhen Research Institute, City University of Hong Kong. The authors gratefully acknowledge the financial support from the Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS), KAKENHI [Grants JP19H01483, JP20H05631, JP21H00702, JP21K01452, JP21K18430, JP23K20593, and JP23K25515], Nomura Foundation, the International Joint Research Promotion Program at University of Osaka, and the program of the Joint Usage/Research Center for “Behavioral Economics” at ISER, University of Osaka.Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08024.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究考察消费者个人数据管理对数据收集市场与数据应用市场中企业竞争以及福利结果的影响。消费者在这两个市场中从差异化企业购买产品。起初，在数据收集市场中，企业竞争收集消费者数据，以预测数据应用市场中的偏好，从而能够向目标客户提供个性化价格。在企业于数据应用市场设定价格之前，目标消费者可以以固定成本擦除其数据，从而成为非目标消费者。我们表明，个人数据管理导致更高的价格、更低的企业利润、消费者之间的负外部性，以及数据应用市场中消费者剩余的减少。在数据收集市场中，个人数据管理加剧竞争并提高消费者剩余。我们的分析进一步探讨了个人数据管理的扩展情景——包括选择退出数据收集的权利、数据可携带性和数据所有权——并揭示企业的两市场利润和总消费者剩余随消费者数据权利非单调变化。具体而言，赋予消费者超出简单数据擦除的数据权利可能逆转仅擦除的效果，使企业受益而损害消费者。此外，数据管理对跨市场竞争的影响因消费者在哪个市场行使其数据权利而大不相同。最后，我们讨论了企业可以采取的主动策略，以在个人数据法律下维持盈利能力。本文由市场营销领域的Dmitri Kuksov接受。资助：J. Cong感谢国家自然科学基金（项目72473024、72192845）的财政支持，以及香港城市大学深圳研究院的支持。作者们感谢日本学术振兴会（JSPS）的财政支持，KAKENHI [资助号JP19H01483、JP20H05631、JP21H00702、JP21K01452、JP21K18430、JP23K20593和JP23K25515]，野村基金会，大阪大学国际联合研究促进计划，以及大阪大学ISER“行为经济学”联合使用/研究中心项目。补充材料：在线附录可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08024获取。
papers.title_original: The Effects of Personal Data Management on Competition and Welfare

papers.abstract_original: To better understand how prosocial behavior can be effectively encouraged, we study four unresolved issues: whether small rewards also motivate prosocial behavior, how short-term effects differ from longer-run behavioral adjustments, whether incentives induce substitution away from other prosocial activities, and whether reminders about existing rewards meaningfully influence behavior. We examine these issues in a long-run randomized field experiment across 12 donation centers of the Belgian Red Cross-Flanders. Donors normally receive one thank-you-coupon (worth €1.5) for a blood donation and two coupons for a plasma donation. Informing donors about the existing rewards increases plasma donations by 4.6% during the nine-month information period, although this effect fades with repeated reminders. Rewarding plasma donors with an extra coupon raises plasma donations by an additional 7.1% during the six-month reward period; this effect grows during the reward period but disappears immediately afterward. We also document a substitution effect; the plasma reward reduces blood donations by 3.3%. Survey evidence suggests that small rewards act as signals of increased need or as gifts eliciting reciprocity and that our findings may extend to volunteering decisions more broadly.This paper was accepted by Marie Claire Villeval, Behavioral Economics and Decision Analysis.Funding: This paper is based on research funded by the Belgian Red Cross-Flanders; the content reflects solely the views of the authors and not those of the Red Cross.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08081.
papers.abstract_zh: 为了更好地理解如何有效鼓励亲社会行为，我们研究了四个尚未解决的问题：小额奖励是否也能激励亲社会行为，短期效应与较长期的行为调整有何不同，激励是否会导致人们转向其他亲社会活动，以及关于现有奖励的提醒是否会显著影响行为。我们在比利时佛兰德红十字会的12个捐献中心开展了一项长期随机实地实验，以考察这些问题。捐献者通常因献血获得一张感谢券（价值1.5欧元），因捐献血浆获得两张感谢券。告知捐献者现有奖励后，在为期九个月的信息期内，血浆捐献增加了4.6%，尽管这一效应随着反复提醒而减弱。向血浆捐献者额外奖励一张感谢券后，在为期六个月的奖励期内，血浆捐献又增加了7.1%；这一效应在奖励期内逐渐增强，但在奖励期结束后立即消失。我们还记录到一种替代效应：血浆奖励使献血减少了3.3%。调查证据表明，小额奖励起到信号作用，表明需求增加，或作为引发互惠的礼物，并且我们的发现可能更广泛地适用于志愿服务决策。本文由Marie Claire Villeval、Behavioral Economics and Decision Analysis接受。资助：本文基于比利时佛兰德红十字会资助的研究；内容仅反映作者的观点，而非红十字会的观点。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08081获取。

papers.abstract_original: People sometimes enjoy the thrill of the hunt, which implies search can generate joy in addition to costs. Some customers say they enjoy searching for unique items such as vintage T-shirts and luxury handbags, and managers at warehouse stores, thrift stores, and many online selling platforms say they design their store format to offer a treasure hunt experience. We develop a model in which customers enjoy searching for a treasure. Our model’s search utility function includes a term based on the treasure’s net value, a term based on the instantaneous likelihood of discovering treasure, and a constant term reflecting other factors such as social aspects of shopping and customers’ enthusiasm level for the product category. We derive the optimal product price and treasure hunt difficulty level. In equilibrium, for products with either very low or very high value, customers’ utility from visiting the store comes primarily from the thrill of the hunt.This paper was accepted by Raphael Thomadsen, marketing.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08105.
papers.abstract_zh: 人们有时享受搜寻的刺激，这意味着搜寻除了带来成本之外还能产生愉悦。一些顾客表示他们享受搜寻独特物品的过程，例如复古T恤和奢侈手袋，而仓储式商店、二手商店以及许多在线销售平台的管理者表示，他们设计店铺形式就是为了提供寻宝体验。我们建立了一个顾客享受搜寻宝藏的模型。我们模型的搜寻效用函数包括一个基于宝藏净价值的项、一个基于瞬时发现宝藏可能性的项，以及一个反映购物社交层面和顾客对产品类别热情程度等其他因素的常数项。我们推导出最优产品价格和寻宝难度水平。在均衡中，对于价值极低或极高的产品，顾客到店购物的效用主要来自寻宝的刺激。本文由市场营销学领域的Raphael Thomadsen接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08105获取。

papers.abstract_original: We use a unique data set of individual housing transaction histories from Norway and a novel shift-share design to show that temporary changes in the transaction sequencing decisions of moving homeowners—whether to buy first and then sell or vice versa—cause temporary local increases in house prices and seller liquidity. Our findings are consistent with a simple theory of how transaction sequencing decisions impact house prices in a frictional housing market. We also provide the first causal estimate of the elasticity of house prices to market tightness, which is around 0.1. Overall, our findings highlight the importance of trading frictions and supply-demand imbalances for housing market dynamics.This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance.Funding: This work was supported by Norges Forskningsråd [Grant 274678: Frictions in the Housing Market].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08149.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们利用来自挪威的独特个人住房交易历史数据集和一种新颖的移动份额设计，表明搬迁房主交易顺序决策的暂时变化——是先买后卖还是相反——会导致房价和卖方流动性的暂时局部上升。我们的发现与一个关于交易顺序决策如何在有摩擦的住房市场中影响房价的简单理论相一致。我们还首次提供了房价对市场紧俏度的弹性的因果估计，该弹性约为0.1。总体而言，我们的发现凸显了交易摩擦和供需失衡对住房市场动态的重要性。本文由金融学领域的Bo Becker接受。资助：本工作得到了挪威研究理事会[资助号274678：住房市场中的摩擦]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08149获取。

papers.abstract_original: S&P 500 is commonly used in empirical finance and macroeconomics as a measure of overall capital market sentiment, and the associated VIX is taken as an indicator of economic uncertainty. While both assume that the S&P 500 index is objectively constructed, we show that its membership decisions have a nontrivial amount of discretion unexplained by its published methodology. Importantly, we show that firms’ purchases of S&P ratings appear to improve their chance of entering the index (but purchases of Moody’s ratings do not). Furthermore, openings in index membership tend to motivate firms to purchase more S&P ratings. This is also confirmed by an event study of a 2002 membership rule change. These patterns raise concerns over potential governance issues.This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance.Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08157.
papers.abstract_zh: 标普500在实证金融学和宏观经济学中常被用作衡量整体资本市场情绪的指标，与之相关的VIX被视为经济不确定性的指标。尽管两者都假定标普500指数是客观构建的，但我们表明其纳入决策含有相当程度的、无法由其公布的方法论解释的自由裁量权。重要的是，我们表明公司购买标普评级似乎提高了其进入该指数的机会（但购买穆迪评级则不会）。此外，指数纳入名额的空缺往往会促使公司购买更多标普评级。这一点也得到了一项关于2002年纳入规则变更的事件研究的证实。这些模式引发了对潜在治理问题的担忧。本文由Will Cong（金融）接受。补充材料：互联网附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08157获取。

papers.abstract_original: Complexity can create value. At the same time, understanding more complex goods requires more of an agent’s attention. We show that equilibrium complexity is generally inefficient when agents face competing demands on their limited attention. Because attention allocation is hump-shaped in complexity, equilibrium complexity is distorted toward intermediate levels: well-understood goods are inefficiently complex, whereas less well-understood goods are oversimplified. We apply our model to financial institutions facing regulatory bodies and CEOs interacting with corporate divisions. This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance. Funding: This project has received funding from the European Research Council (ERC) under the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation program [Grant 715467].
papers.abstract_zh: 复杂性可以创造价值。与此同时，理解更复杂的商品需要代理人投入更多的注意力。我们表明，当代理人有限的注意力面临相互竞争的需求时，均衡复杂性通常是无效率的。由于注意力配置随复杂性呈驼峰形，均衡复杂性被扭曲至中间水平：被充分理解的商品复杂得无效率，而理解不足的商品则被过度简化。我们将模型应用于面临监管机构的金融机构以及与公司部门互动的首席执行官。本文由金融领域的Will Cong接受。资助：本项目已获得欧盟“地平线2020”研究与创新计划下欧洲研究理事会（ERC）的资助[资助编号715467]。

papers.abstract_original: Randomized experiments have become the standard method for companies to evaluate the performance of new products or services. Beyond aiding managerial decision making, experiments mitigate risk by limiting the proportion of customers exposed to innovations. Because many experiments are conducted sequentially over time, an emerging strategy to further derisk the process is to allow managers to “peek” at the results as new data become available and stop the test if the results are statistically significant. The class of statistical methods that allow managers to peek and still provide valid inference are often called anytime valid because they maintain proper uniform type 1 error guarantees. In this paper, we extend existing anytime-valid approaches to accommodate the more complex yet standard settings in time series, switchback, and panel experiments. To achieve this, we leverage the design-based approach to focus on assumption-light and managerially relevant finite-sample estimands defined on the study participants as a direct measure of the risks incurred by companies. As a special case, our (asymptotic) results also provide a robust method for achieving always-valid inference in A/B tests. We further provide a variance reduction technique incorporating modeling assumptions and covariates. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed approach through a simulation study and three real-world applications from Netflix. Our results show that using our confidence sequence, harmful experiments could be stopped after observing only a handful of units; for instance, our method would have stopped a 30,000-person Netflix experiment after the first 100 people.This paper was accepted by J. George Shanthikumar, data science.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08235.
papers.abstract_zh: 随机实验已成为公司评估新产品或服务绩效的标准方法。除了帮助管理者决策外，实验还通过限制暴露于创新的客户比例来缓解风险。由于许多实验是随时间顺序进行的，一种新兴的进一步降低风险策略是允许管理者在新数据可用时“窥视”结果，并在结果具有统计显著性时停止测试。允许管理者窥视且仍能提供有效推断的这类统计方法通常被称为任意时间有效，因为它们保持了适当的统一类型1错误保证。在本文中，我们将现有的任意时间有效方法扩展到时间序列、切换回和面板实验中更复杂但标准的设置。为实现这一点，我们利用基于设计的方法，聚焦于定义在研究参与者上的、假设较少且与管理相关的有限样本估计量，作为公司所承担风险的直接度量。作为一个特例，我们的（渐近）结果还提供了一种在A/B测试中实现始终有效推断的稳健方法。我们进一步提供了一种纳入建模假设和协变量的方差减少技术。最后，我们通过一项模拟研究和来自Netflix的三个真实世界应用展示了我们提出方法的有效性。我们的结果表明，使用我们的置信序列，有害实验可以在仅观察到少数单位后就被停止；例如，我们的方法会在一个30,000人的Netflix实验中，在前100人之后将其停止。本文由数据科学领域的J. George Shanthikumar接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08235 获取。
papers.title_original: Design-Based Confidence Sequences: A General Approach to Risk Mitigation in Panel Experiments
papers.title_zh: 基于设计的置信序列：面板实验中风险缓解的一般方法

papers.abstract_original: Short-form video platforms have become central to debates about digital overuse and sleep disruption, yet causal evidence on their behavioral impacts remains limited. We study the effects of adopting short-form video in the context of TikTok, which pioneered the format and accounts for a large share of global short-form video consumption. Using granular smartphone touchstream data from a large opt-in panel of U.S. Android users, we track app usage, screen time, and inferred sleep behavior before and after TikTok adoption. We employ a difference-in-differences framework leveraging a high-frequency app usage data set from nearly 7,000 TikTok adopters. Our findings reveal a significant increase in overall screen time—averaging 221 minutes per week for heavy TikTok users—following TikTok adoption, alongside notable declines in usage of other social media and gaming apps, suggesting a strong substitution effect. The screen time effects are highest during late night hours. We also observe shifts in sleep patterns, including delayed bedtimes and a moderate reduction in sleep duration, among high-intensity users. We observe no effects for low-intensity users, who engage minimally with TikTok postadoption. Our findings show that short-form video adoption expands total digital attention rather than merely reallocating it, with important implications for platform design, regulation, and digital well-being. As a side result, our analysis provides clear evidence of substitutability between TikTok and traditional social media platforms, which has important implications for competition policy.This paper was accepted by D. J. Wu, information systems.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08260.
papers.abstract_zh: 短视频平台已成为关于数字过度使用和睡眠中断争论的核心，然而关于其行为影响的因果证据仍然有限。我们在TikTok的背景下研究采用短视频的影响，TikTok开创了这种格式并占全球短视频消费的很大份额。使用来自美国Android用户大型自愿参与面板的细粒度智能手机触摸流数据，我们追踪TikTok采用前后的应用使用、屏幕时间和推断的睡眠行为。我们采用双重差分框架，利用来自近7,000名TikTok采用者的高频应用使用数据集。我们的发现揭示了在采用TikTok后总体屏幕时间显著增加——对于重度TikTok用户平均每周221分钟——同时其他社交媒体和游戏应用的使用显著下降，表明存在强烈的替代效应。屏幕时间效应在深夜时段最高。我们还观察到睡眠模式的转变，包括就寝时间延迟和睡眠时长适度减少，在高强度用户中。我们未观察到低强度用户的效应，他们在采用后对TikTok的参与极少。我们的发现表明，采用短视频扩大了总的数字注意力，而不仅仅是重新分配它，这对平台设计、监管和数字福祉具有重要含义。作为一个附带结果，我们的分析提供了TikTok与传统社交媒体平台之间可替代性的明确证据，这对竞争政策具有重要含义。本文由D. J. Wu，信息系统领域接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08260获取。
papers.title_original: Impact of Short-Form Videos on Screentime and Sleep: Evidence from TikTok
papers.title_zh: 短视频对屏幕时间和睡眠的影响：来自TikTok的证据

papers.abstract_original: This paper uses a large data set of single family home mortgage applications to study the relationship between borrower age and application outcomes. Conditional on a rich set of observable characteristics, age is positively correlated with rejection probability and coupon rate. The results hold for young borrowers, implying that age, not just old age, is an important determinant of mortgage application outcomes. Empirical tests that exploit COVID-19 suggest that the rejection probability results are partly driven by age-related mortality risk. Survey data suggests that the pricing results are partly driven by insufficient shopping.This paper was accepted by Tomasz Piskorski, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08264.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文使用一个大型的单户住宅抵押贷款申请数据集，研究借款人年龄与申请结果之间的关系。在控制一组丰富的可观测特征后，年龄与拒绝概率和票面利率正相关。这些结果对年轻借款人也成立，意味着年龄——而不仅仅是老年——是抵押贷款申请结果的重要决定因素。利用COVID-19进行的实证检验表明，拒绝概率结果部分由与年龄相关的死亡风险驱动。调查数据表明，定价结果部分由比价不足驱动。本文由金融学Tomasz Piskorski接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08264 获取。
papers.title_original: The Age Gap in Mortgage Access
papers.title_zh: 抵押贷款获取中的年龄差距

papers.abstract_original: We study the impact of a financial education program on portfolio choices in a setting that allows us to examine both participation decisions and differences in program benefits across individuals. We directly elicit willingness to pay for financial education and show that individuals with higher financial literacy, greater confidence in applying new knowledge, and higher expected returns are willing to pay more. Using incentivized portfolio allocation tasks, we develop outcome measures tailored to individual risk preferences and show that financial education improves decision quality along these dimensions. The program increases the share of participants who experience an improvement by 20 percentage points, corresponding to average gains of 3.2 percentage points of initial wealth. Individuals with the highest willingness to participate benefit disproportionately from the program, with important implications for the design and evaluation of financial education initiatives. By isolating a specific investment skill in a setting with voluntary participation, our design sheds light on how selection into financial education shapes measured program effects and informs the assessment of broader workplace and public training programs.This paper was accepted by Marie Claire Villeval, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Funding: The authors thank the Pension Research Council of Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania, as well as the Retirement and Savings Institute at HEC Montréal, for generous research funding.Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08268.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们在一个能够同时考察参与决策和项目收益在个体间差异的情境中，研究一项金融教育项目对投资组合选择的影响。我们直接引出对金融教育的支付意愿，并表明，金融素养更高、对运用新知识更有信心以及预期回报更高的个体愿意支付更多。利用激励性投资组合配置任务，我们构建了针对个体风险偏好的结果指标，并表明金融教育在这些维度上改善了决策质量。该项目使经历改善的参与者比例提高了20个百分点，相当于初始财富平均增加3.2个百分点。参与意愿最高的个体从项目中获益不成比例地更大，这对金融教育举措的设计和评估具有重要含义。通过在自愿参与的情境中分离出一项具体的投资技能，我们的设计揭示了金融教育的选择进入如何塑造所测得的项目效应，并为评估更广泛的工作场所和公共培训项目提供了启示。本文由行为经济学与决策分析领域的Marie Claire Villeval接受。资助：作者感谢宾夕法尼亚大学沃顿商学院养老金研究委员会以及蒙特利尔高等商学院退休与储蓄研究所的慷慨研究资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08268 获取。

papers.abstract_original: Many performance-enhancing workplace practices require collaboration between managers and workers for successful adoption. However, managers and workers often have diverging incentives and misunderstandings regarding what needs to be done, impeding collaboration. We conduct a field experiment involving 12,761 small- and medium-sized firms, encouraging collaboration between owners/managers and workers on workplace safety. We find that the treatment increases safety training and reduces the rate and severity of accidents. Further, firms achieve these safety improvements without an increase in the number of workers. We explore heterogeneous treatment effects and find the following: At the managerial level, managers informed about safety yield stronger results; at the firm level, pre-existing intermediate levels of safety practices, low supervisory span of control, and low worker turnover enhance the effectiveness of the collaboration treatment; and at the environmental level, low market competition strengthens the treatment’s impact. Overall, we provide evidence on the importance of manager-worker collaboration and its contingencies for practice adoption and performance.This paper was accepted by Maria Guadalupe, business strategy.Funding: This work was supported by the Agencia Nacional de Investigacion y Desarrollo [Grant NC2024-021, M-NEW].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08287.
papers.abstract_zh: 许多旨在提升绩效的工作场所实践需要管理者与工人之间的协作才能成功采纳。然而，管理者与工人往往在需要做什么方面存在激励分歧和误解，从而阻碍协作。我们开展了一项涉及12,761家中小企业的实地实验，鼓励所有者/管理者与工人在工作场所安全方面开展协作。我们发现，该处理增加了安全培训，并降低了事故的发生率和严重程度。此外，企业在不增加工人数量的情况下实现了这些安全改善。我们探讨了异质性处理效应，发现如下：在管理者层面，被告知安全信息的管理者产生了更强的效果；在企业层面，既有的中等水平安全实践、较低的监督控制幅度以及较低的工人流动率增强了协作处理的有效性；在环境层面，较低的市场竞争强度增强了处理的影响。总体而言，我们提供了关于管理者—工人协作的重要性及其对实践采纳和绩效的权变条件的证据。本文由Maria Guadalupe（商业战略）接受。资助：本研究得到Agencia Nacional de Investigacion y Desarrollo的资助[Grant NC2024-021, M-NEW]。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08287获取。
papers.title_original: Collaboration, Workplace Practice Adoption, and Performance: Evidence from a Field Experiment
papers.title_zh: 协作、工作场所实践采纳与绩效：来自一项实地实验的证据

papers.abstract_original: We exploit a quasi-natural experiment, the change in Sustainalytics’ environmental, social, and governance (ESG) rating methodology, which reassesses risk and inverts the rating scale, to examine how reliance on ESG ratings impacts stock returns. The change in the ESG rating influences stocks’ returns, but this is due to retail investors’ misinterpretation about the change in the ratings scale. Sophisticated investors, such as 13F institutions and short sellers, take advantage of individual investors’ blind trust in ratings by taking the opposite side of their trades. Our results highlight the potential for blind reliance on ESG ratings that can generate mispricing and inefficiencies, especially among less informed market participants.This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance.Funding: This work was supported by Growing Resilient, INclusive and Sustainable (GRINS) [GRINS PE00000018 - CUP H73C22000930001]; European Commission as part of ESG UPTAKE project [101145727]; and Progetti di ricerca di Rilevante Interesse Nazionale (PRIN) as part of the National Recovery and Resilience Plan (PNRR) [CUP H53D23002190006 and CUP H53D23008390001]. L. Pelizzon thanks the Leibniz Institute for Financial Research SAFE and the European Investment Bank Institute for EIBURS Project “ESG-Credit.eu-ESG Factors and Climate Change for Credit Analysis and Rating” for financially sponsoring this research.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08288.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们利用一项准自然实验——Sustainalytics环境、社会和治理（ESG）评级方法的变化，该变化重新评估风险并反转评级量表——来考察对ESG评级的依赖如何影响股票收益。ESG评级的变化影响股票收益，但这是由于散户投资者对评级量表变化的误解所致。成熟投资者，例如13F机构和卖空者，利用个人投资者对评级的盲目信任，采取与其交易相反的头寸。我们的结果凸显了对ESG评级盲目依赖的可能性，这可能产生错误定价和低效率，尤其是在信息较少的市场参与者中。本文由金融领域的Camelia Kuhnen接受。资助：本工作得到Growing Resilient, INclusive and Sustainable (GRINS) [GRINS PE00000018 - CUP H73C22000930001]；欧盟委员会作为ESG UPTAKE项目的一部分[101145727]；以及国家恢复与韧性计划（PNRR）下国家相关研究项目（PRIN）[CUP H53D23002190006和CUP H53D23008390001]的支持。L. Pelizzon感谢莱布尼茨金融研究SAFE研究所和欧洲投资银行研究所对EIBURS项目“ESG-Credit.eu-ESG Factors and Climate Change for Credit Analysis and Rating”对本研究的财务赞助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08288获取。

papers.title_zh: 投资者对ESG评级的依赖与股价表现

papers.abstract_original: We propose a novel and easy-to-implement framework for forecasting time-varying correlations based on a large set of salient realized correlation features and the sparsity-encouraging Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator technique. Considering the universe of S&P 500 stocks, we find that the new approach manifests in statistically superior out-of-sample forecasts compared with commonly used procedures. We further demonstrate how the forecasts translate into significant economic gains in the form of higher pairs trading profits, better equity premium predictions, more accurate portfolio risk targeting, and superior overall risk control and minimization. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Funding: S. Z. Li received financial support from the Rutgers Business School Dean’s Research Seed Fund. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08294.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个新颖且易于实施的框架，用于预测时变相关性，该框架基于一大组显著的已实现相关性特征以及鼓励稀疏性的最小绝对收缩和选择算子技术。以标普500只股票为研究总体，我们发现，与常用方法相比，新方法在样本外预测中表现出统计上更优的结果。我们进一步展示这些预测如何转化为显著的经济收益，其形式包括更高的配对交易利润、更好的股权溢价预测、更准确的投资组合风险目标设定，以及更优越的整体风险控制与最小化。本文由金融领域编辑Kay Giesecke接受。资助：S. Z. Li获得罗格斯商学院院长研究种子基金的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08294 获取。
papers.title_original: Forecasting and Managing Correlation Risks
papers.title_zh: 相关性风险的预测与管理

papers.abstract_original: We study randomized experiments in a service system when stochastic congestion can arise from temporarily limited supply or excess demand. Such congestion gives rise to cross-unit interference between the waiting customers, and analytic strategies that do not account for this interference may be biased. In current practice, one of the most widely used ways to address stochastic congestion is to use switchback experiments that turn a target intervention on and off for the whole system in alternation. We find, however, that under a queueing model for stochastic congestion, the standard way of analyzing switchbacks is inefficient and that estimators that leverage the queueing model can be materially more accurate. Additionally, we show how the queueing model enables estimation of total policy gradients from unit-level randomized experiments, thus giving practitioners an alternative experimental approach they can use without needing to precommit to a fixed switchback length before data collection.This paper was accepted by Vivek Farias, data science.Funding: This work was supported by the ONR [Grant N000142412091].Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08306.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究服务系统中的随机实验，此时随机拥堵可能由暂时有限的供给或过度需求引起。这种拥堵会在等待的客户之间产生跨单位干扰，而不考虑这种干扰的分析策略可能会有偏。在当前实践中，应对随机拥堵最广泛使用的方法之一是使用切换回实验，即对整个系统交替开启和关闭目标干预。然而，我们发现，在随机拥堵的排队模型下，分析切换回的标准方式效率低下，而利用排队模型的估计量可以显著更准确。此外，我们展示了排队模型如何能够从单位级随机实验中估计总政策梯度，从而为实践者提供一种替代实验方法，使他们无需在数据收集前预先承诺固定的切换回长度即可使用。本文由数据科学领域的Vivek Farias接受。资助：本工作得到ONR [Grant N000142412091]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08306 获取。
papers.title_original: Experimenting Under Stochastic Congestion
papers.title_zh: 随机拥堵下的实验

papers.abstract_original: Key challenges in running a business include deciding which products or services to present to consumers (the assortment problem) and how to price products (the pricing problem) to maximize revenue or profit. Instead of considering these problems in isolation, we address assortment-pricing jointly and tackle the intrinsic doubly high dimensionality—both actions and contextual vectors can take continuous value in high-dimensional spaces. We propose a doubly high-dimensional contextual bandit model to formulate this problem. To circumvent the curse of dimensionality, our model is simple, yet flexible, capturing the interaction effects between covariates (context) and actions on the reward via a low-rank representation matrix. The resulting class of models is reasonably expressive while remaining interpretable through latent factors and includes various bandit and pricing models as special cases, making it suitable for applications involving simultaneous multiple decision-making beyond joint assortment-pricing. We develop a computationally tractable procedure that combines an exploration/exploitation protocol with an efficient low-rank matrix estimator. We provide a nonasymptotic instance-dependent regret bound involving dimensions and rank in addition to the time horizon. Simulations on standard bandit and pricing models—special cases of our model—demonstrate that our method yields lower regret than state-of-the-art methods. Real-world assortment-pricing case studies, from an industry-leading instant noodle manufacturer to an emerging beauty start-up, underscore the gains achievable using our method, showing at least three-fold gains in revenue/profit and the interpretability of the latent factor models that are learned.This paper was accepted by J. George Shanthikumar, data science.Funding: Financial support from The Wharton School [Wharton AI & Analytics Initiative Fund], the National Science Foundation [Grants DMS-2311072 and DMS-2515896), and the Office of Naval Research [Grant N00014-21-1-2842] is gratefully acknowledged.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08311.
papers.abstract_zh: 经营企业中的关键挑战包括决定向消费者展示哪些产品或服务（选品问题）以及如何为产品定价（定价问题），以最大化收入或利润。我们没有孤立地考虑这些问题，而是联合处理选品-定价，并应对其内在的双重高维性——在高维空间中，行动和上下文向量都可以取连续值。我们提出一个双重高维上下文老虎机模型来刻画这一问题。为规避维数灾难，我们的模型简单而灵活，通过一个低秩表示矩阵捕捉协变量（上下文）与行动之间对奖励的交互效应。由此得到的模型类别具有合理的表达能力，同时通过潜在因子保持可解释性，并将各种老虎机和定价模型作为特例纳入其中，使其适用于除联合选品-定价之外的同步多重决策应用。我们开发了一种计算上可处理的程序，将探索/利用协议与高效的低秩矩阵估计器相结合。我们提供了一个非渐近的、依赖于实例的遗憾界，其中除时间范围外还涉及维度和秩。对标准老虎机和定价模型——我们模型的特殊情形——的模拟表明，我们的方法比最先进的方法产生更低的遗憾。来自一家行业领先的方便面制造商和一家新兴美容初创企业的真实世界选品-定价案例研究，凸显了使用我们方法可实现的收益，显示收入/利润至少有三倍增长，以及所学潜在因子模型的可解释性。本文由J. George Shanthikumar（数据科学）接受。资助：感谢沃顿商学院[Wharton AI & Analytics Initiative Fund]、美国国家科学基金会[资助号DMS-2311072和DMS-2515896]以及海军研究办公室[资助号N00014-21-1-2842]的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08311获取。
papers.title_original: Doubly High-Dimensional Contextual Bandits: An Interpretable Model for Joint Assortment-Pricing
papers.title_zh: 双重高维上下文老虎机：一种用于联合选品-定价的可解释模型

papers.abstract_original: We find that shifts toward more liberal (i.e., less probusiness) courts predict reductions in local small business activity. A one-standard-deviation increase in liberal ideology predicts a 1% reduction in firm count relative to bordering counties in different federal court jurisdictions. This effect has more than doubled since 2000 and is particularly pronounced in circuit-years with elevated small business–related federal cases or public attention to the legal environment. The effect manifests predominantly through the exit of young firms, not firm relocations, and coincides with a shift away from litigation-sensitive industries. In summary, we provide the first evidence that small businesses consider judicial ideology, and the accompanying variation in expected litigation costs, when deciding whether or where to operate.This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance.Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08333.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们发现，法院转向更自由派（即更不亲商）的倾向预示着当地小企业活动的减少。自由派意识形态每增加一个标准差，相对于不同联邦法院司法管辖区的相邻县，企业数量预计减少1%。这一效应自2000年以来已增加一倍以上，并且在小企业相关联邦案件或公众对法律环境关注度较高的巡回法院-年份中尤为明显。该效应主要通过年轻企业的退出而非企业迁移体现，并且与远离诉讼敏感行业的转变同时发生。总之，我们提供了首个证据，表明小企业在决定是否经营或在何处经营时会考虑司法意识形态以及随之而来的预期诉讼成本变化。本文由金融学领域的Bo Becker接受。补充材料：互联网附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08333获取。
papers.title_original: Small Business Judging Judges
papers.title_zh: 小企业评判法官

papers.abstract_original: U.S. hospitals continue to face chronic shortages of essential drugs, jeopardizing patient care and driving up costs. Although prior work has identified the structural and economic drivers of these shortages, little is known about whether pharmaceutical plants accumulate operational knowledge from their recovery efforts—tasks that are often irregular and ill-defined. We assemble a unique data set linking 4,741 drug shortages (2015–2020) to 136 finished dosage form plants to examine whether—and under what conditions—plants learn from past recoveries. Using an instrumental variables approach, we find that each additional shortage a plant has previously resolved significantly reduces its time to recovery for a current shortage, indicating cumulative learning. We further show that learning is concentrated in shortages caused by internal plant issues, with no such effect for externally induced disruptions. Breadth of experience also matters; learning gains are larger when prior recoveries span diverse active ingredients or causal categories. Post hoc analyses reveal that the knowledge gained is confined largely to the focal plant and does not readily transfer across facilities within the same firm. These findings suggest that structured knowledge-capture processes, cross-site learning mechanisms, and incentives to diversify recovery experience can strengthen supply chain resilience.This paper was accepted by Stefan Scholtes, healthcare management.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08337.
papers.abstract_zh: 美国医院继续面临基本药物的长期短缺，危及患者护理并推高成本。尽管先前的研究已确定了这些短缺的结构性和经济性驱动因素，但关于制药工厂是否从其恢复努力——这些任务往往不规律且界定不清——中积累运营知识，人们知之甚少。我们组装了一个独特的数据集，将4,741起药品短缺（2015–2020）与136家成品剂型工厂联系起来，以考察工厂是否——以及在何种条件下——从过去的恢复中学习。使用工具变量方法，我们发现，一家工厂先前解决的每一起额外短缺都显著缩短了其当前短缺的恢复时间，表明存在累积学习。我们进一步表明，学习集中在由工厂内部问题引起的短缺中，而对于外部引发的中断则没有这种效应。经验的广度也很重要；当先前的恢复涵盖多种活性成分或因果类别时，学习收益更大。事后分析揭示，所获得的知识主要局限于焦点工厂，不易在同一公司内的不同设施之间转移。这些发现表明，结构化的知识捕获流程、跨站点学习机制以及多样化恢复经验的激励可以增强供应链韧性。本文由医疗管理领域的Stefan Scholtes接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08337获取。
papers.title_original: Learning in Recovery from Disruption: Empirical Evidence from the U.S. Drug Shortages
papers.title_zh: 从中断中恢复的学习：来自美国药品短缺的经验证据

papers.abstract_original: Stablecoins are the current go-to digital money to settle transactions on the blockchain. We explore the implications of introducing competing tokenized public digital monies (i.e., tokenized central bank digital currencies (CBDCs)). When they pay a moderate interest rate and guarantee users’ anonymity, tokenized CBDCs crowd out stablecoins. However, when they pay a high interest rate and have low anonymity features, stablecoin issuers could use tokenized CBDCs as collateral, promoting the creation of stablecoins. We identify conditions under which introducing a CBDC to compete with stablecoins in the crypto sector would be socially optimal.This paper was accepted by Will Cong for the Virtual Special Issue on Digital Finance.Funding: Support from Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF) [Grant 100018 219835].
papers.abstract_zh: 稳定币是目前在区块链上结算交易的首选数字货币。我们探讨了引入竞争的代币化公共数字货币（即代币化央行数字货币（CBDC））的影响。当它们支付适度的利率并保证用户匿名性时，代币化CBDC会挤出稳定币。然而，当它们支付高利率且匿名性特征较低时，稳定币发行者可以将代币化CBDC用作抵押品，促进稳定币的创造。我们确定了在加密领域引入CBDC与稳定币竞争在社会层面最优的条件。本文由Will Cong为数字金融虚拟特刊接受。资助：来自瑞士国家科学基金会（SNSF）的支持[资助号100018 219835]。
papers.title_original: Money Creation for Crypto Space: Stablecoins or Central Bank Digital Currencies?
papers.title_zh: 为加密空间创造货币：稳定币还是央行数字货币？

papers.abstract_original: Firms increasingly rely on voluntary training programs to enhance employees’ skills, yet such initiatives often suffer from high dropout rates. We investigate whether providing employees with information about their relative training performance affects their persistence in voluntary training. Social comparison theory suggests that relative performance information (RPI) addresses employees’ inherent need to assess their ability relative to others and maintain a positive self-image by improving their standing. However, whether RPI on training performance is sufficient to increase persistence in voluntary training in the field is unclear. Besides particularly low barriers for dropping out, voluntary training is typically noncore to employees’ primary tasks and often lacks a meaningful comparison group because participants come from a large, heterogeneous, and largely anonymous pool of employees. This calls into question whether the conditions required for social comparison mechanisms are sufficiently met for RPI to take effect. We study this question using a field experiment in a firm offering a voluntary online training program. During the training, employees either receive RPI about their training performance relative to others or only their own performance score. We show that RPI significantly increases employees’ persistence in the training. Consistent with our proposed theoretical mechanism, this effect is particularly pronounced for more competitive individuals. We further find that the likelihood of completing the training is higher and people return to the training quicker if they receive RPI. Our study highlights a simple and cost-effective way to enhance the effectiveness of voluntary training.This paper was accepted by Jan Bouwens, accounting.Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08448.
papers.abstract_zh: 企业日益依赖自愿培训项目来提升员工技能，但此类举措往往面临高退出率。我们研究向员工提供其相对培训绩效信息是否会影响他们在自愿培训中的坚持性。社会比较理论表明，相对绩效信息（RPI）满足了员工评估自身相对于他人能力的内在需求，并通过改善自身排名来维持积极自我形象。然而，在实地环境中，关于培训绩效的RPI是否足以提高自愿培训中的坚持性尚不清楚。除了退出障碍特别低之外，自愿培训通常并非员工主要任务的核心，而且往往缺乏有意义的比较群体，因为参与者来自一个庞大、异质且在很大程度上匿名的员工池。这使人质疑，社会比较机制所需的条件是否得到充分满足，从而使RPI能够发挥作用。我们利用一家提供自愿在线培训项目的企业中的实地实验研究这一问题。在培训期间，员工要么收到关于其培训绩效相对于他人的RPI，要么只收到自己的绩效分数。我们表明，RPI显著提高了员工在培训中的坚持性。与我们提出的理论机制一致，这一效应在更具竞争性的个体中尤为明显。我们进一步发现，如果收到RPI，完成培训的可能性更高，而且人们会更快返回培训。我们的研究强调了一种简单且成本有效的方式来提高自愿培训的有效性。本文由会计学领域的Jan Bouwens接受。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08448获取。
papers.title_original: The Impact of Relative Performance Information on Employees’ Persistence in Voluntary Training
papers.title_zh: 相对绩效信息对员工在自愿培训中坚持性的影响

papers.abstract_original: We study demand for symmetric and asymmetric information sources in the laboratory. Although participants respond to incentives and instrumental considerations, they exhibit a systematic bias towards symmetric sources. These patterns persist among individuals with higher cognitive abilities and better task comprehension, and they are not accounted for by their elicited subjective beliefs.This paper was accepted by Dorothea Kübler, behavioural economics and decision analysis.Funding: This project was supported by a British Academy/Leverhulme Small Research [Grant SG171679]. R. Z. acknowledges support from the Israel Science Foundation [Grant 524/24].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08449.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们在实验室中研究对对称和非对称信息源的需求。尽管参与者对激励和工具性考量作出反应，但他们表现出对对称信息源的系统性偏向。这些模式在认知能力较高和任务理解较好的个体中依然存在，并且无法由他们所报告的主观信念来解释。本文由行为经济学与决策分析领域的Dorothea Kübler接受。资助：本项目得到英国科学院/Leverhulme小型研究[资助号SG171679]的支持。R. Z. 感谢以色列科学基金会[资助号524/24]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08449获取。
papers.title_original: Beyond Value: On the Role of Symmetry in Demand for Information
papers.title_zh: 超越价值：论对称性在信息需求中的作用

papers.abstract_original: Theoretical research suggests internal information asymmetry (IIA) between top managers and divisional managers can reduce productivity by distorting internal resource allocation. The net effect, however, is unclear because IIA also reflects valuable private information within divisions, and empirical evidence is limited because of the unobservability of managers’ private information sets. Using a measure of IIA that exploits differences in returns to insider trading by top and divisional managers, we find that higher IIA is associated with lower total factor productivity. A one standard deviation increase in IIA corresponds to a 2.6% decrease in productivity relative to industry peers. This effect is comparable in magnitude to other important internal informational frictions, such as internal control weaknesses, and is distinct from internal information quality. Cross-sectional analyses indicate that the negative association is stronger when curative measures are limited and when agency conflicts between top managers and shareholders are greater. Mechanism tests indicate that IIA reduces internal capital market efficiency and increases underinvestment. Finally, using brokerage mergers and closures as a plausibly exogenous shock, we find that increases in IIA lead to declines in productivity. Overall, we provide empirical evidence that IIA is an economically important determinant of firm-level productivity.This paper was accepted by Jan Bouwens, accounting.Supplemental Material: The code and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08526.
papers.abstract_zh: 理论研究认为，高层管理者与部门管理者之间的内部信息不对称（IIA）会扭曲内部资源配置，从而降低生产率。然而，净效应并不明确，因为IIA也反映了部门内有价值的私人信息，并且由于管理者私人信息集不可观测，实证证据有限。使用一种利用高层管理者和部门管理者内幕交易回报差异的IIA度量，我们发现较高的IIA与较低的全要素生产率相关。IIA每增加一个标准差，对应于相对于行业同行的生产率下降2.6%。这一效应在量级上与其他重要的内部信息摩擦（如内部控制缺陷）相当，并且与内部信息质量不同。横截面分析表明，当补救措施有限以及高层管理者与股东之间的代理冲突更大时，这种负相关关系更强。机制检验表明，IIA降低了内部资本市场效率并增加了投资不足。最后，使用券商合并和关闭作为看似外生的冲击，我们发现IIA的增加会导致生产率下降。总体而言，我们提供了实证证据，表明IIA是企业层面生产率的一个经济上重要的决定因素。本文由Jan Bouwens（会计领域）接受。补充材料：代码和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08526获取。
papers.title_original: How Important Is Internal Information Asymmetry for Firm-Level Productivity?
papers.title_zh: 内部信息不对称对企业层面生产率有多重要？

papers.abstract_original: The rise of active owners—hedge funds and private equity firms—has raised questions about the influence of corporate owners on employee compensation. Prior research documents that active owners reduce overall compensation through workforce restructuring and slower wage growth. What remains unexplored is whether active owners also pay less for comparable work: whether they compensate the same jobs differently than other owners. Using detailed compensation from more than 20 million employee records across 896 U.S. firms, we compare pay within narrowly defined labor markets that hold constant year, region, occupation, and skill level. We find that firms with active owners pay 2%–4% less for comparable work than other firms. These differentials manifest as both lower base salary and flatter incentive pay and appear to reflect, at least in part, an owner treatment effect. Notably, the effects are concentrated in more monitorable contexts, including routine jobs, jobs with quantifiable outputs, and those in less knowledge-intensive industries. These patterns are consistent with active owners substituting compensation-based incentives with managerial oversight, particularly in quantifiable and routine settings. This suggests that, as work becomes more measurable, firm ownership may play a greater role in shaping employee outcomes.This paper was accepted by Isabel Fernandez-Mateo, organizations.Funding: C. Gartenberg and E. Pak recognize the generous financial support from the Wharton School at University of Pennsylvania.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08553.
papers.abstract_zh: 积极所有者——对冲基金和私募股权公司——的兴起引发了关于公司所有者对员工薪酬影响的疑问。先前研究记录，积极所有者通过劳动力重组和工资增长放缓来降低总体薪酬。尚未得到探讨的是，积极所有者是否也为可比工作支付更少：他们是否对其他所有者支付相同的岗位给予不同报酬。利用涵盖896家美国公司、超过20百万条员工记录的详细薪酬数据，我们在保持年份、地区、职业和技能水平不变的狭义界定劳动力市场内比较薪酬。我们发现，拥有积极所有者的公司为可比工作支付的薪酬比其他公司少2%–4%。这些差异表现为更低的基本工资和更平缓的激励薪酬，并且似乎至少部分反映了一种所有者处理效应。值得注意的是，这些效应集中在更可监督的情境中，包括常规工作、产出可量化的工作以及知识密集度较低行业中的工作。这些模式与积极所有者用管理监督替代基于薪酬的激励相一致，尤其是在可量化和常规化的环境中。这表明，随着工作变得更可衡量，公司所有权可能在塑造员工结果方面发挥更大作用。本文由Isabel Fernandez-Mateo（组织）接受。资助：C. Gartenberg和E. Pak感谢宾夕法尼亚大学沃顿商学院的慷慨财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08553获取。
papers.title_original: More Monitoring, Less Pay: Active Ownership and Employee Compensation
papers.title_zh: 更多监督，更少薪酬：积极所有权与员工薪酬

papers.abstract_original: We examine concerns that pricing algorithms, employing reinforcement learning, used by competitors would autonomously and systematically learn to collude. Findings of supracompetitive prices with Q-learning have recently raised that alarm. However, a detailed analysis of the inner workings of this algorithm type reveals that it often does not satisfy conditions for what constitutes “autonomous” algorithmic collusion that would be a cartel risk in practice. We find that Q-learning can learn collusive equilibria only on timescales irrelevant to the firm’s objective. Competitors are committed to using the same Q-learning algorithm, starting at the same moment, with the same hyperparameters and action spaces, although it is outperformed by the first alternative pricing rule. This level of synchronization suggests the need for an explicit cartel agreement. Our analysis gives criteria for practically relevant, explicitly and tacitly colluding pricing algorithms that would constitute a threat to competition. Whether autonomous algorithmic collusion is a potential threat to competition remains to be seen. There is not yet reason for competition agencies to be overly suspicious of pricing algorithms, other than of “collusion by algorithm,” in which pricing software is used to implement cartel agreements or is coded with collusive intent.This paper was accepted by Martin Bichler, market design, platform, and demand analytics.Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08557.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察了这样一种担忧：竞争者使用的采用强化学习的定价算法会自主且系统地学会合谋。Q学习产生超竞争价格的发现最近引发了这种警报。然而，对该算法类型内部运作的详细分析表明，它往往不满足构成实践中会成为卡特尔风险的“自主”算法合谋的条件。我们发现，Q学习只有在与公司目标无关的时间尺度上才能学会合谋均衡。竞争者承诺使用相同的Q学习算法，在同一时刻开始，具有相同的超参数和行动空间，尽管它被第一个替代定价规则所超越。这种同步程度表明需要明确的卡特尔协议。我们的分析给出了对竞争构成威胁的、实践相关的、明确和默契合谋定价算法的标准。自主算法合谋是否是对竞争的潜在威胁仍有待观察。除了“通过算法合谋”——即定价软件被用于实施卡特尔协议或被编码为具有合谋意图——之外，竞争机构尚无理由对定价算法过度怀疑。本文由Martin Bichler（市场设计、平台与需求分析）接受。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08557获取。
papers.title_original: Artificial Collusion: Examining Supracompetitive Pricing by Q-Learning Algorithms
papers.title_zh: 人工合谋：考察Q学习算法的超竞争定价

papers.abstract_original: Many studies have shown that consumers, before deciding whether to purchase a new product or service, draw inferences from the choices of other consumers and actively acquire information from other sources. We propose a novel model that integrates two learning processes: observational learning and active learning. Building upon the classic observational learning framework, this model allows each consumer to make dynamic choices of information acquisition. We first analyze consumers’ learning behavior with a given price, and then, we endogenize the seller’s dynamic pricing strategy in response to the two learning processes of consumers. We show that a forward-looking seller may find it optimal to sacrifice short-run profits by setting a price that induces active learning rather than deters it, thereby improving the information transmitted through observational learning and ultimately, increasing expected future profits. We also investigate consumers’ learning behavior, the seller’s dynamic pricing strategy, and long-run market learning outcomes when the speed of information acquisition increases with sales.This paper was accepted by Greg Shaffer, marketing.Funding: Z. Gong thanks the National Science Foundation of China [Grant 72332004] for the support.Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08603.
papers.abstract_zh: 许多研究表明，消费者在决定是否购买新产品或服务之前，会从其他消费者的选择中推断信息，并从其他来源主动获取信息。我们提出一个新颖的模型，整合了两种学习过程：观察学习和主动学习。在经典观察学习框架的基础上，该模型允许每个消费者动态选择信息获取。我们首先分析给定价格下消费者的学习行为，然后将卖方的动态定价策略内生化，以回应消费者的两种学习过程。我们表明，一个前瞻性的卖方可能会发现，通过设定一个诱导而非阻止主动学习的价格来牺牲短期利润是最优的，从而提高通过观察学习传递的信息，并最终增加预期的未来利润。我们还考察了当信息获取速度随销售增加时，消费者的学习行为、卖方的动态定价策略以及长期市场学习结果。本文由Greg Shaffer，市场营销领域接受。资助：Z. Gong感谢国家自然科学基金[资助号72332004]的支持。补充材料：在线附录可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08603获取。
papers.title_original: A Model of Two Learning Processes
papers.title_zh: 一个关于两种学习过程的模型

papers.abstract_original: We examine the role of second-tier stock exchanges in an entrepreneurial context from a global perspective. We construct a country-industry-year panel of global venture capitalist (VC)-invested startups, and find a significant increase in entrepreneurial activity following the launch of such markets. A causal interpretation is supported by additional tests for staggered difference-in-differences regressions and interacted regressions based on industry-specific dependence on second-tier stock exchanges. We propose a VC exit mechanism that receives empirical support: the launch of second-tier stock exchanges positively predicts (i) VC investment in startups, (ii) VCs’ valuation of startups, (iii) startups’ patenting records, (iv) startups’ initial public offering (IPO) likelihood, and (v) startups’ IPO valuation. We find that more startups are created in countries with more VC investment after the launch of such markets. We also find that the effect of second-tier stock exchanges on entrepreneurial ventures increases with financial resources, human capital, and intellectual property protection.This paper was accepted by Matt Marx, entrepreneurship and innovation.Funding: H. Gao acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72472028]. P.-H. Hsu acknowledges research support from the National Science and Technology Council in Taiwan [Grants NSTC 113-2410-H-007-008-MY3 and NSTC 114-2410-H-007-016-MY3], the Mack Institute for Innovation Management of the Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania, and the E.SUN Academic Award for financial and research support. Y. Wang acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72402130]. This work was also supported by the Dalian Commodity Exchange.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08619.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们从全球视角考察第二层级股票交易所在创业情境中的作用。我们构建了一个全球风险投资（VC）投资的初创企业的国家-行业-年份面板，发现此类市场推出后创业活动显著增加。基于行业对第二层级股票交易所特定依赖的交互回归和交错双重差分回归的额外检验支持了因果解释。我们提出了一种获得实证支持的风险投资退出机制：第二层级股票交易所的推出正向预测（i）风险投资对初创企业的投资，（ii）风险投资对初创企业的估值，（iii）初创企业的专利记录，（iv）初创企业首次公开募股（IPO）的可能性，以及（v）初创企业IPO估值。我们发现，在此类市场推出后，风险投资投资更多的国家创造了更多初创企业。我们还发现，第二层级股票交易所对创业企业的影响随着金融资源、人力资本和知识产权保护的增加而增强。本文由创业与创新领域的Matt Marx接受。资助：H. Gao感谢国家自然科学基金[资助号72472028]的财务支持。P.-H. Hsu感谢台湾国家科学技术委员会[资助号NSTC 113-2410-H-007-008-MY3和NSTC 114-2410-H-007-016-MY3]、宾夕法尼亚大学沃顿商学院Mack创新管理研究所和玉山学术奖的财务和研究支持。Y. Wang感谢国家自然科学基金[资助号72402130]的财务支持。这项工作还得到了大连商品交易所的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08619获取。

papers.abstract_original: This study quantifies the impact of voluntary carbon goal announcements on cumulative abnormal stock returns (CAR). Using 188 announcements of U.S. publicly traded firms between 2018 and 2024 across a variety of industries, this event study offers new and economically relevant insights on when and how firms should announce their carbon goals. First, a voluntary carbon goal announcement is associated with 0.65% positive CAR for the main event window (−2,+2), which translates to an increase of about $490 million based on the average market capitalization of firms in our data set. Notably, despite the substantial financial commitments implied by carbon neutrality, this corresponds to an average gain of about $75 in abnormal return per current ton of CO2-equivalent emissions. Second, our analysis of announcement-related media coverage using topic modeling reveals that investors respond more positively when the media highlights the expected business impact of the carbon goal. Third, firms with higher current emissions in the scopes they commit to eliminate are evaluated more favorably by the stock market, suggesting that investors value the larger emission reduction volume associated with such commitments. Finally, the positive effects of emphasizing business impact and promising to eliminate higher current emissions diminish over time. We conduct a series of robustness checks to ensure that our results are reliable and unbiased. Overall, this study provides a strong empirical foundation for understanding the consequences of voluntary carbon goal announcements of firms and discusses implications for theory and practice.This paper was accepted by Anita McGahan, business strategy.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08673.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究量化了自愿碳目标公告对累计异常股票收益（CAR）的影响。本研究利用188家美国上市公司在2018年至2024年间跨多个行业的公告，这一事件研究就企业应何时以及如何宣布其碳目标提供了新的且具有经济相关性的洞见。首先，自愿碳目标公告与主事件窗口（−2,+2）内0.65%的正向CAR相关，根据我们数据集中企业的平均市值，这相当于约490百万美元的增加。值得注意的是，尽管碳中和意味着巨大的财务承诺，这相当于每当前吨二氧化碳（CO2）当量排放约75美元的异常收益平均增益。其次，我们使用主题建模对与公告相关的媒体报道进行分析后发现，当媒体强调碳目标的预期商业影响时，投资者的反应更为积极。第三，在其承诺消除的范围内当前排放量较高的企业，被股票市场评价得更为有利，这表明投资者看重与此类承诺相关的更大减排量。最后，强调商业影响和承诺消除更高当前排放量的正向效应会随时间推移而减弱。我们进行了一系列稳健性检验，以确保我们的结果是可靠且无偏的。总体而言，本研究为理解企业自愿碳目标公告的后果提供了坚实的实证基础，并讨论了其对理论与实践的意义。本文由Anita McGahan（商业战略）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08673获取。
