papers.abstract_original: We examine whether the mandated convergence of local German Generally Accepted Accounting Principles with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) increases investment by foreign equity investors in German private firms. Exploiting a large-sample quasi-experimental setting, we document an average foreign ownership increase of 2%–8% in firms affected by the accounting reform compared with our unaffected control firms. Based on our identification strategy, using both the unique setting and accounting system comparability (that is, the comparability of cash flows in the next period), we show that increased comparability can minimize challenges faced by investors in private firms. We also find that those investors more familiar with IFRS benefit more from the increased accounting comparability. In addition, the effect is stronger for firms with higher proprietary costs before the mandatory accounting comparability increase. Our findings are robust to alternative matching procedures and a placebo test. We provide evidence for ongoing discussions on the costs of separate accounting standards for private firms. We show significant benefits when private firms’ accounting becomes more (and not less) comparable to that of public firms.This paper was accepted by Eric So, accounting.Funding: K. D. Allee acknowledges the support of the Doyle Z. Williams Chair in Professional Accounting at the Sam M. Walton College of Business.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08765.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察德国本地公认会计原则与国际财务报告准则（IFRS）的强制趋同是否增加了外国股权投资者对德国私营企业的投资。利用大样本准实验设定，我们记录到，与未受影响的对照公司相比，受会计改革影响的公司外国所有权平均增加2%–8%。基于我们的识别策略，利用这一独特设定和会计系统可比性（即下一期现金流的可比性），我们表明可比性提高可以最小化投资者在私营企业中面临的挑战。我们还发现，那些更熟悉IFRS的投资者从会计可比性提高中获益更多。此外，对于在强制会计可比性提高之前专有成本较高的公司，这一效应更强。我们的发现在替代匹配程序和安慰剂检验下稳健。我们为关于私营企业单独会计准则成本的持续讨论提供了证据。我们表明，当私营企业的会计与上市公司的会计变得更（而非更不）可比时，会产生显著益处。本文由Eric So（会计领域）接受。资助：K. D. Allee感谢Sam M. Walton商学院Doyle Z. Williams专业会计教席的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08765获取。
papers.title_original: Cross-Border Investments in Private Firms: The Benefits of Comparability for Foreign Investors
papers.title_zh: 对私营企业的跨境投资：可比性对外国投资者的益处

papers.abstract_original: Hedge funds can subsequently amend their originally reported 13F quarterly holdings using restatements. We conduct the first systematic analysis of such filings, which are as common as confidential filings (used by funds to delay holding disclosures) but affect three times as many stocks. Restated holdings are associated with significant abnormal returns, suggesting that some original holdings are strategically misreported to hide funds’ trading intentions and that later restatements facilitate copycat trading and price convergence. We construct a restatement return gap measure to gauge the value added by such restatements and find that a positive return gap is predictive of superior future fund performance.This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance.Funding: S. Cao acknowledges support from the AI Initiative from Capital Markets Research at the University of Maryland.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08833.
papers.abstract_zh: 对冲基金随后可以使用重述来修正其最初报告的13F季度持仓。我们对这类申报进行了首次系统性分析，这类申报与保密申报（基金用以延迟持仓披露）一样常见，但影响的股票数量是后者的三倍。被重述的持仓与显著的异常收益相关，这表明一些原始持仓被策略性地误报以隐藏基金的交易意图，而随后的重述促进了跟风交易和价格趋同。我们构建了一个重述收益差指标来衡量此类重述所增加的价值，并发现正的收益差可预测未来更优的基金业绩。本文由Kay Giesecke（金融学）接受。资助：S. Cao感谢马里兰大学资本市场研究AI Initiative的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08833获取。
papers.title_original: Do Hedge Funds Strategically Misreport Their Holdings? Evidence from 13F Restatements
papers.title_zh: 对冲基金是否策略性地误报其持仓？来自13F重述的证据

papers.abstract_original: We study the equity factor zoo using a duration-matching return-decomposition approach that adjusts factor returns by subtracting returns on duration-matched government bond portfolios. By doing so, we remove the component of factor returns attributable to interest rate movements while preserving shocks to expected growth and risk premia observed in the data. Among commonly used factors, the value, investment, and profitability premia increase after duration matching, while the market and size premia decrease, over the post-1981 sample period. Furthermore, the effect of duration matching on mean factor returns depends importantly on the interest rate environment, consistent with our return decomposition framework.This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08851.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们使用久期匹配的收益分解方法研究股票因子动物园，该方法通过减去久期匹配的政府债券组合的收益来调整因子收益。通过这样做，我们剔除了因子收益中可归因于利率变动的成分，同时保留了数据中观察到的对预期增长和风险溢价的冲击。在1981年后的样本期内，在常用因子中，价值、投资和盈利溢价在久期匹配后上升，而市场溢价和规模溢价下降。此外，久期匹配对平均因子收益的影响在很大程度上取决于利率环境，这与我们的收益分解框架一致。本文由Kay Giesecke（金融领域）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08851获取。
papers.title_original: The Factor Multiverse: The Role of Interest Rates in Factor Return Measurement
papers.title_zh: 因子多重宇宙：利率在因子收益度量中的作用

papers.abstract_original: Recession risk fluctuates substantially “before the storm,” yet little is known about how firms of different sizes adapt their policies accordingly. We embed time-varying recession risk into a model of liquidity management and investment, allowing firms to time their precautionary policies. Estimation reveals that small firms are less sensitive than large firms in their issuance, payout, and investment strategies to variations in recession risk. This is because small firms proactively build larger cash reserves relative to their current cash flow volatility during periods of low recession risk, anticipating that aggressive investment will gradually drain liquidity, grow cash flow volatility, and raise the risk of liquidation if a recession occurs. In contrast, large firms rely on robust cash flows to replenish liquidity during periods of low recession risk, deferring other precautionary actions until recession risk intensifies. These results have important implications for estimating the impact of recessions and macroprudential policy.This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08861.
papers.abstract_zh: 衰退风险在“风暴之前”会大幅波动，然而关于不同规模的企业如何相应调整其政策，人们知之甚少。我们将时变衰退风险嵌入一个流动性管理与投资模型，使企业能够择时采取预防性政策。估计结果显示，与大型企业相比，小型企业在发行、支付和投资策略上对衰退风险变化的敏感度更低。这是因为小型企业在衰退风险较低的时期，会相对于其当前现金流波动性主动积累更大的现金储备，预期到激进投资将逐步消耗流动性、提高现金流波动性，并在衰退发生时提高清算风险。相比之下，大型企业依赖稳健的现金流在衰退风险较低的时期补充流动性，并将其他预防性行动推迟到衰退风险加剧之时。这些结果对估计衰退影响和宏观审慎政策具有重要意义。本文由金融学领域的Lukas Schmid接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08861获取。
papers.title_original: Before the Storm: Firm Policies and Varying Recession Risk
papers.title_zh: 风暴之前：企业政策与变化的衰退风险

papers.abstract_original: Advances in machine learning have made it easier to extract useful information from both structured and unstructured data. Accordingly, empirical researchers often seek to leverage machine learning for statistical inference and hypothesis testing. We study an increasingly popular practice wherein a supervised machine learning model is trained to predict a certain variable of interest, and the predicted values are subsequently used in regression models as independent variables to draw statistical inferences. However, inevitably, errors in predictions manifest as measurement errors in regression models and lead to estimation biases. In this paper, we design and evaluate a novel approach, termed EnsembleIV, to address the issue. We propose the use of ensemble machine learning techniques to generate the predictions and show that individual learners in the ensemble (after a proposed special-purpose data-driven transformation procedure) can serve as instrumental variables to correct for the measurement error and avoid estimation biases. EnsembleIV’s effectiveness is demonstrated on both synthetic and real data sets for both linear and generalized linear regression models. We also compare EnsembleIV with several alternative bias correction methods and highlight its advantages. Overall, EnsembleIV represents a flexible algorithm that enables empirical researchers to draw robust statistical inferences with independent variables generated via machine learning.This paper was accepted by D.J. Wu, information systems.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08999.
papers.abstract_zh: 机器学习的进步使得从结构化和非结构化数据中提取有用信息变得更加容易。相应地，实证研究者常常寻求利用机器学习进行统计推断和假设检验。我们研究了一种日益流行的做法，即训练一个监督机器学习模型来预测某个感兴趣的变量，随后将预测值作为自变量用于回归模型以进行统计推断。然而，预测中的误差不可避免地表现为回归模型中的测量误差，并导致估计偏差。在本文中，我们设计并评估了一种新颖的方法，称为EnsembleIV，以解决该问题。我们提出使用集成机器学习技术来生成预测，并表明集成中的个体学习器（在经过所提出的特殊用途的数据驱动变换程序之后）可以作为工具变量来校正测量误差并避免估计偏差。EnsembleIV的有效性在线性回归模型和广义线性回归模型的合成数据集和真实数据集上均得到了证明。我们还将EnsembleIV与若干替代偏差校正方法进行了比较，并突出了其优势。总体而言，EnsembleIV代表了一种灵活的算法，使实证研究者能够利用通过机器学习生成的自变量得出稳健的统计推断。本文由D.J. Wu（信息系统）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08999获取。
papers.title_original: EnsembleIV: Creating Instrumental Variables from Ensemble Learners for Robust Statistical Inference with ML- Generated Variables
papers.title_zh: EnsembleIV：从集成学习器创建工具变量以实现对机器学习生成变量的稳健统计推断

papers.abstract_original: This study examines the unintended consequences of quality disclosures, focusing on how Academy Award nominations impact consumer satisfaction in the movie industry. Awards and certifications typically signal high quality and increase consumer expectations. Yet, if the experience falls short of the expectation, they may also lead to disappointment. Using a novel data set from MovieLens, we analyze user ratings for movies surrounding Academy Award nominations from 1995 to 2019. We first implement a difference-in-differences strategy comparing nominated and non-nominated films and then introduce a novel recommendation-based matching approach that leverages vector representations of user preferences trained prior to the nominations. Our analysis removes taste-based selection and isolates changes in user experience: users who rate a movie after its nomination assign significantly lower ratings than similar users who rated the same film earlier. This effect accounts for more than 7% of the prenomination rating gap between nominated and non-nominated films and is most pronounced among less experienced users. Our findings are validated with data from IMDb, where the effect is even more pronounced, likely reflecting differences in the composition of the user base across platforms. Additional textual analysis of user-generated content on both platforms provides further evidence that the postnomination decline in ratings is driven by disappointment, rather than disinterest, deteriorating viewing conditions, or snob effects associated with mainstream popularity.This paper was accepted by Duncan Simester, marketing.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.09016.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究考察质量披露的意外后果，聚焦于奥斯卡奖提名如何影响电影行业中消费者满意度。奖项与认证通常传递高质量信号并提高消费者预期。然而，如果体验未达到预期，它们也可能导致失望。我们使用来自MovieLens的新颖数据集，分析1995年至2019年奥斯卡奖提名前后电影的用户评分。我们首先实施双重差分策略，比较获提名与未获提名的影片，然后引入一种新颖的基于推荐的匹配方法，该方法利用在提名之前训练的用户偏好向量表示。我们的分析消除了基于品味的自选择，并分离出用户体验的变化：在电影获提名后对其评分的用户，给出的评分显著低于较早对同一影片评分的相似用户。这一效应占获提名与未获提名影片在提名前评分差距的7%以上，并且在经验较少的用户中最为明显。我们的发现通过IMDb数据得到验证，在该数据中效应更为明显，这可能反映了不同平台用户群体构成的差异。对两个平台上用户生成内容的额外文本分析进一步提供证据表明，提名后评分的下降是由失望驱动的，而非不感兴趣、观影条件恶化或与主流流行度相关的势利效应。本文由市场营销领域的Duncan Simester接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.09016获取。

papers.abstract_original: Leaders shape firm strategy not only through the decisions they make directly, but also through influencing employees’ workplace behavior. We argue that leaders’ formative life experiences, which shape personal traits, can influence employee behavior and work performance. Using detailed data from Chinese securities firms, we examine the impact of chairpersons’ experiences as “sent-down youths” (SDYs) during China’s Cultural Revolution, which instilled in them a strong work ethic in the face of adversity. We argue that SDY chairpersons encourage security analysts to increase efforts to improve the accuracy of earnings forecasts for the publicly listed firms they follow. We show that when the same analyst experiences a change in chairperson within the same securities firm—from one without any SDY experience to one with SDY experience (both within the same cohort)—their forecast accuracy for the same listed firm increases. Specific actions, such as conducting site visits to gather company information firsthand, contribute to improving forecast accuracy. We find that analysts led by SDY chairpersons are more likely to conduct site visits, visit more companies for the first time, visit companies located in less-accessible areas, ask more targeted questions during site visits, and update forecasts promptly after major events. To strengthen causal inference, we employ fixed effects, examine various types of chairperson turnovers, and employ instrumental variable approaches and placebo tests. Our study suggests that, through influencing employee behavior, the “style” of a firm leader spreads far within an organization.This paper was accepted by Alfonso Gambardella, business strategy.Funding: Y. Wang received financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72172090 and 72572103]; N. Xu received financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72225005 and 72495154]; and R. Xie received financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72202249] and the Program for Innovation Research in Central University of Finance and Economics.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.09097.
papers.abstract_zh: 领导者不仅通过直接做出的决策塑造企业战略，还通过影响员工的工作场所行为来塑造企业战略。我们认为，领导者塑造个人特质的成长生活经历可以影响员工行为和工作绩效。利用中国证券公司的详细数据，我们考察了中国文化大革命期间“上山下乡知识青年”（SDYs）经历对董事长的影响，这种经历在逆境中灌输了强烈的职业道德。我们认为，有SDY经历的董事长鼓励证券分析师加大努力，以提高他们所跟踪的上市公司的盈利预测准确性。我们表明，当同一分析师在同一证券公司内经历董事长变更——从没有SDY经历的董事长变为有SDY经历的董事长（两者均在同一队列内）——他们对同一上市公司的预测准确性提高。具体行动，如进行实地调研以 firsthand 收集公司信息，有助于提高预测准确性。我们发现，由SDY董事长领导的分析师更可能进行实地调研、首次访问更多公司、访问位于交通不便地区的公司、在实地调研中提出更有针对性的问题，并在重大事件后及时更新预测。为加强因果推断，我们采用固定效应、考察各种类型的董事长更替，并采用工具变量方法和安慰剂检验。我们的研究表明，通过影响员工行为，企业领导者的“风格”在组织内广泛传播。本文由Alfonso Gambardella（商业战略领域）接受。资助：Y. Wang获得国家自然科学基金[资助号72172090和72572103]的财务支持；N. Xu获得国家自然科学基金[资助号72225005和72495154]的财务支持；R. Xie获得国家自然科学基金[资助号72202249]和中央财经大学创新研究项目的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.09097获取。

papers.abstract_original: A generalized matching problem consists of a set of agents, a set of objects, the agents’ endowments, a set of feasible matchings, and the agents’ preferences over feasible matchings. Respect for improvement means that when the ranking of an agent’s endowment improves in some other agent’s preference (while keeping other preferences unchanged), then this agent weakly benefits from it. Our main result shows across matching applications that on the strict domain, individual rationality, strategy-proofness, and nonbossiness imply respecting improvement. As a consequence for housing markets, we obtain that top trading with fixed tiebreaking and top trading with random tiebreaking satisfy respecting improvement on the weak domain. We further show that several application-based extensions of the top-trading-cycles mechanism (such as for kidney exchange and school choice) satisfy (a weak version of) respecting improvement.This paper was accepted by Martin Bichler, market design, platform, and demand analytics.Funding: The author acknowledges financial support from the Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Canada under Insight Grant 435-2023-0129 and the Fonds de recherche du Québec under Soutien aux équipes de recherche / Universitaire- nouvelle équipe 367853.
papers.abstract_zh: 一个广义匹配问题由一组代理人、一组物品、代理人的禀赋、一组可行匹配以及代理人对可行匹配的偏好组成。尊重改进意味着，当某个代理人的禀赋在其他某个代理人的偏好中排名提高时（同时保持其他偏好不变），那么该代理人会从这一变化中弱受益。我们的主要结果表明，在匹配应用中，在严格偏好域上，个体理性、策略防伪性和非霸道性蕴含尊重改进。作为住房市场的一个推论，我们得到，固定打破平局规则的顶层交易和随机打破平局规则的顶层交易在弱偏好域上满足尊重改进。我们进一步表明，顶层交易循环机制的若干基于应用的扩展（例如用于肾脏交换和学校选择）满足（一个弱版本的）尊重改进。本文由Martin Bichler（市场设计、平台与需求分析）接受。资助：作者感谢加拿大社会科学与人文研究理事会在洞察基金435-2023-0129下的资助，以及魁北克研究基金会在研究团队支持/大学新团队367853下的资助。

papers.title_zh: 在不可分物品市场中尊重改进

papers.abstract_original: Product Improvement (PI) involves making minimal changes to an existing product to enhance its market performance. A key source of information for PI is Consumer Evaluation (CE), provided either in aggregate (e.g., sales volume) or descriptive (e.g., online reviews) form. Existing PI approaches analyze the descriptive CE of the focal product, which limits their applicability when descriptive CE is missing, abstract, or interdependent. More importantly, current methods are primarily descriptive and do not generate actionable PI recommendations, despite their considerable value to practitioners. We address these challenges with a new approach that leverages both aggregate and descriptive CE across the entire market to prescribe specific PI recommendations. We first develop Product Segmentation (PS) trees, a type of decision tree with a customized objective function designed to identify the features that best segment products by market performance. We then build a constrained shortest-path algorithm over the PS tree structure to prescribe minimal improvements for any underperforming product. To enhance robustness, we ensemble multiple PS trees, each trained with distinct objectives, into a novel PS forest. Using both real and synthetic data, our approach achieves 73% average precision in PI and improves upon the best benchmarks by 11%. Lastly, we conduct a conjoint analysis to behaviorally validate that consumers prefer the PI recommendations generated by our method over the original underperforming products. Our theoretical and empirical results show that the proposed approach addresses key challenges in using CE for PI and offers interpretable and actionable decision support for practitioners.This paper was accepted by D. J. Wu, information systems.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00055.
papers.abstract_zh: 产品改进（PI）涉及对现有产品进行最小程度的改动以提升其市场表现。产品改进的一个关键信息来源是消费者评价（CE），其以汇总形式（如销售量）或描述性形式（如在线评论）提供。现有的产品改进方法分析焦点产品的描述性消费者评价，这限制了它们在描述性消费者评价缺失、抽象或相互依赖时的适用性。更重要的是，当前方法主要是描述性的，尽管对实践者具有相当大的价值，却无法生成可操作的产品改进建议。我们通过一种新方法应对这些挑战，该方法利用整个市场上的汇总和描述性消费者评价来给出具体的产品改进建议。我们首先开发了产品细分（PS）树，这是一种决策树，具有定制的目标函数，旨在识别最能按市场表现对产品进行细分的特征。然后，我们在产品细分树结构上构建了一个约束最短路径算法，为任何表现不佳的产品给出最小程度的改进建议。为增强稳健性，我们将多棵产品细分树集成到一个新颖的产品细分森林中，每棵树以不同的目标进行训练。使用真实数据和合成数据，我们的方法在产品改进中达到了73%的平均精度，并比最佳基准提高了11%。最后，我们进行了联合分析，从行为上验证消费者更偏好我们的方法生成的改进建议，而非原始表现不佳的产品。我们的理论和实证结果表明，所提出的方法解决了利用消费者评价进行产品改进的关键挑战，并为实践者提供了可解释且可操作的决策支持。本文由信息系统领域的D. J. Wu接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00055获取。
papers.title_original: Learning Product Improvement from Consumer Evaluations
papers.title_zh: 从消费者评价中学习产品改进

papers.abstract_original: Shareholders want a firm’s objective function to place some weight on consumer welfare, motivated by both self-interest and altruism. Firms have a unique technology for improving consumer welfare: lowering inefficient price markups. Optimal pricing formulas can account for shareholders’ marginal rate of substitution between profits and consumer welfare. Calibrations show shareholders should place nontrivial weights on consumers. A survey experiment with a representative sample shows how shareholders would vote on resolutions giving strategic guidance to firms. Only 7% would vote for pure profit maximization. The median individual is indifferent between $0.44 in profits or $1 in consumer surplus.This paper was accepted by John Beshears, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Funding: This work was supported by Boston University (Impact Measurement and Allocation Program and Ravi K. Mehrotra Institute for Business, Markets, and Society).Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00094.
papers.abstract_zh: 股东希望企业的目标函数对消费者福利赋予一定权重，这既出于自利，也出于利他。企业拥有一种改善消费者福利的独特技术：降低无效率的价格加成。最优定价公式可以纳入股东在利润与消费者福利之间的边际替代率。校准表明，股东应当对消费者赋予不可忽视的权重。一项具有代表性样本的调查实验显示了股东将如何就向企业提供战略指导的决议进行投票。只有7%会投票支持纯粹的利润最大化。中位个体在$0.44的利润或$1的消费者剩余之间无差异。本文由John Beshears（行为经济学与决策分析）接受。资助：本工作得到波士顿大学（影响测度与分配项目以及Ravi K. Mehrotra商业、市场与社会研究所）的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00094获取。
papers.title_original: What Do Shareholders Want? Consumer Welfare and the Objective of the Firm
papers.title_zh: 股东想要什么？消费者福利与企业目标

papers.abstract_original: We investigate the impact of a unique legislative reform that granted anonymity to plaintiffs in court rulings for personal injury claims. Prior to the reform’s implementation in August 2015, claimants who rejected settlement offers faced the risk that court proceedings would publicly disclose sensitive information regarding their health and earnings. By eliminating this source of privacy loss, the reform provides an opportunity to examine how privacy considerations affect outcomes in a real-world setting. Our analysis measures changes in payments for personal injury versus property damage claims (which were not affected by the reform) for car accident cases handled by the major insurance firms in Israel between 2011 and 2020. Using a difference-in-differences framework, we find that the reform led to a 12%–17% increase in payments for personal injury claims. We interpret this estimate as the implicit cost claimants were previously willing to bear, in the form of lower settlements, to avoid the disclosure of private information through court rulings. This result underscores the economic value individuals place on privacy, revealing that concerns about public exposure can significantly influence decision making and negotiation outcomes. Our findings demonstrate the importance of privacy considerations in customer interactions where sensitive information is often involved.This paper was accepted by Dorothea Kübler, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Funding: This work was supported by the Ministry of Justice of Israel [Grant 88/2024], The Falk Institute [Grant 24.03], and the Israel Science Foundation [Grant 1224/24].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00107.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一项独特立法改革的影响，该改革在人身伤害索赔的法院裁决中给予原告匿名权。在该改革于2015年8月实施之前，拒绝和解提议的索赔人面临法院程序公开披露其健康和收入敏感信息的风险。通过消除这一隐私损失来源，该改革提供了一个机会，用以考察隐私考量如何在现实环境中影响结果。我们的分析衡量了2011年至2020年间由以色列主要保险公司处理的车祸案件中，人身伤害索赔相对于财产损失索赔（未受该改革影响）的赔付变化。使用双重差分框架，我们发现该改革导致人身伤害索赔赔付增加12%–17%。我们将这一估计解释为索赔人此前愿意以较低和解金形式承担的隐性成本，以避免通过法院裁决披露私人信息。这一结果凸显了个人赋予隐私的经济价值，表明对公开曝光的担忧能够显著影响决策和谈判结果。我们的发现证明了在通常涉及敏感信息的客户互动中隐私考量的重要性。本文由Dorothea Kübler（行为经济学与决策分析）接受。资助：本工作得到以色列司法部[Grant 88/2024]、Falk研究所[Grant 24.03]和以色列科学基金会[Grant 1224/24]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00107获取。
papers.title_original: Does Privacy Matter? Evidence from a Legal Reform
papers.title_zh: 隐私重要吗？来自一项法律改革的证据

papers.abstract_original: Traders devote significant resources to producing private information. The value of such information is eroded when it is leaked. We study the use of multiple brokers by institutions to help mitigate information leakage. We document that trades using multiple brokers better predict future returns and have higher future profits, consistent with information possessed by investors driving the decision to use multiple brokers. We find that trades using multiple brokers are more informed and, yet, have lower price impacts, lower implementation shortfalls, and fewer follower trades than similar single-broker trades. The results suggest that traders use multiple brokers to successfully reduce information leakage.This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance.Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00201.
papers.abstract_zh: 交易者投入大量资源来生产私人信息。此类信息的价值在泄露时会被侵蚀。我们研究机构使用多个经纪商以帮助缓解信息泄露。我们记录到，使用多个经纪商的交易能更好地预测未来收益并具有更高的未来利润，这与投资者所拥有的信息驱动其使用多个经纪商的决策相一致。我们发现，与类似的单一经纪商交易相比，使用多个经纪商的交易更具信息含量，然而价格影响更低、实施缺口更小、跟随交易更少。结果表明，交易者使用多个经纪商成功减少了信息泄露。本文由Camelia Kuhnen，金融学接受。补充材料：互联网附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00201获取。
papers.title_original: Preventing Information Leakage
papers.title_zh: 防止信息泄露

papers.abstract_original: Despite growing regulatory concerns about potential overcharging of sustainable investors, empirical evidence is lacking. In two controlled laboratory-in-the-field experiments with 415 professional financial advisors from Europe and the United States and an incentivized survey, we identify two distinct but interacting effects. First, advisors charge sustainable investors a premium. This premium persists even when accounting for differences in skill, effort, and costs. Second, advisors impose higher fees on clients with low financial literacy. These factors interact. Sustainable investors with low financial literacy are charged the highest fee, whereas those with high financial literacy do not pay a sustainability premium. Our findings suggest that advisors extract additional fees for sustainable investment mandates but avoid overcharging sustainable investors with high financial literacy.This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance.Funding: P. Smeets was supported by the Nederlandse Organisatie voor Wetenschappelijk Onderzoek [Grant VI.Vidi.221E.011]. The experiments were financially supported by the Graduate School of Business and Economics at Maastricht University, Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam, and Radboud University.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00232.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管监管机构日益担忧可持续投资者可能被过度收费，但缺乏实证证据。在两项受控的实地实验室实验中，我们使用了来自欧洲和美国的415名专业财务顾问以及一项激励性调查，识别出两种不同但相互作用的效应。第一，顾问向可持续投资者收取溢价。即使考虑到技能、努力和成本的差异，这种溢价仍然存在。第二，顾问对金融素养较低的客户收取更高的费用。这些因素相互作用。金融素养低的可持续投资者被收取最高费用，而金融素养高的可持续投资者则不需支付可持续性溢价。我们的发现表明，顾问会为可持续投资委托提取额外费用，但避免对金融素养高的可持续投资者过度收费。本文被金融领域的Camelia Kuhnen接受。资助：P. Smeets得到荷兰科学研究组织[资助号VI.Vidi.221E.011]的支持。实验得到马斯特里赫特大学商业与经济研究生院、阿姆斯特丹自由大学和拉德堡德大学的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00232获取。

papers.abstract_original: We document that the sectoral composition and marginal buyers of government debt differ notably across jurisdictions and over time. We use instrumental variables derived from monetary policy surprises to estimate the demand elasticities of various sectors. In the United States, commercial banks and mutual funds exhibit the most price-elastic demand, whereas the foreign official sector has a price-inelastic demand. Based on these estimates and under certain assumptions, we find that a 1% increase in the Central Bank holdings of U.S. Treasuries results in an around 8- to 13-basis-point drop in long-term yields depending on the market composition. Elasticities of individual sectors do not differ in a statistically significant manner when the Central Bank share in the Treasury market increases or decreases. However, different market compositions during various quantitative easing (QE) and quantitative tightening (QT) programs have led to an asymmetric effect with the impact of QE on yields being greater than that of QT. Our results suggest that, overall, the demand for U.S. Treasuries is considerably more elastic than for equities, corporate bonds, and emerging market sovereign bonds found in the literature. We also repeat the analysis for other jurisdictions and compare estimates for different sectors.This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00332.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们记录到，政府债务的部门构成和边际买家在不同司法管辖区之间以及随时间推移存在显著差异。我们使用由货币政策意外推导出的工具变量来估计各部门的需求弹性。在美国，商业银行和共同基金表现出最具价格弹性的需求，而外国官方部门的需求则缺乏价格弹性。基于这些估计并在某些假设下，我们发现，中央银行持有的美国国债增加1%会导致长期收益率下降约8至13个基点，具体取决于市场构成。当中央银行在国债市场中的份额增加或减少时，各部门的弹性在统计上并无显著差异。然而，在各种量化宽松（QE）和量化紧缩（QT）计划期间不同的市场构成导致了不对称效应，QE对收益率的影响大于QT。我们的结果表明，总体而言，美国国债的需求弹性远高于文献中发现的股票、公司债券和新兴市场主权债券。我们还对其他司法管辖区重复了分析，并比较了不同部门的估计值。本文由金融学领域的Lukas Schmid接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00332获取。
papers.title_original: The Demand for Government Debt
papers.title_zh: 政府债务的需求

papers.abstract_original: People and organizations often set goals to self-motivate and achieve better outcomes in challenging tasks. But goals—and their effectiveness—might depend on what people expect to happen. Do goals reflect expectations, or do goals set expectations? How do goals and expectations affect performance? These distinctions are important for motivation and intervention design. We run an online real-effort task to answer these two questions by introducing exogenous variation in goals and expectations. First, we find that goals mostly reflect existing expectations rather than set expectations. Second, practicing an easier version of a task leads to higher expectations and higher performance. Third, eliciting a goal also leads to higher average performance, and changing the goal level has local effects that pull people toward the goal. However, revising goals has little effect on average performance. Our findings imply that increasing expectations is an important motivating tool that increases goals and performance. Having any goal helps performance; however, people cannot fool themselves into expecting and doing more simply by choosing a different goal.This paper was accepted by John Beshears, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Funding: Financial support from the University of California San Diego Academic Senate and the Willard Graham Research Fund at Chicago Booth is gratefully acknowledged.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00480.
papers.abstract_zh: 个人和组织常常设定目标以自我激励，并在具有挑战性的任务中取得更好的结果。但目标——及其有效性——可能取决于人们预期会发生什么。目标是反映期望，还是设定期望？目标和期望如何影响绩效？这些区分对于激励和干预设计很重要。我们运行一项在线实际努力任务，通过引入目标和期望的外生变化来回答这两个问题。第一，我们发现目标大多反映既有期望，而非设定期望。第二，练习任务的较容易版本会带来更高的期望和更高的绩效。第三，引出目标也会带来更高的平均绩效，而改变目标水平会产生局部效应，将人们拉向目标。然而，修订目标对平均绩效几乎没有影响。我们的发现意味着，提高期望是一种重要的激励工具，可以提高目标和绩效。拥有任何目标都有助于绩效；然而，人们不能仅仅通过选择不同的目标来欺骗自己期望并做得更多。本文已被John Beshears接受，行为经济学与决策分析领域。资助：感谢加州大学圣地亚哥分校学术评议会和芝加哥布斯商学院的Willard Graham研究基金的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00480获取。
papers.title_original: Goals, Expectations, and Performance
papers.title_zh: 目标、期望与绩效

papers.abstract_original: This study evaluates the effect of generative artificial intelligence (AI) on software developer productivity via randomized controlled trials at Microsoft, Accenture, and an anonymous Fortune 100 company. These field experiments, run by the companies as part of their ordinary course of business, provided a random subset of developers with access to an AI-based coding assistant suggesting intelligent code completions. Although each experiment is noisy and results vary across experiments, when data are combined across three experiments and 4,867 developers, our analysis reveals a 26.08% increase (standard error: 10.3%) in completed tasks among developers using the AI tool. Notably, less experienced developers had higher adoption rates and greater productivity gains.This paper was accepted by Jean-Pierre Dube, marketing.Funding: M. Demirer and T. Salz thank the MIT GenAI Initiative for funding.Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00535.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究通过在微软、埃森哲和一家匿名《财富》100强公司开展的随机对照试验，评估生成式人工智能（AI）对软件开发者生产率的影响。这些实地实验由各公司作为其日常业务的一部分运行，为随机抽取的一部分开发者提供了使用基于AI的编码助手的机会，该助手会建议智能代码补全。尽管每项实验都有噪声且结果因实验而异，但当数据跨三项实验和4,867名开发者合并时，我们的分析揭示，使用AI工具的开发者完成的任务增加了26.08%（标准误：10.3%）。值得注意的是，经验较少的开发者采用率更高，生产率提升也更大。本文由Jean-Pierre Dube（市场营销）接受。资助：M. Demirer和T. Salz感谢MIT GenAI Initiative的资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00535获取。

papers.abstract_original: We study an overlooked driver of heterogeneity in green investment behavior: differences in expectations about the long-term trajectory of the energy transition (climate transition beliefs). Drawing on a survey of U.S. retail investors, we document considerable heterogeneity in climate transition beliefs at different long-term horizons. Transition optimism is positively associated with expected green financial performance and preferences for green investments, particularly among investors without strong pro-environmental attitudes. Two preregistered survey experiments provide causal evidence that transition beliefs play a key role in shaping green return expectations and investment decisions. Distinguishing between heterogeneous beliefs and preferences is crucial for a better understanding of the motivations behind green investment behavior.This paper was accepted by Caroline Flammer, sustainability.Funding: This work was supported by the Universität St. Gallen Basic Research Fund [Grant 2130787].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00564.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究绿色投资行为异质性中一个被忽视的驱动因素：对能源转型长期轨迹预期的差异（气候转型信念）。基于一项对美国散户投资者的调查，我们记录了在不同长期期限上气候转型信念的显著异质性。转型乐观情绪与预期绿色财务表现和对绿色投资的偏好正相关，尤其是在没有强烈亲环境态度的投资者中。两项预注册调查实验提供了因果证据，表明转型信念在塑造绿色回报预期和投资决策中发挥关键作用。区分异质性信念和偏好对于更好地理解绿色投资行为背后的动机至关重要。本文由可持续发展领域的Caroline Flammer接受。资助：本研究得到圣加仑大学基础研究基金[资助编号2130787]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00564获取。

papers.abstract_original: We present one of the first systematic audits of cryptocurrency market data quality across leading vendors. We document pervasive mislabeling, identifier instability, and large cross-provider discrepancies in prices, market caps, and volumes. To address these issues, we develop an aggregation method that yields asymptotically correct data by autonomously identifying and filtering unreliable observations. Using this framework, we construct an index to measure data quality over time and a grading system to benchmark providers. Our findings show that data inconsistencies can materially distort empirical research and investment analysis. They highlight possible oversight gaps in the market for crypto data.This paper was accepted by Will Cong for the Special Issue on Digital Finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00611.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们呈现了对领先供应商加密货币市场数据质量的首批系统性审计之一。我们记录了普遍存在的错误标注、标识符不稳定，以及价格、市值和交易量方面供应商之间的巨大差异。为解决这些问题，我们开发了一种聚合方法，通过自主识别并过滤不可靠观测值，产生渐近正确的数据。使用这一框架，我们构建了一个衡量数据质量随时间变化的指数，以及一个对供应商进行基准比较的评级系统。我们的发现表明，数据不一致可能实质性扭曲实证研究和投资分析。它们凸显了加密数据市场可能存在的监管缺口。本文由Will Cong为数字金融特刊接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00611获取。

papers.abstract_original: We investigate the heritability of risk, uncertainty, and time preferences using a large-scale field experiment with adult twins, complemented by a comprehensive meta-analysis of prior studies. Our research introduces a novel empirical approach that integrates behavioral genetics with structural econometrics, enabling us to directly quantify the heritability of latent preference parameters in behavioral models of decision making, without relying on observed proxies. Our incentive-compatible experiment is the first to simultaneously elicit all three types of preferences within the same individuals in a twin study. Our findings reveal a stronger genetic influence on risk and uncertainty preferences than previously reported. We demonstrate that conventional proxy measures for preferences and simplified structural models tend to overstate the influence of unique environmental factors. These results help contextualize preference heterogeneity as a driver of persistent differences in decision making across individuals, leaders, and organizations.This paper was accepted by Aurélien Baillon, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Funding: Support from the University of Technology Sydney and from the Australian Government through the Australian Research Council’s Centre of Excellence for Children and Families over the Life Course [Project IDs CE140100027 and CE200100025] is gratefully acknowledged. This research was facilitated through access to Twins Research Australia, a national resource supported by the National Health & Medical Research Council since 1981, administered by the University of Melbourne.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00669.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们利用一项针对成年双胞胎的大规模实地实验，并辅以对既有研究的全面元分析，考察风险、不确定性和时间偏好的遗传性。我们的研究引入了一种新颖的实证方法，将行为遗传学与结构计量经济学相结合，使我们能够直接量化决策行为模型中潜在偏好参数的遗传性，而无需依赖可观测的代理变量。我们的激励相容实验是首个在双胞胎研究中同时在同一批个体身上引出全部三类偏好的实验。我们的发现揭示了遗传对风险和不确定性偏好的影响比此前报告的更强。我们证明，传统的偏好代理测量指标和简化结构模型往往会高估独特环境因素的影响。这些结果有助于将偏好异质性理解为个体、领导者和组织之间决策持续差异的驱动因素。本文由行为经济学与决策分析领域编辑Aurélien Baillon接受。资助：我们感谢悉尼科技大学以及澳大利亚政府通过澳大利亚研究理事会儿童与家庭生命历程卓越中心[项目编号CE140100027和CE200100025]提供的支持。本研究通过获取Twins Research Australia的数据得以开展，该机构是一个自1981年以来由国家健康与医学研究理事会支持、由墨尔本大学管理的全国性资源。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00669获取。

papers.abstract_original: This study examines how a first-time malignant cancer diagnosis, acting as an informational shock to perceived longevity, affects the demand for life annuities. Using a quasi-experimental design and exploiting Swedish administrative data, we show that receiving a cancer diagnosis close to retirement reduces annuitization rates by 5.5%. The diagnosis lowers the money’s worth ratio of a life annuity by 33%, representing a substantial financial loss. Combined with the modest behavioral response, this yields a low demand elasticity of 0.17 with respect to the perceived annuity value. Evidence from a complementary laboratory experiment indicates that this limited adjustment is driven by the influence of a default option that reduces responsiveness to private health information and may disadvantage individuals in poor health.This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance.Funding: This work was supported by The Henry Crown Institute of Business Research in Israel [Grant 08923100], the Israel Science Foundation [Grant 1637/23], the Jeremy Coller Foundation [Grant 0612017581], the Hamrin Foundation [Grant 2023-09], the Solomon Lew Center for Consumer Behavior [Grant 08923200], the Swedish Research Council for Health Working Life and Welfare [Grant 2023-00046], and the Center for Agriculture, Environment and Natural Resource [Grant 0004].Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00682.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究考察首次恶性癌症诊断作为一种对感知寿命的信息冲击，如何影响对终身年金的需求。使用准实验设计并利用瑞典行政数据，我们表明，在临近退休时收到癌症诊断会使年金化率降低5.5%。该诊断使终身年金的货币价值比降低33%，代表着重大的财务损失。结合温和的行为反应，这产生了相对于感知年金价值的低需求弹性，为0.17。来自一项补充实验室实验的证据表明，这种有限的调整是由默认选项的影响所驱动的，该默认选项降低了对私人健康信息的反应性，并可能使健康状况不佳的个体处于不利地位。本文由Camelia Kuhnen（金融学）接受。资助：本工作得到以色列Henry Crown商业研究所[资助号08923100]、以色列科学基金会[资助号1637/23]、Jeremy Coller基金会[资助号0612017581]、Hamrin基金会[资助号2023-09]、Solomon Lew消费者行为中心[资助号08923200]、瑞典健康、工作生活与福利研究委员会[资助号2023-00046]以及农业、环境与自然资源中心[资助号0004]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00682获取。

papers.abstract_original: This study investigates the unintended effect of the introduction of the 2011 Social Insurance Law on corporate pollution emissions. Using a difference-in-differences framework, our analysis reveals that enhanced social insurance contributions lead to higher industrial pollution emissions, as measured by chemical oxygen demand and wastewater emissions. The mechanism analysis indicates that the enforcement of the law increases firms’ labor costs and financial distress, motivating them to reduce efforts on end-of-pipe treatment activities and measures taken during the production process, which results in higher pollution emission intensity. Our study highlights the potential conflict between employee protection and corporate environmental goals. Further analysis suggests that stronger environmental monitoring and environmental, social, and governance disclosure requirements can partially mitigate this tradeoff, providing valuable insights for policymakers.This paper was accepted by Caroline Flammer, sustainability.Funding: Y. Li acknowledges research support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72403026]. Y. Qin acknowledges research support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72342031].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00714.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究考察2011年《社会保险法》的出台对企业污染排放的意外影响。采用双重差分框架，我们的分析表明，社会保险缴费的加强导致工业污染排放增加，以化学需氧量和废水排放量衡量。机制分析表明，该法的执行增加了企业的劳动力成本和财务困境，促使它们减少末端治理活动以及生产过程中所采取措施的努力，从而导致污染排放强度上升。我们的研究凸显了员工保护与企业环境目标之间可能存在的冲突。进一步分析表明，更强的环境监测以及环境、社会和治理（ESG）信息披露要求可以部分缓解这一权衡，为政策制定者提供了有价值的启示。本文由可持续发展领域编辑Caroline Flammer接受。资助：Y. Li感谢国家自然科学基金[资助号72403026]的研究支持。Y. Qin感谢国家自然科学基金[资助号72342031]的研究支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00714获取。

papers.abstract_original: We consider parametric portfolio policies of any complexity using deep neural networks to optimize investor utility. Risk aversion acts as an economic regularization mechanism, with higher risk aversion constraining model complexity. Empirically, Deep Parametric Portfolio Policies generate 43-102 basis points higher monthly certainty equivalent returns compared with linear policies. Looking beyond expected returns, nonlinear portfolio policies better capture the complex relationship between investor preferences and firm characteristics but the benefits of using complex models vary with investor preferences. Results hold across different utility functions and remain robust to transaction costs and short-selling restrictions. Overall, economic regularization constrains model complexity much like statistical regularization but emerges endogenously from investor preferences.This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00721.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考虑使用深度神经网络来优化投资者效用的任意复杂度的参数化投资组合策略。风险厌恶充当一种经济正则化机制，更高的风险厌恶会约束模型复杂度。在实证上，与线性策略相比，深度参数化投资组合策略每月产生高出43-102个基点的确定性等价收益。超越预期收益来看，非线性投资组合策略能更好地捕捉投资者偏好与企业特征之间的复杂关系，但使用复杂模型的收益随投资者偏好而异。结果在不同效用函数下均成立，并且对交易成本和卖空限制保持稳健。总体而言，经济正则化像统计正则化一样约束模型复杂度，但它是从投资者偏好中内生地产生的。本文由金融学领域的Kay Giesecke接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00721获取。

papers.abstract_original: In online markets, consumers tend to search and purchase prominently positioned products. We develop an experimental paradigm to distinguish between two mechanisms driving this behavior: position-specific search costs and beliefs about expected returns to search. Using incentivized experiments, we find that both mechanisms exist, and short-term randomization of rankings alone does not separate the two mechanisms. Failing to account for beliefs leads to biased estimates of search costs and incorrect consumer welfare predictions under alternative recommendation systems, such as platform self-preferencing. We discuss solutions for estimating unbiased search costs in real-world search settings.This paper was accepted by Raphael Thomadsen, marketing.Funding: This work was supported by the UC Berkeley Fisher Center for Business Analytics.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00761.
papers.abstract_zh: 在在线市场中，消费者倾向于搜索并购买位置显眼的产品。我们开发了一种实验范式，以区分驱动这一行为的两种机制：位置特定的搜索成本，以及关于搜索预期回报的信念。通过激励性实验，我们发现这两种机制都存在，而仅对排名进行短期随机化并不能区分这两种机制。未能考虑信念会导致搜索成本估计有偏，并在替代推荐系统（如平台自我优待）下对消费者福利作出错误预测。我们讨论了在现实世界搜索环境中估计无偏搜索成本的解决方案。本文由市场营销领域的Raphael Thomadsen接受。资助：本工作得到加州大学伯克利分校Fisher商业分析中心的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00761获取。
papers.title_original: Consumer Inferences from Product Rankings: The Role of Beliefs in Search Behavior
papers.title_zh: 消费者从产品排名中作出的推断：信念在搜索行为中的作用

papers.abstract_original: Left-digit bias in price perception has been widely documented. We study how it affects firms’ joint pricing and quality choices. The bias increases quality at interior prices but decreases quality at 99-ending prices. At 99-ending price points, the bias discourages price adjustment, leading firms to absorb cost shocks through quality changes and thereby, contributing to shrinkflation (quality reductions with nominal prices held fixed). In channels, the bias can either exacerbate double marginalization via a prisoner’s dilemma or—because retailers are rigid at 99-ending prices—induce wholesale price adjustments that may strengthen coordination. When manufacturers choose quality, for empirically relevant bias magnitudes, the bias can generate 99-ending retail pricing and raise total channel profits; its coordination effects depend on whether the induced move to 99-ending prices is upward or downward. In decentralized channels, consumer surplus can sometimes increase alongside total channel profit.This paper was accepted by Greg Shaffer, marketing.Funding: X. Peng acknowledges the support from National Natural Science Foundation of China [72531009] and China Scholarship Council.Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00771.
papers.abstract_zh: 价格感知中的左位数偏差已被广泛记录。我们研究它如何影响企业的联合定价和质量选择。该偏差会提高内部价格处的质量，但会降低以99结尾价格处的质量。在以99结尾的价格点上，该偏差抑制价格调整，导致企业通过质量变化吸收成本冲击，从而促成缩水式通胀（名义价格固定而质量下降）。在渠道中，该偏差既可能通过囚徒困境加剧双重边际化，也可能——由于零售商在以99结尾价格处具有刚性——引致可能加强协调的批发价格调整。当制造商选择质量时，对于经验相关的偏差幅度，该偏差可以产生以99结尾的零售定价并提高渠道总利润；其协调效应取决于被引致的向以99结尾价格的移动是向上还是向下。在分散化渠道中，消费者剩余有时可能随渠道总利润一同增加。本文由市场营销领域的Greg Shaffer接受。资助：X. Peng感谢国家自然科学基金[72531009]和中国国家留学基金管理委员会的支持。补充材料：在线附录可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00771获取。
papers.title_original: Left-Digit Bias, Quality Choice, and Channel Coordination
papers.title_zh: 左位数偏差、质量选择与渠道协调

papers.abstract_original: Mobile payments are reshaping the global payment landscape with some developing economies leapfrogging advanced economies in adoption. We build and estimate a dynamic model of sequential payment innovations—progressing from cash to card to mobile—to explain this pattern. The model matches cross-country payment technology adoption patterns and shows how advanced economies’ early success in adopting card payments dampens subsequent mobile payment adoption. Extending the framework to a two-sided market with price coherence, we show that payment externalities justify policy intervention: Promoting mobile payment adoption and usage (e.g., via subsidies or price differentiation) enhances welfare, especially in developing economies.This paper was accepted by Lin William Cong, Virtual Special Issue on Digital Finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00781.
papers.abstract_zh: 移动支付正在重塑全球支付格局，一些发展中经济体在采纳方面实现了对发达经济体的蛙跳。我们构建并估计了一个序贯支付创新的动态模型——从现金到银行卡再到移动支付——以解释这一模式。该模型与跨国支付技术采纳模式相匹配，并表明发达经济体在采纳银行卡支付方面的早期成功抑制了随后对移动支付的采纳。将该框架扩展到具有价格一致性的双边市场，我们表明支付外部性为政策干预提供了理由：促进移动支付的采纳和使用（例如通过补贴或价格差异化）能提升福利，尤其是在发展中经济体。本文由Lin William Cong接受，数字金融虚拟特刊。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00781获取。
papers.title_original: Technology Adoption and Leapfrogging: Racing for Mobile Payments
papers.title_zh: 技术采纳与蛙跳：竞逐移动支付

papers.abstract_original: When designing product rankings, online retailers and platforms choose which outcome to maximize: revenues from commissions or markups, the number of transactions, or consumer welfare. These objectives need not align, creating potential trade-offs. This paper studies how rankings differ between objectives and quantifies the resulting trade-offs. I provide descriptive evidence showing that lower-priced and high-utility alternatives gain more demand when ranked higher, suggesting that ranking them higher increases transactions and consumer welfare but may decrease revenues. To quantify these trade-offs, I develop and estimate a structural demand model in which consumers search and discover products, and construct rankings for each objective. The results show that these counterfactual rankings all increase consumer welfare, transactions, and platform revenues relative to a neutral benchmark and the status quo and that trade-offs between these rankings are limited.This paper was accepted by Jean-Pierre Dube, marketing.Funding: R. P. Greminger received financial support from the Nederlandse Organisatie voor Wetenschappelijk Onderzoek [Research Talent Grant 406.18.568].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00782.
papers.abstract_zh: 在设计产品排名时，在线零售商和平台选择最大化哪种结果：来自佣金或加价的收入、交易数量，还是消费者福利。这些目标不一定一致，从而产生潜在的权衡。本文研究了排名在不同目标之间的差异，并量化了由此产生的权衡。我提供了描述性证据，表明价格较低和高实用性的替代品在排名更高时获得更多需求，这表明将它们排名更高会增加交易和消费者福利，但可能减少收入。为了量化这些权衡，我开发并估计了一个结构需求模型，其中消费者搜索和发现产品，并为每个目标构建排名。结果表明，相对于中性基准和现状，这些反事实排名都增加了消费者福利、交易和平台收入，并且这些排名之间的权衡有限。本文由Jean-Pierre Dube（营销领域）接受。资助：R. P. Greminger获得了荷兰科学研究组织[研究人才资助406.18.568]的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00782获取。
papers.title_original: Trade-Offs Between Ranking Objectives: Descriptive Evidence and Structural Estimation
papers.title_zh: 排名目标之间的权衡：描述性证据与结构估计

papers.abstract_original: With the rapid expansion of online food delivery (OFD) platforms, subscription models have emerged as a strategic tool to retain users and shape consumption behavior. Despite their growing prevalence, the broader impacts of these subscriptions—both within the OFD sector and across downstream consumer activities—remain underexplored. Leveraging a difference-in-differences approach and a large-scale individual-level transaction data set, we identify a significant shift in consumption from a competing platform to the focal platform following the introduction of a subscription service. This shift did not result in cannibalization; instead, overall food consumption within the OFD market increased. Geospatial analysis shows that subscribers were more likely to engage in offline spillovers, including increased local dining and activity in nearby noncompeting economic sectors. These patterns suggest that subscriptions in physical services, like OFD, not only reshape digital engagement, but also, they influence consumer mobility and stimulate localized economic ecosystems. Mechanistic testing supports the interpretation that these effects are driven by increased variety-seeking behavior for offline restaurants that predominantly serve non-OFD cuisines within a proximal location, suggesting that such behavior is constrained by transportation costs. Overall, this study offers novel insights into how subscription models in physical service platforms can expand market demand, foster crosschannel engagement, and generate positive spillovers in adjacent sectors. The findings offer actionable guidance for platform designers and policymakers to enhance consumer welfare and support local economic vitality. They also provide new evidence for restaurants that additional platform usage costs may be offset by latent economic benefits from heightened consumer engagement.This paper was accepted by D. J. Wu, information systems.Funding: F. J. Costello acknowledges funding by Fundação para a Ciência e a Tecnologia (UID/00124/2025, UID/ PRR/00124/2025, Nova School of Business and Economics DOI: https://doi.org/10.54499/UID/00124/2025), UID/PRR2/00124/2025: DOI: https://doi.org/10.54499/UID/PRR2/00124/2025 and LISBOA2030 (DataLab2030 - LISBOA2030-FEDER-01314200).Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00954.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着在线外卖（OFD）平台的快速扩张，订阅模式已成为留存用户和塑造消费行为的战略工具。尽管其日益普及，这些订阅的更广泛影响——无论是在外卖行业内部还是在下游消费者活动中——仍研究不足。利用双重差分方法和大规模个体层面交易数据集，我们发现，在推出订阅服务后，消费从竞争平台显著转移至焦点平台。这一转移并未导致内部蚕食；相反，外卖市场的整体食品消费增加了。地理空间分析显示，订阅用户更可能产生线下溢出效应，包括本地餐饮增加以及附近非竞争经济部门的活动增加。这些模式表明，像外卖这类实体服务中的订阅不仅重塑数字参与，还影响消费者流动性并刺激本地化经济生态。机制检验支持以下解释：这些效应由对主要提供非外卖菜系的邻近线下餐厅的多样化寻求行为增加所驱动，表明此类行为受交通成本约束。总体而言，本研究就实体服务平台中的订阅模式如何扩大市场需求、促进跨渠道参与并在相邻部门产生正向溢出提供了新见解。研究结果为平台设计者和政策制定者提升消费者福利和支持本地经济活力提供了可操作的指导。它们还为餐厅提供了新证据：额外的平台使用成本可能被消费者参与度提高带来的潜在经济收益所抵消。本文由信息系统领域的D. J. Wu接受。资助：F. J. Costello感谢Fundação para a Ciência e a Tecnologia的资助（UID/00124/2025、UID/PRR/00124/2025、Nova School of Business and Economics DOI: https://doi.org/10.54499/UID/00124/2025）、UID/PRR2/00124/2025: DOI: https://doi.org/10.54499/UID/PRR2/00124/2025以及LISBOA2030（DataLab2030 - LISBOA2030-FEDER-01314200）。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00954获取。

papers.abstract_original: As organizations increasingly adopt pay transparency policies, a key challenge is determining what compensation information to disclose. However, little is known about the effectiveness of disclosing only parts of total compensation, such as salary, while excluding other components, such as benefits. Using an online experiment on Prolific, this paper uncovers a concerning outcome: when decision makers are incentivized to allocate bonus earnings between workers, partial transparency systematically increases the influence of component equality on the allocation choices. This causes decision makers to focus more heavily on ensuring equality within the transparent component. This focus is significantly amplified for the transparent component relative to a nontransparent pay component, and this tendency persists even when doing so worsens overall pay inequality. We further show that social preferences play a central role in generating this asymmetry, whereas monetary incentives for decision makers primarily exert a level effect that shifts allocation behavior without altering the asymmetric pattern. In addition, decision makers’ beliefs about the importance of visible relative earnings differences help explain variation in allocation behaviors. In contrast, this asymmetric focus on achieving component equality disappears when either all or none of the compensation is transparent. Our results suggest that firms implementing partial transparency may inadvertently reinforce pay disparities rather than reducing them. These findings highlight the need for organizations to carefully design transparency policies to avoid distortions in fairness perceptions and pay allocation decisions.This paper was accepted by Marie Claire Villeval, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Funding: X. Pan gratefully acknowledges financial support from Bryant University [Summer Research Grant].Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01032.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着组织越来越多地采用薪酬透明度政策，一个关键挑战是确定应披露哪些薪酬信息。然而，对于仅披露总薪酬的一部分（例如工资）而排除其他组成部分（例如福利）的有效性，人们知之甚少。本文通过在Prolific上进行的一项在线实验，揭示了一个令人担忧的结果：当决策者被激励在工人之间分配奖金收入时，部分透明度会系统性地增加组成部分平等对分配选择的影响。这导致决策者更加注重确保透明组成部分内部的平等。相对于不透明的薪酬组成部分，这种对透明组成部分的关注显著增强，而且即使这样做会加剧整体薪酬不平等，这种倾向仍然持续存在。我们进一步表明，社会偏好在这种不对称性的产生中发挥了核心作用，而对决策者的货币激励主要产生一种水平效应，即改变分配行为而不改变这种不对称模式。此外，决策者关于可见相对收入差异重要性的信念有助于解释分配行为的差异。相比之下，当所有薪酬或没有薪酬透明时，这种对实现组成部分平等的不对称关注就会消失。我们的结果表明，实施部分透明度的公司可能会无意中强化薪酬差距，而不是减少差距。这些发现凸显了组织需要仔细设计透明度政策，以避免公平感知和薪酬分配决策中的扭曲。本文由行为经济学与决策分析领域的Marie Claire Villeval接受。资助：X. Pan感谢Bryant University[暑期研究资助]的财务支持。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01032获取。
papers.title_original: Does Partial Pay Transparency Reduce Pay Inequality? An Experimental Investigation
papers.title_zh: 部分薪酬透明度会减少薪酬不平等吗？一项实验研究

papers.abstract_original: Sustainability certifications have gained increasing popularity for agricultural product sourcing. To help improve smallholder farmers’ livelihoods, these certifications set a premium that firms must pay to farmers for certified crops on top of the market price. This premium can be structured in different ways: a popular approach adopted by several major certifications is called a fixed premium, under which farmers receive a fixed level of premium independent of the market price. However, this approach has been criticized for not sufficiently protecting farmers when the market price is low. Accordingly, an alternative approach called a flexible premium, under which farmers receive a higher premium when the market price is lower, has been promoted by farmer advocacy groups and recently implemented by some certifications. We analyze and compare the effectiveness of these premium approaches and offer several managerial insights. First, contrary to expectation, we show that the flexible premium approach can lead to a lower expected farmer income than the fixed premium approach. Even when a flexible premium improves farmer income, it can lead to a lower expected sustainable sourcing quantity and firm profit. Second, we nevertheless identify that a flexible premium can lead to a win–win–win outcome for farmer income, sustainable sourcing quantity, and firm profit but only in settings with ample certified supply relative to demand. Finally, motivated by the trend of firms creating their own sustainability labels, we show that such self-labeling can lead to a higher sustainable sourcing quantity but lower farmer income compared with nongovernmental organization labeling.This paper was accepted by Jayashankar Swaminathan, operations management.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01093.
papers.abstract_zh: 可持续性认证在农产品采购中日益流行。为帮助改善小农户的生计，这些认证设定了一种溢价，企业必须就认证作物在市场价之外向农民支付该溢价。这种溢价可以以不同方式构建：若干主要认证采用的一种流行方法称为固定溢价，在该方法下，农民获得固定水平的溢价，与市场价格无关。然而，这种方法因在市场价较低时未能充分保护农民而受到批评。相应地，农民倡导团体推动了一种称为灵活溢价的替代方法，在该方法下，当市场价格较低时农民获得更高的溢价，并且最近已被一些认证实施。我们分析并比较这些溢价方法的有效性，并提供若干管理启示。首先，与预期相反，我们表明灵活溢价方法可能导致比固定溢价方法更低的预期农民收入。即使灵活溢价提高了农民收入，它也可能导致更低的预期可持续采购量和企业利润。其次，我们仍然识别出，灵活溢价可以在农民收入、可持续采购量和企业利润方面带来三赢结果，但仅在认证供应相对于需求充足的设定中如此。最后，受企业创建自有可持续性标签趋势的启发，我们表明，与非政府组织标签相比，这种自我标签可能导致更高的可持续采购量但更低的农民收入。本文由运营管理领域的Jayashankar Swaminathan接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01093获取。
papers.title_original: Sustainable Sourcing of Agricultural Products: Fixed vs. Flexible Premiums
papers.title_zh: 农产品的可持续采购：固定溢价与灵活溢价

papers.abstract_original: Consumers’ willful ignorance about the consequences of their actions may impede moral behavior. We test this concern in a real-world context based on a laboratory experiment and field data. We find that willful ignorance about farming practices increases consumption of meat from intensive farming, both in the laboratory and at university canteens. Individuals who prefer to avoid costless evidence are particularly responsive to it, yet their behavioral response vanishes within two weeks. Both findings demonstrate how difficult it is for organizations and governments to address willful ignorance through information interventions.This paper was accepted by Marie Claire Villeval, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Funding: This work was funded by the Austrian Science Fund [Grant 10.55776/F63] and the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft [Grant CRC TR 224].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01176.
papers.abstract_zh: 消费者对其行为后果的故意无知可能会阻碍道德行为。我们基于一项实验室实验和实地数据，在现实世界情境中检验了这一担忧。我们发现，对养殖方式的故意无知增加了来自集约化养殖的肉类消费，这在实验室和大学食堂中均是如此。偏好回避无成本证据的个体对此尤其敏感，然而他们的行为反应在两周内就消失了。这两项发现表明，组织和政府通过信息干预来解决故意无知是多么困难。本文由行为经济学与决策分析领域编辑Marie Claire Villeval接受。资助：本工作由奥地利科学基金[资助号10.55776/F63]和德国研究联合会[资助号CRC TR 224]资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01176获取。
papers.title_original: Willful Ignorance and Moral Behavior
papers.title_zh: 故意无知与道德行为

papers.abstract_original: Unlike traditional products, data have unique traits that make their trading a novel retail activity with distinct operational dynamics. Data evaluation is a situation in which a data buyer can ascertain the value of data from a seller. However, as indicated by Arrow’s information paradox, the intangible nature of data presents significant challenges to data evaluation, particularly in data trading between competitors, a scenario that is becoming increasingly common and relevant. Although offering free samples is widely recommended as an effective approach for data evaluation, its actual impacts remain unclear. We develop a theoretical model to examine the mechanics of data evaluation when a seller sells data to a buyer and the two then compete in product selling. In this model, the low-type seller (offering data of low value) has an incentive to pretend to be the high-type seller, leading to signaling challenges in data trading. The results show that data evaluation can be achieved through a signaling approach in which the high-type seller sells a portion of the data to reveal his or her type, whereas the low-type seller sells all the data. Moreover, we show that offering free samples is also an efficient way to achieve data evaluation; in this case, the high-type seller has to offer a certain volume of free samples, whereas the low-type seller does not. The intuition hinges on the effects of data monetization, which induces the seller to sell more data, and an information advantage over the buyer in product selling, which hinders data selling. In addition, offering free samples helps increase data transactions (i.e., selling volume and price) between the seller and the buyer but undermines the profit of the high-type seller. Finally, facilitating data evaluation is not always beneficial for sellers; maintaining buyer uncertainty regarding the value of data may be profitable for both types of sellers.This paper was accepted by Jeannette Song, operations management.Funding: This research is supported in part by National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant nos. 72572015, 72325013, 72532002, 72202017, 72272013, and 72321002], the Fundamental Research Funds for the Central Universities.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01256.
papers.abstract_zh: 与传统产品不同，数据具有独特特征，使其交易成为一种具有独特运营动态的新型零售活动。数据评估是指数据买方能够从卖方处确定数据价值的情形。然而，正如阿罗信息悖论所指出的，数据的无形性给数据评估带来了重大挑战，尤其是在竞争者之间的数据交易中，这种情形正变得越来越普遍和相关。尽管提供免费样本被广泛推荐为数据评估的有效方法，但其实际影响仍不明确。我们建立了一个理论模型，考察当卖方将数据出售给买方，随后双方在产品销售中竞争时数据评估的机制。在该模型中，低类型卖方（提供低价值数据）有动机假装成高类型卖方，导致数据交易中的信号传递挑战。结果表明，数据评估可以通过信号传递方法实现，其中高类型卖方出售一部分数据以揭示其类型，而低类型卖方出售全部数据。此外，我们表明提供免费样本也是实现数据评估的有效方式；在这种情况下，高类型卖方必须提供一定数量的免费样本，而低类型卖方则不需要。其直觉在于数据货币化的效应，这促使卖方出售更多数据，以及在产品销售中相对于买方的信息优势，这阻碍了数据出售。此外，提供免费样本有助于增加卖方与买方之间的数据交易（即销售量和价格），但会损害高类型卖方的利润。最后，促进数据评估并不总是对卖方有利；维持买方对数据价值的不确定性可能对两类卖方都有利。本文由Jeannette Song（运营管理领域）接受。资助：本研究部分得到国家自然科学基金[资助号72572015、72325013、72532002、72202017、72272013和72321002]以及中央高校基本科研业务费的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01256获取。
papers.title_original: Data Evaluation: Mechanisms and Implications
papers.title_zh: 数据评估：机制与含义

papers.abstract_original: Organizations increasingly face polarized beliefs about issues such as sustainability and environmental action. This paper demonstrates that such polarization can, paradoxically, be leveraged as a managerial advantage. When individuals’ subjective beliefs diverge from market probabilities, organizations can design state-specific payouts, where bonuses or refunds are tied to verifiable future outcomes. Under such schemes, individuals receive larger payouts in the states they overestimate relative to market probabilities. This increases an initiative’s subjective expected value without affecting its objective expected cost. Across multiple large-scale experiments spanning corporate and public contexts, state-specific payouts substantially increase support for contested initiatives, particularly among individuals whose beliefs deviate from market probabilities. Additional studies explore ethical and practical boundaries. Together, the results introduce a principle of belief-based design. By applying insights from financial engineering to managerial decision making, organizations can align incentives with heterogeneous beliefs and transform polarization from a barrier into a strategic asset.This paper was accepted by Aurelien Baillon, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01277.
papers.abstract_zh: 组织日益面临关于可持续性和环境行动等议题的极化信念。本文表明，这种极化可以悖论性地被用作一种管理优势。当个体的主观信念偏离市场概率时，组织可以设计状态特定支付，其中奖金或退款与可验证的未来结果挂钩。在此类方案下，个体在其高估的状态中相对于市场概率获得更大的支付。这增加了倡议的主观期望价值，而不影响其客观期望成本。在跨越企业和公共情境的多项大规模实验中，状态特定支付大幅增加了对有争议倡议的支持，尤其是在信念偏离市场概率的个体中。其他研究探讨了伦理和实践边界。总之，这些结果引入了一种基于信念的设计原则。通过将金融工程洞见应用于管理决策，组织可以使激励与异质信念相一致，并将极化从障碍转变为策略性资产。本文由行为经济学与决策分析领域的Aurelien Baillon接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01277获取。
papers.title_original: Beating Expectations: Turning Polarized Beliefs into Support for Sustainable Initiatives
papers.title_zh: 超越预期：将极化信念转化为对可持续倡议的支持

papers.abstract_original: We propose a new Fast and Simple Elicitation procedure (FSE) for the measurement of decision models. Our procedure bounds the function of the decision model, iteratively halves the maximal distance between the bounds, and incrementally restricts the feasible space of associated parameters. It requires no distributional assumptions and relies on linear programming and approximating splines, improving tractability and descriptiveness. We apply FSE to elicit the probability weighting function in three studies: a simulation and two experiments. Our results demonstrate FSE’s ability to faithfully recover the function. Both in the laboratory and online, FSE reflects the choices made by a respondent more precisely than alternative elicitation procedures and standard functional forms. Importantly, FSE also predicts the out-of-sample choices of a representative online sample more accurately than its alternatives. Taken together, our results shed new light on the prevalence of possibility and certainty effects, and convey general implications for experimental modeling and design.This paper was accepted by Manel Baucells, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Funding: This work was supported by INSEAD R&D and by a grant from Sorbonne University.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01348.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新的快速而简单的引出程序（FSE），用于测量决策模型。我们的程序对决策模型函数进行界定，迭代地将界定之间的最大距离减半，并逐步限制相关参数的可行空间。它不需要分布假设，并依赖线性规划和近似样条，提高了可处理性和描述性。我们将FSE应用于三项研究中引出概率权重函数：一项模拟和两项实验。我们的结果表明，FSE能够忠实地恢复该函数。无论是在实验室还是在线上，FSE都比替代引出程序和标准函数形式更精确地反映受访者所做的选择。重要的是，FSE还比其替代方案更准确地预测代表性在线样本的样本外选择。综合来看，我们的结果为可能性效应和确定性效应的普遍性提供了新的启示，并对实验建模和设计传达了一般性含义。本文由行为经济学与决策分析领域的Manel Baucells接受。资助：本研究得到INSEAD研发基金以及索邦大学一项资助的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01348获取。
papers.title_original: Fast and Simple Adaptive Elicitations
papers.title_zh: 快速而简单的自适应引出法

papers.abstract_original: The economic literature on delegation focuses on the subordinate’s improved motivation when liberated from managerial intervention in decision making. However, many managers motivate employees while proactively intervening in the decision-making process. We build a principal-agent model to analyze when managerial intervention is, and is not, motivational to the agent. Although managerial intervention may demotivate the agent when leading to actions that waste employee effort, managerial intervention can also motivate the agent by incentivizing principal effort that complements the agent’s effort. In fact, delegation may demotivate the agent when the principal and agent work collaboratively. Our results speak to understanding the role of strategic complementarity in determining when various managerial practices do, and do not, motivate employees.This paper was accepted by Maria Guadalupe, business strategy.
papers.abstract_zh: 关于授权的经济学文献关注的是下属在决策中摆脱管理者干预后动机的改善。然而，许多管理者在激励员工的同时，会主动干预决策过程。我们构建了一个委托—代理模型，以分析管理者干预何时对代理人具有激励作用、何时不具有。尽管管理者干预在导致浪费员工努力的行为时可能使代理人失去动力，但管理者干预也可以通过激励与代理人努力互补的委托人努力来激励代理人。事实上，当委托人和代理人协作工作时，授权可能使代理人失去动力。我们的结果有助于理解战略互补性在决定各种管理实践何时激励、何时不激励员工方面的作用。本文由Maria Guadalupe（商业战略）接受。

papers.abstract_original: In Chinese culture, the digit 8 is considered lucky and the digit 4 unlucky. We find that this numerological superstition has a significant impact across China’s stock, bond, foreign exchange, and commodity futures markets, affecting asset prices in both the primary and secondary markets. The superstition effect, that is, asset prices ending in a lucky (unlucky) digit are far more (less) frequent than expected by chance, is prevalent across finance markets. We show that this phenomenon is driven by two mechanisms: sophisticated investors’ reliance on superstition as an anchor to manage ambiguity, and the overoptimism of unsophisticated investors. While the superstition effect does not lead to any systematic mispricing for assets traded primarily by sophisticated investors, it is closely associated with overpricing for assets heavily traded by unsophisticated investors.This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance.Funding: J. (J.) Chang received financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72573148].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01449.
papers.abstract_zh: 在中国文化中，数字8被认为吉利，数字4被认为不吉利。我们发现，这种数字迷信对中国的股票、债券、外汇和商品期货市场均有显著影响，影响了一级和二级市场的资产价格。迷信效应，即以吉利（不吉利）数字结尾的资产价格出现的频率远高于（低于）随机预期，在金融市场中普遍存在。我们表明，这一现象由两种机制驱动：成熟投资者依赖迷信作为锚点来管理模糊性，以及不成熟投资者的过度乐观。虽然迷信效应不会导致主要由成熟投资者交易的资产出现任何系统性错误定价，但它与由不成熟投资者大量交易的资产的高估密切相关。本文由金融领域的Will Cong接受。资助：J. (J.) Chang获得了国家自然科学基金[资助号72573148]的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01449获取。
papers.title_original: Superstition Everywhere
papers.title_zh: 迷信无处不在

papers.abstract_original: Economists and econometricians typically use aggregate economic and financial variables for gross domestic product (GDP) prediction. However, aggregation often results in a loss of valuable information, diminishing key features such as heterogeneity, interactions, nonlinearity, and structural breaks. We propose a novel microforecasting approach, using large panel data of firm accounting earnings from corporate financial reports to forecast GDP. By employing machine learning methods, we can effectively exploit this large microlevel information set to achieve substantially more accurate GDP forecasts. Our findings highlight the advantages and potential of utilizing microlevel data for macroprediction, diverging from the conventional macroforecasting paradigm that relies on aggregate data to forecast macrovariables.This paper was accepted by Will Cong for the Special Issue on Digital Finance.Funding: Y. Hong is supported by the MOE Social Sciences Innovative Group on Complex Systems Modeling in Economic Management in the Era of Digital Intelligence, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences [Grant E5820801] and the National Science Foundation of China (NSFC) Basic Science Center Project “Econometric Modeling and Economic Policy Studies” [Grant 71988101]. N. Huang is supported by the NSFC [Grant 72473166]. Y. Wang is supported by the Shenzhen Municipal Government, National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 20220810114654001].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01549.
papers.abstract_zh: 经济学家和计量经济学家通常使用总量经济和金融变量来预测国内生产总值（GDP）。然而，加总往往导致有价值信息的损失，削弱了异质性、交互作用、非线性和结构突变等关键特征。我们提出了一种新颖的微观预测方法，利用来自公司财务报告的企业会计盈余大型面板数据来预测GDP。通过采用机器学习方法，我们能够有效利用这一庞大的微观层面信息集，从而实现显著更准确的GDP预测。我们的发现凸显了利用微观层面数据进行宏观预测的优势和潜力，这与依赖总量数据预测宏观变量的传统宏观预测范式不同。本文由Will Cong接受，用于数字金融特刊。资助：Y. Hong获得教育部数字经济时代经济管理复杂系统建模社会科学创新团队、中国科学院大学[资助号E5820801]以及国家自然科学基金（NSFC）基础科学中心项目“计量经济建模与经济政策研究”[资助号71988101]的资助。N. Huang获得国家自然科学基金[资助号72473166]的资助。Y. Wang获得深圳市政府、国家自然科学基金[资助号20220810114654001]的资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01549获取。
papers.title_original: Forecasting GDP Growth Rates Using Accounting Earnings: A Large Panel Microdata Approach
papers.title_zh: 利用会计盈余预测GDP增长率：一种大型面板微观数据方法

papers.abstract_original: Unexpected fund flows may force mutual funds to liquidate assets, thereby depressing demand for securities that become illiquid during outflows. This paper shows that the liquidity beta on flows—defined as the comovement of a security’s liquidity costs with aggregate fund flow shocks—earns a significant risk premium in corporate bonds using firm-month fixed effects and a granular instrumental variables approach. The liquidity beta varies substantially even among bonds issued by the same firm and is largely driven by the interaction between redemption-driven forced sales and bond-level illiquidity. These findings highlight how fund flow shocks amplify liquidity risk through mutual funds' forced sales, shaping the cross section of expected corporate bond returns.This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance.Funding: This work was supported by the University of Melbourne and London Business School.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01690.
papers.abstract_zh: 意外的基金流量可能迫使共同基金清算资产，从而压低在资金流出期间变得缺乏流动性的证券的需求。本文表明，流量流动性贝塔——定义为证券的流动性成本与总体基金流量冲击的联动性——在企业债券中获得了显著的风险溢价，这一结论使用了企业-月度固定效应和细粒度工具变量方法。即使对于同一家企业发行的债券，流动性贝塔也存在显著差异，并且很大程度上由赎回驱动的强制抛售与债券层面流动性不足之间的交互作用所驱动。这些发现凸显了基金流量冲击如何通过共同基金的强制抛售放大流动性风险，从而塑造企业债券预期回报的横截面。本文由金融领域编辑Lukas Schmid接受。资助：本工作得到了墨尔本大学和伦敦商学院的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01690获取。
papers.title_original: Fund Flows, Liquidity, and Asset Prices
papers.title_zh: 基金流量、流动性与资产价格

papers.abstract_original: We define an online learning and optimization problem with discrete and irreversible decisions contributing toward a coverage target. In each period, a decision-maker selects facilities to open, receives information on the success of each one, and updates a classification model to guide future decisions. The goal is to minimize facility openings under a chance constraint reflecting the coverage target, in an asymptotic regime characterized by a large target number of facilities but a finite planning horizon. We prove that, under statistical conditions, the online classifier converges to the Bayes-optimal classifier at the standard square-root rate. Thus, we formulate our online learning and optimization problem with a generalized learning rate and a residual classification error. We derive an asymptotically optimal algorithm and an asymptotically tight lower bound. The regret grows sublinearly under perfect learning and remains sublinear more generally; in particular, the regret converges exponentially fast to its infinite-horizon limit. We extend this result to a more complicated facility location setting in a bipartite facility-customer graph with a target on customer coverage. Throughout, constructive proofs identify a policy featuring limited exploration initially and fast exploitation later on once uncertainty gets mitigated. These results uncover the benefits of limited online learning and optimization through pilot programs prior to full-fledged expansion.This paper was accepted by Wolfram Wiesemann, Data Science.Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01729.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们定义了一个具有离散且不可逆决策、以覆盖目标为贡献的在线学习与优化问题。在每个时期，决策者选择要开设的设施，接收关于每个设施成功与否的信息，并更新分类模型以指导未来决策。目标是在反映覆盖目标的概率约束下最小化设施开设数量，所处渐近机制的特征是目标设施数量很大但规划期有限。我们证明，在统计条件下，在线分类器以标准平方根速率收敛到贝叶斯最优分类器。因此，我们以广义学习率和残差分类误差来表述我们的在线学习与优化问题。我们推导出一个渐近最优算法和一个渐近紧下界。遗憾在完美学习下呈次线性增长，并且在更一般情况下仍保持次线性；特别地，遗憾以指数速度收敛到其无限期极限。我们将这一结果扩展到更复杂的设施选址情形，即在具有客户覆盖目标的二分设施-客户图中。贯穿全文，构造性证明识别出一种最初探索有限、随后一旦不确定性得到缓解便快速利用的策略。这些结果揭示了在全面扩张之前通过试点项目进行有限在线学习与优化的益处。本文由数据科学领域的Wolfram Wiesemann接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01729获取。
papers.title_original: Learning to Cover: Online Learning and Optimization with Irreversible Decisions
papers.title_zh: 学习覆盖：不可逆决策下的在线学习与优化

papers.abstract_original: Identifying the cause of discrimination is crucial to designing effective policies and to understanding discrimination dynamics. This paper provides a potential link between existing models of taste-based and statistical discrimination by studying directional belief formation through biased information search and processing. By selectively acquiring and processing information, individuals form directional beliefs and consequently discriminate based on these beliefs. Through a series of experiments in which individuals endogenously acquire and process various signals, I document discrimination stemming from directional beliefs and demonstrate important differences in how it manifests compared with taste-based and statistical discrimination. Finally, I show that limiting individuals’ scope to interpret information reduces such discrimination.This paper was accepted by Marie Claire Villeval, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Funding: Financial support from the Sustainable Architecture for Finance in Europe Experiment Center Frankfurt [Grant 232406], the Interdisciplinary Public Policy Mainz [Grant A2021011], and the Mainzer Wissenschaftsstiftung is gratefully acknowledged.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01818.
papers.abstract_zh: 识别歧视的成因对于设计有效政策和理解歧视动态至关重要。本文通过研究经由有偏信息搜索与处理而形成的方向性信念，在现有的偏好型歧视与统计性歧视模型之间提供了一种潜在联系。通过选择性地获取和处理信息，个体会形成方向性信念，并据此进行歧视。通过一系列让个体内生地获取和处理各种信号的实验，我记录了源于方向性信念的歧视，并展示了其表现形式与偏好型歧视和统计性歧视相比的重要差异。最后，我表明限制个体解读信息的范围可以减少此类歧视。本文由行为经济学与决策分析领域的Marie Claire Villeval接受。资助：感谢欧洲可持续金融架构实验中心法兰克福[资助号232406]、美因茨跨学科公共政策[资助号A2021011]以及美因茨科学基金会的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01818获取。
