papers.title_original: Why Do We Discriminate? Directional Beliefs and Biased Information Processing
papers.title_zh: 我们为什么会歧视？方向性信念与有偏信息处理

papers.abstract_original: How does generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) reshape the skills that organizations seek as they adapt to a new general-purpose technology? GenAI effectively retrieves data, performs analysis, and conveys information, so it can substitute for workers doing these activities and complement workers relying on them. A natural consequence is skill deprioritization, a systematic reduction in firms’ demand for human skills that GenAI can effectively address as organizations adjust the division of labor and integration of effort. We draw on a theoretically grounded classification of organizing skills—task division, task allocation, information provision, reward distribution, and exception management—and a queuing theory model of organizing efficiency to predict which skills firms will deprioritize first. Using a quasiexperimental design that leverages the introduction of ChatGPT as an exogenous shock, we analyze 1,820 publicly listed U.S. companies and track changes in their hiring demand patterns over a period of a ±12-month window surrounds the shock. We find significant declines in demand for monitoring (reward distribution), operational exceptions, and task division skills, with information provision also showing declines. Task allocation and conflict resolution showed greater stability, suggesting greater reliance on human judgment. These effects intensify following GPT-4’s release, indicating that capability improvements also drive adaptation. Our findings demonstrate that firms engage in immediate and selective skill deprioritization, raising questions about longer-term hollowing out of human expertise in automated domains. We contribute a novel taxonomy of organizing skills, extend queuing theory to the GenAI context, and provide early empirical evidence on how GenAI is reshaping organizational skill demands. This paper was accepted by Anita McGahan, Business Strategy. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01859.
papers.abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能（GenAI）如何重塑组织在适应一种新的通用技术时所寻求的技能？GenAI能够有效地检索数据、执行分析并传递信息，因此它可以替代从事这些活动的员工，并补充依赖这些活动的员工。一个自然的后果是技能降级，即随着组织调整劳动分工和努力整合，企业对GenAI能够有效处理的人类技能的需求出现系统性减少。我们借鉴一种有理论基础的组组织技能分类——任务划分、任务分配、信息提供、奖励分配和例外管理——以及一个组织效率的排队论模型，来预测企业将首先降级哪些技能。使用一种准实验设计，利用ChatGPT的推出作为外生冲击，我们分析了1,820家美国上市公司，并追踪其在冲击前后±12个月窗口期内招聘需求模式的变化。我们发现对监控（奖励分配）、运营例外和任务划分技能的需求显著下降，信息提供也显示出下降。任务分配和冲突解决表现出更大的稳定性，表明对人工判断的更大依赖。这些效应在GPT-4发布后加剧，表明能力提升也驱动了适应。我们的发现表明企业进行了即时且选择性的技能降级，这引发了关于自动化领域中人类专业知识长期空心化的疑问。我们贡献了一个新颖的组织技能分类法，将排队论扩展到GenAI情境，并提供了关于GenAI如何重塑组织技能需求的早期经验证据。本文由Anita McGahan，商业战略领域接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01859获取。
papers.title_original: Skill Deprioritization: Reorganizing in the Age of Generative Artificial Intelligence
papers.title_zh: 技能降级：生成式人工智能时代的组织重构

papers.abstract_original: Employees working in teams often fail to coordinate because of strategic uncertainty, i.e., difficulty predicting their colleagues’ actions. Using an incentivized economic experiment, we examine the potentially beneficial effects of a ubiquitous competitive incentive—individual relative performance evaluations (RPE)—in reducing strategic uncertainty and improving team output. When employees work in highly interdependent teams and are motivated by team incentives, we predict that individual RPE reduce employees’ strategic uncertainty and, in doing so, improve coordination. Consistent with our theory, we find that the use of individual RPE reduces employees’ strategic uncertainty about both their team members’ direct effort and indirect actions (i.e., helping or hurting). Furthermore, by reducing each component of strategic uncertainty, we find that firms can effectively improve coordination and team output. Contrary to claims that competitive, individual-level incentives harm team outcomes, our study highlights that individual RPE play an important role in reducing strategic uncertainty such that their use in interdependent teams motivated by cooperative team incentives yields superior outcomes.This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01870.
papers.abstract_zh: 在团队中工作的员工常常因策略不确定性而协调失败，即难以预测同事的行动。通过一项有激励的经济学实验，我们考察了一种普遍存在的竞争性激励——个体相对绩效评估（RPE）——在减少策略不确定性和提高团队产出方面的潜在有益效应。当员工在高度相互依赖的团队中工作并受到团队激励驱动时，我们预测个体RPE会减少员工的策略不确定性，并由此改善协调。与我们的理论一致，我们发现使用个体RPE减少了员工对团队成员直接努力和间接行动（即帮助或伤害）的策略不确定性。此外，通过减少策略不确定性的每个组成部分，我们发现企业可以有效改善协调和团队产出。与竞争性个体层面激励损害团队成果的说法相反，我们的研究强调，个体RPE在减少策略不确定性方面发挥重要作用，以至于在由合作性团队激励驱动的高度相互依赖团队中使用它们能产生更优的结果。本文由Ranjani Krishnan（会计）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.01870获取。
papers.title_original: Improving Coordination in Teams: Combining Team and Individual Relative Performance Evaluations
papers.title_zh: 改善团队协调：结合团队与个体相对绩效评估

papers.abstract_original: Research on discrimination has predominantly relied on audit studies, which provide clean causal estimates through randomized profile testing but offer only static snapshots of bias. We adopt a dynamic perspective to examine how racial discrimination evolves over time. Using observational panel data from an online educational platform, we first find that African-American teachers receive 30.2% fewer bookings, and their opened classes are 3.3% less likely to be booked compared with their White counterparts during their first week on the platform, a gap that may indicate initial discrimination. Employing individual fixed effects models, we estimate how this gap evolves over time. The results show a striking 1,007% widening of the initial gap over the 12-week period. Our mechanism analysis shows that new students are significantly less likely to book classes with African-American teachers than with White teachers, even when African-American and White teachers have minimal or comparable reputation metrics. As a result, African-American teachers accumulate reputation metrics and customers more slowly than White teachers. Over time, the growing gaps in reputation and customer base further exacerbate the booking gap, driven by both new and repeat students. Our findings suggest that traditional audit studies may significantly underestimate the long-term consequences of early-stage discrimination and highlight how reputation and repeat customer accumulation serve as bias amplifiers on online platforms. We also show that this amplification mechanism operates regardless of whether the initial gap stems from racial discrimination and thus generalizes to other contexts.This paper was accepted by Srikanth Jagabathula, market design, platform, and demand analytics.Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02111.
papers.abstract_zh: 关于歧视的研究主要依赖于审计研究，这类研究通过随机化的个人资料测试提供干净的因果估计，但只能提供偏见的静态快照。我们采用动态视角来考察种族歧视如何随时间演变。利用一个在线教育平台的观察性面板数据，我们首先发现，与白人教师相比，非裔美国教师在其入驻平台的第一周内获得的预订量少30.2%，其开设的课程被预订的可能性低3.3%，这一差距可能表明存在初始歧视。采用个体固定效应模型，我们估计了这一差距如何随时间演变。结果显示，在12周的时间内，初始差距惊人地扩大了1,007%。我们的机制分析表明，即使非裔美国教师和白人教师的声誉指标极少或相当，新学生预订非裔美国教师课程的可能性也显著低于预订白人教师课程的可能性。因此，非裔美国教师积累声誉指标和客户的速度比白人教师更慢。随着时间推移，声誉和客户基础方面不断扩大的差距进一步加剧了预订差距，这由新学生和回头客共同驱动。我们的发现表明，传统的审计研究可能显著低估了早期歧视的长期后果，并凸显了声誉和回头客积累如何在在线平台上充当偏见放大器。我们还表明，这种放大机制无论初始差距是否源于种族歧视都会发挥作用，因此可推广到其他情境。本文由Srikanth Jagabathula（市场设计、平台与需求分析领域）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02111获取。
papers.title_original: Evolution of Discrimination on Online Platforms
papers.title_zh: 在线平台上歧视的演变

papers.abstract_original: Information distortion and incentive misalignment often undermine supply chain performance. In response, many firms adopt a “control tower” approach, whereby one party assumes responsibility for replenishment decisions across the supply chain. Industry examples showed that this role may be assigned to the customer, Customer-Managed Inventory (CMI), or to the supplier, Supplier-Managed Inventory (SMI). This paper investigates when one governance structure is preferable. We study a two-echelon, one-to-many supply chain consisting of a single supplier and a customer operating multiple warehouses. We characterize optimal base-stock policies and equilibrium holding-cost-sharing parameters under CMI and SMI and benchmark them against decentralized operations and a fully centralized system. Two primary forces shape the choice between CMI and SMI: the relative shortage penalty costs of the two parties and the structure of the customer’s distribution network. Specifically, CMI is preferred when the customer faces relatively higher shortage penalties and operates in a more asymmetric environment—for example, when demand is concentrated in a subset of its warehouses or when replenishment lead times vary substantially across these locations. In contrast, SMI is favored under opposite conditions. We further examine how intertemporal and interspatial demand correlations affect this comparison. A key finding is that, although neither CMI nor SMI achieves the first-best outcome, their efficiency loss relative to full centralization is typically small. Calibrated numerical studies based on four industry cases disentangle the incremental value of information sharing, decision-right transfer, and cost sharing, showing that most performance gains stem from decision-right transfer supported by appropriate holding-cost sharing.This paper was accepted by Jayashankar Swaminathan, operations management.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02137.
papers.abstract_zh: 信息扭曲和激励错位常常损害供应链绩效。作为回应，许多公司采用“控制塔”方法，即一方承担整个供应链补货决策的责任。行业实例表明，这一角色可以分配给客户，即客户管理库存（CMI），或分配给供应商，即供应商管理库存（SMI）。本文研究何时一种治理结构更可取。我们研究一个两级、一对多的供应链，由单一供应商和一个运营多个仓库的客户组成。我们刻画CMI和SMI下的最优基本库存策略和均衡持有成本分摊参数，并将其与分散运营和完全集中系统进行基准比较。两个主要力量塑造了CMI与SMI之间的选择：双方的相对缺货惩罚成本以及客户分销网络的结构。具体而言，当客户面临相对较高的缺货惩罚并且运营在更不对称的环境中时——例如，当需求集中在其仓库的一个子集，或当补货提前期在这些地点之间差异很大时——CMI更受青睐。相反，在相反条件下SMI更受青睐。我们进一步考察跨期和跨空间需求相关性如何影响这一比较。一个关键发现是，尽管CMI和SMI都没有达到最优结果，但它们相对于完全集中化的效率损失通常很小。基于四个行业案例的校准数值研究分解了信息共享、决策权转移和成本分摊的增量价值，表明大部分绩效提升来自决策权转移，并由适当的持有成本分摊支持。本文由Jayashankar Swaminathan，运营管理领域接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02137获取。

papers.title_zh: 谁指挥控制塔？供应链中的客户管理与供应商管理库存

papers.abstract_original: Millions of people in poverty lack access to basic services such as energy, clean water, and cooking gas. Private firms are increasingly delivering these services—for example, by offering solar home systems or clean cooking packages with remote lockout capabilities—through pay-as-you-go (PAYGo) contracts that give consumers flexibility over payment timing and amount to match their erratic cash flows. Because firms cannot observe consumer liquidity, however, consumers may misuse this flexibility and prioritize other needs over repayment. We study how to design contracts that preserve flexibility while creating incentives for timely repayment using an optimal contracting approach. The optimal contract summarizes each consumer’s payment history with a single score, controls flexibility by recommending payment amounts, and incentivizes payments by specifying how the score updates after each payment. The score determines both the level of technology access granted to the consumer and whether the contract is continued or terminated. Although effective in aligning incentives, this dynamic scheme can be difficult for consumers to comprehend. Therefore, we identify key structural features of the optimal contract and design a simpler, more practical version that preserves these features in which consumers access the technology using credit points that they gain or lose over time based on their payment histories. We also discuss how incorporating these key features could help PAYGo firms improve upon their current practices.This paper was accepted by Jay Swaminathan, operations management.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02156.
papers.abstract_zh: 数百万贫困人口缺乏获得能源、清洁水和炊事燃气等基本服务的机会。私营企业越来越多地提供这些服务——例如，通过提供具有远程锁定功能的太阳能家用系统或清洁炊事套餐——采用即付即用（PAYGo）合同，使消费者在付款时间和金额上具有灵活性，以匹配其不稳定的现金流。然而，由于企业无法观察消费者流动性，消费者可能滥用这种灵活性，将其他需求置于还款之上。我们采用最优合同方法研究如何设计合同，在保持灵活性的同时创造及时还款的激励。最优合同用单一分数概括每个消费者的付款历史，通过推荐付款金额来控制灵活性，并通过规定每次付款后分数如何更新来激励付款。该分数决定了授予消费者的技术访问水平以及合同是继续还是终止。尽管这种动态方案在协调激励方面有效，但消费者可能难以理解。因此，我们识别出最优合同的关键结构特征，并设计了一个更简单、更实用的版本，保留了这些特征，其中消费者使用信用积分来访问技术，这些积分根据其付款历史随时间获得或失去。我们还讨论了纳入这些关键特征如何帮助PAYGo企业改进其当前实践。本文由Jay Swaminathan接受，运营管理。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02156获取。

papers.abstract_original: We propose a novel gain–loss asymmetric utility model—losses relative to a reference point incur discontinuously more disutility than comparable gains—under which we derive closed-form asset pricing solutions within the workhorse “long-run risk” asset pricing model. Our formal analysis reveals gain–loss asymmetry has a dual impact on risk prices. First, a level effect: the expected excess returns of risky assets are made higher and the risk-free rate lower by the kink in the preferences. Second, a cross-sectional effect: the increase in expected returns for an additional unit of risk is higher (lower) for safer (riskier) assets, so expected returns increase nonlinearly with risk exposures. This second effect, absent in standard smooth utility models, can help rationalize, both qualitatively and quantitatively, key puzzles in empirical finance—the fit of the security market line and the downward-sloping term structure of equity risk premia—without compromising on the model’s ability to match the equity premium in the data.This paper was accepted by Tomasz Piskorski, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02286.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的收益-损失不对称效用模型——相对于参考点的损失所带来的负效用不连续地大于可比收益——在该模型下，我们在经典的“长期风险”资产定价模型中推导出了闭式资产定价解。我们的形式化分析揭示，收益-损失不对称对风险价格具有双重影响。第一，水平效应：偏好中的折点使风险资产的预期超额收益更高，无风险利率更低。第二，横截面效应：对于更安全（风险更高）的资产，每增加一单位风险所带来的预期收益增加更高（更低），因此预期收益随风险暴露非线性增加。这第二种效应在标准平滑效用模型中不存在，它有助于在定性和定量上合理化实证金融中的关键谜题——证券市场线的拟合以及股权风险溢价向下倾斜的期限结构——同时不损害模型匹配数据中股权溢价的能力。本文由金融领域的Tomasz Piskorski接受。补充材料：在线附录可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02286获取。
papers.title_original: Risk Pricing Under Gain–Loss Asymmetry

papers.abstract_original: The future architecture of financial systems is a subject of contention, with centralized and decentralized governance proponents. Here, we ask the following question. Would the architecture affect the quality of decision making? We propose a game where financial network participants demarcate the ownership of claims to income. This governance task can be decentralized (shared authority), centralized (single authority), or hybrid (alternating authority). Without communication, all architectures supported poor outcomes. With communication, decentralization ensured good governance and maximum profits, whereas centralization did not—lowering communication’s potency in promoting socially optimal decisions. This indicates that there is scope for decentralization in innovating financial institutions.This paper has been accepted by Camelia Kuhnen for the Virtual Special Issue on Digital Finance.Funding: N. Chemaya acknowledges partial financial support from the NET Institute.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02314.
papers.abstract_zh: 金融体系的未来架构是一个存在争议的话题，中心化和去中心化治理的支持者各执一词。在此，我们提出以下问题：架构是否会影响决策质量？我们提出一个博弈，其中金融网络参与者划分对收入索取权的所有权。这一治理任务可以是去中心化的（共享权威）、中心化的（单一权威）或混合的（交替权威）。在没有沟通的情况下，所有架构都支持了糟糕的结果。在有沟通的情况下，去中心化确保了良好的治理和最大利润，而中心化则没有——降低了沟通在促进社会最优决策方面的效力。这表明，去中心化在创新金融机构方面存在空间。本文已被Camelia Kuhnen接受，用于数字金融虚拟特刊。资助：N. Chemaya感谢NET Institute提供的部分财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02314获取。
papers.title_original: Centralization vs. Decentralization: First Evidence from the Laboratory
papers.title_zh: 中心化与去中心化：来自实验室的首批证据

papers.abstract_original: Generative search is an emerging search paradigm that integrates Generative AI (GenAI) into traditional search engines by presenting users with AI-generated responses before conventional search results. Whereas keyword-based search requires consumers to translate their underlying needs into effective keyword queries, generative search lets users express those intentions directly in natural language, a shift made possible by GenAI’s new mode of information presentation. This shift moves the consumer-search engine interaction upstream to the stage of problem formulation, rendering empirically observable a previously hidden phase of search behavior: the mapping from problem formulation to keyword articulation. Yet, it remains empirically unknown whether generative search increases consumer purchases and how search behavior changes when it can begin from expressed intent rather than keywords. Using a large-scale field experiment conducted on Meituan, a leading Chinese technology platform, this paper provides empirical evidence on the effectiveness of generative search. We find that generative search significantly increases consumer purchases. Further analysis reveals that generative search facilitates more effective and diverse keyword queries and reduces exploratory browsing and clicking, while concentrating evaluation within relevant categories and merchants. The empirical evidence is most consistent with a mechanism in which AI-generated answers provide information about consumers’ underlying needs, while also expanding awareness of relevant attributes and shifting attention toward more relevant categories. These findings provide empirical insights for future consumer search models that allow search to originate at the intention-expressing stage.This paper was accepted by Raphael Thomadsen, marketing.Funding: Financial support from the Ministry of Education – Singapore [Grant A-8001730-00-00] is gratefully acknowledged.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02458.
papers.abstract_zh: 生成式搜索是一种新兴的搜索范式，它将生成式人工智能（GenAI）整合到传统搜索引擎中，在常规搜索结果之前向用户呈现AI生成的回答。基于关键词的搜索要求消费者将其潜在需求转化为有效的关键词查询，而生成式搜索则让用户能够直接用自然语言表达这些意图，这一转变得益于GenAI全新的信息呈现模式。这一转变将消费者与搜索引擎的交互上移至问题构建阶段，使搜索行为中此前隐藏的一个阶段——从问题构建到关键词表述的映射——变得可实证观察。然而，生成式搜索是否增加消费者购买，以及当搜索可以从表达的意图而非关键词开始时搜索行为如何变化，在实证上仍属未知。本文利用在中国领先科技平台美团上进行的一项大规模实地实验，提供了关于生成式搜索有效性的实证证据。我们发现，生成式搜索显著增加了消费者购买。进一步分析表明，生成式搜索促进了更有效和更多样的关键词查询，并减少了探索性浏览和点击，同时将评估集中于相关的品类和商家。实证证据与以下机制最为一致：AI生成的回答提供了关于消费者潜在需求的信息，同时扩展了对相关属性的认知，并将注意力转向更相关的品类。这些发现为未来允许搜索从意图表达阶段开始的消费者搜索模型提供了实证洞见。本文由市场营销领域的Raphael Thomadsen接受。资助：感谢新加坡教育部[资助号A-8001730-00-00]的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02458获取。
papers.title_original: Generative Search: Evidence from a Large-Scale Field Experiment
papers.title_zh: 生成式搜索：来自大规模实地实验的证据

papers.abstract_original: Following a 2018 ruling of the U.S. Supreme Court, 39 states and the District of Columbia have legalized sports gambling. We study how this policy has impacted consumer financial health using the University of California Consumer Credit Panel, which contains credit report data for a representative sample of roughly 7 million U.S. consumers. Exploiting the staggered rollout of legal sports betting across states, we evaluate two treatment effects: the overall effect of any legal sports betting (General Access) and the incremental effect of introducing online or mobile betting in states that already offer retail betting (Retail-to-Online Access). We find that General Access is associated with a modest decline in average credit scores (0.7 points), whereas the introduction of online sports gambling leads to a substantially larger decline (about 12 points). These credit score declines are associated with increases in indicators of excessive debt, including bankruptcy filings, debt sent to collections, credit card delinquencies, and auto loan delinquencies. Together, our results indicate that the ease of access to sports gambling—particularly through online and mobile channels—harms consumer financial health by increasing levels of excessive debt.This paper was accepted by Jean-Pierre Dube, marketing.Funding: This work was supported by the UCLA Briskin Fund.Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02515.
papers.abstract_zh: 在美国最高法院作出2018年裁决之后，39个州和哥伦比亚特区已将体育博彩合法化。我们利用加州大学消费者信用面板研究这一政策如何影响消费者的财务健康，该面板包含约7百万美国消费者代表性样本的信用报告数据。利用各州合法体育博彩交错推出的特点，我们评估了两种处理效应：任何合法体育博彩的整体效应（一般准入）以及在已提供实体投注的州引入在线或移动投注的增量效应（实体转在线准入）。我们发现，一般准入与平均信用评分的温和下降相关（0.7分），而在线体育博彩的引入则导致大幅得多的下降（约12分）。这些信用评分下降与过度负债指标的上升相关，包括破产申请、被送往催收的债务、信用卡拖欠和汽车贷款拖欠。总之，我们的结果表明，体育博彩的便利可及性——尤其是通过在线和移动渠道——会通过提高过度负债水平而损害消费者财务健康。本文由市场营销领域的Jean-Pierre Dube接受。资助：本工作得到加州大学洛杉矶分校Briskin基金的支持。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02515获取。
papers.title_original: The Financial Consequences of Legalized Sports Gambling
papers.title_zh: 体育博彩合法化的财务后果

papers.abstract_original: Generative artificial intelligence (genAI) is a potentially important new technology, but its impact on the economy depends on the speed and intensity of adoption. This paper reports results from a series of nationally representative U.S. surveys of genAI use at work and at home. As of late 2024, 45% of the U.S. population age 18–64 uses genAI. Among employed respondents, 27% used genAI for work at least once in the previous week: 10% used it every workday and 17% on some but not all workdays. Relative to each technology’s first mass-market product launch, work adoption of genAI has been faster than the personal computer (PC), and overall adoption has outpaced both PCs and the internet by an even wider margin. Between 1% and 7% of all work hours are currently assisted by genAI, and respondents report time savings equivalent to 1.4% of total work hours. Potential productivity gains vary widely by industry, and firm climate and policies play an important role in adoption patterns.This paper was accepted by Alfonso Gambardella, business strategy.Funding: This work was supported by the Walmart Foundation [Grant 252882].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02523.
papers.abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能（genAI）是一种潜在重要的新技术，但其对经济的影响取决于采用的速度和强度。本文报告了一系列具有全国代表性的美国调查结果，涉及工作场所和家庭中genAI的使用。截至2024年底，45%的18至64岁美国人口使用genAI。在就业受访者中，27%在前一周至少使用过一次genAI工作：10%每个工作日都使用，17%在一些但并非所有工作日使用。相对于每种技术的首个大众市场产品发布，genAI的工作采用速度快于个人电脑（PC），总体采用速度更是以更大的幅度超过了PC和互联网。目前，所有工作小时中有1%至7%由genAI辅助，受访者报告的时间节省相当于总工作小时的1.4%。潜在的生产率提升因行业而异，公司氛围和政策在采用模式中发挥重要作用。本文被商业战略领域的Alfonso Gambardella接受。资助：本工作得到沃尔玛基金会[资助号252882]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02523获取。

papers.abstract_original: In recent years, the ride service industry has been evolving rapidly, driven by disruptive technologies such as mobile apps, artificial intelligence, and autonomous vehicles (AVs). Whereas platform-based decentralized ride-hailing (RH) companies have gained significant market share, vertically integrated robotaxi services using emerging AVs are starting to enter the market. In this paper, we aim to provide insights about the evolution and the future of ride services, studying these two competing business approaches. We game-theoretically model and analyze the competition between a platform-based RH firm and an AV-based ride-service firm. Although the AV model has a capacity commitment advantage, we find that, in larger markets with sufficiently patient customers, the RH firm surprisingly gains the upper hand in competition, having higher market share and profits as well as lower service delays and higher prices even if it has a cost disadvantage. Further, entry of the AV firm into a market with an RH monopolist incumbent may reduce total vehicle supply and increase customer wait costs. We also find that, when customers are impatient, the entry of a high-cost AV firm may lead to a decrease in social welfare despite introducing competition, suggesting that regulators should be careful about introduction of robotaxi services in a market if they are not sufficiently cost-efficient. From a broader perspective, our results demonstrate that platform business models may have significant strategic advantages over firms with traditional vertically integrated models under competition, and loss of platforms’ dominance in a market may result in welfare losses.This paper was accepted by Victor Martinez-de-Albeniz, operations management.Funding: This study is partially supported by Korea University Business School Research Grant.Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02733.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，在移动应用、人工智能和自动驾驶汽车（AVs）等颠覆性技术的推动下，网约车服务行业迅速发展。尽管基于平台的分散式网约车（RH）公司已获得显著的市场份额，但使用新兴自动驾驶汽车的垂直一体化Robotaxi服务正开始进入市场。在本文中，我们旨在提供关于网约车服务演进与未来的洞见，研究这两种相互竞争的商业方式。我们以博弈论方法建模并分析了一家基于平台的网约车公司与一家基于自动驾驶汽车的网约车服务公司之间的竞争。尽管自动驾驶汽车模式具有产能承诺优势，但我们发现，在规模较大且顾客足够有耐心的市场中，网约车公司在竞争中出人意料地占据上风，即使它存在成本劣势，也拥有更高的市场份额和利润，以及更低的服务延迟和更高的价格。此外，自动驾驶汽车公司进入一个已有网约车垄断在位者的市场，可能会减少车辆总供给并增加顾客等待成本。我们还发现，当顾客缺乏耐心时，一家高成本的自动驾驶汽车公司的进入尽管引入了竞争，却可能导致社会福利下降，这表明监管者在市场中的自动驾驶出租车服务成本效率不够高时应谨慎引入。从更广阔的视角看，我们的结果表明，平台商业模式在竞争下可能相对于采用传统垂直一体化模式的公司具有显著的战略优势，而平台在市场中主导地位的丧失可能导致福利损失。本文由Victor Martinez-de-Albeniz（运营管理）接受。资助：本研究部分得到高丽大学商学院研究基金的资助。补充材料：在线附录可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02733获取。
papers.title_original: Evolution of Ride Services: From Ride Hailing to Autonomous Vehicles
papers.title_zh: 网约车服务的演进：从网约车到自动驾驶汽车

papers.abstract_original: By extracting information from economic news articles, this paper proposes a novel measure of narrative-based ambiguity that captures investors’ attitudes toward narrative uncertainty and exhibits strong in- and out-of-sample predictive power for the stock market returns. It reveals general ambiguity aversion except in high loss probability scenarios in which ambiguity tolerance emerges. Further tests confirm the significant pricing power and distinct information of the narrative ambiguity on top of existing ambiguity measures, such as survey- and return-based ambiguity. By aligning industry-specific narrative ambiguity, we construct a superior predictor for market returns with the predictability predominantly driven by the ambiguity from consumption-, energy-, and technology-related sectors. Our findings also carry broad implications as the predictability remains significant across international markets and other asset classes.This paper has been accepted by Will Cong for the Virtual Special Issue on Digital Finance.Funding: Q. Wei acknowledges research support from the Capital University of Economics and Business Scientific Research Project [Grant XRZ2025010].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02735.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文通过从经济新闻文章中提取信息，提出了一种新的基于叙事的模糊性度量，该度量捕捉了投资者对叙事不确定性的态度，并对股票市场回报表现出强烈的样本内和样本外预测能力。它揭示了普遍的模糊厌恶，但在高损失概率情景下除外，此时模糊容忍出现。进一步检验证实，在现有模糊性度量（如基于调查和基于回报的模糊性）之上，叙事模糊性具有显著的定价能力和独特信息。通过对齐行业特定的叙事模糊性，我们构建了一个更优的市场回报预测因子，其可预测性主要由消费、能源和技术相关部门的模糊性驱动。我们的发现还具有广泛意义，因为这种可预测性在国际市场和其他资产类别中仍然显著。本文已被Will Cong接受，用于数字金融虚拟特刊。资助：Q. Zhang感谢国家自然科学基金[资助编号72573098]、国家自然科学基金优秀青年科学基金项目[资助编号72222013]以及国家重点研发计划[资助编号2023YFA1009200]的研究支持。X. Wei感谢首都经济贸易大学科研项目[资助编号XRZ2025010]的研究支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02735获取。

papers.abstract_original: Recent evidence, both in the laboratory and in the wild, suggests that the use of generative artificial intelligence reduces the diversity of content produced. As generative AI penetrates more markets and reaches widespread adoption, should we still expect to see content homogenization? Our work begins with a simple observation: content producers do not act in isolation. Instead, they compete with one another (e.g., for customers or attention). We explore the impact competition has on both content diversity and overall social welfare when producers use generative AI. Through a formal game-theoretic model, we show that competitive markets select for diverse AI models, mitigating monoculture. We further show that a generative AI model that performs well in isolation (i.e., according to a benchmark) may fail to provide value in a competitive market. Our results highlight the importance of evaluating generative AI models across the breadth of their output distributions, particularly when they will be deployed in competitive environments. We validate our theoretical results with a series of experiments involving generative text and image models. Overall, our results suggest that homogenization due to generative AI is unlikely to persist under strong competition.This paper was accepted by Itai Ashlagi, market design, platform, and demand analytics.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02761.
papers.abstract_zh: 来自实验室和现实世界的近期证据均表明，使用生成式人工智能会降低所生产内容的多样性。随着生成式人工智能渗透更多市场并得到广泛采用，我们是否仍应预期出现内容同质化？我们的工作始于一个简单的观察：内容生产者并非孤立行动。相反，他们彼此竞争（例如，争夺客户或注意力）。我们探讨当生产者使用生成式人工智能时，竞争对内容多样性和整体社会福利的影响。通过一个正式博弈论模型，我们表明竞争性市场会选择多样化的AI模型，从而缓解单一文化。我们进一步表明，一个在孤立环境中表现良好（即根据基准）的生成式人工智能模型，在竞争性市场中可能无法提供价值。我们的结果凸显了在其输出分布的整体范围内评估生成式人工智能模型的重要性，尤其是当这些模型将被部署在竞争性环境中时。我们通过一系列涉及生成式文本和图像模型的实验验证了我们的理论结果。总体而言，我们的结果表明，由生成式人工智能导致的同质化在强竞争下不太可能持续。本文由Itai Ashlagi（市场设计、平台与需求分析领域）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02761 获取。

papers.abstract_original: Economists estimate that zoning regulations raise house prices, lower productivity, and reduce aggregate welfare, yet regulations remain widespread. We develop and solve a model in which fragmented zoning authority leads to overly strict regulations: Homeowners impose stricter regulations to mitigate local congestion but fail to internalize the broader impact on metro-wide affordability. Empirically, the Herfindahl-Hirschman index of local governments explains 12% of the variation in zoning restrictiveness. Using an instrument based on 19th-century municipal fragmentation, we show that greater fragmentation leads to stricter zoning and higher housing costs. These findings suggest that centralizing zoning decisions could alleviate housing affordability challenges.This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance.Funding: This work was supported by the Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Canada [Grant AWD-027881 SSHRC 2023].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02844.
papers.abstract_zh: 经济学家估计，分区规划法规会推高房价、降低生产率并减少总体福利，然而此类法规仍然广泛存在。我们构建并求解了一个模型，其中碎片化的分区规划权限导致法规过于严格：房主施加更严格的法规以缓解本地拥堵，却未能将对其大都市区整体住房可负担性的更广泛影响内部化。在实证上，地方政府层面的赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数解释了分区规划严格程度变异的12%。使用一个基于19世纪市政碎片化的工具变量，我们表明，更大的碎片化会导致更严格的分区规划和更高的住房成本。这些发现表明，集中化分区规划决策可能缓解住房可负担性挑战。本文由Lukas Schmid（金融学）接受。资助：本工作得到加拿大社会科学与人文研究理事会资助[Grant AWD-027881 SSHRC 2023]。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02844 获取。

papers.abstract_original: Consumers dislike sharing data with fintechs, but greater access to data can improve loan market outcomes through better screening. We study how the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), which grants users control over and mitigates concerns about sharing their data, affects fintech lending. After the CCPA’s introduction, fintechs’ loan rates decline relative to those of other lenders. In addition, rate dispersion across fintech loans increases, fintechs deny more applications, and they make greater use of nontraditional credit scoring models, whereas their default rates decline by more than those of other lenders. These results are consistent with an improved screening process enabled by additional data. Mortgage originations by fintechs also increase, suggesting that well-designed privacy regulation may enhance financial inclusion.This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02874.
papers.abstract_zh: 消费者不喜欢与金融科技公司共享数据，但更大的数据获取权限可以通过更好的筛选改善贷款市场结果。我们研究《加州消费者隐私法案》（CCPA）如何影响金融科技贷款，该法案赋予用户对其数据共享的控制权并缓解了相关担忧。在CCPA出台后，金融科技公司的贷款利率相对于其他贷款机构下降。此外，金融科技贷款的利率离散度上升，金融科技公司拒绝更多申请，并更多地使用非传统信用评分模型，而其违约率的下降幅度超过其他贷款机构。这些结果与额外数据所带来的筛选流程改善相一致。金融科技公司的抵押贷款发放量也增加，表明设计良好的隐私监管可能增强金融普惠性。本文由金融领域编辑Bo Becker接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02874 获取。

papers.abstract_original: We examine how funding deficit pressures shape the risk-taking of U.S. corporate defined-benefit pension plans and how targeted regulatory relief can mitigate these incentives. Using the 2012 Moving Ahead for Progress in the 21st Century Act reform, which temporarily eased funding pressure by revising discount rate calculations, we show that plans receiving greater relief significantly reduced their equity allocations and shifted toward safer assets. This derisking was most pronounced among active plans and those sponsored by more financially constrained firms. Our findings demonstrate that targeted regulatory relief can curb risk-taking incentives even without altering underlying economic conditions or financial reporting standards and shed light on the likely (and unlikely) frictions driving such behavior.This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance.Funding: R. Pinto acknowledges financial support from the Lancaster University Management School Pump Prime Program.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02928.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察资金缺口压力如何塑造美国企业固定收益养老金计划的风险承担行为，以及有针对性的监管纾困如何能够缓解这些激励。利用2012年《21世纪前进法案》改革——该改革通过修订折现率计算暂时缓解了资金压力——我们表明，获得更大纾困的计划显著降低了其股票配置，并转向更安全的资产。这种去风险化在仍在运营的计划以及由财务约束更强的公司发起的计划中最为明显。我们的发现表明，有针对性的监管纾困即使不改变 underlying 经济状况或财务报告标准，也能抑制风险承担激励，并揭示了驱动此类行为的可能（以及不太可能）的摩擦。本文由金融学领域的Bo Becker接受。资助：R. Pinto 感谢兰卡斯特大学管理学院 Pump Prime Program 的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02928 获取。

papers.abstract_original: Can investor stewardship codes that call for coordinated activism be satisfied by an Investor Collective Action Organization (ICAO)? In an ICAO, investors work collectively, like a large shareholder, to monitor management and increase value. We analyze the endogenous formation of an ICAO and its equilibrium size, considering free-rider problems and coordination costs. While the ICAO overcomes free-rider problems among its members, it exacerbates them between the ICAO and solo activists. The benefit of joining an ICAO is hump-shaped in size. With moderate coordination costs, ICAO formation features multiple equilibria. Small changes in coordination costs significantly influence ICAO formation and activism.This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance.Funding: L. Yang thanks the support from the Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Canada [Grants 435-2021-0040, 435-2026-0060] and the Bank of Canada [Fellowship].Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02975.
papers.abstract_zh: 呼吁协调行动主义的投资者 stewardship 准则能否由投资者集体行动组织（ICAO）来满足？在ICAO中，投资者像一个大股东那样集体行动，监督管理层并提升价值。我们分析了ICAO的内生形成及其均衡规模，并考虑了搭便车问题和协调成本。虽然ICAO克服了其成员之间的搭便车问题，但它加剧了ICAO与单独行动主义者之间的搭便车问题。加入ICAO的收益随规模呈驼峰形。在中等协调成本下，ICAO的形成具有多重均衡。协调成本的微小变化会显著影响ICAO的形成和行动主义。本文由Will Cong（金融）接受。资助：L. Yang感谢加拿大社会科学与人文研究理事会[资助号435-2021-0040，435-2026-0060]和加拿大银行[奖学金]的支持。补充材料：在线附录可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02975获取。

papers.abstract_original: We study how an online platform strategically uses information to both guide consumer search and influence sellers’ targeted advertising. Our model unifies personalized recommendations and targeted ads under an information design framework. We illustrate a fundamental tradeoff facing the platform between improving match efficiency and extracting seller surplus by inducing their competition for prominence. The optimal information design may be socially inefficient because it balances the tradeoff by limiting consumer search and mixing the matched product with a long tail of unmatched ones for recommendation. This implies that sponsored targeted advertising on retail platforms may introduce match inefficiency.This paper was accepted by Greg Shaffer, marketing.Funding: T. T. Ke acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72422003 and 72394395] and the Hong Kong Research Grants Council [Grant 14503122].
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究在线平台如何策略性地利用信息来引导消费者搜索并影响卖家的定向广告。我们的模型在一个信息设计框架下统一了个性化推荐和定向广告。我们阐明了平台面临的一个基本权衡，即在提高匹配效率和通过诱导卖家争夺突出位置来榨取卖家剩余之间进行权衡。最优信息设计可能在社会层面是低效的，因为它通过限制消费者搜索并将匹配产品与一长串不匹配产品混合推荐来平衡这一权衡。这意味着零售平台上的赞助定向广告可能引入匹配低效。本文由Greg Shaffer（市场营销）接受。资助：T. T. Ke感谢国家自然科学基金[资助号72422003和72394395]以及香港研究资助局[资助号14503122]的财务支持。

papers.abstract_original: We study the impact of inventory constraints on bundling in a dynamic pricing setting, challenging the classical view that bundling consistently enhances revenue. Traditional bundling theory, which typically assumes abundant inventory and static pricing, often asserts that bundling generates higher revenue than selling products individually. However, we show that limited inventory, in fact, distorts the revenue-extraction capability of bundling, favoring the sale of products or services separately. We study the optimal dynamic mixed bundling strategy in a large market regime where the market size grows relative to limited inventory. Leveraging this framework, we derive optimal dynamic pricing policies and value functions for commonly used bundling strategies, including mixed bundling, pure bundling, bundle size pricing, and component pricing. Our analysis reveals that as inventory becomes more constrained relative to market size, the optimal dynamic mixed bundling strategy converges to a dynamic component pricing strategy, outperforming both dynamic bundle size pricing and dynamic pure bundling. Moreover, the performance gap between these strategies increases with the number of items, a factor typically viewed as favoring bundling when inventory is abundant. Notably, our numerical experiments reveal that these structural insights extend to policies derived from the standard fluid regime. As the market size grows relative to the inventory, the dynamic mixed bundling policy obtained by resolving the deterministic fluid problem also reduces to a dynamic component pricing policy.This paper was accepted by Karan Girotra, operations management.Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.03120.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究库存约束对动态定价环境中捆绑销售的影响，挑战了捆绑销售总能持续提高收入的经典观点。传统捆绑销售理论通常假设库存充足且定价静态，往往断言捆绑销售比单独销售产品能产生更高收入。然而，我们表明，有限的库存实际上会扭曲捆绑销售的收入提取能力，使其更有利于单独销售产品或服务。我们研究在市场相对于有限库存而增长的大市场情形下的最优动态混合捆绑策略。利用这一框架，我们为常用的捆绑策略推导出最优动态定价政策和价值函数，包括混合捆绑、纯捆绑、捆绑规模定价和组件定价。我们的分析揭示，随着库存相对于市场规模变得更加受限，最优动态混合捆绑策略会收敛为动态组件定价策略，其表现优于动态捆绑规模定价和动态纯捆绑。此外，这些策略之间的绩效差距会随着物品数量的增加而扩大，而在库存充足时，物品数量通常被视为有利于捆绑销售的因素。值得注意的是，我们的数值实验表明，这些结构性洞见也适用于从标准流体情形推导出的政策。随着市场规模相对于库存增长，通过重新求解确定性流体问题得到的动态混合捆绑政策也会退化为动态组件定价政策。本文由运营管理领域的Karan Girotra接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.03120 获取。
papers.title_original: The Diminishing Value of Bundling Under Inventory Scarcity
papers.title_zh: 库存稀缺下捆绑销售价值的递减

papers.abstract_original: We propose an exact linear programming (LP)-based solution approach to the Guaranteed Service Model (GSM), one of the most widely applied models for optimizing safety stock placement in supply chain networks. Our approach handles any directed acyclic network and any cost function that depends on a stage’s incoming and outgoing service times. It scales polynomially in the number of nodes n in the network, pseudo-polynomially with respect to the bit size of the maximum replenishment time M, and (for fixed M) exponentially in its treewidth, which quantifies how “tree-like” a network is and can be much smaller than n. This contrasts with existing approaches, which scale exponentially in n. The proof of exactness relies crucially on showing that the join of transportation-like polytopes remains integral and is more broadly applicable to other Operations Management problems. In addition to an exact formulation, our LP-based approach enables a practical solution strategy for the GSM built on a hierarchy of LP relaxations. These relaxations provide valid lower bounds, certify optimality when integral, and can strengthen existing exact methods. In our computational study, the smallest relaxation already recovers an optimal GSM solution on every real-world benchmark instance, leading to substantial speed-ups over the state-of-the-art exact algorithm and commercial general-purpose solvers. The framework also supports sensitivity analysis and accommodates additional operational constraints. Overall, our approach builds a new bridge between Operations Management and Computer Science, providing new theoretical foundations and practical tools for managing safety stocks in complex modern supply chain networks.This paper was accepted by Jeannette Song, operations management.Funding: A. P. Calmon acknowledges financial support provided by the Ray C. Anderson Center for Sustainable Business.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.03155.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种基于精确线性规划（LP）的求解方法，用于保证服务模型（GSM），这是应用最广泛的供应链网络中安全库存配置优化模型之一。我们的方法可处理任意有向无环网络，以及任何依赖于某一阶段流入和流出服务时间的成本函数。其规模随网络中节点数n呈多项式增长，相对于最大补货时间M的比特大小呈伪多项式增长，并且（对于固定的M）随其树宽呈指数增长；树宽量化了一个网络有多“像树”，且可能远小于n。这与现有方法形成对比，现有方法随n呈指数增长。精确性的证明关键依赖于表明类运输多面体的并仍保持整性，并且更广泛地适用于其他运营管理问题。除精确公式外，我们基于LP的方法还为GSM提供了一种建立在LP松弛层级之上的实用求解策略。这些松弛提供有效的下界，在整性时证明最优性，并可以增强现有的精确方法。在我们的计算研究中，最小的松弛已经在每一个现实世界基准实例上恢复了最优GSM解，相较于最先进的精确算法和商业通用求解器带来了显著加速。该框架还支持敏感性分析，并能容纳额外的运营约束。总体而言，我们的方法在运营管理与计算机科学之间架起了一座新桥梁，为管理复杂现代供应链网络中的安全库存提供了新的理论基础和实用工具。本文由运营管理领域的Jeannette Song接受。资助：A. P. Calmon感谢Ray C. Anderson可持续商业中心提供的财政支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.03155获取。
papers.title_original: From Trees to Treewidth: Inventory Management in Complex Supply Chain Networks
papers.title_zh: 从树到树宽：复杂供应链网络中的库存管理

papers.abstract_original: We examine whether designating banks as systemically important affects loan performance in an emerging-market setting where such banks are large domestic institutions and market imperfections make monitoring crucial for loan performance. Using loan-level data and the staggered designation of banks as Domestic Systemically Important Banks (DSIBs) in India, we find that loan performance deteriorates following DSIB designation. The evidence points to bank-level moral hazard as the underlying mechanism: DSIBs reduce postorigination monitoring and weaken loan recovery efforts. Borrowers respond accordingly, exhibiting poorer financial health and loan repayment, particularly on loans extended by DSIBs.This paper was accepted by Jan Bouwens, accounting.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.03238.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察在新兴市场环境中将银行指定为系统重要性银行是否会影响贷款表现，在该环境中此类银行是大型国内机构，且市场不完美使监测对贷款表现至关重要。利用贷款层面数据以及印度将银行分批指定为国内系统重要性银行（DSIBs）的做法，我们发现贷款表现在DSIB指定之后恶化。证据指向银行层面的道德风险是 underlying mechanism：DSIBs减少了发放后监测并削弱了贷款回收努力。借款人也相应作出反应，表现出更差的财务状况和贷款偿还情况，尤其是在DSIBs发放的贷款上。本文由会计领域的Jan Bouwens接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.03238获取。

papers.abstract_original: Almost all firms repurchase shares through open-market repurchase programs. In contrast, issue methods are more diverse; at-the-market offerings, analogous to open-market repurchases, and seasoned equity offerings, analogous to rarely used tender-offer repurchases, are both used by significant fractions of firms. Furthermore, average seasoned equity offerings are larger than at-the-market offerings. We show that this asymmetry in the diversity of transaction methods in issuances and repurchases and the size-method relation in issuances are natural consequences of the single informational friction of a firm having superior information to investors. Moreover, although this friction always leads firms to issue inefficiently little, it leads firms to repurchase too little if they maximize long-term shareholder value but too much if the primary goal is to boost short-term share prices.This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance.Funding: Y. Yuan acknowledges support from the Paul Woolley Centre, the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Projects 72342020 and 72495152], and University College London. H. Zhong acknowledges support from the Economic and Social Research Council [New Investigator Grant ES/T003758/1].Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.03301.
papers.abstract_zh: 几乎所有公司都通过公开市场回购计划回购股票。相比之下，发行方式更为多样；与公开市场回购类似的按市价发行（at-the-market offerings）和与很少使用的要约收购回购类似的增发（seasoned equity offerings），都被相当比例的公司所使用。此外，平均而言，增发的规模大于按市价发行。我们表明，发行与回购中交易方式多样性的这种不对称，以及发行中规模与方式之间的关系，是企业相对于投资者拥有信息优势这一单一信息摩擦的自然结果。此外，尽管这种摩擦总是导致企业发行过少而无效率，但如果企业最大化长期股东价值，它会导致企业回购过少；而如果首要目标是提振短期股价，则会导致企业回购过多。本文由Bo Becker（金融学）接收。资助：Y. papers.abstract_original: Two empirical patterns emerge in business-to-business settings, particularly in retail distribution channels such as grocery markets. First, linear contracts are widely observed alongside nonlinear contracts with fixed payments, despite the claimed efficiency advantages of the latter. Second, when fixed payments arise, they often flow from suppliers to retailers (slotting fees) rather than the reverse. We develop and analyze a model of multilateral bargaining in which a supplier negotiates separately with competing retailers to explain these patterns. The key mechanism is a trade-off between two distortions: under linear contracts, wholesale prices reflect bargaining power and can be either above or below the channel-profit-maximizing level, whereas under two-part tariffs, wholesale prices are set to maximize bilateral surplus independently of bargaining power but are systematically too low from an overall channel perspective because of rent shifting across relationships. As a result, neither contractual form uniformly dominates; instead, relative performance depends on how bargaining shapes gains from trade across firms. When bargaining leads to slotting fees, two-part tariffs yield higher channel profits than linear contracts, whereas when it would imply payments from retailers to suppliers, linear contracts may perform better. These findings offer a unified explanation for the persistence of linear contracts alongside two-part tariffs, the direction of fixed payments, and the conditions under which each contractual form is likely to arise.This paper was accepted by Miguel Villas-Boas, marketing.Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.03426.
papers.abstract_zh: 在企业对企业环境中，尤其是在杂货市场等零售分销渠道中，出现了两种经验模式。第一，尽管非线性合同（含固定支付）被宣称具有效率优势，线性合同仍与非线性合同一起被广泛观察到。第二，当固定支付出现时，它们往往从供应商流向零售商（上架费），而非相反方向。我们构建并分析了一个多边谈判模型，其中供应商分别与相互竞争的零售商进行谈判，以解释这些模式。关键机制是两种扭曲之间的权衡：在线性合同下，批发价格反映谈判力，可能高于或低于渠道利润最大化水平；而在两部定价下，批发价格被设定为最大化双边剩余，独立于谈判力，但由于关系间的租金转移，从整体渠道角度看系统性地过低。因此，没有一种合同形式统一占优；相反，相对表现取决于谈判如何塑造企业间的贸易收益。当谈判导致上架费时，两部定价比线性合同产生更高的渠道利润；而当谈判意味着零售商向供应商支付时，线性合同可能表现更好。这些发现为线性合同与两部定价并存、固定支付的方向以及每种合同形式可能出现的条件提供了统一解释。本文由营销领域的Miguel Villas-Boas接受。补充材料：在线附录可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.03426 获取。

papers.abstract_original: In prior publications, we introduced a global system of interconnected E-ledgers that produces—in as close to real time as practicable—accurate, comparable, and verifiable accounts of the cradle-to-gate (net) greenhouse gas emissions in any product or service that transacts in the economy. In this paper, we delve more deeply into the accounting infrastructure required for the E-ledgers system, including the specific journal entries for recording E-liabilities and E-assets. We explain how the E-ledgers of different entities in the economy articulate with each other and how they connect with jurisdictional E-ledgers that record emissions from end consumers. These entity and jurisdictional E-ledgers can be aggregated into a geological master ledger that tracks anthropogenic GHG emissions and removals, as debits and credits, to a geological carbon equity account. We also provide summary insights from computational technology and pilot studies to guide rapid and cost-effective E-ledgers deployment at scale.This paper was accepted by Shiva Rajgopal, accounting.Funding: Funding for R. S. Kaplan’s research was provided by Harvard Business School. K. Ramanna receives a salary from Oxford University. The authors are co-founders of E-ledgers Institute, a nonprofit organization, which seeks to implement the E-ledgers carbon accounting method in practice.
papers.abstract_zh: 在之前的出版物中，我们介绍了一个由相互连接的电子账本组成的全球系统，该系统能够尽可能接近实时地生成经济中交易的任何产品或服务的从摇篮到大门的（净）温室气体排放的准确、可比和可验证的账目。在本文中，我们更深入地探讨了电子账本系统所需的会计基础设施，包括记录电子负债和电子资产的具体日记账分录。我们解释了经济中不同实体的电子账本如何相互衔接，以及它们如何与记录最终消费者排放的辖区电子账本连接。这些实体和辖区电子账本可以汇总到一个地质总账本中，该账本将人为温室气体排放和清除作为借方和贷方跟踪到一个地质碳权益账户。我们还提供了来自计算技术和试点研究的总结性见解，以指导大规模快速且成本有效地部署电子账本。本文由Shiva Rajgopal（会计领域）接受。资助：R. papers.abstract_original: Morgan and Tumlinson (2019, Management Science 65(10), 4489–4504) study a game in which citizens first fund a company venture or purchase bonds, and then bondholders and the firm’s manager, acting on behalf of the shareholders, contribute to a public good. One of their major results is that the venture is funded with positive probability in all trembling-hand perfect Nash equilibria. The purpose of this note is to prove the existence of economies in which the venture is not funded in all trembling-hand perfect Nash equilibria.This paper was accepted by Joshua Gans, business strategy.
papers.abstract_zh: Morgan和Tumlinson（2019，Management Science 65(10)，4489–4504）研究了一个博弈：公民首先为企业创业项目提供资金或购买债券，随后债券持有人和企业经理（代表股东行事）向公共品进行捐赠。他们的主要结果之一是，在所有颤抖手完美纳什均衡中，该创业项目以正概率获得融资。本评注的目的是证明存在这样的经济体：在其中，该创业项目并非在所有颤抖手完美纳什均衡中都获得融资。本文由Joshua Gans（商业战略）接受。

papers.abstract_original: We propose a simple framework for estimating the pricing kernel in factor space by constructing the mean–variance efficient factor portfolio via an ordinary least squares formulation with least absolute shrinkage and selection operator regularization. The method accommodates high-dimensional settings in which the number of candidate factors exceeds the sample size and automatically shrinks redundant factor weights toward zero. We show theoretically that the out-of-sample Sharpe ratio of the estimated portfolio converges to the theoretical maximum at the fastest rate among existing regression-based approaches. Applying the method to 174 characteristic-based factors together with the market factor, we obtain an out-of-sample Sharpe ratio of 3.59, substantially outperforming competing strategies and delivering the smallest aggregate pricing errors. The selected factors vary over time in both composition and number, averaging about 50. We further develop a model comparison test and reject the hypothesis that eight widely used sparse factor models are sufficient to span the pricing kernel.This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance.Funding: This work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72671091, 72371079, and 72501192, and Key Program 72432005] and the Science and Technology Planning Project of Guangdong Province [Grant 2023B1515020045].Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.03608.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个简单的框架，通过在因子空间中构建均值-方差有效因子组合来估计定价核，该组合通过带有最小绝对收缩和选择算子正则化的普通最小二乘公式构造。该方法适用于候选因子数量超过样本量的高维情形，并自动将冗余因子权重收缩至零。我们从理论上证明，所估计组合的样本外夏普比率以现有基于回归的方法中最快的速度收敛于理论最大值。将该方法应用于174个基于特征的因子以及市场因子，我们得到3.59的样本外夏普比率，显著优于竞争策略，并产生最小的总体定价误差。所选因子在构成和数量上随时间变化，平均约为50个。我们进一步开发了一个模型比较检验，并拒绝了八个广泛使用的稀疏因子模型足以张成定价核的假设。本文由金融领域编辑Kay Giesecke接受。资助：本工作得到国家自然科学基金[资助号72671091、72371079和72501192，以及重点项目72432005]和广东省科技计划项目[资助号2023B1515020045]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.03608获取。

papers.abstract_original: A key assumption of dynamic asset pricing theory is that agents have perfect foresight: for all future contingencies, they correctly foresee the corresponding equilibrium prices. Is it possible for prices to still reflect perfect foresight even if agents have imperfect foresight? We answer affirmatively, provided agents exhibit a mild form of narrow framing, which we refer to as dynamic narrow framing: while accounting for future endowments, agents ignore retrading opportunities. This behavior vastly simplifies computation of optimal choices because it obviates the need to form beliefs about future prices. Obviously, choices will generally be different, and hence, suboptimal, compared with those that obtain if agents were to optimize dynamically using perfect foresight about future prices. With a controlled experiment, we verify that our behavioral assumption explains both prices and choices. Our findings allow us to reinterpret the successes (when evaluating prices only) and failures (when evaluating prices against choices) of traditional tests of asset pricing theory on historical data from the field.This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance.Funding: P. Bossaerts acknowledges funding from the Australian Research Council [Grant DP180102284], from a R@MAP Chair at the University of Melbourne, and from The Leverhulme Trust.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.03690.
papers.abstract_zh: 动态资产定价理论的一个关键假设是代理人具有完美预见：对于所有未来或有情形，他们都能正确预见相应的均衡价格。即使代理人具有不完全预见，价格是否仍可能反映完美预见？我们给出肯定回答，前提是代理人表现出一种温和形式的窄框架，我们将其称为动态窄框架：在考虑未来禀赋的同时，代理人忽略再交易机会。这种行为极大地简化了最优选择的计算，因为它免除了形成关于未来价格信念的需要。显然，与代理人在对未来价格具有完美预见的情况下进行动态优化所得到的选择相比，这些选择通常会是不同的，从而是次优的。通过一项受控实验，我们验证了我们的行为假设能够解释价格和选择。我们的发现使我们能够重新解释资产定价理论传统检验在来自实地的历史数据上的成功（仅评估价格时）与失败（将价格与选择对照评估时）。本文由金融学领域的Lukas Schmid接受。资助：P. Bossaerts感谢澳大利亚研究理事会[资助号 DP180102284]、墨尔本大学R@MAP讲席以及The Leverhulme Trust的资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.03690 获取。

papers.abstract_original: Firms are often allowed to sell new drugs based on preliminary efficacy evidence, with final approval contingent on confirmatory testing. We characterize optimal approval policies for a government agency that maximizes consumer welfare while considering the firm’s incentives. We assume that firms have private information about testing costs and the government’s payoff depends on the drug’s expected efficacy. The optimal policy may include partial conditional approval for drugs with low expected efficacy, and leniency in granting final approval below conventional standards. Our calibration suggests these tools can generate hundreds of millions of dollars in annual social value.This paper was accepted by Martin Bichler, market design, platform, and demand analytics.Funding: The authors received no external funding for this research.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.03836.
papers.abstract_zh: 企业常被允许基于初步疗效证据销售新药，最终批准取决于确证性试验。我们刻画了一个政府机构的最优批准政策，该机构在考虑企业激励的同时最大化消费者福利。我们假设企业拥有关于试验成本的私人信息，且政府的收益取决于药物的预期疗效。最优政策可能包括对预期疗效较低的药物给予部分有条件批准，以及在低于常规标准的情况下宽松地给予最终批准。我们的校准表明，这些工具每年可产生数亿美元的社会价值。本文由Martin Bichler（市场设计、平台与需求分析领域）接受。资助：作者未获得本研究的外部资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.03836获取。

papers.abstract_original: We quantify the equilibrium impact of retail traders on the U.S. equity market within a structural model of asset demand. Estimating investor-specific demand curves, we find that Robinhood traders are fundamentally distinct from all other investors, including other households: their demand is the most elastic and tilts most strongly toward volatile and microcap stocks. Each dollar invested through Robinhood generates more than five dollars in aggregate equity repricing, exceeding hedge funds, other households, and all other investor types. We decompose the cross-sectional variation in stock returns during Robinhood’s growth surge in 2020 into investor-specific components and find that shifts in Robinhood traders’ latent demand drove 11% of small-cap return volatility despite their negligible aggregate wealth share. To explain these demand shifts, we show that Robinhood traders are the only investor group whose latent demand is well explained by attention proxies: their demand exhibits a V-shaped response to past returns and rises sharply with trading volume. Our findings suggest that the growth of retail trading platforms represents a fundamental shift in the composition of equity demand with equilibrium consequences disproportionate to retail investors’ share of aggregate wealth.This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance.Funding: P. van der Beck acknowledges financial support from the Swiss National Science Foundation.Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.04854.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们在一个资产需求的结构模型中量化了散户交易者对美国股票市场的均衡影响。通过估计投资者特定的需求曲线，我们发现Robinhood交易者与其他所有投资者（包括其他家庭）存在根本性差异：他们的需求最具弹性，并且最强烈地偏向于高波动股票和微型市值股票。通过Robinhood投入的每一美元会产生超过五美元的总体股票重新定价，超过对冲基金、其他家庭以及所有其他投资者类型。我们将2020年Robinhood增长激增期间股票回报的横截面变异分解为投资者特定成分，发现尽管Robinhood交易者的总财富份额微不足道，但其潜在需求的变动驱动了小盘股回报波动的11%。为解释这些需求变动，我们表明Robinhood交易者是唯一其潜在需求能被关注度代理变量很好地解释的投资者群体：他们的需求对过去回报呈现V形反应，并随交易量急剧上升。我们的发现表明，散户交易平台的增长代表着股票需求构成的根本性转变，其均衡后果与散户投资者在总财富中的份额不成比例。本文由Lukas Schmid（金融学）接受。资助：P. van der Beck感谢瑞士国家科学基金会的财务支持。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.04854获取。

papers.abstract_original: This study provides a rigorous empirical test for motivated memory as a cause for procrastination. In a longitudinal experiment over four weeks, individuals had to complete a cumbersome task of unknown length and receive noisy signals about their assigned workload. Varying scope for motivated memory results in more optimistic beliefs among workers who receive negative signals but not among those who receive positive ones. This suppression of negative news through motivated memory causes individuals to defer more work to the future.This paper was accepted by Marie Claire Villeval, behavioral economics and decision analysis.Funding: Financial support from the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft [Grant CRC TRR 190 (project number 280092119)] is gratefully acknowledged.Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.05353.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究为有动机的记忆是拖延的一个原因提供了严格的实证检验。在一项为期四周的纵向实验中，个体必须完成一项长度未知的繁琐任务，并收到关于其被分配工作量的有噪声信号。有动机的记忆空间的变化，导致收到负面信号的工人产生更乐观的信念，但收到正面信号的工人则不然。这种通过有动机的记忆对负面消息的抑制，导致个体将更多工作推迟到未来。本文由行为经济学与决策分析领域的Marie Claire Villeval接受。资助：感谢德国研究联合会[资助号CRC TRR 190（项目编号280092119）]的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.05353获取。
